<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--snu">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-s_r">

    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सृ</span> <i>sṛ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sarati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(sisarti)</i> pft. <i>(sasāra)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sṛta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ati</i>, <i>anu</i>, <i>apa</i>, <i>abhi</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>prati</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> couler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> courir, aller rapidement; fuir en courant; glisser; souffler (vent) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'avancer rapidement, surgir; poursuivre, attaquer; s'imposer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> traverser — ca. <i>(sārayati)</i> mettre en mouvement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> écarter, enlever.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-s_rj_1">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-s_rp">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sarpati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sṛpta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ava</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>vi</i><i>)</i> ramper; se glisser vers <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. (rituel) s'avancer en planant, le corps penché, main dans la main, (not. du <a href="#entry-sadas" class="skt-link">sadas</a> au <a href="#entry-bahi_spavamaana" class="skt-link">bahiṣpavamāna</a>) — ca. <i>(sarpayati)</i> faire ramper <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ερπω; lat. <i>serpo</i>; fr. serpent.

</div>

[MS.] nom d'un peuple qui abusa des sacrifices et en fut puni.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mh_r">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mh_r_s">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संहिता</span> <i>saṃhitā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-sa_mhita" class="skt-link">saṃhita</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> conjonction, union; proximité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaapaa_tha" class="skt-link">saṃhitāpāṭha</a>] énonciation continue; texte sous forme continue où s'applique la liaison [<a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. recueil de textes (not. du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>), collection d'ouvrages, compilation.<br> <i>saṃhitāyām</i> gram. en phrase continue (où le <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> est effectué).<br> <i>saṃhitaikapade</i> <i>nityā</i> <i>nityā</i> <i>dhātūpasargayoḥ</i> <i>nityāsamāse</i> <i>vākye</i> <i>tu</i> <i>sā</i> <i>vivakṣāmapekṣate</i> L'énonciation continue est obligatoire à l'intérieur d'un mot, obligatoire entre un préverbe et une forme verbale, obligatoire à l'intérieur d'un composé, mais dans la phrase elle doit respecter l'intention d'expression du locuteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mhitaapaa_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃhitāpāṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_tha" class="skt-link">pāṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mhitaapaa_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. récitation du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> par la lecture continue appliquant le <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-padapaa_tha" class="skt-link">padapāṭha</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uzaakalya" class="skt-link">Śākalya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. forme écrite où la liaison entre mots [<a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>] est effectuée.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mhraad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संह्राद्</span> <i>saṃhrād</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-hraad" class="skt-link">hrād</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃhrādate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃhrādita</i><i>)</i> cliqueter en s'entrechoquant — ca. <i>(saṃhrādayati)</i> ppr. <i>(saṃhrādayat)</i> faire cliqueter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mhraada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संह्राद</span> <i>saṃhrāda</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mhraad" class="skt-link">saṃhrād</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mhraada" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Saṃhrāda «Cliquetis», fils de <a href="#entry-Uhira_nyakazipu" class="skt-link">Hiraṇyakaśipu</a>; ses fils sont <a href="#entry-Uaayu_smat" class="skt-link">Āyuṣmat</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzibi_1" class="skt-link">Śibi_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubaa_skala_1" class="skt-link">Bāṣkala_1</a> et <a href="#entry-Upa_ncajana" class="skt-link">Pañcajana</a> (par <a href="#entry-Uk_rti" class="skt-link">Kṛti</a>); il s'incarna en <a href="#entry-Uzalya" class="skt-link">Śalya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mhraadayat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संह्रादयत्</span> <i>saṃhrādayat</i> [ca. ppr. <a href="#entry-sa_mhraad" class="skt-link">saṃhrād</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mhraadayat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mhraadayat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mhraadayantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃhrādayantī</i> qui fait cliqueter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mlaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संलाप</span> <i>saṃlāpa</i> var. <i>saṃllāpa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mlap" class="skt-link">saṃlap</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mlaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> conversation, discussion amicale; dialogue.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mlap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संलप्</span> <i>saṃlap</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-lap" class="skt-link">lap</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃlapati)</i> converser, s'entretenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mraaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संराज्</span> <i>saṃrāj</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-raaj_1" class="skt-link">rāj_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃrājati)</i> régner universellement (sur ⟨g.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrabdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरब्ध</span> <i>saṃrabdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mrabh" class="skt-link">saṃrabh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mrabdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mrabdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mrabdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃrabdhā</i> excité, irrité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrabh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरभ्</span> <i>saṃrabh</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-rabh" class="skt-link">rabh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃrabhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃrabdha</i><i>)</i> être excité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrak_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरक्ष्</span> <i>saṃrakṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-rak_s" class="skt-link">rakṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃrakṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃrakṣita</i><i>)</i> protéger, garder, défendre; préserver, sauver de ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरक्ष</span> <i>saṃrakṣa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_s" class="skt-link">saṃrakṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃrakṣā</i> qui garde — <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> garde, gardien — <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃrakṣā</i> garde, protection, soin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrak_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरक्षित</span> <i>saṃrakṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_s" class="skt-link">saṃrakṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mrak_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃrakṣitā</i> protégé; préservé; dont on a pris soin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrambha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरम्भ</span> <i>saṃrambha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mrabh" class="skt-link">saṃrabh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mrambha" class="skt-link">m.</a> émotion, excitation intérieure; élan, enthousiasme, zèle, empressement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agitation, véhémence; colère, fureur (contre <a href="#entry-upari" class="skt-link">upari</a> ⟨loc. g.⟩) — iic. excessivement, intensément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरोध</span> <i>saṃrodha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mrudh" class="skt-link">saṃrudh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mrodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> complète obstruction; arrêt, empêchement, suppression; entrave, enfermement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrodhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरोधन</span> <i>saṃrodhana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mrudh" class="skt-link">saṃrudh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mrodhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> complète obstruction; fait d'arrêter, d'empêcher; suppression; entrave, enfermement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mruddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरुद्ध</span> <i>saṃruddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mrudh" class="skt-link">saṃrudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mruddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mruddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mruddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃruddhā</i> complètement arrêté; bloqué, entravé, empêché, retenu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cerné, assiégé (par ⟨iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> couvert, caché; refusé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mrudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संरुध्</span> <i>saṃrudh</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-rudh_2" class="skt-link">rudh_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(saṃruṇaddhi)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃrunddhe)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃruddha</i><i>)</i> arrêter complètement; bloquer, entraver; not. bloquer une route <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obstruer, empêcher, enfermer; fermer son esprit au monde extérieur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> assiéger, cerner; investir, opprimer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ms_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसृ</span> <i>saṃsṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsarati)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃsarate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃsṛta</i><i>)</i> circuler, parcourir, errer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. passer par des renaissances successives — ca. <i>(saṃsārayati)</i> phil. faire subir les transmigrations.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ms_r_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसृष्ट</span> <i>saṃsṛṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_ms_rj" class="skt-link">saṃsṛj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃsṛṣṭā</i> rassemblé, collecté; uni, combiné, mélangé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> issu de la même litière; associé, partenaire — ifc. connecté avec, appartenant à — <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> amitié; intimité.<br> <i>saṃsṛṣṭaṃ</i> <i>car</i> devenir intime avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ms_r_s_tatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃsṛṣṭatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r_s_tatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> association, mélange.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">saṃsṛṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ms_r_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसृष्टि</span> <i>saṃsṛṣṭi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_ms_rj" class="skt-link">saṃsṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> union, combinaison, association; promiscuité, acte sexuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vie commune dans une même famille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> collection, assemblage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. association de deux métaphores différentes dans une même phrase.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ms_rj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसृज्</span> <i>saṃsṛj</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-s_rj_1" class="skt-link">sṛj_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsṛjati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃsṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> unir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaadh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसाध्</span> <i>saṃsādh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sa_msidh" class="skt-link">saṃsidh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsādhayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>saṃsādhya</i><i>)</i> accomplir complètement; procurer; dominer, maîtriser; préparer (nourriture) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire respecter, appliquer (promesse); recouvrer (dette) — ps. <i>(saṃsādhyate)</i> être complètement accompli ou fourni.<br> <i>maruṃ</i> <i>saṃsādh</i> s'abstenir de boisson.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaadhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसाधन</span> <i>saṃsādhana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_msaadh" class="skt-link">saṃsādh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msaadhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> accomplissement; réalisation, exécution — <a href="#entry-sa_msaadhanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃsādhanī</i> œuvre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaadhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसाध्य</span> <i>saṃsādhya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sa_msaadh" class="skt-link">saṃsādh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_msaadhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_msaadhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_msaadhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃsādhyā</i> qui peut ou doit être accompli; qui peut ou doit être exécuté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> maîtrisable; que l'on peut soumettre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसार्</span> <i>saṃsār</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sa_ms_r" class="skt-link">saṃsṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsārayati)</i> phil. faire subir les transmigrations.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसार</span> <i>saṃsāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_msaar" class="skt-link">saṃsār</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> transition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. transmigration; courant des renaissances successives <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ici-bas, la condition humaine; le monde phénoménal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> la vie séculière; le flux de la vie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. la vie familiale; l'itinéraire personnel.<br> <i>ā</i> <i>saṃsārāt</i> depuis le début du monde.<br> <i>saṃsārakaṭuvṛkṣasya</i> <i>dve</i> <i>phale</i> <i>hy</i> <i>amṛtopame</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>subhāṣitarasāsvādaḥ</i> <i>saṅgatiḥ</i> <i>sujanaiḥ</i> <i>saha</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> De l'arbre amer de l'existence deux fruits sont semblables au nectar divin: la délectation des proverbes et la fréquentation des justes.<br> <i>citte</i> <i>calati</i> <i>saṃsāro</i> <i>niścale</i> <i>mokṣa</i> <i>eva</i> <i>tu</i> Lorsque la pensée est en mouvement on ressent le monde phénoménal, quand elle s'arrête on est libéré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaaracakra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃsāracakra</i> [<a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msaaracakra" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. le cycle des renaissances <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la roue de l'existence [<a href="#entry-bhavacakra" class="skt-link">bhavacakra</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaarasaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃsārasāra</i> [<a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msaarasaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> le sel de l'existence.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_msaara" class="skt-link">saṃsāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaarasafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃsārasaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-safga" class="skt-link">saṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msaarasafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> l'attachement au monde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msaarika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसारिक</span> <i>saṃsārika</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_msaara" class="skt-link">saṃsāra</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_msaarika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_msaarika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_msaarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃsārikā</i> mondain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msad_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसद्</span> <i>saṃsad_1</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-sad_1" class="skt-link">sad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsīdati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃsanna</i><i>)</i> s'asseoir ensemble.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msad_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसद्</span> <i>saṃsad_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_msad_1" class="skt-link">saṃsad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msad_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> assemblée, cour d'un prince.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msargaabhaava">

[<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] négation d'une prédication; non existence, l'un des sens de la négation [<a href="#entry-na" class="skt-link">na</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-anyonyaabhaava" class="skt-link">anyonyābhāva</a>; on en distingue 3 sortes: absence de naissance, destruction présente, et nécessaire ultime annihilation.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_msarga" class="skt-link">saṃsarga</a>
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msiddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संसिद्ध</span> <i>saṃsiddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_msidh" class="skt-link">saṃsidh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_msiddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_msiddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_msiddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃsiddhā</i> complètement accompli; réussi; préparé (nourriture) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prêt, fermement résolu (à ⟨dat.⟩); habile à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a atteint le but (not. de libération).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msidh">

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsidhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃsiddha</i><i>)</i> réussir parfaitement; atteindre la béatitude — ca. <i>(saṃsādhayati)</i> cf. <a href="#entry-sa_msaadh" class="skt-link">saṃsādh</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msk_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संस्कृ</span> <i>saṃskṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-k_r_1" class="skt-link">kṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(saṃskaroti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃskṛta</i><i>)</i> préparer, arranger; décorer, parer, orner; consacrer; parfaire.<br> <i>vācaṃ</i> <i>hyevaitāṃ</i> <i>saṃskurute</i> [SB.] C'est la parole qu'ainsi il parfait.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msk_rtavaac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msk_rtavyaakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msk_rtoccara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mskaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संस्कार</span> <i>saṃskāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_msk_r" class="skt-link">saṃskṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mskaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> préparation, arrangement; apprêt, décoration; impression <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apprêt d'une chose lui conférant l'aptitude à une fonction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> disposition acquise; tendances résiduelles subconscientes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. apprêt rituel; consécration; cérémonie religieuse; sacrement, initiation, rite de purification; cf. <a href="#entry-garbhaadhaana" class="skt-link">garbhādhāna</a>, <a href="#entry-pu_msavana" class="skt-link">puṃsavana</a>, <a href="#entry-siimantonnayana" class="skt-link">sīmantonnayana</a>, <a href="#entry-jaatakarman" class="skt-link">jātakarman</a>, <a href="#entry-naamakara_na" class="skt-link">nāmakaraṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-annapraazana" class="skt-link">annaprāśana</a>, <a href="#entry-kar_navedha" class="skt-link">karṇavedha</a>, <a href="#entry-cau_da" class="skt-link">cauḍa</a>-<a href="#entry-cuu_daakara_na" class="skt-link">cūḍākaraṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-vidyaarambha" class="skt-link">vidyārambha</a>, <a href="#entry-upanayana" class="skt-link">upanayana</a>, <a href="#entry-godaana" class="skt-link">godāna</a>, <a href="#entry-kezaanta" class="skt-link">keśānta</a>, <a href="#entry-snaana" class="skt-link">snāna</a>-<a href="#entry-samaavartana" class="skt-link">samāvartana</a>, <a href="#entry-vivaaha" class="skt-link">vivāha</a>, <a href="#entry-antye_s_ti" class="skt-link">antyeṣṭi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> purification du corps; toilette; bonne éducation; fait d'être correct <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prédisposition, impulsion innée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] disposition acquise; nature émotive; formation mentale rémanente, impression composant la personnalité; on atteint la libération en les sublimant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la formation mentale, un des 5 agrégats [<a href="#entry-skandha" class="skt-link">skandha</a>] de l'ego; c'est la 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ cause de souffrance [<a href="#entry-pratiityasamutpaada" class="skt-link">pratītyasamutpāda</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. formation correcte d'un mot; usage correct <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>saṅkhāra</i>.<br> <i>jananāt</i> <i>jāyate</i> <i>śūdraḥ</i> <i>saṃskārāt</i> <i>dvija</i> <i>ucyate</i> Par la naissance on naît <a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a>; par le sacrement on est appelé <a href="#entry-dvija" class="skt-link">dvija</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsmarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃsmṛta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i><i>)</i> se rappeler, se souvenir de ⟨acc. g.⟩ — ca. <i>(saṃsmārayati)</i> rappeler qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ à qqn. ⟨acc. g.⟩.

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃsravati)</i> couler alentour, suinter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confluer — ca. <i>(saṃsrāvayati)</i> faire couler ensemble; mélanger des restes de liquides.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mstha">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msthaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संस्था</span> <i>saṃsthā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃtiṣṭhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃsthita</i><i>)</i> s'arrêter, s'achever, arriver à son terme; être accompli, réussir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être ruiné, mourir — ca. <i>(saṃsthāpayati)</i> établir, achever, accomplir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msthaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संस्था</span> <i>saṃsthā_2</i> [f. <a href="#entry-sa_mstha" class="skt-link">saṃstha</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msthaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> demeure en ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> manifestation, apparition; forme; fait de paraître comme ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> règle, ordre établi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qualité, propriété; nature <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conclusion, terminaison, complétion; fin, mort; crémation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. destruction du monde; syn. <a href="#entry-pralaya" class="skt-link">pralaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. séquence liturgique lors d'un sacrifice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संस्थान</span> <i>saṃsthāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_msthaa_1" class="skt-link">saṃsthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> existence, présence; forme, aspect, apparence; nature, condition, état <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. structure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. institut, institution.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msthaanaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mstu">

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(saṃstauti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃstuta</i><i>)</i> louer avec ⟨i.⟩; célébrer ensemble ou simultanément <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> louer abondamment, célébrer en grandes pompes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mstuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संस्तुत</span> <i>saṃstuta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mstu" class="skt-link">saṃstu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mstuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mstuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mstutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃstutā</i> célébré, encensé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संस्वेद</span> <i>saṃsveda</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-sveda" class="skt-link">sveda</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> sueur, transpiration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_msvedaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃsvedaja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_msvedaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«né de la sueur»] vermine.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_msveda" class="skt-link">saṃsveda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृ</span> <i>saṃvṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(saṃvṛṇoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃvṛṇute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃvṛta</i><i>)</i> couvrir, envelopper, entourer; cacher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enfermer, obstruer; repousser.<br> <i>mā</i> <i>vama</i> <i>saṃvṛṇu</i> <i>viṣam</i> <i>idam</i> [<a href="#entry-Ugovardhana_1" class="skt-link">Govardhana_1</a>] Ne vomis pas ce poison, enferme le en toi (<a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> ayant avalé le poison <a href="#entry-halaahala" class="skt-link">halāhala</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृद्ध</span> <i>saṃvṛddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rdh" class="skt-link">saṃvṛdh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvṛddhā</i> accru, augmenté, grandi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bien développé; prospère.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rdh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृध्</span> <i>saṃvṛdh</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-v_rdh_1" class="skt-link">vṛdh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃvardhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃvṛddha</i><i>)</i> croître, grandir, prendre des forces — ca. <i>(saṃvardhayati)</i> cf. <a href="#entry-sa_mvardh" class="skt-link">saṃvardh</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृत्</span> <i>saṃvṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-v_rt_1" class="skt-link">vṛt_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃvartate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃvṛtta</i><i>)</i> commencer, se produire, devenir; se réaliser — ca. <i>(saṃvartayati)</i> rouler, lancer; accomplir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृत</span> <i>saṃvṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_r" class="skt-link">saṃvṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvṛtā</i> couvert, fermé; enveloppé de ⟨loc.⟩; caché, gardé, secret <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> réprimé, restreint, retiré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृति</span> <i>saṃvṛti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_r" class="skt-link">saṃvṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fermeture, obstruction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dissimulation, fait de garder secret; hypocrisie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. vérité conventionnelle ou dissimulée (opp. <a href="#entry-paramaartha" class="skt-link">paramārtha</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rtisatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃvṛtisatya</i> [<a href="#entry-satya" class="skt-link">satya</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rtisatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. vérité conventionnelle ou dissimulée (opp. <a href="#entry-paramaarthasatya" class="skt-link">paramārthasatya</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [«réel d'enveloppement»] plan de la réalité ordinaire.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rti" class="skt-link">saṃvṛti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृत्त</span> <i>saṃvṛtta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rt" class="skt-link">saṃvṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rtta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvṛttā</i> qui a lieu, qui se produit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arrivé, advenu; devenu; accompli, réalisé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mv_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवृत्ति</span> <i>saṃvṛtti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rt" class="skt-link">saṃvṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> occupation usuelle, routine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accomplissement, réalisation; existence, état <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cf. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rti" class="skt-link">saṃvṛti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवाद</span> <i>saṃvāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mvad" class="skt-link">saṃvad</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> entretien, conversation, dialogue; discussion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accord, entente; rencontre, colloque <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> affaire judiciaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agrément, conformité; similarité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> informations, nouvelles — <a href="#entry-sa_mvaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvādā</i> ifc. conversation avec.<br> <i>saṃvādaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> converser, s'entretenir avec ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवादन</span> <i>saṃvādana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mvad" class="skt-link">saṃvad</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvaadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> accord, entente.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवाह</span> <i>saṃvāha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mvah" class="skt-link">saṃvah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mvaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvaaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvaahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvāhā</i> qui transporte — <a href="#entry-sa_mvaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> transport <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> massage, caresse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaahaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवाहक</span> <i>saṃvāhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mvah" class="skt-link">saṃvah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mvaahaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvaahaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvaahikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvāhikā</i> qui masse — <a href="#entry-sa_mvaahaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du parieur Saṃvāhaka dans la pièce <a href="#entry-Um_rcchaka_tikaa" class="skt-link">Mṛcchakaṭikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaahana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवाहन</span> <i>saṃvāhana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mvah" class="skt-link">saṃvah</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvaahana" class="skt-link">n.</a> transport; conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> massage, shampoing.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवार</span> <i>saṃvāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_r" class="skt-link">saṃvṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> fermeture, couverture, contraction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. contraction des organes de la voix, compression de la gorge; opp. <a href="#entry-vivaara" class="skt-link">vivāra</a> — <a href="#entry-sa_mvaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvārā</i> fermeture de, contraction de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवास</span> <i>saṃvāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mvas" class="skt-link">saṃvas</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> cohabitation; union avec <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de s'installer; habitation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> association, compagnie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवद्</span> <i>saṃvad</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃvadati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samudita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>saṃvaditavya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> converser, s'entretenir, causer (avec qqn. ⟨i.⟩, de qqc. ⟨loc.⟩); parler à, s'adresser à ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être d'accord, s'entendre — ca. <i>(saṃvādayati)</i> faire parler (avec qqn. ⟨i.⟩, de qqc. ⟨loc.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inviter à parler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jouer d'un instrument de musique.<br> <i>saṃvādya</i> ind. ayant déclaré sincèrement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवदन</span> <i>saṃvadana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mvad" class="skt-link">saṃvad</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> conversation; examen; message — <a href="#entry-sa_mvadanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvadanā</i> fait de soumettre à la magie; charme, amulette.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवह्</span> <i>saṃvah</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃvahati)</i> porter avec soi; apporter; transporter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> charger (chariot, voiture) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prendre femme, se marier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> masser, caresser — ca. <i>(saṃvāhayati)</i> faire apporter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> guider, conduire (chariot, voiture).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवह</span> <i>saṃvaha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mvah" class="skt-link">saṃvah</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Saṃvaha «qui transporte», vent de l'une des 7 voies du ciel [<a href="#entry-maarga" class="skt-link">mārga</a>], au-dessus d'<a href="#entry-Uudvaha" class="skt-link">Udvaha</a>; il propulse la Lune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'une des 7 langues d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवर</span> <i>saṃvara</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_r" class="skt-link">saṃvṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvarā</i> qui restreint, qui arrête, qui repousse — <a href="#entry-sa_mvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> barrage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cf. <a href="#entry-zambara" class="skt-link">śambara</a> — <a href="#entry-sa_mvara" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. restriction; abstention (d'une observance rituelle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवरण</span> <i>saṃvaraṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_r" class="skt-link">saṃvṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mvara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvaraṇā</i> qui couvre, qui contient, qui cache — <a href="#entry-sa_mvara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Saṃvaraṇa «Sanctuaire», roi de la lignée lunaire, 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ descendant de <a href="#entry-Ubharata" class="skt-link">Bharata</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-U_rk_sa" class="skt-link">Ṛkṣa</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] attaqué par un roi <a href="#entry-Upaa_ncaala" class="skt-link">Pāñcāla</a>, il fit appel à <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a> pour regagner son royaume; il était un dévot de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>, dont il épousa la fille <a href="#entry-Utapatii" class="skt-link">Tapatī</a>; le roi <a href="#entry-Ukuru" class="skt-link">Kuru</a> est leur fils — <a href="#entry-sa_mvara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> mise au secret, acte caché; sanctuaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. enclos du sacrifice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. choix d'un mari.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvara_nasraj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃvaraṇasraj</i> [<a href="#entry-sraj" class="skt-link">sraj</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvara_nasraj" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. couronne donnée par une jeune fille à l'époux de son choix.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_mvara_na" class="skt-link">saṃvaraṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvardh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवर्ध्</span> <i>saṃvardh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rdh" class="skt-link">saṃvṛdh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃvardhayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃvardhita</i><i>)</i> agrandir, augmenter, fortifier; élever, nourrir, faire prospérer; gratifier de ⟨i.⟩, exhaucer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvardhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवर्धन</span> <i>saṃvardhana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rdh" class="skt-link">saṃvṛdh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mvardhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvardhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvardhanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvardhanā</i> qui augmente, qui fait prospérer; fortifiant — <a href="#entry-sa_mvardhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> croissance, prospérité; soin, entretien, nourrice; augmentation, accroissement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvardhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवर्धित</span> <i>saṃvardhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mvardh" class="skt-link">saṃvardh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mvardhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvardhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvardhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvardhitā</i> nourri, élevé, soigné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvart">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवर्त्</span> <i>saṃvart</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rt" class="skt-link">saṃvṛt</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃvartayati)</i> rouler, lancer; accomplir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvarta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवर्त</span> <i>saṃvarta</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rt" class="skt-link">saṃvṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mvarta" class="skt-link">m.</a> rencontre, combat; destruction, fin du monde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [«ce qui est roulé»] boule; motte; foule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Saṃvarta «Apocalypse», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uzraddhaa" class="skt-link">Śraddhā</a>, frère de <a href="#entry-Ub_rhaspati" class="skt-link">Bṛhaspati</a>; il officia au sacrifice du roi <a href="#entry-Umarutta" class="skt-link">Marutta</a>, profané par <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvartaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवर्तक</span> <i>saṃvartaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mv_rt" class="skt-link">saṃvṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mvartaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvartaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mvartikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃvartikā</i> qui détruit tout (à l'apocalyse) — <a href="#entry-sa_mvartaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> feu destructeur; nuées de fin du monde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>saṃvartakās</i> les flammes de l'enfer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃvasati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃvasita</i><i>)</i> vivre ou séjourner ensemble, cohabiter avec; frayer avec ⟨i. acc.⟩; s'assembler.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संवत्</span> <i>saṃvat</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] adv. en l'an; not. en l'an de l'ère <a href="#entry-Uvikrama" class="skt-link">Vikrama</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. désigne la date selon une ère dynastique, not. <a href="#entry-Umaalava" class="skt-link">Mālava</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uvikrama" class="skt-link">Vikrama</a> (57 ant.), <a href="#entry-Uzaka" class="skt-link">Śaka</a> (78), <a href="#entry-Ugupta" class="skt-link">Gupta</a> (319-320), <a href="#entry-Uhar_sa" class="skt-link">Harṣa</a> (606), <a href="#entry-Uvikramacaalukya" class="skt-link">Vikramacālukya</a> (1075) — ifc. l'année du règne de.
  </div>
</div>

class="skt-link">Pramādī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uaananda_1" class="skt-link">Ānanda_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraak_sasa" class="skt-link">Rākṣasa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uanala" class="skt-link">Anala</a>, <a href="#entry-Upifgala_1" class="skt-link">Piṅgala_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukaalayukta" class="skt-link">Kālayukta</a>, <a href="#entry-Usiddhaarthii" class="skt-link">Siddhārthī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraudra" class="skt-link">Raudra</a>, <a href="#entry-Udurmati" class="skt-link">Durmati</a>, <a href="#entry-Udundubhi_1" class="skt-link">Dundubhi_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Urudhirodgaarii" class="skt-link">Rudhirodgārī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraktaak_sa" class="skt-link">Raktākṣa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukrodhana" class="skt-link">Krodhana</a> et <a href="#entry-Uk_saya" class="skt-link">Kṣaya</a>; les 20 premiers sont dédiés à <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, les 20 suivants à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, les 20 derniers à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; ces 60 ans correspondent à la conjonction de Jupiter (de période 12 ans) et de Saturne (de période 30 ans); ils sont personnifiés comme les 60 fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a>.<br> <i>saṃvatsareṇa</i> adv. dans l'année.
  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयमिन्</span> <i>saṃyamin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_myam" class="skt-link">saṃyam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myamin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myamin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myaminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃyaminī</i> qui a des liens; qui se discipline <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a dompté ses sens; maître de soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयत्</span> <i>saṃyat</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-yat_2" class="skt-link">yat_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myat" class="skt-link">f.</a> cohérent; contigu; continu, ininterrompu — <a href="#entry-sa_myat" class="skt-link">f.</a> convention, agrément <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conflit, bataille, guerre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयत</span> <i>saṃyata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_myam" class="skt-link">saṃyam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃyatā</i> restreint, contraint, réprimé, subjugué; retenu, entravé, enchaîné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myatendriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃyatendriya</i> [<a href="#entry-indriya" class="skt-link">indriya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myatendriya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myatendriya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myatendriya" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃyatendriya</i> qui contrôle ses sens.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_myata" class="skt-link">saṃyata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयोग</span> <i>saṃyoga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_1" class="skt-link">saṃyuj_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_myoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> union, combinaison, association; opp. <a href="#entry-vibhaaga" class="skt-link">vibhāga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la propriété [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] d'union <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] conjonction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. groupe de consonnes contiguës; ligature.<br> <i>dravyayoreva</i> <i>saṃyogaḥ</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] La relation de contact n'existe qu'entre deux substances.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myogavibhaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃyogavibhāga</i> [<a href="#entry-vibhaaga" class="skt-link">vibhāga</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_myogavibhaaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> du. <i>saṃyogavibhāgau</i> (<a href="#entry-dvandva" class="skt-link">dvandva</a> d'opposés) l'union et la séparation.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_myoga" class="skt-link">saṃyoga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myogin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयोगिन्</span> <i>saṃyogin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_1" class="skt-link">saṃyuj_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myogin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myogin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myoginii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃyoginī</i> en contact avec, connecté à ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> uni (avec un objet aimé); opp. <a href="#entry-virahin" class="skt-link">virahin</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. consonne dans un groupe de consonnes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयु</span> <i>saṃyu</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-yu_1" class="skt-link">yu_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(saṃyauti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃyuta</i><i>)</i> véd. joindre à soi, prendre en soi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se joindre à, faire union avec ⟨i.⟩; s'unir à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myuga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयुग</span> <i>saṃyuga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_1" class="skt-link">saṃyuj_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_myuga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myuga" class="skt-link">n.</a> union, conjonction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confrontation; combat, bataille, guerre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myuj_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयुज्</span> <i>saṃyuj_1</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-yuj_1" class="skt-link">yuj_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(saṃyunakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃyukta</i><i>)</i> unir, joindre, combiner, lier — ca. <i>(saṃyojayati)</i> harnacher, équiper; dompter (ses sens) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> munir de ⟨i.⟩; confier ⟨acc.⟩ à ⟨g.⟩; accomplir — pr. md. <i>(saṃyuṅkte)</i> méditer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myuj_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयुज्</span> <i>saṃyuj_2</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_1" class="skt-link">saṃyuj_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> conjoint; unifié; connecté, relié — <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> relation — <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> union, connection.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयुक्त</span> <i>saṃyukta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_myuj_1" class="skt-link">saṃyuj_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃyuktā</i> uni, lié; réuni, joint, combiné; marié à ⟨i.⟩; placé, assigné à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accompagné de, muni de, qui possède ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. (voyelle) composée (‘e’, ‘ai’, ‘o’, ‘au’) — ifc. relatif à, concernant.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_myuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संयुत</span> <i>saṃyuta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_myu" class="skt-link">saṃyu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_myuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_myutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃyutā</i> lié ensemble, joint <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>saṃyutta</i> f. id. — ifc. en conjonction avec.<br> <i>saṃyutta</i> <i>hastau</i> mains jointes.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] point contestable.<br> <i>na</i> <i>saṃśayaḥ</i> sans aucun doute.<br> <i>atra</i> <i>na</i> <i>saṃśayaḥ</i> ça ne fait aucun doute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzayika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(saṃśliṣyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃśliṣṭa</i><i>)</i> étreindre, embrasser, se presser contre — ca. <i>(saṃśleṣayati)</i> unir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzodhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संशोधन</span> <i>saṃśodhana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mzudh" class="skt-link">saṃśudh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mzodhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> purification; acquittement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> amendement, correction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzraya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संश्रय</span> <i>saṃśraya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_mzri" class="skt-link">saṃśri</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mzraya" class="skt-link">m.</a> refuge, séjour, résidence; abri, appui, protection — ifc. associé à, se rapportant à, dévoué à.<br> <i>saṃśrayāt</i> adv. à l'aide de, au moyen de; en conséquence de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संश्रि</span> <i>saṃśri</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-zri" class="skt-link">śri</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃśrayati)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃśrayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃśrita</i><i>)</i> rejoindre, se réfugier auprès de, demander protection à ⟨acc.⟩; dépendre de, compter sur ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzrita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संश्रित</span> <i>saṃśrita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mzri" class="skt-link">saṃśri</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-sa_mzrita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mzrita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mzritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃśritā</i> associé, attaché, en relation avec; adonné à; qui choisit, qui sert.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzuddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_mzudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संशुध्</span> <i>saṃśudh</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-zudh" class="skt-link">śudh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(saṃśudhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃśuddha</i><i>)</i> se purifier parfaitement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'acquitter de — ca. <i>(saṃśodhayati)</i> purifier complètement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'acquitter de; sécuriser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_taa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सटा</span> <i>saṭā</i> <a href="#entry-sa_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> tresse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स</span> <i>sa_1</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a>] pf. avec, ayant, muni de, y compris.<br> <i>sakṣatram</i> adv. comme il convient à un <a href="#entry-k_satriya" class="skt-link">kṣatriya</a>.<br> <i>sacakram</i> adv. en même temps que la roue.<br> <i>sataddhitam</i> <i>adhīte</i> adv. il étudie jusqu'au (chapitre du) suffixe secondaire.<br> <i>salakṣmi</i> adv. se comportant comme <a href="#entry-Ulak_smii" class="skt-link">Lakṣmī</a>.<br> <i>savīṇam</i> adv. comme une <a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स</span> <i>sa_2</i> [m. <a href="#entry-tad" class="skt-link">tad</a>] pn. 3ème pers. <a href="#entry-sa_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> il; ce, cet; ce ... là, cet ... là, celui-là <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [corrél. de <a href="#entry-ya_1" class="skt-link">ya_1</a>] (celui qui) ... il.<br> <i>sa</i> <i>...</i> <i>ābhara</i> toi-même ... apporte (accord démonstratif <i>sa</i> avec 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ pers.).
  </div>
</div>
