  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saa_myogika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सांयोगिक</span> <i>sāṃyogika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sa_myoga" class="skt-link">saṃyoga</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saa_myogika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_myogika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_myogikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāṃyogikā</i> relié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (sens) figuré ou métaphorique; opp. <a href="#entry-auddezika" class="skt-link">auddeśika</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सा</span> <i>sā_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(syati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ava</i><i>)</i> détruire, tuer; terminer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सा</span> <i>sā_2</i> [f. <a href="#entry-tad" class="skt-link">tad</a>] pn. 3ème pers. <a href="#entry-saa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> elle, cette, celle-là.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saabhinaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साभिनय</span> <i>sābhinaya</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-abhinaya" class="skt-link">abhinaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saabhinaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saabhinaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saabhinayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sābhinayā</i> faisant des gestes.<br> <i>sābhinayam</i> par gestes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saacin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साचिन्</span> <i>sācin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sac" class="skt-link">sac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saacin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saacin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saacinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sācinī</i> qui atteint; cf. <a href="#entry-savya" class="skt-link">savya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saacivya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साचिव्य</span> <i>sācivya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-saciva" class="skt-link">saciva</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saacivya" class="skt-link">n.</a> compagnonnage, amitié, assistance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> charge de ministre ou de conseiller d'un prince.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साद्</span> <i>sād</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sad_1" class="skt-link">sad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(sādayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sādita</i><i>)</i> asseoir, faire asseoir; placer dans ou sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ruiner, abattre, détruire, faire périr, réduire à néant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saad_rzya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सादृश्य</span> <i>sādṛśya</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-d_rzya" class="skt-link">dṛśya</a>] <a href="#entry-saad_rzya" class="skt-link">n.</a> ressemblance, similarité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le fait d'être à l'image de Dieu; un des buts du <a href="#entry-karmayoga" class="skt-link">karmayoga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साद</span> <i>sāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-saad" class="skt-link">sād</a>] <a href="#entry-saada" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. équitation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> affaissement, enlisement; fatigue, affaiblissement; découragement, désespoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साध्</span> <i>sādh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(sādhayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sādhita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>sādhya</i><i>)</i> arranger, régler; accomplir, effectuer, réaliser; partir (faire ce qu'on a à faire) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pratiquer, s'exercer à, s'efforcer d'atteindre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aller droit au but; obtenir, gagner, acquérir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gagner à sa cause, conjurer, s'emparer de; subjuguer; l'emporter sur ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> démontrer, prouver — ps. <i>(sādhyate)</i> être soumis, être dominé — dés. <i>(siṣādhayiṣati)</i> vouloir l'emporter.<br> <i>mantraṃ</i> <i>sādh</i> réciter un <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>.<br> <i>maruṃ</i> <i>sādh</i> s'abstenir de boisson.<br> <i>vākyaṃ</i> <i>sādh</i> tenir sa parole, accomplir une promesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साधार</span> <i>sādhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aadhaara" class="skt-link">ādhāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhārā</i> qui a un support.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhaara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhāraṇā</i> ayant la même base que, analogue à ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commun à ⟨g. dat. i. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-saadhaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> propriété commune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. terroir intermédiaire entre les terres sèches [<a href="#entry-jaafgala" class="skt-link">jāṅgala</a>] et les terres paludéennes [<a href="#entry-anuupa" class="skt-link">anūpa</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Sādhāraṇa «Frontière», personnifiant l'an 44 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].<br> <i>sādhāraṇīkṛ</i> mettre en commun; partager.<br> <i>sādhāraṇīkaraṇa</i> mise en commun; généralisation.<br> <i>sādhāraṇībhū</i> devenir égal; s'identifier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhaara_nadharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhāraṇadharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhaara_nadharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. le devoir moral universel, supérieur à celui de sa propre condition [<a href="#entry-svadharma" class="skt-link">svadharma</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-saadhaara_na" class="skt-link">sādhāraṇa</a> <br> <a href="#entry-saadhaara" class="skt-link">sādhāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साधक</span> <i>sādhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhikā</i> qui opère, qui effectue, qui influence, qui maîtrise <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> efficace, utile; rationnel — <a href="#entry-saadhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. pratiquant du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. pratiquant spirituel établi dans une voie de salut <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> magicien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhakatama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhakatama</i> a. <a href="#entry-saadhakatama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhakatama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhakatamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhakatamā</i> super. le plus efficace <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. moyen qui caractérise la cause principale de l'action, associé au rôle sémantique [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] d'instrument [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>]; il est marqué par l'instrumental [<a href="#entry-t_rtiiya" class="skt-link">tṛtīya</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] facteur causal d'efficacité maximale engendrant une connaissance correcte [<a href="#entry-pramaa_2" class="skt-link">pramā_2</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-saadhaka" class="skt-link">sādhaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साधन</span> <i>sādhana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhanā</i> efficace — ifc. qui effectue, qui produit, qui procure ⟨iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-saadhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> exécution, réalisation, accomplissement; acquisition, obtention <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> moyen, instrument, facteur; preuve, résultat <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. pratique spirituelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. facteur de réalisation d'un suffixe <a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a>; il exprime un agent [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] de l'action ou l'action elle même [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (adj.) qui réalise le facteur ⟨iic.⟩ (se dit d'un suffixe <a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a> ou d'un <a href="#entry-k_rdanta" class="skt-link">kṛdanta</a>) — <a href="#entry-saadhanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhanā</i> phil. maîtrise du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>; en gén. pratique d'une discipline spirituelle.<br> <i>sādhanīkṛ</i> employer comme moyen pour ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>sādhanībhū</i> devenir un moyen ou un instrument.<br> <i>karmasādhana</i> gram. qui exprime l'objet de l'action (exprimée par le verbe).<br> <i>bhāvasādhana</i> gram. qui exprime l'action complétée (comme le <a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a> <i>ap</i>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhanacatu_s_taya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhanacatuṣṭaya</i> [<a href="#entry-catu_s_taya" class="skt-link">catuṣṭaya</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhanacatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] les quatre qualifications de l'aspirant à la libération: savoir distinguer dans le réel entre le permanent et l'éphémère [<a href="#entry-nityaanityavastuviveka" class="skt-link">nityānityavastuviveka</a>], être indifférent au profit des fruits de son action [<a href="#entry-arthaphalabhogaviraaga" class="skt-link">arthaphalabhogavirāga</a>] ici et dans l'au-delà [<a href="#entry-ihaamutra" class="skt-link">ihāmutra</a>], avoir accompli les 6 perfections [<a href="#entry-_sa_tkasampatti" class="skt-link">ṣaṭkasampatti</a>], et désirer la libération [<a href="#entry-mumuk_sutva" class="skt-link">mumukṣutva</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhanamaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhanamālā</i> [<a href="#entry-maalaa" class="skt-link">mālā</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhanamaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Sādhanamālā «Guirlande de réalisation spirituelle», ouvrage [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] bd. donnant 300 instructions pour la visualisation des divinités et les formules [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] qui leur sont appropriées, composé entre le 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ et le 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle.<br> <a href="#entry-saadhana" class="skt-link">sādhana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhanapaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhanapāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhanapaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] np. du Sādhanapāda, section du <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> traitant de la Voie de la réalisation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhanapa_ncaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhanapañcaka</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaka" class="skt-link">pañcaka</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhanapa_ncaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sādhanapañcaka «Cinq versets sur la discipline spirituelle», où <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṃkara_1</a> donne 40 conseils à ses disciples pour atteindre l'Éveil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साधनीय</span> <i>sādhanīya</i> [<a href="#entry-saadhana" class="skt-link">sādhana</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhanīyā</i> qui doit être accompli ou exécuté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. qui doit être formé (mot) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. qui être être acquis (savoir); à démontrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadharmya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साधर्म्य</span> <i>sādharmya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sadharma" class="skt-link">sadharma</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saadharmya" class="skt-link">n.</a> égalité d'attributions; identité de nature <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la participation aux œuvres de Dieu, un des devoirs du <a href="#entry-karmayoga" class="skt-link">karmayoga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साधित</span> <i>sādhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-saadh" class="skt-link">sādh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhitā</i> accompli; effectué; provoqué; complété <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> maîtrisé, soumis; puni, contraint à payer une amende <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> appointé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. démontré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ordonné (punition, amende).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साधु</span> <i>sādhu</i> [<a href="#entry-saadh" class="skt-link">sādh</a><a href="#entry--u" class="skt-link">-u</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhvii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhvī</i> bon, bienveillant; honnête, vertueux, excellent; capable, efficace; accompli — <a href="#entry-saadhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme de bien, saint homme, saint; mod. ascète errant — <a href="#entry-saadhu" class="skt-link">n.</a> le bien, l'honnêteté.<br> <i>sādhum</i> adv. bien.<br> <i>sādhu</i> <i>man</i> approuver.<br> <i>sādhu</i> <i>kṛ</i> bien faire.<br> <i>sādhu</i> <i>sādhu</i> très bien!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhumata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhumata</i> [<a href="#entry-mata" class="skt-link">mata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhumata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhumata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhumataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhumatā</i> porté en haute estime.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhutaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhutā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> correction, validité; bonté; excellence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhutva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhutva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhutva" class="skt-link">n.</a> correction, validité; excellence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhvaacaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhvācāra</i> [<a href="#entry-aacaara" class="skt-link">ācāra</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhvaacaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> bonne conduite; comportement vertueux — a. <a href="#entry-saadhvaacaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhvaacaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhvaacaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhvācārā</i> qui se conduit bien.<br> <a href="#entry-saadhu" class="skt-link">sādhu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साध्य</span> <i>sādhya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhyā</i> à soumettre, que l'on peut ou doit gagner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à accomplir, à atteindre, à réaliser; qui doit se réaliser; pouvant être exécuté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à déduire, à démontrer — <a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> but, objectif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] partie d'une formule [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] exprimant le but souhaité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] prédicat logique à établir; thèse; cf. <a href="#entry-pratij_naa_2" class="skt-link">pratijñā_2</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sādhyās</i> véd. les perfectibles, classe d'êtres divins ayant précédé les dieux; on leur offre ce qui est surabondant [<a href="#entry-atirikta" class="skt-link">atirikta</a>] dans le sacrifice; les <i>sādhyās</i> sont associés au zénith [<a href="#entry-upari_s_taat" class="skt-link">upariṣṭāt</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-aaptyaas" class="skt-link">āptyās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhyanaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhyanāma</i> [<a href="#entry-naaman" class="skt-link">nāman</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhyanaama" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. «nom» d'un mantra, exprimant son but.<br> <a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साध्यता</span> <i>sādhyatā</i> [<a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a><a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> faisabilité, réalisabilité, atteignabilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. caractère non accompli d'une action; opp. <a href="#entry-siddhataa" class="skt-link">siddhatā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhyataavacchedaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādhyatāvacchedaka</i> [<a href="#entry-avacchedaka" class="skt-link">avacchedaka</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhyataavacchedaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] caractéristique du fait à établir.<br> <a href="#entry-saadhyataa" class="skt-link">sādhyatā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhyatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साध्यत्व</span> <i>sādhyatva</i> [<a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a><a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-saadhyatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> curabilité; fait d'être améliorable ou réussi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadhyavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साध्यवत्</span> <i>sādhyavat</i> [<a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a><a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadhyavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhyavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadhyavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādhyavatī</i> qui comprend le but à atteindre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qui vérifie le prédicat — <a href="#entry-saadhyavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. partie d'un procès à qui il incombe de faire la preuve.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sādin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sad_1" class="skt-link">sad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-saadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> cavalier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> destructeur.<br> <a href="#entry-saada" class="skt-link">sāda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सादित</span> <i>sādita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-saad" class="skt-link">sād</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saaditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāditā</i> assis, installé; en selle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fatigué, déprimé, découragé; détruit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साद्य</span> <i>sādya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sad_1" class="skt-link">sad_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sādyā</i> sellé, harnaché — <a href="#entry-saadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> cheval à monter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafghika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सांघिक</span> <i>sāṃghika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-safgha" class="skt-link">saṃgha</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saa_mghika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_mghika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_mghikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāṃghikī</i> bd. qui concerne la communauté des moines.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafgrahasuutrika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सांग्रहसूत्रिक</span> <i>sāṃgrahasūtrika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-safgrahasuutra" class="skt-link">saṃgrahasūtra</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saa_mgrahasuutrika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_mgrahasuutrika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_mgrahasuutrikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāṃgrahasūtrikā</i> soc. qui étudie les aphorismes du <a href="#entry-Usafgrahasuutra" class="skt-link">Saṃgrahasūtra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafkhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सांख्य</span> <i>sāṃkhya</i> var. <i>sāṅkhya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-safkhya" class="skt-link">saṃkhya</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mkhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> «le mesurable», doctrine philosophique fondée sur la discrimination, et attribuée à <a href="#entry-Ukapila" class="skt-link">Kapila</a>; c'est l'un des 6 points de vue [<a href="#entry-_sa_ddarzana" class="skt-link">ṣaḍdarśana</a>] de l'Hindouisme orthodoxe; il traite des structures universelles, ou macrocosme; il postule un principe suprême [<a href="#entry-aastika" class="skt-link">āstika</a>] bien qu'athée [<a href="#entry-niriizvara" class="skt-link">nirīśvara</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a>, <a href="#entry-puru_sa" class="skt-link">puruṣa</a>, <a href="#entry-prak_rti" class="skt-link">prakṛti</a>, <a href="#entry-Uiizvarak_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Īśvarakṛṣṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafkhyakaarikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāṃkhyakārikā</i> [<a href="#entry-kaarikaa" class="skt-link">kārikā</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mkhyakaarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. lit. np. des Sāṃkhyakārikās ou Sāṃkhyasaptati, collection de 72 strophes dûe à <a href="#entry-Uiizvarak_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Īśvarakṛṣṇa</a>, première élaboration systématique de la doctrine du <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>; elle enseigne comment l'homme peut se libérer en supprimant les trois sortes de souffrance [<a href="#entry-taapatraya" class="skt-link">tāpatraya</a>]: psychique [<a href="#entry-aadhyaatmika" class="skt-link">ādhyātmika</a>], matérielle [<a href="#entry-aadhibhautika" class="skt-link">ādhibhautika</a>], et surnaturelle [<a href="#entry-aadhidaivika" class="skt-link">ādhidaivika</a>]; <a href="#entry-Ugau_dapaada" class="skt-link">Gauḍapāda</a> en fit un commentaire [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>], <a href="#entry-Umaa_thara" class="skt-link">Māṭhara</a> aussi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafkhyapravacanabhaa_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāṃkhyapravacanabhāṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-pravacana" class="skt-link">pravacana</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mkhyapravacanabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sāṃkhyapravacanabhāṣya, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Usaafkhyasuutra" class="skt-link">Sāṃkhyasūtra</a> par <a href="#entry-Uvij_naanabhik_su" class="skt-link">Vijñānabhikṣu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafkhyasaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāṃkhyasāra</i> [<a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mkhyasaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Sāṃkhyasāra, œuvre phil. de <a href="#entry-Uvij_naanabhik_su" class="skt-link">Vijñānabhikṣu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafkhyasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāṃkhyasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mkhyasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. lit. np. du Sāṃkhyasūtra ou Sāṃkhyapravacanasūtra, œuvre fondatrice du <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>, attribuée à <a href="#entry-Ukapila" class="skt-link">Kapila</a>; le texte actuel est tardif (14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).<br> <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saafkhyatattvakaumudii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāṃkhyatattvakaumudī</i> [<a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a>-<a href="#entry-kaumudii" class="skt-link">kaumudī</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mkhyatattvakaumudii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Sāṃkhyatattvakaumudī, exposition de la doctrine <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a> due à <a href="#entry-Uvaacaspati_1" class="skt-link">Vācaspati_1</a> <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सागर</span> <i>sāgara</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sagara" class="skt-link">sagara</a>] <a href="#entry-saagara" class="skt-link">m.</a> mer, océan <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) immensité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sāgara l'Océan; il fut creusé par les 60000 fils du roi <a href="#entry-Usagara" class="skt-link">Sagara</a> pour retrouver le cheval de son sacrifice égaré aux enfers <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sāgarās</i> myth. les 60000 fils de <a href="#entry-Usagara" class="skt-link">Sagara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saagaraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāgaraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saagaraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saagaraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saagarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāgarikā</i> qui habite le bord de mer — <a href="#entry-saagarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāgarikā</i> lit. [<a href="#entry-Uratnaavalii_1" class="skt-link">Ratnāvalī_1</a>] np. de Sāgarikā «Océane», nom d'emprunt de <a href="#entry-Uratnaavalii_2" class="skt-link">Ratnāvalī_2</a>, fille du roi de Ceylan, naufragée, sauvée et introduite à la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Uudayana" class="skt-link">Udayana</a> comme dame de compagnie de la reine <a href="#entry-Uvaasavadattaa_2" class="skt-link">Vāsavadattā_2</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-saagara" class="skt-link">sāgara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saagnika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साग्निक</span> <i>sāgnika</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-agni" class="skt-link">agni</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saagnika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saagnika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saagnikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāgnikā</i> accompagné d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साह्</span> <i>sāh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sah_1" class="skt-link">sah_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(sāhayati)</i> supporter, endurer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahaayaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहायक</span> <i>sāhāyaka</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sahaaya" class="skt-link">sahāya</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-saahaayaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> aide, secours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahaayya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहाय्य</span> <i>sāhāyya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sahaaya" class="skt-link">sahāya</a>] <a href="#entry-saahaayya" class="skt-link">n.</a> aide, secours.<br> <i>sāhāyyam</i> <i>kṛ</i> donner assistance.<br> <i>sāhāyyam</i> <i>sthā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahaayyaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāhāyyārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-saahaayyaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> occupation à porter secours.<br> <a href="#entry-saahaayya" class="skt-link">sāhāyya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahacarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहचर्य</span> <i>sāhacarya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sahacara" class="skt-link">sahacara</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saahacarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> compagnie, société, association (avec ⟨i. iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. co-location.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहस</span> <i>sāhasa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sahas" class="skt-link">sahas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saahasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāhasā</i> hâtif, irréfléchi; audacieux, imprudent — <a href="#entry-saahasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> audace, témérité; précipitation; violence, agression, cruauté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahasika">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहसिक</span> <i>sāhasika</i> [<a href="#entry-saahasa" class="skt-link">sāhasa</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saahasika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāhasikī</i> audacieux, téméraire; impétueux, fougueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> brutal, féroce, cruel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahasra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहस्र</span> <i>sāhasra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sahasra" class="skt-link">sahasra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saahasra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāhasrā</i> <a href="#entry-saahasrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāhasrī</i> composé de mille parts; très nombreux — <a href="#entry-saahasra" class="skt-link">n.</a> millier.<br> <i>sāhasreṇa</i> adv. par milliers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahasraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहस्रक</span> <i>sāhasraka</i> [<a href="#entry-saahasra" class="skt-link">sāhasra</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saahasraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saahasrikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāhasrikā</i> constitué d'un millier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहय</span> <i>sāhaya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-saah" class="skt-link">sāh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saahaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saahaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saahayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāhayā</i> qui supporte, qui endure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahitya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साहित्य</span> <i>sāhitya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sahita" class="skt-link">sahita</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saahitya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'être ensemble, union, unité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rhétorique; art poétique; littérature.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahityadarpa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāhityadarpaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-darpa_na" class="skt-link">darpaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-saahityadarpa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Sāhityadarpaṇa, ouvrage de poétique dû à <a href="#entry-Uvizvanaatha_1" class="skt-link">Viśvanātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Ukaviraaja" class="skt-link">Kavirāja</a> (14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saahityotsava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāhityotsava</i> [<a href="#entry-utsava" class="skt-link">utsava</a>] <a href="#entry-saahityotsava" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. festival.<br> <a href="#entry-saahitya" class="skt-link">sāhitya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saak_saadd_r_s_ta">
