  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saak_saat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साक्षात्</span> <i>sākṣāt</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] adv. <i>de visu</i>, de ses propres yeux; sous les yeux; visiblement, réellement, directement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en réalité, en personne, en chair et en os, sous forme corporelle.<br> <i>sākṣāt</i> <i>kṛ</i> voir de ses propres yeux.<br> <i>sākṣāt</i> <i>kṛtya</i> ind. lui ayant mis sous les yeux.<br> <i>sākṣād</i> <i>bhū</i> apparaître en personne, se matérialiser, devenir visible.<br> <i>sākṣātkāvyārtha</i> sens littéral d'un poème.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saak_saatkaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sākṣātkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saak_saatkaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saak_saatkaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saak_saatkaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sākṣātkārī</i> phil. dont on a l'expérience directe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saak_si">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साक्षि</span> <i>sākṣi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-saak_sin" class="skt-link">sākṣin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saak_sicaitanya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sākṣicaitanya</i> [<a href="#entry-caitanya" class="skt-link">caitanya</a>] <a href="#entry-saak_sicaitanya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [«conscience de témoin»] pure conscience.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saak_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साक्षिन्</span> <i>sākṣin</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-saak_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> spectateur, témoin oculaire; témoin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. témoin désintéressé.<br> <i>sākṣīkṛ</i> citer comme témoin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saak_sivat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sākṣivat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saak_sivat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saak_sivat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saak_sivatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sākṣivatī</i> comme un témoin.<br> <a href="#entry-saak_si" class="skt-link">sākṣi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साकार</span> <i>sākāra</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aakaara_1" class="skt-link">ākāra_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saakaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saakaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sākārā</i> qui a une forme; défini <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a une jolie forme, beau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saakam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साकम्</span> <i>sākam</i> adv. à la fois, simultanément, ensemble — prép. cl. en même temps que, de concert avec, en commun avec ⟨i.⟩; syn. <a href="#entry-samam" class="skt-link">samam</a>, <a href="#entry-saha_1" class="skt-link">saha_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saakamedha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sākamedha</i> [<a href="#entry-edha" class="skt-link">edha</a>] <a href="#entry-saakamedha" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>sākamedhās</i> soc. 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ rite de <a href="#entry-caaturmaasya" class="skt-link">cāturmāsya</a> à la pleine lune du mois <a href="#entry-kaarttika" class="skt-link">kārttika</a>, où l'on «embrase les feux tous à la fois».<br> <a href="#entry-saakam" class="skt-link">sākam</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaketa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साकेत</span> <i>sāketa</i> <a href="#entry-saaketa" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Sāketa, proche d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a>; elle fut renommée en Faizabad comme capitale du Nawab d'Avadh en 1722.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saalafkaayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सालङ्कायन</span> <i>sālaṅkāyana</i> <a href="#entry-saalafkaayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. patr. du <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> Sālaṅkāyana ou <a href="#entry-Uzaalafkaayana" class="skt-link">Śālaṅkāyana</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saalokya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सालोक्य</span> <i>sālokya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-saloka" class="skt-link">saloka</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saalokya" class="skt-link">n.</a> cohabitation avec, fait d'être dans le même monde, le même pays, au même endroit que ⟨g. i.-<a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a> iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. immersion dans l'Être suprême [<a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a>]; cohabitation avec l'Essence Divine, fait d'être en présence de Dieu, un des buts du <a href="#entry-bhaktiyoga" class="skt-link">bhaktiyoga</a>; un des 4 états de libération [<a href="#entry-mukti" class="skt-link">mukti</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-saalokyaadicatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">sālokyādicatuṣṭaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saalokyaadicatu_s_taya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sālokyādicatuṣṭaya</i> [<a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a>-<a href="#entry-catu_s_taya" class="skt-link">catuṣṭaya</a>] <a href="#entry-saalokyaadicatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. les 4 états de libération [<a href="#entry-mukti" class="skt-link">mukti</a>]: la proximité de Dieu [<a href="#entry-saamiipya" class="skt-link">sāmīpya</a>], le fait d'être en présence de Dieu [<a href="#entry-saalokya" class="skt-link">sālokya</a>], le fait d'être à l'image de Dieu [<a href="#entry-saaruupya" class="skt-link">sārūpya</a>], l'absorption dans l'Essence Divine [<a href="#entry-saayujya" class="skt-link">sāyujya</a>]; parfois on ajoute l'obtention du Pouvoir Divin [<a href="#entry-saar_s_titaa" class="skt-link">sārṣṭitā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-saalokya" class="skt-link">sālokya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साम</span> <i>sāma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-saaman" class="skt-link">sāman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaajikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामाजिका</span> <i>sāmājikā</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samaaja" class="skt-link">samāja</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamaajikaa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaajikaa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaajikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmājikī</i> qui fait partie d'une assemblée — <a href="#entry-saamaajikaa" class="skt-link">m.</a> participant; spectateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanaadhikara_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामानाधिकरण्य</span> <i>sāmānādhikaraṇya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samaanaadhikara_na" class="skt-link">samānādhikaraṇa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaanaadhikara_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. congruence, accord; apposition; corrélation; co-référence, fait de dénoter un même objet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] inhérence dans le même substrat ou réceptacle, colocation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामान्य</span> <i>sāmānya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samaana_2" class="skt-link">samāna_2</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaanyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmānyā</i> semblable, similaire; commun à plusieurs ou à tous <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commun, ordinaire, usuel — <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">n.</a> identité, similitude; trait commun <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] catégorie [<a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>] des universaux ou substrats génériques; un tel substrat peut être supérieur [<a href="#entry-para" class="skt-link">para</a>] s'il est général, comme l'existence [<a href="#entry-sattaa" class="skt-link">sattā</a>] ou inférieur [<a href="#entry-apara" class="skt-link">apara</a>] s'il l'est moins, comme la substantialité [<a href="#entry-dravyatva" class="skt-link">dravyatva</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-anuv_rttipratyayahetu" class="skt-link">anuvṛttipratyayahetu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. fonds de textes sacrés commun, libre d'accès aux 4 classes sociales; il comprend les deux épopées <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a> et <a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>, et les recueils mythologiques [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-saamaanyavize_sa" class="skt-link">sāmānyaviśeṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanyaabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmānyābhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-abhaava" class="skt-link">abhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaanyaabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] inégalité, négation.<br> <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanyakriyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmānyakriyā</i> [<a href="#entry-kriyaa" class="skt-link">kriyā</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaanyakriyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. emploi d'un verbe à la voix impersonnelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanyalak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmānyalakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaanyalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] perception spécifique de reconnaissance d'un type universel par son signe (analogie).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanyatama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामान्यतम</span> <i>sāmānyatama</i> [super. <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamaanyatama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaanyatama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaanyatamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmānyatamā</i> extrêmement similaire, pareil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanyatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामान्यतर</span> <i>sāmānyatara</i> [compar. <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a>] plus commun; très commun, banal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanyavize_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmānyaviśeṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">viśeṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaanyavize_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. textes sacrés réservés aux 3 classes <a href="#entry-dvija" class="skt-link">dvija</a>, comprenant les textes révélés [<a href="#entry-zruti" class="skt-link">śruti</a>] (<a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> et textes associés) et les recueils de loi [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>] (<a href="#entry-dharmazaastra" class="skt-link">dharmaśāstra</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaanyiiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामान्यीय</span> <i>sāmānyīya</i> [<a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamaanyiiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaanyiiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamaanyiiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmānyīyā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qui concerne le substrat générique [<a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaayika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामायिक</span> <i>sāmāyika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samaya" class="skt-link">samaya</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaayika" class="skt-link">n.</a> équanimité, sérénité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>sāmāyikavrata</i>] jn. la pratique de la méditation, un <a href="#entry-zik_saavrata" class="skt-link">śikṣāvrata</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmaga</i> [<a href="#entry-ga_2" class="skt-link">ga_2</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. chantre, <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a> qui chante le <a href="#entry-Usaamaveda" class="skt-link">Sāmaveda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>sāmagā</i> id. — <a href="#entry-saamagii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmagī</i> épouse d'un chantre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamagrii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामग्री</span> <i>sāmagrī</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samagra" class="skt-link">samagra</a>] <a href="#entry-saamagrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> totalité, intégralité; complétude; not. collection complète, matériel complet, totalité des bagages, des effets ou des meubles <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> moyens disponibles <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. moyens requis pour un rituel.<br> <i>kā</i> <i>te</i> <i>sāmagrī</i> de quels moyens disposez vous?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamagrya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामग्र्य</span> <i>sāmagrya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samagra" class="skt-link">samagra</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saamagrya" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-saamagrii" class="skt-link">sāmagrī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामन्</span> <i>sāman</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-saantva" class="skt-link">sāntva</a>] <a href="#entry-saaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> aménité; accueil bienveillant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conciliation, négociation à l'amiable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la négociation, un des stratagèmes [<a href="#entry-upaaya" class="skt-link">upāya</a>] pour se concilier un adversaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. hymne de louange; not. chant védique, mélodie liturgique pour le <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-udgaat_r" class="skt-link">udgātṛ</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sāmāni</i> cf. <a href="#entry-saamaveda" class="skt-link">sāmaveda</a>.<br> <i>sāmnā</i> i. adv. avec aménité, de bon cœur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sāmabhis</i> par des moyens amicaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामन्त</span> <i>sāmanta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samanta" class="skt-link">samanta</a>] <a href="#entry-saamanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> voisin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. vassal — <a href="#entry-saamanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> voisinage, alentours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamarthya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामर्थ्य</span> <i>sāmarthya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">samartha</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saamarthya" class="skt-link">n.</a> conformité, adéquation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ce qui est conforme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> motifs suffisants pour ⟨loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> puissance, efficacité; aptitude; capacité à ⟨inf. dat. loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. unicité d'objet (syn. <a href="#entry-ekaarthiibhaava" class="skt-link">ekārthībhāva</a>); accord (syn. <a href="#entry-vyapek_saa" class="skt-link">vyapekṣā</a>); co-référence; aptitude à évoquer un sens spécifique d'après le contexte.<br> <i>sāmarthyāt</i> selon les circonstances; de par la situation; pour cette raison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en vertu du fait que ⟨iic.⟩; par suite de ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>sāmarthyaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> faire son possible.<br> <i>sāmarthyaṃ</i> <i>bhaj</i> s'efforcer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamarthyavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmarthyavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamarthyavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamarthyavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamarthyavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmarthyavatī</i> capable, puissant.<br> <a href="#entry-saamarthya" class="skt-link">sāmarthya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamartyatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmartyatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. ainsi que la situation l'exige — ifc. à la suite de, conformément à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamaveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmaveda</i> [<a href="#entry-veda" class="skt-link">veda</a>] <a href="#entry-saamaveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. le Sāmaveda, ou <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> des hymnes [<a href="#entry-saaman" class="skt-link">sāman</a>], recueil de chants, l'une des 4 parties du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>; il y a trois écoles de chant: <a href="#entry-kauthuma" class="skt-link">kauthuma</a>, <a href="#entry-raa_naayaniiya" class="skt-link">rāṇāyanīya</a> et <a href="#entry-jaiminiiya" class="skt-link">jaiminīya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-saama" class="skt-link">sāma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamayika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामयिक</span> <i>sāmayika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samaya" class="skt-link">samaya</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamayika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamayika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamayikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmayikī</i> usuel, coutumier, conventionnel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de même opinion, d'accord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui se conforme à ses engagements <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> précis, exact; à temps, ponctuel; récurrent, périodique; temporaire.<br> <i>devi</i> <i>sāmayikā</i> <i>bhavāmaḥ</i> [MAl.] Majesté, soyons ponctuels au rendez-vous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamba">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साम्ब</span> <i>sāmba</i> <a href="#entry-saamba" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [Mah] np. de Sāmba ou Śāmba, fils de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Ujaambavatii" class="skt-link">Jāmbavatī</a>; il menait une vie dissolue à <a href="#entry-Udvaarakaa" class="skt-link">Dvārakā</a> et se moquait des dévotions de <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>, <a href="#entry-Udurvaasaa" class="skt-link">Durvāsā</a> et <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a>; il se déguisa en femme enceinte et leur demanda de prédire s'il allait accoucher d'une fille ou d'un garçon; ils le condamnèrent à enfanter d'un pieu de fer qui serait la perte de la race de <a href="#entry-Uyadu" class="skt-link">Yadu</a>; <a href="#entry-Uugrasena" class="skt-link">Ugrasena</a> le fit réduire en poudre et jeter à la mer, mais un morceau fut trouvé dans un poisson par un pêcheur qui le vendit au chasseur <a href="#entry-Ujaraa_h" class="skt-link">Jarāḥ</a> qui s'en servit à faire la pointe de la flèche avec laquelle il tua <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>; maudit par <a href="#entry-Udurvaasaa" class="skt-link">Durvāsā</a> il devint lépreux; il en fut délivré par <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>, auquel il construisit un temple sur les rives de la Chenab.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saambadazamii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmbadaśamī</i> [<a href="#entry-dazamii" class="skt-link">daśamī</a>] <a href="#entry-saambadazamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine claire du mois <a href="#entry-pau_sa" class="skt-link">pauṣa</a>; on y célèbre la <a href="#entry-suuryapuujaa" class="skt-link">sūryapūjā</a>, qui fête la guérison de la lèpre de <a href="#entry-Usaamba" class="skt-link">Sāmba</a> par <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saambapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmbapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-saambapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sāmbapurāṇa, un récit d'antan mineur [<a href="#entry-upapuraa_na" class="skt-link">upapurāṇa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saambopapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmbopapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-upapuraa_na" class="skt-link">upapurāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-saambopapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-saambapuraa_na" class="skt-link">sāmbapurāṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-saamba" class="skt-link">sāmba</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saami">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामि</span> <i>sāmi</i> adv. prématurément, incomplètement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à moitié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>semi</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamiipya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामीप्य</span> <i>sāmīpya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samiipa" class="skt-link">samīpa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamiipya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamiipya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamiipyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmīpyā</i> voisin, avoisinant, connexe — <a href="#entry-saamiipya" class="skt-link">n.</a> voisinage, proximité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. temps connexe à celui de la narration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la proximité de Dieu, un des buts du <a href="#entry-bhaktiyoga" class="skt-link">bhaktiyoga</a>; un des 4 états de libération [<a href="#entry-mukti" class="skt-link">mukti</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-saalokyaadicatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">sālokyādicatuṣṭaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamik_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmikṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamik_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamik_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamik_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmikṛtā</i> à moitié fini.<br> <a href="#entry-saami" class="skt-link">sāmi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamprata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सांप्रत</span> <i>sāṃprata</i> var. <i>sāmprata</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samprati" class="skt-link">saṃprati</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saa_mprata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_mprata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saa_mprataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāṃpratā</i> approprié, adéquat, convenable, correct.<br> <i>sāṃpratam</i> var. <i>sāmpratam</i> acc. adv. actuellement, à présent, maintenant; immédiatement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamraajya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साम्राज्य</span> <i>sāmrājya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samraaj" class="skt-link">samrāj</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saamraajya" class="skt-link">n.</a> souveraineté, empire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pouvoir suprême (sur ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamudra_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामुद्र</span> <i>sāmudra_1</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samudra_1" class="skt-link">samudra_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saamudra_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamudra_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamudraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmudrā</i> relatif à la mer, maritime, marin — <a href="#entry-saamudra_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> marin, navigateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamudra_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सामुद्र</span> <i>sāmudra_2</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-samudra_2" class="skt-link">samudra_2</a>] <a href="#entry-saamudra_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> marque corporelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamudraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmudraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-saamudraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> interprète de signes corporels, devin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamudrakavidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmudrakavidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] <a href="#entry-saamudrakavidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> science de l'interprétation des signes et des présages [<a href="#entry-zubhalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">śubhalakṣaṇa</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-saamudraka" class="skt-link">sāmudraka</a> <br> <a href="#entry-saamudra_2" class="skt-link">sāmudra_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साम्य</span> <i>sāmya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sama" class="skt-link">sama</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saamya" class="skt-link">n.</a> égalité, identité; accord parfait (avec ⟨i. loc. iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> équilibre; état normal; égalité d'humeur, sang froid; impartialité (envers [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-loc.]) — a. <a href="#entry-saamya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saamya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saamyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāmyā</i> ordinaire, moyen, normal; impartial.<br> <i>sāmyam</i> <i>i</i> devenir identique à, ne faire qu'un avec.<br> <i>sāmyaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> rendre justice à ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>sāmyaṃ</i> <i>nī</i> calmer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saamyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> égalité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saamyatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāmyatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-saamyatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> égalité.<br> <a href="#entry-saamya" class="skt-link">sāmya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saanaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सानय</span> <i>sānaya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sana_2" class="skt-link">sana_2</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saanaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saanaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saanayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sānayā</i> vieux; ancien; durable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saandiipani">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सांदीपनि</span> <i>sāṃdīpani</i> var. <i>sāndīpani</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sandiipana" class="skt-link">saṃdīpana</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mdiipani" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [VP.] np. du sage Sāndīpani «l'Illuminateur», précepteur de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a>, <a href="#entry-Usudaama" class="skt-link">Sudāma</a>, <a href="#entry-Uuddhava" class="skt-link">Uddhava</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzvetaketu_1" class="skt-link">Śvetaketu_1</a>; son <a href="#entry-aazrama" class="skt-link">āśrama</a> était situé près d'<a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>; il réclama à <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> comme prix de son service la libération de son fils, prisonnier sous les eaux du démon <a href="#entry-Upa_ncajana" class="skt-link">Pañcajana</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uafkapaata" class="skt-link">Aṅkapāta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सान्द्र</span> <i>sāndra</i> a. <a href="#entry-saandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saandra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saandraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāndrā</i> visqueux, onctueux, huileux; suintant de ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> solide, compact, dense <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fort, intense; véhément — iic. garni de, couronné par, plein de ⟨i. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-saandra" class="skt-link">n.</a> taillis, bois; tas, grappe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saannidhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सांनिध्य</span> <i>sāṃnidhya</i> var. <i>sānnidhya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sannidhi" class="skt-link">saṃnidhi</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mnidhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> vicinité, proximité, voisinage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. cooccurrence, collocation.<br> <i>sāṃnidhyaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> apparaître, se présenter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (causatif) faire se rapprocher.<br> <i>sāṃnidhyaṃ</i> <i>yā</i> s'approcher.<br> <i>sāṃnidhyaṃ</i> <i>vraj</i> s'approcher.<br> <i>sāṃnidhyapakṣe</i> <i>jan</i> prendre la place de ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saannidhyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāṃnidhyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saa_mnidhyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> proximité, vicinité, voisinage.<br> <a href="#entry-saannidhya" class="skt-link">sāṃnidhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saannidhyatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāṃnidhyatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. par proximité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सान्तर</span> <i>sāntara</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saantara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saantaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāntarā</i> ayant un intervalle ou des interstices <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> multiforme, non uniforme (opp. <a href="#entry-ekaruupa" class="skt-link">ekarūpa</a>); non compact, discontinu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. non dans la portée de la règle par une clause additionnelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saantva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सान्त्व</span> <i>sāntva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sat" class="skt-link">sat</a><a href="#entry--va" class="skt-link">-va</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saantva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saantva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saantvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāntvā</i> gentil, réconfortant — <a href="#entry-saantva" class="skt-link">n.</a> consolation, conciliation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sāntvāni</i> bonnes paroles, paroles d'apaisement ou de réconfort — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(sāntvayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>sāntvya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pari</i><i>)</i> consoler, réconforter; apaiser, calmer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saantvana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāntvana</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-saantvana" class="skt-link">n.</a> acte d'apaisement ou de réconciliation; consolation de ⟨g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sāntvanāni</i> id. — <a href="#entry-saantvanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāntvanā</i> id.<br> <a href="#entry-saantva" class="skt-link">sāntva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saanvaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सान्वय</span> <i>sānvaya</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-anvaya" class="skt-link">anvaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saanvaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saanvaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saanvayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sānvayā</i> avec la famille; avec les descendants <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> parent, proche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sensé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de même occupation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saapatna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सापत्न</span> <i>sāpatna</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sapatna" class="skt-link">sapatna</a>] <a href="#entry-saapatna" class="skt-link">m.</a> fils d'une épouse rivale — <a href="#entry-saapatnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāpatnī</i> fille d'une épouse rivale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saapatnya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सापत्न्य</span> <i>sāpatnya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sapatna" class="skt-link">sapatna</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saapatnya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saapatnya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saapatnyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāpatnyā</i> basé sur la rivalité; né d'une autre épouse — <a href="#entry-saapatnya" class="skt-link">m.</a> demi-frère; rival, ennemi — <a href="#entry-saapatnya" class="skt-link">n.</a> inimitié entre femmes d'un même mari <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> relation entre demi-frères.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saapek_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सापेक्ष</span> <i>sāpekṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-apek_saa" class="skt-link">apekṣā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saapek_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saapek_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saapek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāpekṣā</i> concerné par, ayant du respect pour ⟨iic. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> attentif; intéressé; partiel; opp. <a href="#entry-nirapek_sa" class="skt-link">nirapekṣa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. ayant une dépendance ou présupposition — <a href="#entry-nirapek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>nirapekṣā</i> intérêt.<br> <i>sāpekṣam</i> adv. avec intérêt; intentionnellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saapek_sataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāpekṣatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saapek_sataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> intérêt <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. dépendance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saapek_satva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāpekṣatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-saapek_satva" class="skt-link">n.</a> id.<br> <a href="#entry-saapek_sa" class="skt-link">sāpekṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaphalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साफल्य</span> <i>sāphalya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-saphala" class="skt-link">saphala</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saaphalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fécondité; profitabilité; avantage; bon résultat; succès.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saapi_n_dya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सापिण्ड्य</span> <i>sāpiṇḍya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sapi_n_da" class="skt-link">sapiṇḍa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saapi_n_dya" class="skt-link">n.</a> degré de consanguinité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saar_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सार्ष्टि</span> <i>sārṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aar_sa" class="skt-link">ārṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saar_s_ti" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saar_s_ti" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saar_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> de même rang ou condition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saar_s_titaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārṣṭitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saar_s_titaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> égalité de rang ou de valeur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. atteinte du rang Divin, obtention du Pouvoir Divin, un des 4 états de libération [<a href="#entry-mukti" class="skt-link">mukti</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-saalokyaadicatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">sālokyādicatuṣṭaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saar_s_tya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārṣṭya</i> [<a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saar_s_tya" class="skt-link">n.</a> id.<br> <a href="#entry-saar_s_ti" class="skt-link">sārṣṭi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सार</span> <i>sāra</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārā</i> précieux, excellent; solide, fort — <a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">n.</a> noyau, essence; mœlle, quintessence; le meilleur d'une chose <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> partie solide d'un corps <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> crème; nectar <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> résine; épanchement, pus; excrément <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. l'un des 7 constituants du corps, dont la proportion détermine le tempérament: <a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a> l'intelligence, <a href="#entry-zukra" class="skt-link">śukra</a> le sperme, <a href="#entry-majjan" class="skt-link">majjan</a> la mœlle, <a href="#entry-asthi" class="skt-link">asthi</a> les os, <a href="#entry-medas" class="skt-link">medas</a> la graisse, <a href="#entry-maa_msa" class="skt-link">māṃsa</a> la chair, et <a href="#entry-rakta" class="skt-link">rakta</a> le sang <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fortune, richesse; force, vigueur, puissance; énergie; solidité, dureté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pion du jeu d'échecs <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. sommaire — ifc. constitué essentiellement de; qui a l'essence de; plein de ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>serum</i>.<br> <i>candanasāra</i> essence de santal.<br> <i>khadirasāra</i> essence de cachou.<br> <i>dharmasāraṃ</i> <i>jagat</i> Le Monde repose sur la Justice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारण</span> <i>sāraṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāraṇī</i> craqué, fendu; qui fuit — <a href="#entry-saara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> diarrhée, dysenterie; fuite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vent d'automne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Sāraṇa, frère de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaraasaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārāsāra</i> [<a href="#entry-asaara" class="skt-link">asāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saaraasaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saaraasaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saaraasaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārāsārā</i> relativement substantiel; plus ou moins fort — <a href="#entry-saaraasaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> force relative; plus ou moins bonne qualité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaraavalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārāvalī</i> [<a href="#entry-aavalii" class="skt-link">āvalī</a>] <a href="#entry-saaraavalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. titre d'ouvrages.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarabhaa_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārabhāṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_n_da" class="skt-link">bhāṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-saarabhaa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> bien précieux, trésor.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarabhaa_n_dabhuumig_rha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārabhāṇḍabhūmigṛha</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuumig_rha" class="skt-link">bhūmigṛha</a>] <a href="#entry-saarabhaa_n_dabhuumig_rha" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. cachot où la reine emprisonne ses rivales.<br> <a href="#entry-saarabhaa_n_da" class="skt-link">sārabhāṇḍa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारङ्ग</span> <i>sāraṅga</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sarafga" class="skt-link">saraṅga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarafgii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāraṅgī</i> tacheté, moucheté — <a href="#entry-saarafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. zoo. <i>Cucculus melanoleucus</i> ou zoo. <i>Clamator jacobinus</i>, coucou jacobin, oiseau noir et blanc; toujours assoiffé, on dit qu'il se nourrit des gouttes de pluie; syn. <a href="#entry-caataka" class="skt-link">cātaka</a> — <a href="#entry-saarafgii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāraṅgī</i> mus. instrument à cordes (sarangi).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारल</span> <i>sārala</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sarala" class="skt-link">sarala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saaralaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāralā</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Usarala" class="skt-link">Sarala</a> — <a href="#entry-saarala" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Sārala <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mahābhārata</a>, dû à <a href="#entry-Usarala" class="skt-link">Sarala</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaranaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāranātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-saaranaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Sāranātha, lieu au nord de <a href="#entry-Uvaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Vārāṇasī</a>, où <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> révéla son enseignement par son premier sermon, dans le parc aux gazelles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारस</span> <i>sārasa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-saras" class="skt-link">saras</a>] <a href="#entry-saarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārasī</i> natu. zoo. héron, grue.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-saarasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] np. du Sārasaṃgraha, compendium de rituel <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारसन</span> <i>sārasana</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-saarazana" class="skt-link">sāraśana</a>] <a href="#entry-saarasana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gaine, corset; ceinture (not. militaire); armure de poitrine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarasvata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारस्वत</span> <i>sārasvata</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sarasvat" class="skt-link">sarasvat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarasvata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarasvata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārasvatī</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Usarasvaan" class="skt-link">Sarasvān</a>, à <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a>, ou à la <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_1" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_1</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du pays des <a href="#entry-Usaarasvataas" class="skt-link">Sārasvatās</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> éloquent; instruit — <a href="#entry-saarasvata" class="skt-link">m.</a> bâton de <a href="#entry-bilva" class="skt-link">bilva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Sārasvata «issu de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a>» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sārasvatās</i> géo. np. du peuple des Sārasvatās, qui vivaient sur les bords de la <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_1" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_1</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. tribu de brâhmanes originaires de cette région; ils se disent descendants de <a href="#entry-Usaarasvata" class="skt-link">Sārasvata</a>; les brâhmanes lettrés [<a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>] du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> sont des <a href="#entry-saarasvataas" class="skt-link">sārasvatās</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. communauté de brâhmanes de la région de Goa et de la côte nord du <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_taka" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭaka</a>; ils suivent la doctrine <a href="#entry-dvaita" class="skt-link">dvaita</a> de <a href="#entry-Umadhvaacaarya" class="skt-link">Madhvācārya</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ucitrapura" class="skt-link">Citrapura</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saarataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> solidité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarathi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारथि</span> <i>sārathi</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-saratha" class="skt-link">saratha</a>] <a href="#entry-saarathi" class="skt-link">m.</a> cocher — ifc. qui guide, qui dirige.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarathya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārathya</i> [<a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saarathya" class="skt-link">n.</a> condition de cocher; fait de conduire comme un cocher.<br> <a href="#entry-saarathi" class="skt-link">sārathi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारशन</span> <i>sāraśana</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sarazana" class="skt-link">saraśana</a>] <a href="#entry-saarazana" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-saarasana" class="skt-link">sārasana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saardha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सार्ध</span> <i>sārdha</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">ardha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saardha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saardha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saardhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārdhā</i> augmenté de moitié.<br> <i>sārdham</i> adv. de moitié, avec, en compagnie de ⟨i.⟩; ensemble.<br> <i>sārdham</i> <i>ādā</i> prendre avec soi.<br> <i>dve</i> <i>śate</i> <i>sārdhe</i> 250.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारिक</span> <i>sārika</i> [<a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-saarika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārikā</i> natu. zoo. <i>Turdus Salika</i>, merle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. zoo. <i>Gracula Religiosa</i>, mainate — <a href="#entry-saarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārikā</i> confidente.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaroddhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāroddhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-uddhaara" class="skt-link">uddhāra</a>] <a href="#entry-saaroddhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> réceptacle d'écoulement; recueil de l'essence d'une matière — ifc. lit. [«quintessence de»] titre d'ouvrages.<br> <a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सार्प</span> <i>sārpa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sarpa" class="skt-link">sarpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarpa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarpaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārpā</i> relatif aux serpents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सार्थ</span> <i>sārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārthā</i> riche; profitable; significatif, sensé; qui réussit — <a href="#entry-saartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> caravane; compagnie, troupe, entreprise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarthaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārthaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarthaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarthaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarthakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārthakā</i> utile; significatif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a du succès.<br> <a href="#entry-saartha" class="skt-link">sārtha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaruupya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सारूप्य</span> <i>sārūpya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-saruupa" class="skt-link">sarūpa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saaruupya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'avoir la même forme que, similarité, ressemblance avec ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. conformité avec l'Essence Divine, fait d'être à l'image de Dieu; un des 4 états de libération [<a href="#entry-mukti" class="skt-link">mukti</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-saalokyaadicatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">sālokyādicatuṣṭaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सार्व</span> <i>sārva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sarva" class="skt-link">sarva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārvā</i> général, universel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarvabhauma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārvabhauma</i> [<a href="#entry-bhauma" class="skt-link">bhauma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarvabhauma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarvabhauma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarvabhaumaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārvabhaumā</i> universel — <a href="#entry-saarvabhauma" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«roi de toute la terre»] empereur; cf. <a href="#entry-Ulalitaaditya" class="skt-link">Lalitāditya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'éléphant céleste Sārvabhauma «Empereur», <a href="#entry-diggaja" class="skt-link">diggaja</a> du Nord, au service de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de <a href="#entry-Uvaasudeva_3" class="skt-link">Vāsudeva_3</a> Sārvabhauma_1, maître bengali du 15⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Usaarvabhaumanirukta" class="skt-link">Sārvabhaumanirukta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarvabhaumanirukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sārvabhaumanirukta</i> [<a href="#entry-nirukta" class="skt-link">nirukta</a>] <a href="#entry-saarvabhaumanirukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] np. du Sārvabhaumanirukta, œuvre de <a href="#entry-Uvaasudeva_3" class="skt-link">Vāsudeva_3</a> <a href="#entry-Usaarvabhauma_1" class="skt-link">Sārvabhauma_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-saarvabhauma" class="skt-link">sārvabhauma</a> <br> <a href="#entry-saarva" class="skt-link">sārva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saarvadhaatuka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सार्वधातुक</span> <i>sārvadhātuka</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sarvadhaatu" class="skt-link">sarvadhātu</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saarvadhaatuka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saarvadhaatuka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saarvadhaatukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sārvadhātukā</i> gram. [«propre à la totalité de la racine»] se dit des terminaisons verbales des temps du système du présent (présent, imparfait, impératif et optatif); aussi de l'aoriste, du futur et du conditionnel; opp. <a href="#entry-aardhadhaatuka" class="skt-link">ārdhadhātuka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saasnaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सास्ना</span> <i>sāsnā</i> <a href="#entry-saasnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fanon de bétail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saasnaavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāsnāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saasnaavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saasnaavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saasnaavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāsnāvatī</i> [«porteur de fanon»] qualifie le bétail par son signe caractéristique [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saasnaavattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāsnāvattva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-saasnaavattva" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] universel du bétail; syn. <a href="#entry-gotva" class="skt-link">gotva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-saasnaavat" class="skt-link">sāsnāvat</a> <br> <a href="#entry-saasnaa" class="skt-link">sāsnā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सात</span> <i>sāta</i> <a href="#entry-saata" class="skt-link">n.</a> plaisir, délice — <a href="#entry-saata" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du centaure [<a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a>] Sāta «Plaisir».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saatavaahana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sātavāhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vaahana" class="skt-link">vāhana</a>] <a href="#entry-saatavaahana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du roi Sātavāhana, qui enfant chevauchait le <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a> <a href="#entry-Usaata" class="skt-link">Sāta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sātavāhanās</i> hist. np. du peuple et de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a> des Sātavāhanās, qui régnèrent sur le Deccan après la chute de l'empire <a href="#entry-Umaurya" class="skt-link">Maurya</a>, et jusque vers l'an 200; leur capitale était <a href="#entry-Uprati_s_thaanapura" class="skt-link">Pratiṣṭhānapura</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uzaalivaahana" class="skt-link">Śālivāhana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-saata" class="skt-link">sāta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saatma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सात्म</span> <i>sātma</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aatma" class="skt-link">ātma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saatma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saatma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saatmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sātmā</i> avec sa propre personne; de sa propre nature.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saatmataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sātmatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saatmataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'être de la même essence que ⟨g. i. iic.⟩.<br> <a href="#entry-saatma" class="skt-link">sātma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saatmya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सात्म्य</span> <i>sātmya</i> [<a href="#entry-saatma" class="skt-link">sātma</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saatmya" class="skt-link">n.</a> communauté de nature; appropriation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. conformité à la norme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. traitement approprié; habitude de vie; régime.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सात्त्व</span> <i>sāttva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saattva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saattva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saattvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāttvā</i> concernant la qualité <a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saattvika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāttvika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saattvika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saattvika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saattvikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāttvikī</i> qui a du caractère, ferme; vigoureux, énergique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [«dont le <a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a> prépondérant est <a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a>»] vertueux, pur; naturel; honnête, authentique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. qualifie une nourriture végétarienne sans ail ni oignons, et un mode de vie vertueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. qualifie 6 recueils mythologiques [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] d'obédience <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>: <a href="#entry-Upadmapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Padmapurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nupuraa_na" class="skt-link">Viṣṇupurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Unaaradapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Nāradapurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhaagavatapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Bhāgavatapurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugaru_dapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Garuḍapurāṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvaaraahapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Vārāhapurāṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-saattva" class="skt-link">sāttva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saatvata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सात्वत</span> <i>sātvata</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-satvat" class="skt-link">satvat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saatvata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saatvata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saatvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sātvatī</i> géo. concernant le peuple <a href="#entry-satvat" class="skt-link">satvat</a>; qui appartient à ce peuple <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] épith. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, leur prince.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सात्य</span> <i>sātya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-satya" class="skt-link">satya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saatyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sātyā</i> dont la nature est la vérité; de confiance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saatyaki">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सात्यकि</span> <i>sātyaki</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-satyaka" class="skt-link">satyaka</a>] <a href="#entry-saatyaki" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Sātyaki, patr. du <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">vṛṣṇi</a> <a href="#entry-Uyuyudhaana" class="skt-link">Yuyudhāna</a> «fils de <a href="#entry-Usatyaka" class="skt-link">Satyaka</a>», ami de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साव</span> <i>sāva</i> [act. <a href="#entry-su_2" class="skt-link">su_2</a>] <a href="#entry-saava" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. libation de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saavadhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सावधान</span> <i>sāvadhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avadhaana" class="skt-link">avadhāna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saavadhaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saavadhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saavadhaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāvadhānā</i> attentif (à ⟨loc.⟩), vigilant, prudent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a l'intention de ⟨inf.⟩ — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(sāvadhānayati)</i> faire attention, être sur ses gardes.<br> <i>sāvadhānam</i> adv. attentivement; prudemment.<br> <i>sāvadhānībhū</i> faire attention (à ⟨loc.⟩).<br> <i>sāvadhānīkṛ</i> avertir, mettre sur ses gardes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saavadhaanataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāvadhānatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-saavadhaanataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> attention, prudence.<br> <a href="#entry-saavadhaana" class="skt-link">sāvadhāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saavana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सावन</span> <i>sāvana</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-savana_1" class="skt-link">savana_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saavana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saavanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāvanā</i> soc. qui détermine les 3 libations de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> quotidiennes — <a href="#entry-saavana" class="skt-link">m.</a> patron d'un sacrifice — <a href="#entry-saavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> temps solaire vrai.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saavar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सावर्ण</span> <i>sāvarṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-savar_na" class="skt-link">savarṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saavar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saavar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saavar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāvarṇā</i> qui est de la même couleur ou caste que <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. homophone (se dit de phonèmes de même point d'articulation) — <a href="#entry-saavar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sāvarṇa ou Sāvarṇi, fils de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uchaayaa" class="skt-link">Chāyā</a>, 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-manu" class="skt-link">manu</a> du <a href="#entry-kalpa" class="skt-link">kalpa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saavar_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सावर्ण्य</span> <i>sāvarṇya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-savar_na" class="skt-link">savarṇa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-saavar_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> identité de couleur ou de caste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. homophonie de phonèmes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saavayava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सावयव</span> <i>sāvayava</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avayava" class="skt-link">avayava</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saavayava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saavayava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saavayavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāvayavā</i> composé de parts <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. d'extension limitée; non éternel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saavitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सावित्र</span> <i>sāvitra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-savit_r" class="skt-link">savitṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saavitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saavitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saavitrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāvitrī</i> relatif au Soleil; descendant du Soleil (désigne divers êtres célestes) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] not. np. de Sāvitra, épith. de la Lumière <a href="#entry-Uprabhaasa" class="skt-link">Prabhāsa</a>, huitième <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>; il pulvérisa le <a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a> <a href="#entry-Usumaali" class="skt-link">Sumāli</a> de sa massue — <a href="#entry-saavitrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sāvitrī</i> lit. l'un des hymnes les plus sacrés du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>, louant <a href="#entry-Usavitaa" class="skt-link">Savitā</a>; syn. <a href="#entry-gaayatrii" class="skt-link">gāyatrī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sāvitrī l'Incitatrice, épouse de <a href="#entry-Usavitaa" class="skt-link">Savitā</a>; elle est la muse personnifiant l'inspiration et l'intuition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Sāvitrī_1, épouse de <a href="#entry-Usatyavaan" class="skt-link">Satyavān</a>; elle demanda à <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a> de ne pas se lever pour que <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a> ne vienne pas prendre son mari, mordu par un serpent mortel; elle représente le modèle de l'amour conjugal; on la célèbre à la pleine lune de <a href="#entry-jyai_s_tha" class="skt-link">jyaiṣṭha</a> [<a href="#entry-va_tapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">vaṭapūrṇimā</a>] avec la <a href="#entry-va_tasaavitriipuujaa" class="skt-link">vaṭasāvitrīpūjā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साय</span> <i>sāya</i> <a href="#entry-saaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> soir, soirée.<br> <i>sāyam</i> adv. le soir.<br> <i>hyaḥ</i> <i>sāyam</i> adv. hier soir.<br> <i>sāyaṃ</i> <i>prātar</i> adv. le soir et le matin, matin et soir.<br> <i>sāyaṃ</i> <i>sāyam</i> adv. chaque soir, tous les soirs.<br> <i>sāyaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> passer la nuit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saaya_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सायण</span> <i>sāyaṇa</i> <a href="#entry-saaya_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Sāyaṇa ou Sāyaṇācārya, ministre du roi <a href="#entry-Uharihara" class="skt-link">Harihara</a> II de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a>, élève de <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraananda" class="skt-link">Śaṃkarānanda</a>, érudit commentateur de textes védiques, et not. du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>, mort en 1387; cf. <a href="#entry-Umaadhaviiyadhaatuv_rtti" class="skt-link">Mādhavīyadhātuvṛtti</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvedaarthaprakaaza" class="skt-link">Vedārthaprakāśa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhaaratiitiirtha" class="skt-link">Bhāratītīrtha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saayaahan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sāyāhan</i> [<a href="#entry-ahan" class="skt-link">ahan</a>] <a href="#entry-saayaahan" class="skt-link">n.</a> le soir — <a href="#entry-saayaahna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>sāyāhna</i> id.<br> <a href="#entry-saaya" class="skt-link">sāya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सायन</span> <i>sāyana</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ayana" class="skt-link">ayana</a>] <a href="#entry-saayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. zodiaque tropique [«avec mouvement»], lié à l'année terrestre; opp. <a href="#entry-nirayana" class="skt-link">nirayana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saayujya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सायुज्य</span> <i>sāyujya</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yujya" class="skt-link">yujya</a>] <a href="#entry-saayujya" class="skt-link">n.</a> union, communion avec, absorption dans ⟨g. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. absorption dans l'Essence Divine, union avec Dieu; but ultime du <a href="#entry-j_naanayoga" class="skt-link">jñānayoga</a>; un des 4 états de libération [<a href="#entry-mukti" class="skt-link">mukti</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-saalokyaadicatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">sālokyādicatuṣṭaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saa_ncii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">साञ्ची</span> <i>sāñcī</i> <a href="#entry-saa_ncii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de Sāñcī, au Madhya Pradesh, lieu de construction d'un <a href="#entry-stuupa" class="skt-link">stūpa</a> important (1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.); il fait 12,80 m de haut et 32,20 m de diamètre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sabala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सबल</span> <i>sabala</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bala" class="skt-link">bala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sabala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sabala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sabalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sabalā</i> puissant, fort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accompagné d'une escorte ou d'une armée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. accompagné de <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sabandhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sabarmat">

  </div>
</div>

Sippe.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sad_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सद्</span> <i>sad_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sīdati)</i> pft. <i>(sasāda)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sanna</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ava</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>prati</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> s'asseoir, être assis <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> siéger, résider <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'affaisser, défaillir; dépérir, succomber; désespérer — ca. <i>(sādayati)</i> asseoir, faire asseoir; placer dans ou sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ruiner, abattre, détruire, faire périr, réduire à néant — int. md. <i>(sāsadyate)</i> s'avachir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. εζομαι; lat. <i>sedeo</i>; all. sitzen; ang. to sit.

[<a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a>] np. de Sadāśiva, forme suprême de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; il a 5 visages: <a href="#entry-Usadyojaata" class="skt-link">Sadyojāta</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaamadeva" class="skt-link">Vāmadeva</a>, <a href="#entry-Uaghora" class="skt-link">Aghora</a>, <a href="#entry-Utatpuru_sa" class="skt-link">Tatpuruṣa</a> et <a href="#entry-Uiizaana" class="skt-link">Īśāna</a>, respectivement associés à 5 aspects ou mondes du <a href="#entry-bindu" class="skt-link">bindu</a>, 5 éléments, 5 couleurs et 5 directions de l'espace <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Sadāśiva_1, empereur de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> (1542–1576); il succéda à son oncle <a href="#entry-Uacyutadeva" class="skt-link">Acyutadeva</a> <a href="#entry-Uraaya" class="skt-link">Rāya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sadaa" class="skt-link">sadā</a>
  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] caractérise la perception [<a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">pratyakṣa</a>] ordinaire, par les 5 sens et l'esprit; opp. <a href="#entry-asadhaara_na" class="skt-link">asadhāraṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] qui appartient à plus d'instances que celle présentée, partie du paradoxe <a href="#entry-anaikaantika" class="skt-link">anaikāntika</a> — <a href="#entry-sadhaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> propriété générique.

[<a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a>] np. de Sadyojāta, visage de félicité de <a href="#entry-Usadaaziva" class="skt-link">Sadāśiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Unandi" class="skt-link">Nandi</a>, tourné vers l'Ouest, associé au monde de cessation d'activité [<a href="#entry-niv_rtti" class="skt-link">nivṛtti</a>], à l'élément terre et à la couleur blanche — <a href="#entry-sadyojaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sadyojātā</i> jeune accouchée.

</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संगणक</span> <i>saṃgaṇaka</i> var. <i>saṅgaṇaka</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-ga_naka" class="skt-link">gaṇaka</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mga_naka" class="skt-link">m.</a> boulier, calculateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safga_nakayantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃgaṇakayantra</i> [<a href="#entry-yantra" class="skt-link">yantra</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mga_nakayantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> mod. ordinateur.<br> <a href="#entry-safga_naka" class="skt-link">saṃgaṇaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संगा</span> <i>saṃgā</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-gaa_2" class="skt-link">gā_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃgāyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃgīta</i><i>)</i> chanter en chœur; célébrer en chantant ensemble.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संगम्</span> <i>saṃgam</i> var. <i>saṅgam</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-gam" class="skt-link">gam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃgacchate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃgata</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>upa</i><i>)</i> rencontrer, se réunir, entrer en relations avec ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'entendre, convenir — ca. <i>(saṃgamayati)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>saṃgamayya</i><i>)</i> rassembler, réunir; mettre en rapport avec ⟨i.⟩; conduire qqn. vers ⟨2 acc.⟩; transmettre à ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>saṃgacchadhvam</i> rassemblez vous.<br> <i>ratnaṃ</i> <i>ratnena</i> <i>saṃgacchate</i> Qui se ressemble s'assemble.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संगम</span> <i>saṃgama</i> var. <i>saṅgama</i> [act. <a href="#entry-safgam" class="skt-link">saṃgam</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mgama" class="skt-link">m.</a> rencontre; collision; réunion, contact; union; équipe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confluence de deux tivières <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fréquentation; penchant, attirance; union charnelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Saṅgama, père de <a href="#entry-Uharihara_1" class="skt-link">Harihara_1</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubukka_1" class="skt-link">Bukka_1</a>, qui fondèrent la dynastie éponyme de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> (14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); la dynastie s'éteignit en 1485 et fut suivie de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Usaluva" class="skt-link">Saluva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgamezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃgameśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mgamezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Saṃgameśvara, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «Maître des confluences de rivière».<br> <a href="#entry-safgama" class="skt-link">saṃgama</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgara_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संगर</span> <i>saṃgara_1</i> [act. <a href="#entry-safg_rr_1" class="skt-link">saṃgṝ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mgara_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> acte d'avaler, de dévorer; engloutissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-Ukaamasuutra" class="skt-link">Kāmasūtra</a>] mode de fellation [<a href="#entry-aupari_s_taka" class="skt-link">aupariṣṭaka</a>] où le pénis pénètre complètement — <a href="#entry-sa_mgara_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> poison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> calamité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgara_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संगर</span> <i>saṃgara_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-safg_rr_2" class="skt-link">saṃgṝ_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mgara_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> consentement, agrément, accord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conflit, combat; bataille (pour ⟨g.⟩, avec ⟨i.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transaction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संगत</span> <i>saṃgata</i> var. <i>saṅgata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-safgam" class="skt-link">saṃgam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mgata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mgata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mgataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃgatā</i> qui s'est rencontré, qui s'est réuni; contracté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mis ensemble <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conforme, convenable — <a href="#entry-sa_mgata" class="skt-link">m.</a> alliance, paix — <a href="#entry-sa_mgata" class="skt-link">n.</a> rencontre, accord, association, union; association, intimité avec ⟨i. g. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-safgataartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
