    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समास</span> <i>samāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samaas" class="skt-link">samās</a>] <a href="#entry-samaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> réunion, conjonction, combinaison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. mot composé substantif; il peut être copulatif [<a href="#entry-dvandva" class="skt-link">dvandva</a>] ou déterminatif [<a href="#entry-tatpuru_sa" class="skt-link">tatpuruṣa</a>]; il est parfois exocentrique et utilisé comme adjectif [<a href="#entry-bahuvriihi" class="skt-link">bahuvrīhi</a>] ou comme adverbe invariable [<a href="#entry-avyayiibhaava" class="skt-link">avyayībhāva</a>]; le <a href="#entry-karmadhaaraya" class="skt-link">karmadhāraya</a> est un cas particulier de <a href="#entry-tatpuru_sa" class="skt-link">tatpuruṣa</a>, le <a href="#entry-dvigu" class="skt-link">dvigu</a> un cas particulier de <a href="#entry-karmadhaaraya" class="skt-link">karmadhāraya</a>; le premier terme est dit <a href="#entry-puurvapada" class="skt-link">pūrvapada</a>, le second <a href="#entry-uttarapada" class="skt-link">uttarapada</a>.<br> <i>dvandvaḥ</i> <i>dvigurapi</i> <i>cāhaṃ</i> <i>madgehe</i> <i>nityamavyayībhāvaḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>tatpuruṣa</i> <i>karmadhāraya</i> <i>yenāhaṃ</i> <i>syāṃ</i> <i>bahuvrīhiḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vers mnémotechnique des variétés de mots composés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samaasaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samāsānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-samaasaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> se dit d'un suffixe s'appliquant à un mot composé.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samāsīdati)</i> s'approcher de, se rendre à, se diriger vers ⟨acc.⟩; atteindre, trouver — ca. <i>(samāsādayati)</i> s'approcher de, atteindre; rencontrer, attaquer.

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समलंकृत</span> <i>samalaṃkṛta</i> var. <i>samalaṅkṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-alafk_rta" class="skt-link">alaṃkṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samala_mk_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samala_mk_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samala_mk_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samalaṃkṛtā</i> complètement décoré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समन</span> <i>samana</i> [<a href="#entry-sama" class="skt-link">sama</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-samana" class="skt-link">n.</a> rencontre; assemblée, festival <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enlacement; commerce amoureux.<br> <i>samanā</i> adv. ensemble; en un seul point; au même moment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de même; uniformément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samanantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समनन्तर</span> <i>samanantara</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-anantara" class="skt-link">anantara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samanantara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samanantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samanantaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samanantarā</i> immédiatement contigu à; qui suit immédiatement ⟨abl. g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> continu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samanas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समनस्</span> <i>samanas</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-manas" class="skt-link">manas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samanas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samanas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samanas" class="skt-link">f.</a> du même avis; unanime <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> doué de raison.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समन्त</span> <i>samanta</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samantā</i> voisin, contigu, adjacent; entier — <a href="#entry-samanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> limite, borne — <a href="#entry-samantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samantā</i> pl. <i>samantās</i> voisinage.<br> <i>samantam</i> var. <i>samantāt</i> adv. de toutes parts, de tous côtés, tout autour; partout, en tous sens, entièrement.<br> <i>samantena</i> adv. de toutes parts <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (avec <a href="#entry-na" class="skt-link">na</a>) nulle part.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samantabhadra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samantabhadra</i> [<a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>] <a href="#entry-samantabhadra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du prince bengali Samantabhadra, (1016–1100); doué pour les études, il fut envoyé à 8 ans étudier au Cachemire [<a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>]; rentré chez lui, ses parents le marièrent à la <a href="#entry-braahma_nii" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇī</a> Vimaladīpī, mais après quelques années il repartit au Cachemire où il fut ordonnée moine bouddhiste; À 28 ans il partit étudier à <a href="#entry-Unaalandaa" class="skt-link">Nālandā</a>, où il devint abbé; une <a href="#entry-_daakinii" class="skt-link">ḍākinī</a> lui apparut, pour lui dire de partir à la recherche de son maître <a href="#entry-Utilopa" class="skt-link">Tilopa</a> avec lequel il passa 12 ans d'épreuves; il transmit son enseignement à Pullahari près de <a href="#entry-Unaalandaa" class="skt-link">Nālandā</a>; son élève <a href="#entry-Umarpa" class="skt-link">Marpa</a> amena son enseignement au Tibet, y traduisit la doctrine et fonda la lignée Kagyūpa; c'est l'un des 64 accomplis [<a href="#entry-mahaasiddha" class="skt-link">mahāsiddha</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Unaadaprada" class="skt-link">Nādaprada</a>, <a href="#entry-Unaaropa" class="skt-link">Nāropa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. son idéalisation <a href="#entry-Usamantabhadra" class="skt-link">Samantabhadra</a> «le Partout Généreux», accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] incarnant la Compassion Totale; ses 64 représentations du Borobuḍur à Java accueillent le pélerin à la 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ balustrade.<br> <a href="#entry-samanta" class="skt-link">samanta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samantapa_ncaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samantapañcaka</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaka" class="skt-link">pañcaka</a>] <a href="#entry-samantapa_ncaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du gué [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>] Samantapañcaka au <a href="#entry-Ukuruk_setra" class="skt-link">Kurukṣetra</a>, où <a href="#entry-Uparazuraama" class="skt-link">Paraśurāma</a> fit trois lacs du sang des <a href="#entry-k_satriyaas" class="skt-link">kṣatriyās</a> qu'il avait tués.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samantatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samantatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. de toutes parts, de tous côtés, tout autour; partout, en tous sens, entièrement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en conjonction avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samanvaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समन्वय</span> <i>samanvaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samanvi" class="skt-link">samanvi</a>] <a href="#entry-samanvaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> succession, séquence; suite causale; corrélation.<br> <i>samanvayāt</i> adv. par conséquent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samanvi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समन्वि</span> <i>samanvi</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-anvi" class="skt-link">anvi</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(samanveti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samanvita</i><i>)</i> suivre, accompagner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'ensuivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samanvita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समन्वित</span> <i>samanvita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samanvi" class="skt-link">samanvi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samanvita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samanvita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samanvitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samanvitā</i> accompagné de, en relation avec, associé avec; doué de ⟨i. iic.⟩ — ifc. qui correspond à.<br> <i>caturbāhu</i> <i>samanvita</i> doté de 4 bras.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samanyu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समन्यु</span> <i>samanyu</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-manyu" class="skt-link">manyu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samanyu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samanyu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samanyu" class="skt-link">f.</a> rempli de colère, furieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> peiné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समर</span> <i>samara</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sam_r" class="skt-link">samṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-samara" class="skt-link">m.</a> conflit, combat, guerre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samarp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समर्प्</span> <i>samarp</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sam_r" class="skt-link">samṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(samarpayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samarpita</i><i>)</i> envoyer, lancer à ⟨acc.⟩; atteindre, blesser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> livrer; offrir; confier — pr. md. <i>(samarpayate)</i> se livrer, se rendre, s'abandonner.<br> <i>samarpayāmi</i> j'offre (se dit not. au temple).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samarpa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समर्पण</span> <i>samarpaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-samarp" class="skt-link">samarp</a>] <a href="#entry-samarpa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> don, transmission, communication; fait de se dédier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abandon, reddition.<br> <i>saṃskṛtasya</i> <i>sevanaṃ</i> <i>saṃskṛtāya</i> <i>jīvanam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>lokahita</i> <i>samṛddhaye</i> <i>bhavatu</i> <i>tanu</i> <i>samarpaṇam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Servons le sanskrit, vivons pour le sanskrit, dévouons nous à améliorer le bien-être du monde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samarpita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समर्पित</span> <i>samarpita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samarp" class="skt-link">samarp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samarpita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samarpita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samarpitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samarpitā</i> livré; offert; confié; transmis.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samarth">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समर्थ्</span> <i>samarth</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-arth" class="skt-link">arth</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. md. <i>(samarthayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samarthita</i><i>)</i> préparer; terminer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> considérer; comtempler; juger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> percevoir; comprendre; déterminer; approuver <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> encourager, réconforter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समर्थ</span> <i>samartha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-samarth" class="skt-link">samarth</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samarthā</i> conforme, approprié, adéquat; utile; puissant, compétent; capable, à même de ⟨inf. loc. dat.⟩; intelligent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (mot) contribuant au sens d'une phrase <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de même sens — <a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. habilité; titre d'assistant de prêtres dans un temple; par ex. joueur d'instrument ou chargé de fixer le drapeau au faîte du temple (non brâhmane) — <a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> capacité, compétence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. syntaxe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samarthatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samarthatara</i> [compar. <a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">samartha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samarthatara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samarthatara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samarthataraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samarthatarā</i> très intelligent; meilleur que.<br> <a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">samartha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समस्</span> <i>samas</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-as_2" class="skt-link">as_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(samasyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samasta</i><i>)</i> combiner, composer, réunir — ps. <i>(samasyate)</i> former un composé, être réuni.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समसन</span> <i>samasana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samas" class="skt-link">samas</a>] <a href="#entry-samasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> rassemblement, combinaison, composition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. formation d'un mot composé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samasta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समस्त</span> <i>samasta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samas" class="skt-link">samas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samasta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samasta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samastaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samastā</i> combiné, rassemblé; condensé; réuni, entier; total, formant un tout <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. composé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. inhérent; pénétrant, imprégnant — <a href="#entry-samasta" class="skt-link">m.</a> totalité, agrégat.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samastaloka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samastaloka</i> [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] <a href="#entry-samastaloka" class="skt-link">m.</a> le Monde entier.<br> <i>samastalokāḥ</i> <i>sukhino</i> <i>bhavantu</i> Œuvrons au bonheur dans tous les mondes.<br> <a href="#entry-samasta" class="skt-link">samasta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samastapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samastapada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] <a href="#entry-samastapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. mot composé; syn. <a href="#entry-samaasa" class="skt-link">samāsa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samastha</i> [<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samasthā</i> [«qui vit normalement»] heureux; opp. <a href="#entry-vi_samastha" class="skt-link">viṣamastha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समस्य</span> <i>samasya</i> [<a href="#entry-samas" class="skt-link">samas</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samasya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samasya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samasyā</i> à rassembler, à compléter — ifc. ensemble des — <a href="#entry-samasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samasyā</i> réunion; fait de demeurer ensemble <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> problème en forme de phrase ou de poème à compléter — ifc. réunion avec, famille des.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samasyapuurti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samasyapūrti</i> [<a href="#entry-puurti" class="skt-link">pūrti</a>] <a href="#entry-samasyapuurti" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. compétition de lettrés pour compléter un début de vers.<br> <a href="#entry-samasya" class="skt-link">samasya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-samataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> similitude; égalité, identité; équilibre; symétrie; équité.<br> <i>samatāṃ</i> <i>nī</i> partager équitablement; équilibrer, régulariser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samataavasthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samatāvasthā</i> [<a href="#entry-avasthaa_2" class="skt-link">avasthā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-samataavasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. état psychologique d'équilibre; syn. <a href="#entry-samaadhi" class="skt-link">samādhi</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-samataa" class="skt-link">samatā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-samatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> égalité, identité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> égalité d'humeur, équilibre; régularité, uniformité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samav_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samavṛtta</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtta" class="skt-link">vṛtta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samav_rtta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samav_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samav_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samavṛttā</i> phon. homosyllabique, se dit d'un mètre dont les 4 pieds [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] ont la même structure; cette classe comprend les mètres védiques <a href="#entry-gaayatrii" class="skt-link">gāyatrī</a>, <a href="#entry-u_s_nih" class="skt-link">uṣṇih</a>, <a href="#entry-anu_s_tubh_2" class="skt-link">anuṣṭubh_2</a>, <a href="#entry-b_rhatii" class="skt-link">bṛhatī</a>, <a href="#entry-pafkti" class="skt-link">paṅkti</a>, <a href="#entry-tri_s_tubh" class="skt-link">triṣṭubh</a> et <a href="#entry-jagatii" class="skt-link">jagatī</a> (de resp. 6 à 12 syllabes par pied) et les mètres classiques <a href="#entry-upajaati" class="skt-link">upajāti</a>, <a href="#entry-va_mzastha" class="skt-link">vaṃśastha</a>, <a href="#entry-vasantatilakaa" class="skt-link">vasantatilakā</a>, <a href="#entry-mandaakraantaa" class="skt-link">mandākrāntā</a>, <a href="#entry-zaarduulavikrii_dita" class="skt-link">śārdūlavikrīḍita</a>, et <a href="#entry-sragdharaa" class="skt-link">sragdharā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samavaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समवाय</span> <i>samavāya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samave" class="skt-link">samave</a>] <a href="#entry-samavaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> rencontre, union, réunion, assemblage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> concomitance; collision, conflit; conjonction (astres) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la catégorie [<a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>] des inhérences: relation indissociable de coexistence entre le sujet et le prédicat, entre le tout et ses parties, entre la qualité et le qualifié, entre le mouvement et le mouvant, entre l'individu et le genre, entre la propriété et la substance.<br> <i>samavāyāt</i> var. <i>samavāyena</i> en combinaison.<br> <i>samavāyaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> se rassembler, se grouper, s'allier.<br> <i>guṇaguṇinoḥ</i> <i>samavāyaḥ</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] relation inhérente entre la qualité et le qualifié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samavaayasambandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samavāyasaṃbandha</i> [<a href="#entry-sambandha" class="skt-link">saṃbandha</a>] <a href="#entry-samavaayasa_mbandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] relation d'inhérence.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(samavadyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samavatta</i><i>)</i> couper en morceaux et rassembler.

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] présence simultanée.

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samave">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समय</span> <i>samaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sami" class="skt-link">sami</a>] <a href="#entry-samaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> rencontre, fréquentation; convention, accord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occasion, événement, circonstance, temps approprié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> temps courant; heure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> règle, pratique, doctrine; rite.<br> <i>samayaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> convenir avec qqn. ⟨i.⟩; s'engager.<br> <i>samayaṃ</i> <i>grah</i> souscrire à une convention.<br> <i>samayaṃ</i> <i>tyaj</i> contrevenir à un engagement.<br> <i>samayaṃ</i> <i>rakṣ</i> tenir un engagement.<br> <i>samayaḥ</i> <i>asti</i> il y a le temps.<br> <i>samayāt</i> adv. sous réserve d'accord.<br> <i>samayena</i> adv. selon la convention.<br> <i>tena</i> <i>samayena</i> adv. en ce temps.<br> <i>iha</i> <i>samaye</i> adv. dans ces circonstances.<br> <i>samayīkṛ</i> stipuler, rendre nécessaire.<br> <i>namaskāra</i> <i>samaye</i> adv. soc. lors de l'hommage à la divinité.<br> <i>madhyāhnaprāyaḥ</i> <i>samayaḥ</i> il est à peu près midi.<br> <i>samayam</i> <i>anurudhyasva</i> maintiens ton rendez-vous.<br> <i>samayam</i> <i>anupālaya</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समया</span> <i>samayā</i> [<a href="#entry-sama" class="skt-link">sama</a>] prép. à travers, au milieu de, parmi ⟨acc. i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dans le voisinage de ⟨acc. i. g.⟩ — adv. complètement, à fond.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samayaacaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samayācāra</i> [<a href="#entry-aacaara" class="skt-link">ācāra</a>] <a href="#entry-samayaacaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. la voie conforme à la doctrine; syn. <a href="#entry-dak_si_naacaara" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇācāra</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-vaamaacaara" class="skt-link">vāmācāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samayaacaarin">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samayamaat_rkaa">

  </div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(samanakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samakta</i><i>)</i> oindre; orner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> unir par l'onction; en gén. unir avec.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambaddhaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

(composé) dont le sens est compositionnel.

</div>

[<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] catégorie liée à la connaissance du monde physique.<br> <a href="#entry-sambaddhaartha" class="skt-link">saṃbaddhārtha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-sambaddha" class="skt-link">saṃbaddha</a>
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(saṃbadhnāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃbadhnīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃbaddha</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i><i>)</i> lier ensemble, attacher, joindre, unir — ca. <i>(saṃbandhayati)</i> faire lier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संबन्ध</span> <i>saṃbandha</i> var. <i>sambandha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sambandh" class="skt-link">saṃbandh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mbandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> connexion, relation; union, parenté; amitié, lien, affection, liaison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> allié, ami, parent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. relation entre mots dans une phrase, dépendance; not. rôle thématique [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>]; aussi relation de qualification ou de possession entre un s. au g. et le s. qu'il qualifie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] relation de causalité entre x ⟨g.⟩ et y ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>sambandhatvam</i> <i>viśiṣṭapratītiniyāmakatvam</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Unyaayabodhinii" class="skt-link">Nyāyabodhinī</a>] La nature d'une relation est de spécifier une connaissance spécifique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambandhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambandhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambandhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃbandhitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mbandhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> connection avec, relation avec ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> degré de parenté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambandhitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(saṃbibharti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃbharati)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃbharate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃbhṛta</i><i>)</i> réunir, amasser; préparer (not. le sacrifice); équiper.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambh_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambhaa_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संभाष्</span> <i>saṃbhāṣ</i> var. <i>sambhāṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_s" class="skt-link">bhāṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃbhāṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃbhāṣita</i><i>)</i> parler, s'adresser à, discuter avec; dire, réciter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambhaa_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संभाष</span> <i>saṃbhāṣa</i> var. <i>sambhāṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sambhaa_s" class="skt-link">saṃbhāṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mbhaa_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> conversation — <a href="#entry-sa_mbhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃbhāṣā</i> id. cf. <a href="#entry-tadvidya" class="skt-link">tadvidya</a>, <a href="#entry-vig_rhya" class="skt-link">vigṛhya</a>, <a href="#entry-sandhaaya" class="skt-link">saṃdhāya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambhaa_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संभाषण</span> <i>saṃbhāṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sambhaa_s" class="skt-link">saṃbhāṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mbhaa_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> conversation (avec ⟨i. iic.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संभार</span> <i>saṃbhāra</i> var. <i>sambhāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sambh_r" class="skt-link">saṃbhṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mbhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> collection; préparation, équipement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> provision; matériel nécessaire, ingrédient <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> complétude; multitude, nombre, quantité; excès <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> richesse; support, nourriture <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. qualité nécessaire à la libération; not. <i>puṇyasaṃbhāra</i> les actes méritoires, <i>jñānasaṃbhāra</i> la science, <i>śamathasaṃbhāra</i> la quiétude, et <i>vidarśanasaṃbhāra</i> la prévoyance — <a href="#entry-sa_mbhaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃbhārā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sambhaav">

[<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃbhāvayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>saṃbhāvya</i><i>)</i> produire, effectuer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> honorer, estimer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> supposer, admettre; attribuer à ⟨loc. g.⟩; considérer comme ⟨2 acc.⟩.<br> <i>sarvaṃ</i> <i>saṃbhāvyate</i> n'importe quoi peut arriver.

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiiciina">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(samīhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samīhita</i><i>)</i> aspirer à, désirer, chercher à obtenir; s'efforcer de.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiik_s">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(samīkṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samīkṣita</i><i>)</i> percevoir; contempler; examiner, considérer, réfléchir à, investiguer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> découvrir, inventer; faire un choix réfléchi.<br> <i>mitrasya</i> <i>cakṣuṣā</i> <i>samīkṣāmahe</i> [<a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a>] Nous contemplons avec le regard de l'amitié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiika">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiikaara">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiipa">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiipastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiipatara">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samiipataravartin">

  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Samitiṃjaya, fameux guerrier <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">vṛṣṇi</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-samitim" class="skt-link">samitim</a>

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(saṃmāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samṃita</i><i>)</i> mesurer; comparer avec ⟨i.⟩; égaliser; distribuer.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samman">

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(saṃmanyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sammata</i><i>)</i> honorer, respecter; apprécier, estimer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agréer, consentir, autoriser — ca. <i>(saṃmānayati)</i> honorer, traiter avec respect; gratifier de ⟨i.⟩.<br> <i>sammānanīyāḥ</i> adr. salutations respectueuses.
  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammantra">

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(sammantrayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sammantrita</i><i>)</i> se consulter; prendre conseil de ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> délibérer; conseiller; exprimer une opinion.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammantrita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमत</span> <i>saṃmata</i> var. <i>sammata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samman" class="skt-link">saṃman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mmata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃmatā</i> consenti, agréé; de même opinion; autorisé (par ⟨g. iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> estimé, apprécié; célébré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> considéré comme ⟨nom.⟩ — ifc. en accord avec, avec l'aval de — <a href="#entry-sa_mmata" class="skt-link">n.</a> opinion, impression; consentement, autorisation.<br> <i>saṃmate</i> avec le consentement de, selon l'opinion de ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>saṃmatena</i> selon l'opinion de ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमति</span> <i>saṃmati</i> var. <i>sammati</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samman" class="skt-link">saṃman</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mmati" class="skt-link">f.</a> accord, approbation, agrément, harmonie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> opinion, point de vue <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hommage; désir; affection; commande.<br> <i>maunaṃ</i> <i>sammati</i> <i>lakṣaṇam</i> Qui ne dit mot consent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammelana">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammita">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमिति</span> <i>saṃmiti</i> var. <i>sammiti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sammaa_1" class="skt-link">saṃmā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mmiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> égalisation; comparaison.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammoda">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammodana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammodika">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammoha">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमोह</span> <i>saṃmoha</i> var. <i>sammoha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sammuh" class="skt-link">saṃmuh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mmoha" class="skt-link">m.</a> stupéfaction; confusion, égarement; illusion, ignorance, folie.<br> <i>krodhād</i> <i>bhavati</i> <i>sammohaḥ</i> <i>sammohāt</i> <i>smṛtivibhramaḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>smṛtibhramasād</i> <i>buddhināśo</i> <i>buddhināśāt</i> <i>praṇaśyati</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [BhG.] De la colère procède l'égarement, de l'égarement la perte de mémoire, de la perte de mémoire la ruine de la raison, de la ruine de la raison on périt.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammud">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammugdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमुग्ध</span> <i>saṃmugdha</i> var. <i>sammugdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sammuh" class="skt-link">saṃmuh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mmugdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmugdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmugdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃmugdhā</i> égaré; stupéfié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammuh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमुह्</span> <i>saṃmuh</i> var. <i>sammuh</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-muh" class="skt-link">muh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(saṃmuhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃmugdha</i>, <i>saṃmūḍha</i><i>)</i> être stupéfié; se troubler, être égaré; être inconscient — ca. <i>(saṃmohayati)</i> égarer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमुख</span> <i>saṃmukha</i> var. <i>sammukha</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mmukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmukhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃmukhī</i> face à face; en face de ⟨g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prêt à commencer; au début de ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> favorable à ⟨g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> adapté aux circonstances, adéquat.<br> <i>sammukham</i> adv. vers, près de; en face <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en présence de ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>sammukhe</i> adv. en face, face à face <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en présence de, au début de ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>sammukhīkṛ</i> se placer en face de; faire face à; prendre pour but.<br> <i>sammukhībhū</i> se trouver face à face; affronter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammuu_dha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमूढ</span> <i>saṃmūḍha</i> var. <i>sammūḍha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sammuh" class="skt-link">saṃmuh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mmuu_dha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmuu_dha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmuu_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃmūḍhā</i> abasourdi; stupéfié; inconscient — <a href="#entry-sammuu_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sammūḍhā</i> énigme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammuu_dhatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃmūḍhatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mmuu_dhatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> stupéfaction.<br> <a href="#entry-sammuu_dha" class="skt-link">saṃmūḍha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammuurch">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमूर्छ्</span> <i>saṃmūrch</i> var. <i>sammūrch</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-muurch" class="skt-link">mūrch</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sammūrchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sammūrchita</i><i>)</i> se solidifier, durcir, épaissir; coaguler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'affermir; grossir, s'accroître; devenir puissant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> devenir stupide; perdre conscience — ca. <i>(sammūrchayati)</i> faire prendre en masse; faire prendre forme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sammuurchita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संमूर्छित</span> <i>saṃmūrchita</i> var. <i>sammūrchita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sammuurch" class="skt-link">sammūrch</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mmuurchita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmuurchita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mmuurchitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃmūrchitā</i> coagulé; congelé; épaissi; intensifié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> stupéfié; évanoui, inconscient.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samp_rc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपृच्</span> <i>saṃpṛc</i> var. <i>sampṛc</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-p_rc" class="skt-link">pṛc</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpṛṇakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpṛkta</i><i>)</i> mélanger, mêler, unir, lier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samp_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपॄ</span> <i>saṃpṝ</i> var. <i>sampṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-p_rr" class="skt-link">pṝ</a>] ps. <i>(saṃpūryate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpūrṇa</i><i>)</i> être complètement rempli — ca. <i>(saṃpūrayati)</i> remplir complètement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampa_th">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपठ्</span> <i>saṃpaṭh</i> var. <i>sampaṭh</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pa_th" class="skt-link">paṭh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpaṭhati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpāṭhya</i><i>)</i> lire à haute voix, réciter (not. le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaa_thya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपाठ्य</span> <i>saṃpāṭhya</i> var. <i>sampāṭhya</i> [ppft. <a href="#entry-sampa_th" class="skt-link">saṃpaṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpaa_thya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaa_thya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaa_thyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpāṭhyā</i> à réciter en cœur — <a href="#entry-sa_mpaa_thya" class="skt-link">n.</a> la déclamation du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> en cœur, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपाद्</span> <i>saṃpād</i> var. <i>sampād</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sampad_1" class="skt-link">saṃpad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpādayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpādita</i><i>)</i> faire réussir; procurer; accomplir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपाद</span> <i>saṃpāda</i> var. <i>sampāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampaad" class="skt-link">saṃpād</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpādā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-du_hsampaada" class="skt-link">duḥsaṃpāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaadaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपादक</span> <i>saṃpādaka</i> var. <i>sampādaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sampaad" class="skt-link">saṃpād</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpādikā</i> qui procure, qui accorde; qui produit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपादन</span> <i>saṃpādana</i> var. <i>sampādana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sampaad" class="skt-link">saṃpād</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpādanī</i> qui procure, qui accorde; qui accomplit — <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de procurer; accomplissement, réussite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaadaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपादनीय</span> <i>saṃpādanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-sampaad" class="skt-link">saṃpād</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpādanīyā</i> à procurer; à accomplir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaadita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपादित</span> <i>saṃpādita</i> var. <i>sampādita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sampaad" class="skt-link">saṃpād</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaaditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpāditā</i> accompli; réussi; complet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपात</span> <i>saṃpāta</i> var. <i>sampāta</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampat" class="skt-link">saṃpat</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> envol; descente, chute <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> choc, collision; rencontre de ⟨g.⟩, avec ⟨<a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a>⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confluence, point de contact, intersection <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apparition, entrée; événement, occurrence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lie, dépôt d'un liquide; résidu, déchets (du sacrifice) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ingrédient.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaatin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपातिन्</span> <i>saṃpātin</i> var. <i>sampātin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sampat" class="skt-link">saṃpat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpaatin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaatin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpaatinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpātinī</i> qui vole de conserve <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aussi rapide que <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui tombe — <a href="#entry-sampaati" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>sampāti</i> myth. np. de l'oiseau fabuleux Sampāti, fils aîné d'<a href="#entry-Uaru_na" class="skt-link">Aruṇa</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uzyenii" class="skt-link">Śyenī</a>; son jeune frère <a href="#entry-Uja_taayu" class="skt-link">Jaṭāyu</a> s'étant imprudement approché du Soleil, il le dépassa pour le protéger, se brûla les ailes, et tomba sur le mont <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>; il y finit ses jours sous la protection du sage <a href="#entry-Unizaakara" class="skt-link">Niśākara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampad_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपद्</span> <i>saṃpad_1</i> var. <i>sampad_1</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pad_1" class="skt-link">pad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃpadyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpanna</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>upa</i><i>)</i> réussir, aboutir; devenir ⟨nom.⟩; conduire à ⟨dat.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'unir à ⟨i.⟩; s'absorber dans ⟨loc.⟩; échoir en partage à ⟨g.⟩ — ca. <i>(saṃpādayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpādita</i><i>)</i> faire réussir; accomplir.<br> <i>pitā</i> <i>vṛddhaḥ</i> <i>saṃpadyate</i> père prend de l'âge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampad_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपद्</span> <i>saṃpad_2</i> var. <i>sampad_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampad_1" class="skt-link">saṃpad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpad_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> succès, bonheur, gloire; possession, richesse; prospérité, bonne fortune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> destinée, lot; avantage, bénéfice; chance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accomplissement, perfection; correction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excellence; splendeur, beauté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abondance; excès <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agrément, accord; égalisation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. équinoxe (<a href="#entry-vasanta" class="skt-link">vasanta</a> <i>sampad</i> de Printemps, <a href="#entry-zarad" class="skt-link">śarad</a> <i>sampad</i> d'Automne) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] vertu cardinale; cf. <a href="#entry-_sa_tsampad" class="skt-link">ṣaṭsampad</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपन्न</span> <i>saṃpanna</i> var. <i>sampanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sampad_1" class="skt-link">saṃpad_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpannā</i> réussi, accompli; devenu, qui s'est transformé en ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> muni, pourvu, doué de ⟨i. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samparipuur_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपरिपूर्ण</span> <i>saṃparipūrṇa</i> var. <i>samparipūrṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-paripuur_na" class="skt-link">paripūrṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mparipuur_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mparipuur_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mparipuur_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃparipūrṇā</i> entièrement rempli, entièrement satisfait; complet, accompli.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samparipuur_navidya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃparipūrṇavidya</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mparipuur_navidya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mparipuur_navidya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mparipuur_navidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃparipūrṇavidyā</i> qui a la connaissance parfaite.<br> <a href="#entry-samparipuur_na" class="skt-link">saṃparipūrṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samparka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपर्क</span> <i>saṃparka</i> var. <i>samparka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samp_rc" class="skt-link">saṃpṛc</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mparka" class="skt-link">m.</a> contact, communication, commerce avec ⟨g. i. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपत्</span> <i>saṃpat</i> var. <i>sampat</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpatita</i><i>)</i> s'élancer, se précipiter vers, se réunir avec ⟨acc.⟩; voler en hâte vers; tomber sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> surgir, survenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampatti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपत्ति</span> <i>saṃpatti</i> var. <i>sampatti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampad_1" class="skt-link">saṃpad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpatti" class="skt-link">f.</a> réussite, succès; excellence; prospérité, abondance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> richesse, propriété <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> heureux événement, chance; bonheur, bien-être.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपश्</span> <i>saṃpaś</i> var. <i>sampaś</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-paz" class="skt-link">paś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpaśyati)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃpaśyate)</i> voir, regarder; prendre en considération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampi_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपिष्</span> <i>saṃpiṣ</i> var. <i>sampiṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pi_s" class="skt-link">piṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpinaṣṭi)</i> réduire en poudre; écraser, détruire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampiiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपीति</span> <i>saṃpīti</i> var. <i>sampīti</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-piiti" class="skt-link">pīti</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpiiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de boire en réunion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samplava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्लव</span> <i>saṃplava</i> var. <i>samplava</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samplu" class="skt-link">saṃplu</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mplava" class="skt-link">m.</a> inondation, déluge; tumulte; destruction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> multitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samplu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्लु</span> <i>saṃplu</i> var. <i>samplu</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-plu" class="skt-link">plu</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(samplavate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sampluta</i><i>)</i> confluer, grossir (eaux, nuages) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fluctuer (pensées) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> couler (navire) — ca. <i>(samplavayati)</i> rassembler (eaux, nuages); submerger, inonder.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampluta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्लुत</span> <i>saṃpluta</i> var. <i>sampluta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samplu" class="skt-link">saṃplu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpluta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpluta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mplutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃplutā</i> conflué, assemblé; grossi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inondé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samplutodaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃplutodaka</i> [<a href="#entry-udaka" class="skt-link">udaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mplutodaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mplutodaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mplutodakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃplutodakā</i> recouvert par les eaux, inondé.<br> <i>yāvān</i> <i>artha</i> <i>udapāne</i> <i>sarvataḥ</i> <i>saṃplutodake</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>tāvān</i> <i>sarveṣu</i> <i>vedeṣu</i> <i>brāhmaṇasya</i> <i>vijānataḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [BhG.] Le puits n'a pas plus d'utilité dans une inondation universelle que le savoir d'un brâhmane noyé dans toute sa connaissance védique.<br> <a href="#entry-sampluta" class="skt-link">saṃpluta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampraap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्राप्</span> <i>saṃprāp</i> var. <i>samprāp</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-praap" class="skt-link">prāp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(saṃprāpnoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃprāpnute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprāpta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprāptavya</i><i>)</i> atteindre complètement, parachever <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obtenir, acquérir; gagner, recevoir; obtenir en mariage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> encourir, subir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampraapta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्राप्त</span> <i>saṃprāpta</i> var. <i>samprāpta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sampraap" class="skt-link">saṃprāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpraapta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpraapta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpraaptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprāptā</i> atteint; obtenu; reçu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampraapti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्राप्ति</span> <i>saṃprāpti</i> var. <i>samprāpti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampraap" class="skt-link">saṃprāp</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpraapti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'atteindre; obtention, acquisition, gain — ifc. arrivée à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprabhaa_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रभाष्</span> <i>saṃprabhāṣ</i> var. <i>samprabhāṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prabhaa_s" class="skt-link">prabhāṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃprabhāṣate)</i> parler à, dire à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampradaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रदा</span> <i>saṃpradā</i> var. <i>sampradā</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pradaa" class="skt-link">pradā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpradadati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpradatta</i><i>)</i> faire don de; offrir complètement, abandonner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transmettre, impartir, enseigner (not. la tradition).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampradaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रदान</span> <i>saṃpradāna</i> var. <i>sampradāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampradaa" class="skt-link">saṃpradā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpradaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> don, cadeau; transmission, enseignement; dation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. dot <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. le rôle [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] de récipiendaire («pour» ou «vers», contrôlé par le datif).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampradaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रदाय</span> <i>saṃpradāya</i> var. <i>sampradāya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampradaa" class="skt-link">saṃpradā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpradaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [«transmission»] tradition, doctrine; usage sectaire, système religieux; enseignement transmis de maître à disciple <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. il y a 4 branches [<a href="#entry-zaakhaa" class="skt-link">śākhā</a>] principales des sectes <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>: le <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> <a href="#entry-sampradaaya" class="skt-link">saṃpradāya</a> fondé par <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, est de doctrine dualiste [<a href="#entry-dvaita" class="skt-link">dvaita</a>] selon <a href="#entry-Umadhva" class="skt-link">Madhva</a> (avec sa sous-branche <a href="#entry-gau_diiya" class="skt-link">gauḍīya</a> de <a href="#entry-Ucaitanya" class="skt-link">Caitanya</a>), le <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a> est duo-moniste [<a href="#entry-dvaitaadvaita" class="skt-link">dvaitādvaita</a>] selon <a href="#entry-Unimbaarka" class="skt-link">Nimbārka</a>, le <a href="#entry-Ukumaara" class="skt-link">Kumāra</a> est moniste pur [<a href="#entry-zuddhaadvaita" class="skt-link">śuddhādvaita</a>] selon <a href="#entry-Uvallabha_1" class="skt-link">Vallabha_1</a> et le <a href="#entry-Ulak_smii" class="skt-link">Lakṣmī</a> est moniste distingué [<a href="#entry-vizi_s_taadvaita" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭādvaita</a>] selon <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a>; ces écoles s'opposent à la doctrine moniste [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprah_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रहृ</span> <i>saṃprahṛ</i> var. <i>samprahṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prah_r" class="skt-link">prahṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpraharati)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃpraharate)</i> jeter, lancer sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> attaquer, assaillir; en venir aux mains, se combattre mutuellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprahaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रहार</span> <i>saṃprahāra</i> var. <i>samprahāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samprah_r" class="skt-link">saṃprahṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mprahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> bagarre, combat, bataille; fait de se battre avec ⟨acc. i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprajval">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रज्वल्</span> <i>saṃprajval</i> var. <i>samprajval</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prajval" class="skt-link">prajval</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃprajvalati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprajvalita</i><i>)</i> s'enflammer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampraj_naa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रज्ञा</span> <i>saṃprajñā</i> var. <i>samprajñā</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-praj_naa_1" class="skt-link">prajñā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(saṃprajānāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprajñāta</i><i>)</i> distinguer, discerner; connaître parfaitement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampraj_naata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रज्ञात</span> <i>saṃprajñāta</i> var. <i>samprajñāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sampraj_naa" class="skt-link">saṃprajñā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpraj_naata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpraj_naata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpraj_naataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprajñātā</i> distingué, discerné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] qualifie l'état d'un <a href="#entry-yogin" class="skt-link">yogin</a> encore conscient.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprasaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रसार्</span> <i>saṃprasār</i> var. <i>samprasār</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pras_r" class="skt-link">prasṛ</a>] ca. <i>(saṃprasārayati)</i> étirer, étendre; éloigner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprasaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रसारण</span> <i>saṃprasāraṇa</i> var. <i>samprasāraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samprasaar" class="skt-link">saṃprasār</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mprasaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> déploiement; éloignement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. vocalisation: transformation d'une semi-voyelle en la voyelle corr. avec élision de la voyelle qui la suit (par ex. <i>uc</i> pour <i>vac</i> et <i>ij</i> pour <i>yaj</i>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रति</span> <i>saṃprati</i> var. <i>samprati</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>] adv. juste en face; justement, précisément, exactement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> au bon moment; en ce moment, maintenant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tout à coup, à ce moment là.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampratii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रती</span> <i>saṃpratī</i> var. <i>sampratī</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pratii_2" class="skt-link">pratī_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpratyeti)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃpratīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpratīta</i><i>)</i> aller vers, arriver à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se persuader de; être convaincu de, avoir confiance en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampratiita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रतीत</span> <i>saṃpratīta</i> var. <i>sampratīta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sampratii" class="skt-link">saṃpratī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpratiita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpratiita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpratiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpratītā</i> confiant, convaincu; décidé, résolu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampratipad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रतिपद्</span> <i>saṃpratipad</i> var. <i>sampratipad</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pratipad_1" class="skt-link">pratipad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃpratipadyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpratipanna</i><i>)</i> aller vers, s'approcher de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> atteindre, obtenir, accomplir; tomber d'accord sur — ca. <i>(saṃpratipādayati)</i> faire obtenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampratipanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
