  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampratipatti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रतिपत्ति</span> <i>saṃpratipatti</i> var. <i>sampratipatti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampratipad" class="skt-link">saṃpratipad</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpratipatti" class="skt-link">f.</a> obtention; compréhension; accord avec ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> assentiment, affirmation, consensus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampratyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रत्यय</span> <i>saṃpratyaya</i> var. <i>sampratyaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sampratii" class="skt-link">saṃpratī</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpratyaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> confiance; foi, conviction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampravac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रवच्</span> <i>saṃpravac</i> var. <i>sampravac</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pravac" class="skt-link">pravac</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpravakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprokta</i><i>)</i> expliquer; annoncer, communiquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampravih_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रविहृ</span> <i>saṃpravihṛ</i> var. <i>sampravihṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pravih_r" class="skt-link">pravihṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃpraviharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃpravihṛta</i><i>)</i> passer à travers, parcourir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampravih_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रविहृत</span> <i>saṃpravihṛta</i> var. <i>sampravihṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sampravih_r" class="skt-link">saṃpravihṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpravih_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpravih_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpravih_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpravihṛtā</i> parcouru.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampravih_rtya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रविहृत्य</span> <i>saṃpravihṛtya</i> var. <i>sampravihṛtya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-sampravih_r" class="skt-link">saṃpravihṛ</a>] ind. ayant parcouru.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprayam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रयम्</span> <i>saṃprayam</i> var. <i>samprayam</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prayam" class="skt-link">prayam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃprayacchati)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃprayacchate)</i> donner, offrir, accorder à ⟨dat. g. i.⟩; redonner — pr. md. <i>(saṃprayacchate)</i> s'accorder mutuellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रयोग</span> <i>saṃprayoga</i> var. <i>samprayoga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samprayuj" class="skt-link">saṃprayuj</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mprayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de joindre, d'attacher ensemble, de lier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conjonction, union, connexion, contact avec ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> union sexuelle avec ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. conjonction de la lune et d'un <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> — <a href="#entry-sa_mprayogaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprayogā</i> ifc. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprayojita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रयोजित</span> <i>saṃprayojita</i> var. <i>samprayojita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-samprayuj" class="skt-link">saṃprayuj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mprayojita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mprayojita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mprayojitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprayojitā</i> connecté; rassemblé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> produit; utilisé; approprié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprayuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रयुज्</span> <i>saṃprayuj</i> var. <i>samprayuj</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prayuj" class="skt-link">prayuj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(samprayunakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(samprayuṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samprayukta</i><i>)</i> assembler; connecter; inciter à ⟨i.⟩ — ca. <i>(samprayojayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samprayojita</i><i>)</i> joindre avec, connecter ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprayukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रयुक्त</span> <i>saṃprayukta</i> var. <i>samprayukta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samprayuj" class="skt-link">saṃprayuj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mprayukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mprayukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mprayuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprayuktā</i> assemblé; connecté; incité à, muni de ⟨i.⟩ — ifc. occupé à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprek_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रेक्ष्</span> <i>saṃprekṣ</i> var. <i>samprekṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prek_s" class="skt-link">prekṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃprekṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprekṣita</i><i>)</i> observer, examiner; percevoir; considérer, réfléchir à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्री</span> <i>saṃprī</i> var. <i>samprī</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prii" class="skt-link">prī</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃprīṇate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprīta</i><i>)</i> être comblé de joie — ca. <i>(saṃprīṇayati)</i> combler de joie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampriita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रीत</span> <i>saṃprīta</i> var. <i>samprīta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samprii" class="skt-link">saṃprī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpriita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpriita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpriitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprītā</i> réjoui, comblé de joie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampriiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रीति</span> <i>saṃprīti</i> var. <i>samprīti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samprii" class="skt-link">saṃprī</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpriiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> plaisir, satisfaction complète, délice en ⟨loc.⟩ — dat. <i>saṃprītyai</i> pour le plaisir de ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>śivasaṃprītyai</i> pour la joie de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> (se dit not. de la nourriture considérée comme oblation).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprok_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रोक्ष्</span> <i>saṃprokṣ</i> var. <i>samprokṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-prok_s" class="skt-link">prokṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(saṃprokṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃprokṣita</i><i>)</i> asperger copieusement d'eau sacrée; consacrer, ondoyer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprok_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रोक्षण</span> <i>saṃprokṣaṇa</i> var. <i>samprokṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samprok_s" class="skt-link">saṃprokṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mprok_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> aspersion (not. d'un corps avant la crémation); consécration (not. d'un temple) — <a href="#entry-sa_mprok_sa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprokṣaṇī</i> eau consacrée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprok_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रोक्षित</span> <i>saṃprokṣita</i> var. <i>samprokṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samprok_s" class="skt-link">saṃprokṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mprok_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mprok_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mprok_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃprokṣitā</i> aspergé, ondoyé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samprokta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संप्रोक्त</span> <i>saṃprokta</i> var. <i>samprokta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sampravac" class="skt-link">saṃpravac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mprokta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mprokta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mproktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃproktā</i> annoncé, proclamé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampu_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपुट</span> <i>saṃpuṭa</i> var. <i>sampuṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-pu_ta" class="skt-link">puṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpu_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> boîte ronde; coffret, cassette <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bol hémisphérique; paire de plats de terre emboîtés formant lampe; cf. <a href="#entry-vardhamaanaka" class="skt-link">vardhamānaka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> emboîtement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] encapsulation des syllabes d'un <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> avec d'autres syllabes, pour accroître leur efficacité [<a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>].<br> <i>saṃpuṭīkṛ</i> envelopper; encapsuler.<br> <i>saṃpuṭe</i> <i>likh</i> inscrire au crédit de ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampu_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃpuṭaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpu_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> emballage, enveloppe; boîte ronde — <a href="#entry-sa_mpu_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpuṭikā</i> cassette.<br> <a href="#entry-sampu_ta" class="skt-link">saṃpuṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampuur_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संपूर्ण</span> <i>saṃpūrṇa</i> var. <i>sampūrṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samp_rr" class="skt-link">saṃpṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpūrṇā</i> plein, rempli; plein de ⟨i. g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> entier, complet; comblé; plein (lune) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abondant, accompli <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excessif — <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. l'élément éther.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampuur_naananda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃpūrṇānanda</i> [<a href="#entry-aananda" class="skt-link">ānanda</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_naananda" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. np. de l'Université de sanskrit Saṃpūrṇānanda; elle a succédé au «Government Sanskrit College» de <a href="#entry-Uvaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Vārāṇasī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sampuur_na" class="skt-link">saṃpūrṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampuur_nataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃpūrṇatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_nataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> plénitude; complétude; perfection <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abondance; pleine part.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampuur_nataayukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃpūrṇatāyukta</i> [<a href="#entry-yukta" class="skt-link">yukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_nataayukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_nataayukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_nataayuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃpūrṇatāyuktā</i> qui a sa pleine part; qui possède l'abondance.<br> <a href="#entry-sampuur_nataa" class="skt-link">saṃpūrṇatā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sampuur_natva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃpūrṇatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mpuur_natva" class="skt-link">n.</a> plénitude; complétude; perfection.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samraa_daasandii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samrāḍāsandī</i> [<a href="#entry-aasandii" class="skt-link">āsandī</a>] <a href="#entry-samraa_daasandii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. [«trône impérial»] tabouret tressé portant les récipients du <a href="#entry-pravargya" class="skt-link">pravargya</a> dans les rites véd. solennels.<br> <a href="#entry-samraaj" class="skt-link">samrāj</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samraaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सम्राज्</span> <i>samrāj</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_mraaj" class="skt-link">saṃrāj</a>] <a href="#entry-samraaj" class="skt-link">m.</a> souverain, monarque absolu, empereur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. véd. souveraineté universelle de <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-svaraaj" class="skt-link">svarāj</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du mathématicien Samrāṭ <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha_3" class="skt-link">Jagannātha_3</a>; il vivait à Amber à la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Ujayasi_mha_6" class="skt-link">Jayasiṃha_6</a>; on lui doit le Rekhāgaṇita, traduction des éléments d'Euclide de l'arabe au sanskrit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. du <a href="#entry-Usamraa_t" class="skt-link">Samrāṭ</a> Yantra, cadran solaire du <a href="#entry-Uyantramandira" class="skt-link">Yantramandira</a> de <a href="#entry-Ujayapura" class="skt-link">Jayapura</a>, établi par le roi <a href="#entry-Ujayasi_mha_6" class="skt-link">Jayasiṃha_6</a> en 1728; plus grand cadran solaire au monde, il a une précision de 15 s.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुच्</span> <i>samuc</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-uc" class="skt-link">uc</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(samucyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samucita</i><i>)</i> se réjouir de, apprécier la compagnie de ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuccaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुच्चय</span> <i>samuccaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samucci" class="skt-link">samucci</a>] <a href="#entry-samuccaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> agrégat, collection, assemblage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. conjonction, coordination; cumul, valeur cumulative <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. coordination (marquée par <a href="#entry-ca" class="skt-link">ca</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. figure de rhétorique (association de deux acteurs différents à la même action) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] ensemble d'instructions à exécuter obligatoirement; opp. <a href="#entry-vikalpa" class="skt-link">vikalpa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuccayapraayazcitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samuccayaprāyaścitta</i> [<a href="#entry-praayazcitta" class="skt-link">prāyaścitta</a>] <a href="#entry-samuccayapraayazcitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. véd. np. des Samuccayaprāyaścittāni, recueil d'expiations d'erreurs de rituel, appendice [<a href="#entry-parizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">pariśiṣṭa</a>] de l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-samuccaya" class="skt-link">samuccaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samucci">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुच्चि</span> <i>samucci</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-ucci" class="skt-link">ucci</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(samuccinoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(samuccinute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samuccita</i><i>)</i> rassembler, réunir; collationner, mettre en ordre; empiler, accumuler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. joindre cumulativement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuccita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुच्चित</span> <i>samuccita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samucci" class="skt-link">samucci</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samuccita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samuccita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samuccitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samuccitā</i> accumulé, rassemblé; mis en ordre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samucita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुचित</span> <i>samucita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samuc" class="skt-link">samuc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samucita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samucita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samucitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samucitā</i> apprécié; approprié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudaacaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुदाचार</span> <i>samudācāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samudaacar" class="skt-link">samudācar</a>] <a href="#entry-samudaacaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> apostrophe, manière d'adressser la parole <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> relations avec, comportement à l'égard de ⟨i.⟩; bons procédés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudaacar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुदाचर्</span> <i>samudācar</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-udaacar" class="skt-link">udācar</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samudācarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samudācarita</i><i>)</i> traiter, agir envers, se comporter à l'égard de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुदाय</span> <i>samudāya</i> var. <i>samudaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samudi" class="skt-link">samudi</a>] <a href="#entry-samudaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> collection, conglomérat, ensemble; multitude; totalité; opp. <a href="#entry-avayava" class="skt-link">avayava</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chose prise collectivement (opp. <a href="#entry-pratyeka" class="skt-link">pratyeka</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. ensemble des éléments constitutifs de l'existence; par ext., Noble Vérité [<a href="#entry-aaryasatya" class="skt-link">āryasatya</a>] de l'origine de la souffrance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudbhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्भव</span> <i>samudbhava</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samudbhuu" class="skt-link">samudbhū</a>] <a href="#entry-samudbhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> production, origine, naissance; résurrection — ifc. provenant de, ayant pour origine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> source de — <a href="#entry-samudbhavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samudbhavā</i> ifc. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudbhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्भू</span> <i>samudbhū</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-udbhuu" class="skt-link">udbhū</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samudbhavati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samudbhūta</i><i>)</i> surgir de; naître de, avoir pour origine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> augmenter, croître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudbhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्भूत</span> <i>samudbhūta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samudbhuu" class="skt-link">samudbhū</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samudbhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samudbhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samudbhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samudbhūtā</i> né, produit, dérivé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> existant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuddeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्देश</span> <i>samuddeśa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samuddiz" class="skt-link">samuddiś</a>] <a href="#entry-samuddeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> exposé complet, description précise; théorie, doctrine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuddh_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्धृ</span> <i>samuddhṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-uddh_r" class="skt-link">uddhṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samuddharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samuddhṛta</i><i>)</i> tirer, extraire, extirper; arracher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arracher au danger; sauver, délivrer; relever, redresser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuddh_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्धृत</span> <i>samuddhṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samuddh_r" class="skt-link">samuddhṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samuddh_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samuddh_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samuddh_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samuddhṛtā</i> dressé, tiré; extrait, extirpé; prélevé, déduit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sauvé, délivré; relevé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuddhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्धार</span> <i>samuddhāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samuddh_r" class="skt-link">samuddhṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-samuddhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de retirer, d'éloigner, d'anéantir; sauvetage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> discernement, choix, sélection; déduction; rachat.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuddhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्धू</span> <i>samuddhū</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-uddhuu" class="skt-link">uddhū</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(samuddhunoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samuddhūta</i><i>)</i> secouer, remuer, agiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuddiz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्दिश्</span> <i>samuddiś</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-uddiz" class="skt-link">uddiś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samuddiśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samuddiṣṭa</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>samuddiśya</i><i>)</i> indiquer complètement; déclarer, communiquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> désigner, nommer ⟨2 acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samuddizya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्दिश्य</span> <i>samuddiśya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-samuddiz" class="skt-link">samuddiś</a>] ind. ayant complètement renseigné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en référence à, de la part de, en honneur à ⟨acc.⟩; selon, vers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुदि</span> <i>samudi</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-udi" class="skt-link">udi</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(samudeti)</i> se lever ensemble; se rassembler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudiir">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुदीर्</span> <i>samudīr</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-udiir" class="skt-link">udīr</a>] ca. <i>(samudīrayati)</i> annoncer, déclarer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुदित</span> <i>samudita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_mvad" class="skt-link">saṃvad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samudita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samudita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samuditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samuditā</i> interlocuteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ce qui est entendu, ce qui est convenu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudra_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्र</span> <i>samudra_1</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-udra" class="skt-link">udra</a>] <a href="#entry-samudra_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> mer, océan <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [ChU.] np. de Samudra, l'Océan personnifié comme quart [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>] du <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre 4 — <a href="#entry-samudra_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> math. cent billions — <a href="#entry-samudraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samudrā</i> ifc. océan de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>samudda</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudra_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्र</span> <i>samudra_2</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samudra_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samudra_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samudraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samudrā</i> tamponné, scellé, marqué.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudraayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudrāyana</i> [<a href="#entry-ayana" class="skt-link">ayana</a>] <a href="#entry-samudraayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> voyage par mer.<br> <a href="#entry-samudra_1" class="skt-link">samudra_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudrag_rha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudragṛha</i> [<a href="#entry-g_rha" class="skt-link">gṛha</a>] <a href="#entry-samudrag_rha" class="skt-link">n.</a> piscine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudragupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudragupta</i> [<a href="#entry-gupta" class="skt-link">gupta</a>] <a href="#entry-samudragupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Samudragupta, fils de <a href="#entry-Ucandragupta_1" class="skt-link">Candragupta_1</a>; il régna de 335 à 375; son empire s'étendait sur toute la vallée du Gange, et il soumit même une partie du Deccan; il célébra un <a href="#entry-azvamedha" class="skt-link">aśvamedha</a>; son fils aîné <a href="#entry-Uraamagupta" class="skt-link">Rāmagupta</a> lui succéda, puis son fils cadet <a href="#entry-Ucandragupta_2" class="skt-link">Candragupta_2</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya</a> s'empara du trône; <a href="#entry-Ukaalidaasa" class="skt-link">Kālidāsa</a> s'inspira de ses exploits pour écrire le <a href="#entry-Uraghuva_mza" class="skt-link">Raghuvaṃśa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ucandramaa" class="skt-link">Candramā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudramathana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudramathana</i> [<a href="#entry-mathana" class="skt-link">mathana</a>] <a href="#entry-samudramathana" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. barattage de l'océan (de lait); cf. <a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudrasetu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudrasetu</i> [<a href="#entry-setu" class="skt-link">setu</a>] <a href="#entry-samudrasetu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] pont construit par les singes entre l'Inde et <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a> pour faire passer l'armée de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudratiira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudratīra</i> [<a href="#entry-tiira" class="skt-link">tīra</a>] <a href="#entry-samudratiira" class="skt-link">n.</a> bord de la mer, rivage; plage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudrayaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudrayāna</i> [<a href="#entry-yaana" class="skt-link">yāna</a>] <a href="#entry-samudrayaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> transport par mer; navire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudrayaanagamana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>samudrayānagamana</i> [<a href="#entry-gamana" class="skt-link">gamana</a>] <a href="#entry-samudrayaanagamana" class="skt-link">n.</a> déplacement sur mer.<br> <i>samudrayānagamanadoṣamīmāṃsā</i> [<a href="#entry-do_sa" class="skt-link">doṣa</a>-<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] f. lit. np. de la Samudrayānadoṣamīmāṃsā, traité rituel sur la faute de voyage à l'étranger, du <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_taacaarya" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭācārya</a> <a href="#entry-Utaaraanaatha" class="skt-link">Tārānātha</a> <a href="#entry-Utarkavaacaspati" class="skt-link">Tarkavācaspati</a> (1870, Calcutta).<br> <a href="#entry-samudrasetu" class="skt-link">samudrasetu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudviik_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्वीक्ष्</span> <i>samudvīkṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-udviik_s" class="skt-link">udvīkṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(samudvīkṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samudvīkṣita</i><i>)</i> regarder autour de soi, considérer, observer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samudyam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुद्यम्</span> <i>samudyam</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-udyam" class="skt-link">udyam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samudyacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samudyata</i><i>)</i> soulever.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samunmiil">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुन्मील्</span> <i>samunmīl</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-unmiil" class="skt-link">unmīl</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samunmīlati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samunmīlita</i><i>)</i> se manifester, s'épanouir — ca. <i>(samunmīlayati)</i> ouvrir (yeux); manifester, déployer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samunnaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुन्नद्ध</span> <i>samunnaddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samunnah" class="skt-link">samunnah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samunnaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samunnaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samunnaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samunnaddhā</i> déchaîné, excessif; arrogant, orgueilleux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samunnah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुन्नह्</span> <i>samunnah</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-unnah" class="skt-link">unnah</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(samunnahyati)</i> pr. md. <i>(samunnahyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samunnaddha</i><i>)</i> se libérer, s'élever.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samunnam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुन्नम्</span> <i>samunnam</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-unnam" class="skt-link">unnam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samunnamati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samunnata</i><i>)</i> s'élever — ca. <i>(samunnamayati)</i> élever, dresser, ériger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samunnata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुन्नत</span> <i>samunnata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samunnam" class="skt-link">samunnam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samunnata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samunnata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samunnataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samunnatā</i> élévé, dressé, haut, proéminent.<br> <i>cittaṃ</i> <i>samunatim</i> <i>aśnute</i> L'esprit ressent l'élévation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samunnati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुन्नति</span> <i>samunnati</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samunnam" class="skt-link">samunnam</a>] <a href="#entry-samunnati" class="skt-link">f.</a> élévation, hauteur; haute situation.<br> <i>manasaḥ</i> <i>samunnati</i> pensée élevée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupaaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपाश्</span> <i>samupāś</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-upaaz" class="skt-link">upāś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(samupāśnoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(samupāśnute)</i> obtenir, acquérir, recevoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupagam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपगम्</span> <i>samupagam</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-upagam" class="skt-link">upagam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samupagacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samupagata</i><i>)</i> aller ensemble vers, recourir à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tomber dans, subir.<br> <i>hastābhyāṃ</i> <i>samupagam</i> tomber entre les mains de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupagata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपगत</span> <i>samupagata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samupagam" class="skt-link">samupagam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samupagata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samupagata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samupagataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samupagatā</i> survenu; subi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupas_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपसृ</span> <i>samupasṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-upas_r" class="skt-link">upasṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samupasarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samupasṛta</i><i>)</i> aller vers, s'approcher de ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupav_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपवृत्</span> <i>samupavṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-upav_rt" class="skt-link">upavṛt</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(samupavartate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samupavṛtta</i><i>)</i> se conduire, se comporter comme ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupavi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपविष्ट</span> <i>samupaviṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samupaviz" class="skt-link">samupaviś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samupavi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samupavi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samupavi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samupaviṣṭā</i> assis.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupaviz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपविश्</span> <i>samupaviś</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-upaviz" class="skt-link">upaviś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(samupaviśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samupaviṣṭa</i><i>)</i> s'asseoir avec ou auprès de, s'asseoir sur ⟨loc. <a href="#entry-upari" class="skt-link">upari</a>-g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'allonger sur — ca. <i>(samupaveśayati)</i> faire s'asseoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupe">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपे</span> <i>samupe</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-upe_1" class="skt-link">upe_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(samupeti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samupeta</i><i>)</i> se réunir, se rencontrer; aller vers, approcher sexuellement ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se produire, survenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupeta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपेत</span> <i>samupeta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samupe" class="skt-link">samupe</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samupeta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samupeta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samupetaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samupetā</i> réuni; arrivé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accompagné de, pourvu de, muni de, riche en ⟨i. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samupo_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुपोषित</span> <i>samupoṣita</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-upo_sita" class="skt-link">upoṣita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samupo_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samupo_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samupo_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samupoṣitā</i> voué à, engagé à ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a jeûné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samutpaad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुत्पाद्</span> <i>samutpād</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-samutpad" class="skt-link">samutpad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(samutpādayati)</i> produire, causer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samutpaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुत्पाद</span> <i>samutpāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-samutpaad" class="skt-link">samutpād</a>] <a href="#entry-samutpaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> avènement, origine, production.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samutpad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुत्पद्</span> <i>samutpad</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-utpad" class="skt-link">utpad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(samutpadyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samutpanna</i><i>)</i> se produire (simultanément), avoir lieu; survenir, surgir, apparaître — ca. <i>(samutpādayati)</i> produire, causer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samutpanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुत्पन्न</span> <i>samutpanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-samutpad" class="skt-link">samutpad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-samutpanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-samutpanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-samutpannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>samutpannā</i> produit, enfanté (de mère ⟨loc.⟩, de père ⟨abl.⟩); survenu, arrivé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samutpat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">समुत्पत्</span> <i>samutpat</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-utpat" class="skt-link">utpat</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(samutpatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>samutpatita</i><i>)</i> s'envoler simultanément, s'élancer, bondir; se lever, s'élever <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> partir, disparaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-samutsarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanakaadi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sanakādi</i> [<a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a>] <a href="#entry-sanakaadi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. l'un des 4 sages [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] éternels; ils émanèrent de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> [<a href="#entry-vaidhaatra" class="skt-link">vaidhātra</a>] pour peupler le Monde; ils se nomment <a href="#entry-Usanaka" class="skt-link">Sanaka</a>, <a href="#entry-Usanatkumaara" class="skt-link">Sanatkumāra</a>, <a href="#entry-Usanandana" class="skt-link">Sanandana</a> et <a href="#entry-Usanaatana" class="skt-link">Sanātana</a> ou <a href="#entry-Usana" class="skt-link">Sana</a>; étant l'incarnation de la pureté [<a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a>], ils refusèrent de procréer; éternellement jeunes, abstinents, experts en <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>, ils parcourent le monde ensemble; visitant un jour le <a href="#entry-Uvaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">Vaikuṇṭha</a>, ils maudirent <a href="#entry-Ujaya_1" class="skt-link">Jaya_1</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvijaya_1" class="skt-link">Vijaya_1</a> qui leur avaient manqué de respect; ils habitent le ciel [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] <a href="#entry-Ujanar" class="skt-link">Janar</a>; on les représente écoutant l'enseignement de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-dak_si_naamuurti" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇāmūrti</a>, qui leur enseigna not. les 14 intervalles phonémiques [<a href="#entry-zivasuutra" class="skt-link">śivasūtra</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-sanaka" class="skt-link">sanaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanandana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सनन्दन</span> <i>sanandana</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-nandana" class="skt-link">nandana</a>] <a href="#entry-sanandana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Sanandana «Joyeux», l'un des 4 éternels [<a href="#entry-sanakaadi" class="skt-link">sanakādi</a>] issus de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सनत्</span> <i>sanat</i> [<a href="#entry-sana_2" class="skt-link">sana_2</a>] adv. toujours, depuis toujours, éternellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanatkumaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sanatkumāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kumaara" class="skt-link">kumāra</a>] <a href="#entry-sanatkumaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sanatkumāra «Éternellement jeune», l'un des 4 éternels [<a href="#entry-sanakaadi" class="skt-link">sanakādi</a>] issus de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>; dans la <a href="#entry-Uchaandogyaa" class="skt-link">Chāndogyā</a> <a href="#entry-upani_sad" class="skt-link">upaniṣad</a>, <a href="#entry-Usanatkumaara" class="skt-link">Sanatkumāra</a> débat avec le sage <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a> des conditions de l'obtention du bonheur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanatsujaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sanatsujāta</i> [<a href="#entry-sujaata" class="skt-link">sujāta</a>] <a href="#entry-sanatsujaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sanatsujāta «Éternellement beau», épith. de l'éternel [<a href="#entry-sanakaadi" class="skt-link">sanakādi</a>] <a href="#entry-Usanatkumaara" class="skt-link">Sanatkumāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanatsujaatiiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sanatsujātīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-sanatsujaatiiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sanatsujātīya, épisode philosophique du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a><br> <a href="#entry-sanatsujaata" class="skt-link">sanatsujāta</a> <br> <a href="#entry-sanat" class="skt-link">sanat</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सनय</span> <i>sanaya</i> var. <i>sānaya</i> [<a href="#entry-sana_2" class="skt-link">sana_2</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sanaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sanaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sanayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sanayā</i> vieux; ancien; durable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sand_rz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदृश्</span> <i>saṃdṛś</i> var. <i>sandṛś</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-d_rz_1" class="skt-link">dṛś_1</a>] abs. <i>(</i><i>saṃdṛśya</i><i>)</i> voir en même temps; contempler, observer — ps. <i>(saṃdṛśyate)</i> être observé; se montrer; ressembler — ca. <i>(saṃdarśayati)</i> faire voir, montrer; exposer, expliquer.<br> <i>nikṛtamivātmānaṃ</i> <i>saṃdarśya</i> affectant un air offensé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanda_mz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदंश्</span> <i>saṃdaṃś</i> var. <i>sandaṃś</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-da_mz" class="skt-link">daṃś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃdaśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃdaṣṭa</i><i>)</i> mordre, saisir avec les dents; serrer, comprimer, pincer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanda_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदष्ट</span> <i>saṃdaṣṭa</i> var. <i>sandaṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sanda_mz" class="skt-link">saṃdaṃś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mda_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mda_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mda_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdaṣṭā</i> mordu; serré, comprimé, écrasé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदा</span> <i>saṃdā</i> var. <i>sandā</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-daa_1" class="skt-link">dā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(saṃdadāti)</i> rassembler des présents; accorder, octroyer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदाय</span> <i>saṃdāya</i> var. <i>sandāya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sandaa" class="skt-link">saṃdā</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdāyā</i> qui octroie, qui accorde ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>gosaṃdāya</i> qui confère une vache.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandaayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदायिन्</span> <i>saṃdāyin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sandaa" class="skt-link">saṃdā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdaayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdaayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdaayinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdāyinī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandarbha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदर्भ</span> <i>saṃdarbha</i> var. <i>sandarbha</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-darbha" class="skt-link">darbha</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdarbha" class="skt-link">m.</a> formation de gerbe, de bouquet, de couronne ou de chapelet; arrangement floral, composition, bouquet — <a href="#entry-sa_mdarbhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdarbhā</i> ifc. bouquet de, gerbe de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandarza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदर्श</span> <i>saṃdarśa</i> var. <i>sandarśa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sand_rz" class="skt-link">saṃdṛś</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdarza" class="skt-link">m.</a> vision; apparition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदर्शन</span> <i>saṃdarśana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sand_rz" class="skt-link">saṃdṛś</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de fixer, de contempler; vision <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait d'être vu par ou en compagnie de ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>saṃdarśane</i> en présence de ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>svapne</i> <i>saṃdarśanaṃ</i> <i>gam</i> être vu (par ⟨g.⟩) en songe.<br> <i>saṃdarśanaṃ</i> <i>prayam</i> se montrer à ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sande_s_tavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदेष्टव्य</span> <i>saṃdeṣṭavya</i> var. <i>sandeṣṭavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-sandiz" class="skt-link">saṃdiś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mde_s_tavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mde_s_tavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mde_s_tavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdeṣṭavyā</i> qui doit être informé; qui doit recevoir les instructions <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit être transmis comme instruction — <a href="#entry-sa_mde_s_tavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> instruction; injonction, ordre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandeha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदेह</span> <i>saṃdeha</i> var. <i>sandeha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sandih" class="skt-link">saṃdih</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdeha" class="skt-link">m.</a> doute, hésitation, confusion; ambiguité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incertitude (concernant ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> risque, danger.<br> <i>nāsti</i> <i>saṃdehaḥ</i> sans aucun doute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandehadolaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdehadolā</i> [<a href="#entry-dolaa" class="skt-link">dolā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdehadolaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> perplexité.<br> <a href="#entry-sandeha" class="skt-link">saṃdeha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandehatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdehatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdehatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> état de doute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदेश</span> <i>saṃdeśa</i> var. <i>sandeśa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sandiz" class="skt-link">saṃdiś</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> indication, renseignement, communication, information; message; explication <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mission; instruction, ordre — <a href="#entry-sa_mdezaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdeśā</i> ifc. information sur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandezaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदेशक</span> <i>saṃdeśaka</i> var. <i>sandeśaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sandiz" class="skt-link">saṃdiś</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdezaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdezaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> informations; nouvelles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandezya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदेश्य</span> <i>saṃdeśya</i> var. <i>sandeśya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sandiz" class="skt-link">saṃdiś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdezya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdezya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdezyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdeśyā</i> qui doit être dirigé; qui doit recevoir les instructions <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait selon les instructions; fait exprès <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étranger; opp. <a href="#entry-videzya" class="skt-link">videśya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandh_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधृ</span> <i>saṃdhṛ</i> var. <i>sandhṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-dh_r" class="skt-link">dhṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃdharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃdhṛta</i><i>)</i> porter, supporter; endurer; soutenir, retenir — ca. <i>(saṃdhārayati)</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधा</span> <i>saṃdhā_1</i> var. <i>sandhā</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaa_1" class="skt-link">dhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(saṃdadhāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃhita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>abhi</i><i>)</i> unir, réunir, combiner; ajuster; poser, fixer (not. la flèche sur la corde de l'arc) — pr. md. <i>(saṃdhatte)</i> se réconcilier avec, s'allier à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधा</span> <i>saṃdhā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sandhaa_1" class="skt-link">saṃdhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> accord, convention, alliance; promesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhaabhaa_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhābhāṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_saa" class="skt-link">bhāṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhaabhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] langage énigmatique; cf. <a href="#entry-sandhyaabhaa_saa" class="skt-link">saṃdhyābhāṣā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sandhaa_2" class="skt-link">saṃdhā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधान</span> <i>saṃdhāna</i> var. <i>sandhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sandhaa_1" class="skt-link">sandhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> réunion, rencontre; assemblée; union <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> réconciliation, accord, alliance (avec ⟨i.-<a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a>⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> point de contact, jonction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de viser avec la flèche en contact avec l'arc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. combinaison de mots; liaison; syn. <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> préparation, mélange (boisson); spiritueux — <a href="#entry-sa_mdhaanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdhānī</i> distillation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] herbe <a href="#entry-sandhaanii" class="skt-link">saṃdhānī</a> «qui répare les membres amputés», rapportée par <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> de l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a> pour guérir l'armée de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.<br> <i>saṃdhānam</i> <i>āyā</i> être admis (dans une assemblée).<br> <i>śarasaṃdhānaṃ</i> <i>kurvan</i> visant avec sa flèche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधार्</span> <i>saṃdhār</i> var. <i>sandhār</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sandh_r" class="skt-link">saṃdhṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃdhārayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃdhārita</i><i>)</i> porter, supporter; soutenir, retenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधाय</span> <i>saṃdhāya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-sandhaa_1" class="skt-link">saṃdhā_1</a>] ind. ayant formé une alliance, ayant fait la paix.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhaayasambhaa_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhāyasaṃbhāṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-sambhaa_saa" class="skt-link">saṃbhāṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhaayasa_mbhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> dialogue amical; opp. <a href="#entry-vig_rhyasambhaa_saa" class="skt-link">vigṛhyasaṃbhāṣā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sandhaaya" class="skt-link">saṃdhāya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधि</span> <i>saṃdhi</i> var. <i>sandhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sandhaa_1" class="skt-link">saṃdhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> union, association, combinaison; alliance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jonction, articulation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. liaison, combinaison euphonique; on distingue le <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> interne [<a href="#entry-antarafga" class="skt-link">antaraṅga</a>] pour former les mots et le <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> externe [<a href="#entry-bahirafga" class="skt-link">bahiraṅga</a>] effectuant la liaison euphonique des mots dans la phrase <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. articulation d'un récit; cf. <a href="#entry-pa_ncasandhi" class="skt-link">pañcasandhi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhirahita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhirahita</i> var. <i>sandhirahita</i> [<a href="#entry-rahita" class="skt-link">rahita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdhirahita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdhirahita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdhirahitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdhirahitā</i> gram. se dit d'un texte dont le <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> a été analysé en mots isolés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhiviccheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhiviccheda</i> var. <i>sandhiviccheda</i> [<a href="#entry-viccheda" class="skt-link">viccheda</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhiviccheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. analyse du <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>, segmentation.<br> <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">saṃdhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhuk_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संधुक्ष्</span> <i>saṃdhukṣ</i> var. <i>sandhukṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-dhuk_s" class="skt-link">dhukṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃdhukṣate)</i> allumer, enflammer, attiser — ca. <i>(saṃdhukṣayati)</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संध्या</span> <i>saṃdhyā</i> var. <i>sandhyā</i> [<a href="#entry-sandhaa_1" class="skt-link">saṃdhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> jonction, période de transition, not. crépuscule; il y en a trois, à l'aube, à midi, et au coucher du soleil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>saṃdhyāvandana</i>] soc. prière au moment d'une <a href="#entry-sandhyaa" class="skt-link">sandhyā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. crépuscule qui précède ou suit un <a href="#entry-yuga" class="skt-link">yuga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sandhyā «Crépuscule», une épouse de <a href="#entry-Ucitrasena" class="skt-link">Citrasena</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ugaalava" class="skt-link">Gālava</a>.<br> <i>saṃdhyām</i> <i>ās</i> var. <i>saṃdhyāmanvās</i>, <i>saṃdhyāmupās</i> soc. exécuter le rite de <a href="#entry-sandhyaa" class="skt-link">saṃdhyā</a>, not. en récitant la <a href="#entry-gaayatrii" class="skt-link">gāyatrī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhyaabhaa_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhyābhāṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_saa" class="skt-link">bhāṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhyaabhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. langage ésotérique, enseignement par énigme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhyaajapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhyājapa</i> [<a href="#entry-japa" class="skt-link">japa</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhyaajapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. récitation d'une prière au moment d'une <a href="#entry-sandhyaa" class="skt-link">sandhyā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhyaakaranandin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhyākaranandin</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>-<a href="#entry-nandin" class="skt-link">nandin</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhyaakaranandin" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du poète Sandhyākaranandī, auteur du <a href="#entry-Uraamacarita_1" class="skt-link">Rāmacarita_1</a>; il vivait au <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dravardhana" class="skt-link">Puṇḍravardhana</a> (Bengale) au 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle à la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Uraamapaala" class="skt-link">Rāmapāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhyaavandana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhyāvandana</i> [<a href="#entry-vandana" class="skt-link">vandana</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhyaavandana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. rite du matin (avant que le disque du soleil ne soit levé) et du soir (après que la moitié du disque solaire ait disparu à l'horizon, et avant que les étoiles ne soient visibles); il s'effectue après le bain rituel, assis le soir en direction du Nord-Ouest, et debout le matin tourné vers l'Est; il comprend la purification de la bouche [<a href="#entry-aacamana" class="skt-link">ācamana</a>], la régulation du souffle [<a href="#entry-praa_naayaama" class="skt-link">prāṇāyāma</a>], l'aspersion en disant les mantras [<a href="#entry-maarjana" class="skt-link">mārjana</a>], l'absolution des péchés [<a href="#entry-aghamar_sa_na" class="skt-link">aghamarṣaṇa</a>], l'accueil rituel du Soleil [<a href="#entry-arghya" class="skt-link">arghya</a>], et la récitation [<a href="#entry-japa" class="skt-link">japa</a>] de la <a href="#entry-saavitrii" class="skt-link">sāvitrī</a> précédée de l'<a href="#entry-om" class="skt-link">om</a> et de l'exclamation rituelle [<a href="#entry-vyaah_rti" class="skt-link">vyāhṛti</a>]; on peut de plus célébrer <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a> le matin et <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a> le soir; syn. <a href="#entry-sandhyopaasana" class="skt-link">sandhyopāsana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandhyopaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdhyopāsana</i> var. <i>sandhyopāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-upaasana" class="skt-link">upāsana</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mdhyopaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-sandhyaavandana" class="skt-link">saṃdhyāvandana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sandhyaa" class="skt-link">saṃdhyā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदिष्ट</span> <i>saṃdiṣṭa</i> var. <i>sandiṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sandiz" class="skt-link">saṃdiś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdiṣṭā</i> montré, stipulé; promis — <a href="#entry-sa_mdi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> communication, information; nouvelles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandigdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदिग्ध</span> <i>saṃdigdha</i> var. <i>sandigdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sandih" class="skt-link">saṃdih</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdigdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdigdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdigdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdigdhā</i> couvert de, oint de, barbouillé de ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obscur, douteux, contestable; incertain, trouble; ambigu, hasardeux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hésitant, qui doute; qui confond — <a href="#entry-sa_mdigdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> incertitude, doute; confusion.<br> <i>tad</i> <i>etad</i> <i>atyantasandigdham</i> <i>vartate</i> <i>ācāryāṇām</i> <i>vibhāṣā</i> <i>anuvartate</i> <i>na</i> <i>veti</i> [<a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a>] C'est ainsi que nous sommes dans une constante incertitude si l'option du Maître est suivie ou non.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandih">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदिह्</span> <i>saṃdih</i> var. <i>sandih</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-dih" class="skt-link">dih</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(saṃdegdhi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃdigdha</i><i>)</i> enduire, salir, barbouiller, brouiller — ca. <i>(saṃdehayati)</i> embrouiller — ca. md. <i>(saṃdehayate)</i> hésiter, douter; confondre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandiip">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदीप्</span> <i>saṃdīp</i> var. <i>sandīp</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-diip" class="skt-link">dīp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃdīpyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃdīpta</i><i>)</i> flamber, flamboyer; s'enflammer, s'exciter — ca. <i>(saṃdīpayati)</i> enflammer; (au fig.) exciter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandiipaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदीपक</span> <i>saṃdīpaka</i> var. <i>sandīpaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sandiip" class="skt-link">saṃdīp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sandiipikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sandīpikā</i> qui excite, qui enflamme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui rend jaloux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandiipana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदीपन</span> <i>saṃdīpana</i> var. <i>sandīpana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sandiip" class="skt-link">saṃdīp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdīpanā</i> qui excite, qui enflamme — <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. nom d'une flèche de fleurs de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> — <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'exciter (l'envie, etc.).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandiipanavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃdīpanavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipanavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipanavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipanavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdīpanavatī</i> qui contient des matières inflammables.<br> <a href="#entry-sandiipana" class="skt-link">saṃdīpana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandiipta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदीप्त</span> <i>saṃdīpta</i> var. <i>sandīpta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sandiip" class="skt-link">saṃdīp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdiipta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mdiiptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃdīptā</i> allumé, embrasé, enflammé, flamboyant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sandiz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संदिश्</span> <i>saṃdiś</i> var. <i>sandiś</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-diz_1" class="skt-link">diś_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃdiśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃdiṣṭa</i><i>)</i> indiquer, signaler, informer, faire savoir; donner un message; expliquer, démontrer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ordonner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanemi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सनेमि</span> <i>sanemi</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-nemi" class="skt-link">nemi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sanemi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sanemi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sanemi" class="skt-link">f.</a> muni d'une jante (roue) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> complet; parfait — adv. complètement; tout le temps; toujours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सन्न</span> <i>sanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sad_1" class="skt-link">sad_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sannā</i> assis.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनद्ध</span> <i>saṃnaddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sannah" class="skt-link">saṃnah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mnaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃnaddhā</i> attaché, lié, fixé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> équipé, harnaché, armé; prêt <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prêt à éclater (orage); prêt à fleurir (bouton).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannaddhakavaca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃnaddhakavaca</i> [<a href="#entry-kavaca" class="skt-link">kavaca</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mnaddhakavaca" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnaddhakavaca" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnaddhakavacaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃnaddhakavacā</i> [«qui a revêtu sa cuirasse»] prêt au combat.<br> <a href="#entry-sannaddha" class="skt-link">saṃnaddha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनह्</span> <i>saṃnah</i> var. <i>sannah</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-nah" class="skt-link">nah</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(saṃnahyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃnaddha</i><i>)</i> attacher, lier, fixer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> revêtir, ceindre, équiper — pr. md. <i>(saṃnahyate)</i> se vêtir, s'équiper, s'harnacher.<br> <i>yuddhāya</i> <i>saṃnahyate</i> il se prépare pour la bataille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sannanta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-sannanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. forme désidérative.<br> <a href="#entry-san_2" class="skt-link">san_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनय</span> <i>saṃnaya</i> var. <i>sannaya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sannii" class="skt-link">saṃnī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mnaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃnayā</i> qui mène, qui rassemble — <a href="#entry-sa_mnaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> collection; assemblée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arrière-garde d'une armée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannib_rh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिबृह्</span> <i>saṃnibṛh</i> var. <i>sannibṛh</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-nib_rh" class="skt-link">nibṛh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(saṃnibṛhati)</i> abattre; réprimer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannibarha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिबर्हण</span> <i>saṃnibarhaṇa</i> var. <i>sannibarhaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sannib_rh" class="skt-link">saṃnibṛh</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mnibarha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> action d'abattre, de vaincre; répression.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannidhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिधा</span> <i>saṃnidhā</i> var. <i>sannidhā</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-nidhaa" class="skt-link">nidhā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(saṃnidadhāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃnihita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>saṃnidheya</i><i>)</i> placer dans ou sur ⟨loc.⟩; déposer; amasser, collectionner — pr. md. <i>(saṃnidhate)</i> nommer à la fonction de ⟨loc.⟩; se trouver dans ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être imminent; être proche — ps. <i>(saṃnidhīyate)</i> être présent; être à proximité — ca. <i>(saṃnidhāpayati)</i> rapprocher; rendre manifeste, représenter.<br> <i>dṛṣṭiṃ</i> <i>saṃnidhā</i> fixer les yeux sur.<br> <i>saṃnidhāpyate</i> il se manifeste en la présence de ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिधान</span> <i>saṃnidhāna</i> var. <i>sannidhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sannidhaa" class="skt-link">saṃnidhā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mnidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> réceptacle; voisinage, présence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannidheya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिधेय</span> <i>saṃnidheya</i> var. <i>sannidheya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sannidhaa" class="skt-link">saṃnidhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mnidheya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnidheya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnidheyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃnidheyā</i> à rapprocher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिधि</span> <i>saṃnidhi</i> var. <i>sannidhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sannidhaa" class="skt-link">saṃnidhā</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mnidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> proximité, présence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. contiguïté (entre constituants).<br> <i>saṃnidhau</i> adv. en présence de ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>saṃnidhiṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> réaliser sa présence.<br> <i>saṃnidhiṃ</i> <i>prāp</i> venir auprès de ⟨g. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannigrah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिग्रह्</span> <i>saṃnigrah</i> var. <i>sannigrah</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-nigrah" class="skt-link">nigrah</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(saṃnigṛhṇāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃnigṛhṇīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃnigṛhīta</i><i>)</i> maîtriser, subjuguer, dompter; réprimer, restreindre; arrêter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannihita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संनिहित</span> <i>saṃnihita</i> var. <i>sannihita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sannidhaa" class="skt-link">saṃnidhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mnihita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnihita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mnihitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃnihitā</i> posé à côté; proche, présent; à portée; contigu, voisin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prêt, préparé à ⟨dat.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃnayati)</i> mener, conduire ensemble; connecter, joindre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mélanger, amalgamer.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(saṃnikṛṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃnikṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> rapprocher.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sannikar_sa">

(aller, ...) près de.<br> <i>saṃnikarṣāt</i> adv. (venir, ...) d'auprès de.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃnipatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃnipatita</i><i>)</i> descendre, fondre sur, se jeter sur ⟨loc.⟩; tomber; tomber avec ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se présenter, paraître parmi ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> périr — ca. <i>(saṃnipātayati)</i> faire tomber, abattre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> assembler, convoquer.
  </div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃniviśate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃniviṣṭa</i><i>)</i> s'asseoir avec; frayer avec, avoir commerce avec ⟨i.⟩ — ca. <i>(saṃniviśyati)</i> faire asseoir ensemble; installer, loger, faire camper; établir, fixer dans; fonder (une ville).

</div>

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-santaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संताप</span> <i>saṃtāpa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-santap" class="skt-link">saṃtap</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mtaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> brûlure intense, fournaise <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tourment, peine, détresse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> auto-mortification, ascèse, pénitence; remords — <a href="#entry-sa_mtaapaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃtāpā</i> ifc. qui souffre de.<br> <i>saṃtāpaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> être affligé de ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> infliger des tourments.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(saṃtanoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃtanute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃtata</i><i>)</i> s'étendre; maintenir la continuité, joindre.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-santap">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃtapati)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃtapate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃtapita</i>, <i>saṃtapta</i><i>)</i> échauffer, brûler, tourmenter — ca. <i>(saṃtāpayati)</i> id.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-santapta">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-santaptaayas">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(saphalayati)</i> rendre profitable; faire réussir; profiter de.<br> <i>saphalaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> rendre profitable, faire fructifier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tenir sa promesse; satisfaire.<br> <i>saphalībhū</i> être profitable, réussir.<br> <i>saphalībhūta</i> devenu profitable; ayant réussi.<br> <i>saphalīkṛ</i> rendre profitable; faire réussir; profiter de.<br> <i>saphalīkṛta</i> rendu profitable ou utile; réussi, accompli.<br> <i>saphalīkaraṇa</i> fait de rendre profitable ou utile; réussite.
