<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptaj_naanabhuumikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptajñānabhūmikā</i> [<a href="#entry-j_naanabhuumikaa" class="skt-link">jñānabhūmikā</a>] <a href="#entry-saptaj_naanabhuumikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. <i>saptajñānabhūmikās</i> phil. [YV.] la série des 7 niveaux de connaissance: <a href="#entry-zubhecchaa" class="skt-link">śubhecchā</a>, <a href="#entry-vicaara_na" class="skt-link">vicāraṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-tanumaanasa" class="skt-link">tanumānasa</a>, <a href="#entry-sattvaapatti" class="skt-link">sattvāpatti</a>, <a href="#entry-asa_mzakti" class="skt-link">asaṃśakti</a>, <a href="#entry-paraarthaabhaavinii" class="skt-link">parārthābhāvinī</a>, <a href="#entry-turyagaa" class="skt-link">turyagā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptama</i> [<a href="#entry--ma" class="skt-link">-ma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saptama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saptama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saptamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptamī</i> ord. septième — <a href="#entry-saptamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptamī</i> gram. locatif (7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ déclinaison) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. cf. <a href="#entry-ziitalaasaptamii" class="skt-link">śītalāsaptamī</a>.<br> <i>sati</i> <i>saptamī</i> gram. locatif absolu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptamaat_rkaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptamātṛkā</i> [<a href="#entry-maat_rkaa" class="skt-link">mātṛkā</a>] <a href="#entry-saptamaat_rkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. <i>saptamātṛkās</i> myth. les 7 aspects de <a href="#entry-Umaataa" class="skt-link">Mātā</a> la Mère; la tradition shivaïte [<a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>] les nomme: <a href="#entry-Ubraahmii" class="skt-link">Brāhmī</a> (<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>), <a href="#entry-Umaahezvarii" class="skt-link">Māheśvarī</a> (<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>), <a href="#entry-Ukaumaarii" class="skt-link">Kaumārī</a> (<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>), <a href="#entry-Uvai_s_navii" class="skt-link">Vaiṣṇavī</a> (<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>), <a href="#entry-Uvaaraahii" class="skt-link">Vārāhī</a> (<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvaraaha" class="skt-link">Varāha</a>), <a href="#entry-Uindraa_nii" class="skt-link">Indrāṇī</a>/<a href="#entry-Uaindrii" class="skt-link">Aindrī</a> (<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>) et <a href="#entry-Ucaamu_n_daa" class="skt-link">Cāmuṇḍā</a> ou <a href="#entry-Ucaamu_n_dii" class="skt-link">Cāmuṇḍī</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uraudrii" class="skt-link">Raudrī</a> (<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सप्तन्</span> <i>saptan</i> num. <a href="#entry-saptan" class="skt-link">*</a> pl. le nombre sept <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. επτα; lat. <i>septem</i>; all. sieben; ang. seven; fr. sept.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptanadii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptanadī</i> [<a href="#entry-nadii" class="skt-link">nadī</a>] <a href="#entry-saptanadii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. les 7 rivières sacrées de l'Inde: <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a>, <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_1" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugodaavarii" class="skt-link">Godāvarī</a>, <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukaaverii" class="skt-link">Kāverī</a> et <a href="#entry-Usindhu" class="skt-link">Sindhu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptanadiijala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptanadījala</i> [<a href="#entry-jala" class="skt-link">jala</a>] <a href="#entry-saptanadiijala" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. eau mélangée des 7 rivières sacrées; elle est utilisée dans des rites de lustration [<a href="#entry-abhi_seka" class="skt-link">abhiṣeka</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-saptanadii" class="skt-link">saptanadī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptapada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saptapada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saptapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saptapadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptapadā</i> soc. qui a fait les 7 pas consacrant le mariage — <a href="#entry-saptapadii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptapadī</i> soc. rite des 7 pas pris par les mariés au nord du feu consacré en direction du Nord-Est lors de la cérémonie du mariage, pour consacrer leur union; la mariée doit marcher du pied droit sur 7 petits tas de riz.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptapadaarthii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptapadārthī</i> [<a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>] <a href="#entry-saptapadaarthii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Saptapadārthī, ouvrage logique de <a href="#entry-Uzivaadityamizra" class="skt-link">Śivādityamiśra</a> (12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptapar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptaparṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-par_na" class="skt-link">parṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saptapar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saptapar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saptapar_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptaparṇī</i> qui a 7 feuilles — <a href="#entry-saptapar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Alstonya scholaris</i>, quinquina d'Inde; arbre de la famille des Apocynées, pouvant atteindre 40 m, au tronc brun, émettant un latex blanc; ses feuilles luisantes sont en corolles de 4 à 7 feuilles elliptiques coriaces; petites fleurs blanc verdâtre en ombelles, très odorantes; il est utilisé en médecine; syn. <a href="#entry-saptacchada" class="skt-link">saptacchada</a> — <a href="#entry-saptapar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> sa fleur — <a href="#entry-saptapar_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptaparṇī</i> natu. bot. <i>Mimosa pudica</i>; syn. <a href="#entry-lajjaa" class="skt-link">lajjā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptapurii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptapurī</i> [<a href="#entry-purii" class="skt-link">purī</a>] <a href="#entry-saptapurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. <i>saptapuryas</i> géo. les 7 villes sacrées de l'Inde: <a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a>, <a href="#entry-Umathuraa" class="skt-link">Mathurā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uharidvaara" class="skt-link">Haridvāra</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Vārāṇasī</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukaa_ncii" class="skt-link">Kāñcī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a> et <a href="#entry-Udvaarakaa" class="skt-link">Dvārakā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptar_si">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptarṣi</i> [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] <a href="#entry-saptar_si" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. les 7 sages ou patriarches védiques; ils sont les géniteurs [<a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a>] issus de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> pour enfanter le monde; on les associe aux étoiles de la Grande Ourse; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] ceux de l'ère [<a href="#entry-manvantara" class="skt-link">manvantara</a>] de <a href="#entry-Usvaayambhuva" class="skt-link">Svāyaṃbhuva</a> sont: <a href="#entry-Umariici" class="skt-link">Marīci</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uatri" class="skt-link">Atri</a>, <a href="#entry-Upulastya" class="skt-link">Pulastya</a>, <a href="#entry-Upulaha" class="skt-link">Pulaha</a> et <a href="#entry-Ukratu" class="skt-link">Kratu</a>; [SB.] ceux de l'ère [<a href="#entry-manvantara" class="skt-link">manvantara</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvaivasvata" class="skt-link">Vaivasvata</a> sont: <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uatri" class="skt-link">Atri</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujamadagni" class="skt-link">Jamadagni</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugautama" class="skt-link">Gautama</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubharadvaaja" class="skt-link">Bharadvāja</a>; on liste parfois aussi <a href="#entry-Uagastya" class="skt-link">Agastya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uka_nva" class="skt-link">Kaṇva</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a>; ils furent sauvés du déluge en s'accrochant à la corne de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Umatsya" class="skt-link">Matsya</a>.<br> <i>saptarṣīnu</i> <i>ha</i> <i>sma</i> <i>vai</i> <i>pura_ṛkṣā</i> <i>ityācakṣate</i> [SB.] (La constellation des) sept sages était en fait aussi nommée, autrefois, les Ours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptar_sima_n_dala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptarṣimaṇḍala</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_n_dala" class="skt-link">maṇḍala</a>] <a href="#entry-saptar_sima_n_dala" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. la Grande Ourse.<br> <a href="#entry-saptar_si" class="skt-link">saptarṣi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptati</i> [<a href="#entry--ti" class="skt-link">-ti</a>] num. <a href="#entry-saptati" class="skt-link">f.</a> sg. soixante-dix; soixante-dizaine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> 70 ans <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. cf. <a href="#entry-Usaafkhyakaarikaas" class="skt-link">Sāṃkhyakārikās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptavi_mzati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptaviṃśati</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_mzati" class="skt-link">viṃśati</a>] <a href="#entry-saptavi_mzati" class="skt-link">f.</a> 27.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saptazata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saptaśata</i> [<a href="#entry-zata" class="skt-link">śata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saptazata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saptazata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saptazatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptaśatī</i> 700 — <a href="#entry-saptazata" class="skt-link">n.</a> 700; 107 — <a href="#entry-saptazatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saptaśatī</i> 700.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sapu_spa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सपुष्प</span> <i>sapuṣpa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-pu_spa" class="skt-link">puṣpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sapu_spa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sapu_spa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sapu_spaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sapuṣpā</i> fleuri, en fleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sar_sapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्षप</span> <i>sarṣapa</i> <a href="#entry-sar_sapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Sinapis dichotoma</i>, moutarde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> grain de moutarde; mesure de poids minime (= 3 <a href="#entry-raajika" class="skt-link">rājika</a>, il y en a 12 dans un <a href="#entry-yava" class="skt-link">yava</a>, et 8 dans un <a href="#entry-ta_n_dula" class="skt-link">taṇḍula</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर</span> <i>sara</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarā</i> fluide, liquide; purgatif, laxatif — <a href="#entry-sarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarī</i> ifc. qui va, qui bouge — <a href="#entry-sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> mouvement, jaillissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> corde; cascade; cordon (d'un collier).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरण</span> <i>saraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> course, mouvement rapide; poursuite — <a href="#entry-sara_ni" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saraṇi</i> route.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sara_nyu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरण्यु</span> <i>saraṇyu</i> [<a href="#entry-sara_na" class="skt-link">saraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sara_nyu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sara_nyu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sara_nyu" class="skt-link">f.</a> rapide, véloce, agile — <a href="#entry-sara_nyuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saraṇyū</i> myth. np. de Saraṇyū «la Rapide», fille de <a href="#entry-Utva_s_taa" class="skt-link">Tvaṣṭā</a>, épouse du Soleil <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>; épuisée par son ardeur, elle fabriqua une femme à son image [<a href="#entry-Usavar_naa" class="skt-link">Savarṇā</a>] et se transforma en jument; <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a> la suivit et ils donnèrent naissance aux <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a> et à <a href="#entry-Urevanta" class="skt-link">Revanta</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Usa_nj_naa" class="skt-link">Sañjñā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saraaghava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सराघव</span> <i>sarāghava</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-raaghava" class="skt-link">rāghava</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saraaghava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saraaghava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saraaghavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarāghavā</i> myth. accompagné des <a href="#entry-raaghavaas" class="skt-link">rāghavās</a> (se dit de <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saraajaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सराजक</span> <i>sarājaka</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-raajaka" class="skt-link">rājaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saraajaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saraajaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saraajikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarājikā</i> accompagné du roi, avec le roi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरङ्ग</span> <i>saraṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-rafga" class="skt-link">raṅga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarafgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saraṅgā</i> coloré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरक</span> <i>saraka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarikā</i> qui se déplace, qui coule — <a href="#entry-saraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> gobelet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> alcool, rhum; action de boire (une boisson alcoolisée).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरल</span> <i>sarala</i> [<a href="#entry-sara" class="skt-link">sara</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saralaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saralā</i> [«qui coule»] droit; direct, franc; spontané <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (moralement) honnête, droit, loyal, sincère; juste, correct; authentique — <a href="#entry-sarala" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Pinus longifolia</i>, variété de pin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Sarala, poète oriya du 15⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il écrivit (en oriya) le <a href="#entry-Usaarala" class="skt-link">Sārala</a> <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mahābhārata</a> — <a href="#entry-sarala" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. résine de pin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saramaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरमा</span> <i>saramā</i> [<a href="#entry-sara" class="skt-link">sara</a><a href="#entry--ma" class="skt-link">-ma</a>] <a href="#entry-saramaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Saramā «Rapide», chienne d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; elle est mère de <a href="#entry-Uzyaama" class="skt-link">Śyāma</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzabala" class="skt-link">Śabala</a>, les chiens des enfers de <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>; [RV.] elle découvrit sur une île de la rivière céleste <a href="#entry-Urasaa" class="skt-link">Rasā</a> la caverne <a href="#entry-Uvala" class="skt-link">Vala</a> où était caché le Soleil, permettant ainsi son retour au solstice d'hiver [<a href="#entry-paritakmyaa" class="skt-link">paritakmyā</a>]; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] elle maudit <a href="#entry-Ujanamejaya" class="skt-link">Janamejaya</a> pour avoir chassé l'un de ses petits lors d'un sacrifice; elle vole des fœtus humains; elle est associée à l'arbre <a href="#entry-kara_nja" class="skt-link">karañja</a>, qui est honoré par les femmes désirant un fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saras">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरस्</span> <i>saras</i> [<a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a><a href="#entry--as" class="skt-link">-as</a>] <a href="#entry-saras" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lac, étang.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरस</span> <i>sarasa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarasā</i> plein de sève, juteux, humide; tonique; vigoureux, puissant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> frais, nouveau; succulent, savoureux; charmant, gracieux, élégant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> passionné, amoureux, plein de désir — ifc. ayant le goût de.<br> <i>sarasam</i> passionnément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarasatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sarasataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'être plein de sève; vigueur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarasatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sarasatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fraîcheur.<br> <a href="#entry-sarasa" class="skt-link">sarasa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarasvat</i> [<a href="#entry-saras" class="skt-link">saras</a><a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarasvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarasvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarasvatī</i> pareil à un lac; qui forme des étangs <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> élégant; sentimental; qui se plaît à ⟨loc.⟩ — <a href="#entry-sarasvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> fleuve, mer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sarasvān, dieu gardien des eaux et de la fertilité — <a href="#entry-sarasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarasvatī</i> myth. np. de Sarasvatī «Gracieuse», épouse-<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> et déesse de la sagesse, de la parole sacrée et de la science; on la représente habillée de blanc et jouant de la <a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a>, et tenant un livre ou une épée symbolisant la connaissance; sa monture est le cygne [<a href="#entry-ha_msa" class="skt-link">haṃsa</a>]; on la dit parfois fille de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; on la célèbre à la fête <a href="#entry-zriipa_ncamii" class="skt-link">śrīpañcamī</a>/<a href="#entry-vasantapa_ncamii" class="skt-link">vasantapañcamī</a>: cf. <a href="#entry-Uiraa" class="skt-link">Irā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukutilaa" class="skt-link">Kutilā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugo" class="skt-link">Go</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaak" class="skt-link">Vāk</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaa_nii" class="skt-link">Vāṇī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzaaradaa" class="skt-link">Śāradā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubraahmii" class="skt-link">Brāhmī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la rivière Sarasvatī_1 «qui forme de nombreux lacs», autrefois affluent de l'Indus [<a href="#entry-Usindhu" class="skt-link">Sindhu</a>] ou fleuve parallèle se jetant dans le marais de Kutch; on pense qu'elle subsiste comme la Sarsutī et la rivière de mousson Ghaggar qui se perdent dans les sables du Rajasthan; myth. c'est une rivière céleste [<a href="#entry-divyagafgaa" class="skt-link">divyagaṅgā</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubrahmanadii" class="skt-link">Brahmanadī</a> — <a href="#entry-sarasvatii" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>sarasvatī</i> soc. np. Sarasvatī_2, titre de renonçant; cf. <a href="#entry-Udayaananda_1" class="skt-link">Dayānanda_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaananda" class="skt-link">Brahmānanda</a>, <a href="#entry-Umadhusuudana_1" class="skt-link">Madhusūdana_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Usatyaananda" class="skt-link">Satyānanda</a>.<br> <i>sarasvatī</i> <i>vandana</i> hommage à <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a>, prononcé lors des cérémonies d'inauguration de lieux de savoir ou d'éducation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasvatiika_n_thaabhara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-ka_n_thaabhara_na" class="skt-link">kaṇṭhābharaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-sarasvatiika_n_thaabhara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa_1 «Collier de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a>», traité sur le style poétique [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] du roi <a href="#entry-Ubhojadeva" class="skt-link">Bhojadeva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa_2, grammaire de sanskrit du même roi; elle était destinée à supplanter l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>; elle influença le <a href="#entry-Usiddhahemazabdaanuzaasana" class="skt-link">Siddhahemaśabdānuśāsana</a> de <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra" class="skt-link">Hemacandra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasvatiika_n_thaabhara_napraasaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇaprāsāda</i> [<a href="#entry-praasaada" class="skt-link">prāsāda</a>] <a href="#entry-sarasvatiika_n_thaabhara_napraasaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. palais du roi <a href="#entry-Ubhojadeva" class="skt-link">Bhojadeva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sarasvatiika_n_thaabhara_na" class="skt-link">sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasvatiivii_naa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarasvatīvīṇā</i> [<a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a>] <a href="#entry-sarasvatiivii_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> luth [<a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a>] d'Inde du Sud.<br> <a href="#entry-saras" class="skt-link">saras</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarasvatiivilaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarasvatīvilāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-vilaasa" class="skt-link">vilāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-sarasvatiivilaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Sarasvatīvilāsa «Divertissement de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a>», précis de droit [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uprataaparudradeva" class="skt-link">Pratāparudradeva</a>; il a deux sections, le Vyavahārakāṇda et l'Ācārakāṇda.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saratha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरथ</span> <i>saratha</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ratha" class="skt-link">ratha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saratha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saratha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarathaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarathā</i> compagnon de char.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarayu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरयु</span> <i>sarayu</i> [<a href="#entry-sara" class="skt-link">sara</a>] <a href="#entry-sarayu" class="skt-link">m.</a> air, vent — <a href="#entry-sarayu" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la Sarayu, rivière du <a href="#entry-Ukosala" class="skt-link">Kosala</a> coulant à <a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a>, affluent (ou section avale) du <a href="#entry-Ugharghara" class="skt-link">Gharghara</a>-Gogra (mod. Surjū), tributaire de la <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>sarayū</i> géo. np. de la Sarayū (id. plus tardif).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरशन</span> <i>saraśana</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-razanaa" class="skt-link">raśanā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarazana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarazanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saraśanā</i> qui porte une ceinture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्ग</span> <i>sarga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-s_rj_1" class="skt-link">sṛj_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> émission, création, émanation, production; créature, progéniture <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> le monde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. cycle de création du monde; cf. <a href="#entry-praak_rtasarga" class="skt-link">prākṛtasarga</a>, <a href="#entry-pratisarga" class="skt-link">pratisarga</a>; <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">pañcalakṣaṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] l'évolution naturelle de la matière; cf. <a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> livre, chapitre, section <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nature, disposition; effort, volonté — <a href="#entry-sargaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sargā</i> ifc. id.<br> <i>sarge</i> adv. ici-bas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरित्</span> <i>sarit</i> [<a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sarit" class="skt-link">f.</a> rivière, cours d'eau; source.<br> <i>saritāṃ</i> <i>varā</i> [«La meilleure des rivières»] Gange.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saro">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरो</span> <i>saro</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-saras" class="skt-link">saras</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saro_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरोष</span> <i>saroṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ro_sa" class="skt-link">roṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saro_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saro_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saro_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saroṣā</i> irrité.<br> <i>saroṣam</i> adv. avec colère.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saroruh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saroruh</i> [<a href="#entry-ruh_2" class="skt-link">ruh_2</a>] <a href="#entry-saroruh" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«qui pousse dans un lac»] lotus <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>saroruha</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarovara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarovara</i> [<a href="#entry-vara_2" class="skt-link">vara_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sarovara" class="skt-link">n.</a> large étang (assez profond pour le lotus), lac.<br> <a href="#entry-saro" class="skt-link">saro</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्प्</span> <i>sarp</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-s_rp" class="skt-link">sṛp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(sarpayati)</i> faire ramper.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्प</span> <i>sarpa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-s_rp" class="skt-link">sṛp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarpa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarpii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarpī</i> qui rampe — <a href="#entry-sarpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> serpent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sarpa «Serpent», l'un des 11 souffles divins [<a href="#entry-marut" class="skt-link">marut</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sarpās</i> myth. catégorie d'êtres mythiques; astr. ils président le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Uaazle_saas" class="skt-link">Āśleṣās</a> (Hydre) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. serpent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्पण</span> <i>sarpaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-s_rp" class="skt-link">sṛp</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> action de ramper, de s'échapper <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. véd. procession où les officiants lancent en l'air le <a href="#entry-prastara" class="skt-link">prastara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpabali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpabali</i> [<a href="#entry-bali" class="skt-link">bali</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpabali" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. sacrifice de serpents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpabandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpabandha</i> [<a href="#entry-bandha" class="skt-link">bandha</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpabandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [«diagramme serpentin»] sculpture de serpent dans le temple <a href="#entry-Umahaakaalezvara" class="skt-link">Mahākāleśvara</a> à <a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>, qui illustre la morphologie flexionnelle du sanskrit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpadevajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpadevajana</i> [<a href="#entry-devajana" class="skt-link">devajana</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpadevajana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. la gent des dieux et des serpents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpadevajanavidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpadevajanavidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpadevajanavidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. la science des êtres divins, un genre littéraire.<br> <a href="#entry-sarpadevajana" class="skt-link">sarpadevajana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpamauli">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpamauli</i> [<a href="#entry-mauli" class="skt-link">mauli</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpamauli" class="skt-link">m.</a> style de représentation de la chevelure de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> avec des serpents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpasattra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpasattra</i> [<a href="#entry-sattra" class="skt-link">sattra</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpasattra" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] grand sacrifice des serpents, effectué par <a href="#entry-Ujanamejaya" class="skt-link">Janamejaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpasattrin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpasattrin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarpasattrin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarpasattrin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarpasattri_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarpasattriṇī</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Sarpasattrī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ujanamejaya" class="skt-link">Janamejaya</a> «Qui célébra le sacrifice des serpents».<br> <a href="#entry-sarpasattra" class="skt-link">sarpasattra</a> <br> <a href="#entry-sarpa" class="skt-link">sarpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpavivara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpavivara</i> [<a href="#entry-vivara" class="skt-link">vivara</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpavivara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarpavivara" class="skt-link">n.</a> trou de serpent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpi_hku_n_dikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarpiḥkuṇḍikā</i> [<a href="#entry-ku_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">kuṇḍikā</a>] <a href="#entry-sarpi_hku_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pot de beurre clarifié.<br> <a href="#entry-sarpis" class="skt-link">sarpis</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्पिन्</span> <i>sarpin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-s_rp" class="skt-link">sṛp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarpin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarpin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarpi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarpiṇī</i> qui rampe.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarpis">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्पिस्</span> <i>sarpis</i> <a href="#entry-sarpis" class="skt-link">n.</a> beurre clarifié; graisse.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarudita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरुदित</span> <i>sarudita</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-rudita" class="skt-link">rudita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarudita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarudita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saruditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saruditā</i> sanglant.<br> <i>saruditam</i> adv. avec du sang.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-saruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सरूप</span> <i>sarūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-saruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-saruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-saruupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarūpā</i> de même forme, pareil à, semblable à, à l'image de ⟨g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à la forme gracieuse, beau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्व</span> <i>sarva</i> pn. <a href="#entry-sarva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvā</i> tout; tout entier, universel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ολος; lat. <i>sollus</i>.<br> <i>sarvam</i> adv. complètement.<br> <i>sarve'pi</i> tous ensemble.<br> <i>sarva</i> <i>ko'pi</i> tous sans exception.<br> <i>te</i> <i>sarve</i> eux tous.<br> <i>gavāṃ</i> <i>sarvam</i> tout ce qui provient de la vache.<br> <i>sarveṣāṃsvastirbhavatu</i> <i>sarveṣāṃśāntirbhavatu</i> <i>sarveṣāmpūrṇambhavatu</i> <i>sarveṣāmmaṅgalambhavatu</i> Bonne chance à tous, paix à tous, abondance à tous, bonheur à tous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarva_msaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvaṃsaha</i> [<a href="#entry-saha_1" class="skt-link">saha_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarva_msaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarva_msaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarva_msahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvaṃsahā</i> qui supporte tout patiemment — <a href="#entry-sarva_msahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvaṃsahā</i> la Terre.<br> <a href="#entry-sarvam" class="skt-link">sarvam</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāc</i> [<a href="#entry-ac" class="skt-link">ac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvaac" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaac" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvācī</i> qui va dans toutes les directions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaadi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvādi</i> [<a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaadi" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. le commencement de toutes choses — a. <a href="#entry-sarvaadi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaadi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaadi" class="skt-link">f.</a> quelqu'en soit le commencement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> le corps entier — a. <a href="#entry-sarvaafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaafgii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvāṅgī</i> complet, qui a toutes ses parties; total; parfait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> indonesian sarong.<br> <i>sarvāṅgam</i> adv. entièrement, totalement; sous tous ses aspects.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaafgaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāṅgāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaafgaasana" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] posture de la chandelle.<br> <a href="#entry-sarvaafga" class="skt-link">sarvāṅga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaah_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सर्वाह्ण</span> <i>sarvāhṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-sarvaahna" class="skt-link">sarvāhna</a>] la journée entière.<br> <i>sarvāhṇam</i> adv. toute la journée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaahna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāhna</i> var. <i>sarvāhṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-ahna" class="skt-link">ahna</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaahna" class="skt-link">n.</a> la journée entière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaanukrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvānukrama</i> [<a href="#entry-anukrama" class="skt-link">anukrama</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaanukrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. index complet d'un ouvrage, not. du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaanukrama_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaanukrama_naka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvānukramaṇaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvaanukrama_naka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaanukrama_naka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaanukrama_nikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvānukramaṇikā</i> lit. qui donne un index complet.<br> <a href="#entry-sarvaanukrama_na" class="skt-link">sarvānukramaṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaanurakta">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaapahaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāpahāra</i> [<a href="#entry-apahaara" class="skt-link">apahāra</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaapahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de tout prendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaapahaaralopa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāpahāralopa</i> [<a href="#entry-lopa" class="skt-link">lopa</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaapahaaralopa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. élision de tous les marqueurs d'un suffixe [<a href="#entry-pratyaya" class="skt-link">pratyaya</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-sarvaapahaara" class="skt-link">sarvāpahāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaastivaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāstivāda</i> [<a href="#entry-asti" class="skt-link">asti</a>-<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaastivaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. école du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> professant la doctrine selon laquelle tout est réel; c'est l'une des 4 écoles du bouddhisme optionnel [<a href="#entry-vaibhaa_sika" class="skt-link">vaibhāṣika</a>]; on dit qu'elle fut fondée par <a href="#entry-Uraahula" class="skt-link">Rāhula</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaastivaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvāstivādin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvaastivaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. tenant de cette doctrine.<br> <a href="#entry-sarvaastivaada" class="skt-link">sarvāstivāda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabaahya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> l'être complet; corps et âme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. tous les êtres.<br> <i>sarvabhāvena</i> var. <i>sarvabhāvais</i> de tout son cœur; corps et âme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhak_sa" class="skt-link">bhakṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvabhakṣā</i> qui mange de tout; omnivore.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhak_saka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhakṣaka</i> [<a href="#entry-bhak_saka" class="skt-link">bhakṣaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_saka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_saka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_sakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvabhakṣakā</i> qui mange tout <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. se dit d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> condamné par <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a> à manger tout et n'importe quoi pour avoir révélé <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_2" class="skt-link">Pulomā_2</a> à <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhak_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhakṣin</i> [<a href="#entry-bhak_sin" class="skt-link">bhakṣin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhak_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvabhakṣiṇī</i> qui mange de tout; omnivore.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhoga</i> [<a href="#entry-bhoga_2" class="skt-link">bhoga_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvabhoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> pleine jouissance (d'un bien).
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhogasamanvita</i> [<a href="#entry-samanvita" class="skt-link">samanvita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvabhogasamanvita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhogasamanvita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhogasamanvitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvabhogasamanvitā</i> soc. doté de la pleine jouissance (d'un bien).<br> <a href="#entry-sarvabhoga" class="skt-link">sarvabhoga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhogin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhogin</i> [<a href="#entry-bhogin_2" class="skt-link">bhogin_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvabhogin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhogin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhoginii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvabhoginī</i> qui a la pleine jouissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhuumi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhūmi</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuumi" class="skt-link">bhūmi</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvabhuumi" class="skt-link">f.</a> la Terre entière — a. <a href="#entry-sarvabhuumi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhuumi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhuumi" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui possède la Terre entière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhūta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvabhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvabhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvabhūtā</i> qui existe partout, universel — <a href="#entry-sarvabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. toutes les créatures.<br> <i>yac</i> <i>cāpi</i> <i>sarvabhūtānāṃ</i> <i>bījaṃ</i> <i>tad</i> <i>aham</i> [BhG.] (<a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> s'adressant à <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a>) Cette source même de tous les êtres, c'est moi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvabhuutaatman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvabhūtātman</i> [<a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvabhuutaatman" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. l'essence de tous les êtres, l'âme universelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sarvabhuuta" class="skt-link">sarvabhūta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvadaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvadamana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvadamana</i> [<a href="#entry-damana" class="skt-link">damana</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvadamana" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. de Sarvadamana «qui peut tout dominer», fils de <a href="#entry-Uzakuntalaa" class="skt-link">Śakuntalā</a> répudiée par <a href="#entry-Udu_syanta" class="skt-link">Duṣyanta</a>; il vécut à l'ermitage de <a href="#entry-Uka_nva" class="skt-link">Kaṇva</a>, et gagna son nom par son courage; reconnu plus tard par son père, il devint le <a href="#entry-cakravartin" class="skt-link">cakravartin</a> <a href="#entry-Ubharata" class="skt-link">Bharata</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvadarzana">

    <i>sarvadarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvadarzana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvadarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvadarzanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvadarśanā</i> œcuménique, universel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvadarzanasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvadarśanasiddhānta</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>-<a href="#entry-siddhaanta" class="skt-link">siddhānta</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvadarzanasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Sarvadarśanasiddhānta «Compendium de tous les dogmes», œuvre de philosophie attribuée à <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sarvadarzana" class="skt-link">sarvadarśana</a>
  </div>
</div>

    <i>sarvadhārin</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaarin" class="skt-link">dhārin</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvadhaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> np. de Sarvadhārī «qui possède tout», personnifiant l'an 22 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvadhaatu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvadhātu</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaatu" class="skt-link">dhātu</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvadhaatu" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-saarvadhaatuka" class="skt-link">sārvadhātuka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvadharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvadharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvadharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvadharma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvadharmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvadharmā</i> relatif à toutes les lois — <a href="#entry-sarvadharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. toutes les lois.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvadharmasamabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvadharmasamabhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-samabhaava" class="skt-link">samabhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-sarvadharmasamabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. tolérance envers toutes les religions.<br> <a href="#entry-sarvadharma" class="skt-link">sarvadharma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sarvaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sarvaga</i> [<a href="#entry-ga_1" class="skt-link">ga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sarvaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvaga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sarvagaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sarvagā</i> omniprésent; immanent.
