    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सौवीर</span> <i>sauvīra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-suviira" class="skt-link">suvīra</a>] <a href="#entry-sauviira" class="skt-link">m.</a> relatif au peuple <a href="#entry-suviira" class="skt-link">suvīra</a>; son roi; syn. <a href="#entry-saindhava" class="skt-link">saindhava</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sauvīrās</i> population <a href="#entry-suviira" class="skt-link">suvīra</a> — <a href="#entry-sauviira" class="skt-link">n.</a> gruau aigre (eau de riz bouilli fermentée).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sauviiraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sauvīraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-sauviiraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme du peuple <a href="#entry-suviira" class="skt-link">suvīra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sauviira" class="skt-link">sauvīra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sava_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सव</span> <i>sava_1</i> [act. <a href="#entry-su_2" class="skt-link">su_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sava_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> pressurage (not. du <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>) — <a href="#entry-sava_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> jus; suc, nectar.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sava_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सव</span> <i>sava_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-suu_1" class="skt-link">sū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sava_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> instigateur; incitateur — <a href="#entry-sava_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> incitation, impulsion, ordre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inauguration, consécration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sava, épith. du Soleil <a href="#entry-Usavitaa" class="skt-link">Savitā</a> l'Incitateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savana_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सवन</span> <i>savana_1</i> [act. <a href="#entry-su_2" class="skt-link">su_2</a>] <a href="#entry-savana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> action de pressurer (not. le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jus de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>; libation <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savana_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सवन</span> <i>savana_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-suu_1" class="skt-link">sū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-savana_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> incitation, instigation; commande — ifc. soc. prière pour obtenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सवर्ण</span> <i>savarṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-var_na" class="skt-link">varṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savarṇā</i> qui est de la même couleur ou caste que; identique, qui a le même aspect que <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> homogène, uniforme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. (consonnes) du même groupe [<a href="#entry-varga" class="skt-link">varga</a>] — <a href="#entry-savar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savarṇā</i> myth. np. de Savarṇā «Identique (à <a href="#entry-Usara_nyuu" class="skt-link">Saraṇyū</a>)», fabriquée par <a href="#entry-Usara_nyuu" class="skt-link">Saraṇyū</a> pour la remplacer auprès de son époux <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>; elle est mère de <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savar_nana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>savarṇana</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-savar_nana" class="skt-link">n.</a> math. réduction au même dénominateur.<br> <a href="#entry-savar_na" class="skt-link">savarṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सवर</span> <i>savara</i> cf. <a href="#entry-zabara" class="skt-link">śabara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savi_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सविष</span> <i>saviṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vi_sa" class="skt-link">viṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savi_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savi_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savi_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saviṣā</i> empoisonné, venimeux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savicaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सविचार</span> <i>savicāra</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaara" class="skt-link">vicāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savicaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savicaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savicārā</i> avec réflexion, avec introspection; avec hésitation; opp. <a href="#entry-nirvicaara" class="skt-link">nirvicāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savikalpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सविकल्प</span> <i>savikalpa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vikalpa" class="skt-link">vikalpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savikalpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savikalpa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savikalpaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savikalpā</i> différencié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] qualifie le <a href="#entry-samaadhi" class="skt-link">samādhi</a> où l'identification à l'objet se fait en restant conscient de son identité; opp. <a href="#entry-nirvikalpa" class="skt-link">nirvikalpa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savikalpaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>savikalpaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savikalpaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savikalpaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savikalpakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savikalpakā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] se dit de connaissance discriminante; opp. <a href="#entry-nirvikalpaka" class="skt-link">nirvikalpaka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-savikalpa" class="skt-link">savikalpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savinaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सविनय</span> <i>savinaya</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vinaya" class="skt-link">vinaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savinaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savinaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savinayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savinayā</i> modeste, bien élevé.<br> <i>savinayam</i> adv. modestement, poliment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savit_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सवितृ</span> <i>savitṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-suu_1" class="skt-link">sū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savit_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savit_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savitrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savitrī</i> stimulateur, incitateur; producteur, créateur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. véd. np. du dieu créateur Savitā, radieux [<a href="#entry-aaditya" class="skt-link">āditya</a>] du Soleil levant, «l'Incitateur» aux mains d'or [<a href="#entry-Uhira_nyahasta" class="skt-link">Hiraṇyahasta</a>]; il symbolise le pouvoir magique du Verbe identifié au pouvoir procréateur du Soleil [<a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>]; astr. il préside le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Uhasta" class="skt-link">Hasta</a> (Corbeau); il est célébré dans la <a href="#entry-gaayatrii" class="skt-link">gāyatrī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savitarka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सवितर्क</span> <i>savitarka</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vitarka" class="skt-link">vitarka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savitarka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savitarka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savitarkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savitarkā</i> raisonné, avec réflexion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] qualifie le premier stade de <a href="#entry-samaadhi" class="skt-link">samādhi</a>, où le <a href="#entry-yogin" class="skt-link">yogin</a> continue de raisonner sur le sujet de sa méditation.<br> <i>savitarkam</i> adv. en réfléchissant, à la réflexion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सव्य</span> <i>savya</i> a. <a href="#entry-savya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savyā</i> gauche; à gauche; opp. <a href="#entry-dak_si_na" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> opposé, contraire — <a href="#entry-savya" class="skt-link">m.</a> main gauche, bras gauche.<br> <i>savyaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> porter le cordon sacré [<a href="#entry-yaj_nopaviita" class="skt-link">yajñopavīta</a>] sur l'épaule gauche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savya_s_thaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>savyaṣṭhā</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaa_2" class="skt-link">sthā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-savya_s_thaa" class="skt-link">m.</a> guerrier se tenant à gauche d'un char.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savyabhicaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सव्यभिचार</span> <i>savyabhicāra</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vyabhicaara" class="skt-link">vyabhicāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savyabhicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savyabhicaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savyabhicaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savyabhicārā</i> de validité douteuse; dont la preuve est incorrecte — <a href="#entry-savyabhicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] utilisation d'un argument trop général.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savyasaacin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>savyasācin</i> [<a href="#entry-saacin" class="skt-link">sācin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-savyasaacin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-savyasaacin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-savyasaacinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>savyasācinī</i> adroit [«qui atteint (même) de la (main) gauche»]; ambidextre — <a href="#entry-savyasaacin" class="skt-link">m.</a> gaucher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Savyasācin, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> «l'Adroit» (qui peut tirer l'arc <a href="#entry-Ugaa_n_diiva" class="skt-link">Gāṇḍīva</a> même de la main gauche).<br> <a href="#entry-savya" class="skt-link">savya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-savyatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>savyatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. à gauche; du côté gauche; de la main gauche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du mauvais côté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sayuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सयुज्</span> <i>sayuj</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yuj_2" class="skt-link">yuj_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sayuj" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sayuj" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sayuj" class="skt-link">f.</a> uni avec — <a href="#entry-sayuj" class="skt-link">m.</a> compagnon, camarade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sayujya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सयुज्य</span> <i>sayujya</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yujya" class="skt-link">yujya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sayujya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sayujya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sayujyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sayujyā</i> très proche, intime; uni avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sayujyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sayujyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sayujyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> intimité; union.<br> <a href="#entry-sayujya" class="skt-link">sayujya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sazabda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सशब्द</span> <i>saśabda</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-zabda" class="skt-link">śabda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sazabda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sazabda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sazabdaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saśabdā</i> bruyant.<br> <i>saśabdam</i> adv. avec fracas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सञ्च</span> <i>sañca</i> <a href="#entry-sa_nca" class="skt-link">m.</a> feuillets pour écrire; cahier, carnet de notes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचार्</span> <i>saṃcār</i> var. <i>sañcār</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sa_ncar" class="skt-link">saṃcar</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃcārayati)</i> faire aller, mettre en mouvement, ébranler, agiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचार</span> <i>saṃcāra</i> var. <i>sañcāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_ncar" class="skt-link">saṃcar</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mcaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> circulation, mouvement, cours; fréquentation, passage, traversée; chemin, route.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचारिन्</span> <i>saṃcārin</i> var. <i>sañcārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_ncar" class="skt-link">saṃcar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mcaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃcāriṇī</i> qui circule, qui marche; mobile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui se propage, qui passe de l'un à l'autre; contagieux; héréditaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contigu; limitrophe — ifc. chez.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sañcaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_ncaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> sceau — <a href="#entry-sa_ncikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sañcikā</i> cahier.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_nca" class="skt-link">sañca</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचर्</span> <i>saṃcar</i> var. <i>sañcar</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-car" class="skt-link">car</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃcarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃcarita</i><i>)</i> aller ensemble, se rencontrer; parcourir, voyager, traverser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vivre, exister, se produire — ca. <i>(saṃcārayati)</i> faire aller, mettre en mouvement, ébranler, agiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचय</span> <i>saṃcaya</i> var. <i>sañcaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_nci" class="skt-link">saṃci</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mcaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> collection; accumulation, entassement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tas, multitude; richesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nchad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संछद्</span> <i>saṃchad</i> var. <i>sañchad</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-chad_1" class="skt-link">chad_1</a>] pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃchanna</i><i>)</i> ca. <i>(saṃchādayati)</i> couvrir complètement, envelopper; recouvrir, cacher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nchanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संछन्न</span> <i>saṃchanna</i> var. <i>sañchanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_nchad" class="skt-link">saṃchad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mchanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mchanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_nchannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sañchannā</i> entièrement recouvert; caché, dissimulé; obscur, inconnu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nci">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचि</span> <i>saṃci</i> var. <i>sañci</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-ci" class="skt-link">ci</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(saṃcinoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(saṃcinute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃcita</i><i>)</i> entasser, accumuler, rassembler, acquérir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncint">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचिन्त्</span> <i>saṃcint</i> var. <i>sañcint</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-cint" class="skt-link">cint</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(saṃcintayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃcintita</i><i>)</i> ppr. md. <i>(saṃcintayāna)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>saṃcintya</i><i>)</i> songer à, se préoccuper de ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncintayaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचिन्तयान</span> <i>saṃcintayāna</i> var. <i>sañcintayāna</i> [ppr. md. <a href="#entry-sa_ncint" class="skt-link">saṃcint</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mcintayaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcintayaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcintayaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃcintayānā</i> qui réfléchit, qui pense.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncintya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचिन्त्य</span> <i>saṃcintya</i> var. <i>sañcintya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sa_ncint" class="skt-link">saṃcint</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mcintya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcintya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcintyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃcintyā</i> qui mérite la réflexion, à considérer, à quoi il faut penser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचित</span> <i>saṃcita</i> var. <i>sañcita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_nci" class="skt-link">saṃci</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mcita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mcitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃcitā</i> accumulé, entassé, assemblé, collecté; acquis <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dense, plein <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. part du <a href="#entry-karma" class="skt-link">karma</a> accumulé qui portera fruit en temps voulu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_ncud">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संचुद्</span> <i>saṃcud</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-cud" class="skt-link">cud</a>] ca. <i>(saṃcodayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃcudita</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(saṃcodayat)</i> inciter, pousser, conduire; exciter, stimuler; ordonner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सञ्ज्</span> <i>sañj</i> var. <i>saj</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sajati)</i> pr. md. <i>(sajate)</i> pft. <i>(sasañja)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sakta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> adhérer — ps. <i>(sajjate)</i> être attaché à, être suspendu à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être dévoué, être attaché, tenir à (affectivement); penser constamment à ⟨loc.⟩ — ca. <i>(sajjayati)</i> faire adhérer; s'engager dans ⟨loc.⟩, s'attacher à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prostituer, livrer (sa femme) à autri <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>segnis</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_njan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संजन्</span> <i>saṃjan</i> var. <i>sañjan</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-jan" class="skt-link">jan</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(saṃjāyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃjāta</i><i>)</i> [«être produit simultanément»] naître, se produire — ca. <i>(saṃjanayati)</i> concevoir, engendrer, produire, créer, former, causer.<br> <i>tasya</i> <i>saṃjanayan</i> <i>harṣam</i> [BhG.] Pour se mettre en joie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_njaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संजय</span> <i>saṃjaya</i> var. <i>sañjaya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_nji" class="skt-link">saṃji</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mjaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Sañjaya «qui les vainc tous», barde de <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>; il connaît le passé, le présent et le futur par sa vision divine [<a href="#entry-divyacak_sus" class="skt-link">divyacakṣus</a>]; il fit ambassade auprès de <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> à <a href="#entry-Uupaplavya" class="skt-link">Upaplavya</a> pour tenter d'éviter la guerre; il raconta la grande bataille à <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nji">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संजि</span> <i>saṃji</i> var. <i>sañji</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-ji" class="skt-link">ji</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃjayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃjita</i><i>)</i> vaincre à la fois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_njiiv">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संजीव्</span> <i>saṃjīv</i> var. <i>sañjīv</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-jiiv" class="skt-link">jīv</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(saṃjīvati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃjīvita</i><i>)</i> revenir à la vie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_njiiva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संजीव</span> <i>saṃjīva</i> var. <i>sañjīva</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_njiiv" class="skt-link">saṃjīv</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mjiiva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mjiiva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃjīvā</i> vivifiant; qui redonne vie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_njiivaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संजीवक</span> <i>saṃjīvaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_njiiv" class="skt-link">saṃjīv</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃjīvikā</i> qui rappelle à la vie — <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [PT.] np. du taureau Saṃjīvaka, ami du roi-lion <a href="#entry-Upifgalaka_1" class="skt-link">Piṅgalaka_1</a>; il sera perdu par la jalousie du chacal <a href="#entry-Udamanaka" class="skt-link">Damanaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_njiivakara_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃjīvakaraṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_nii" class="skt-link">karaṇī</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivakara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. cf. <a href="#entry-sa_njiivanii" class="skt-link">saṃjīvanī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_njiiva" class="skt-link">saṃjīva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_njiivana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संजीवन</span> <i>saṃjīvana</i> var. <i>sañjīvana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_njiiv" class="skt-link">saṃjīv</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃjīvanī</i> vivifiant; qui anime ou redonne vie — <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivana" class="skt-link">n.</a> résurrection, vie — <a href="#entry-sa_mjiivanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃjīvanī</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] herbe de résurrection <a href="#entry-sa_njiivanii" class="skt-link">saṃjīvanī</a> ou <a href="#entry-sa_njiivakara_nii" class="skt-link">saṃjīvakaraṇī</a>, rapportée par <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> de l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a> pour guérir l'armée de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [BhP.] la science de la résurrection, possédée par <a href="#entry-Uzukra" class="skt-link">Śukra</a>; il l'utilisa pour rendre à la vie <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a> mort au combat contre les dieux; il en transmis le secret à <a href="#entry-Ukaca" class="skt-link">Kaca</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_naa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संज्ञा</span> <i>saṃjñā_1</i> var. <i>sañjñā</i> [<a href="#entry-sam" class="skt-link">sam</a>-<a href="#entry-j_naa_1" class="skt-link">jñā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(saṃjānāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>saṃjñāta</i><i>)</i> assigner; comprendre, avoir conscience de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_naa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संज्ञा</span> <i>saṃjñā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_1" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mj_naa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> harmonie, consentement; conscience; perception, compréhension commune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> signe, signal; nom, référence, désignation, appellation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. nom propre; mot autonyme, dénotant sa propre forme; terme technique, métanotion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. mot dont le genre ou le nombre sont conventionnels <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la conscience individuelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la perception, un des 5 agrégats [<a href="#entry-skandha" class="skt-link">skandha</a>] de l'ego <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sañjñā «Conscience», fille de <a href="#entry-Uvizvakarmaa" class="skt-link">Viśvakarmā</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a> dont elle engendra <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvaivasvata" class="skt-link">Vaivasvata</a>, <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a> et <a href="#entry-Uyamii" class="skt-link">Yamī</a>; ne pouvant supporter l'ardeur de son époux, elle se fit remplacer par sa servante l'Ombre [<a href="#entry-Uchaayaa" class="skt-link">Chāyā</a>] et se transforma en jument pour se consacrer à la méditation; <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a> la suivit et ils donnèrent naissance aux <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a> et à <a href="#entry-Urevanta" class="skt-link">Revanta</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvizvakarmaa" class="skt-link">Viśvakarmā</a> rabota alors le huitième de l'éclat du Soleil pour qu'elle puisse le supporter; cf. <a href="#entry-Usara_nyuu" class="skt-link">Saraṇyū</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>saññā</i>.<br> <i>saṃjñāṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> faire signe.<br> <i>saṃjñāṃ</i> <i>dā</i> donner un signe.<br> <i>saṃjñāyām</i> loc. adv. gram. utilisé en tant que nom propre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_naana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संज्ञान</span> <i>saṃjñāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_1" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mj_naana" class="skt-link">n.</a> état conscient; état de perception correcte, bonne conception.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_naanasuukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃjñānasūkta</i> [<a href="#entry-suukta" class="skt-link">sūkta</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mj_naanasuukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. hymne terminal du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a> (10 . 191), prônant la fraternité.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_nj_naana" class="skt-link">saṃjñāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_naasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>saṃjñāsūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-sa_mj_naasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. [<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>] règle [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] définissant un terme technique.<br> <a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_2" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_naata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संज्ञात</span> <i>saṃjñāta</i> var. <i>sañjñāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_1" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mj_naata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mj_naata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mj_naataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃjñātā</i> bien connu, compris — ifc. à l'intention de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_nin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संज्ञिन्</span> <i>saṃjñin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_1" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mj_nin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mj_nin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mj_ninii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃjñinī</i> conscient; conscient de ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nommé, défini <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. notion définie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sa_nj_nita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">संज्ञित</span> <i>saṃjñita</i> var. <i>sañjñita</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_1" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sa_mj_nita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mj_nita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mj_nitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>saṃjñitā</i> communiqué — ifc. appelé, nommé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-se_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेट्</span> <i>seṭ</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-i_t" class="skt-link">iṭ</a>] nota. gram. se dit des racines se conjuguant avec un ‘i’ intercalaire (opp. <a href="#entry-ani_t" class="skt-link">aniṭ</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sec">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेच्</span> <i>sec</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sic" class="skt-link">sic</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(secayati)</i> répandre, arroser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-secana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेचन</span> <i>secana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sic" class="skt-link">sic</a>] <a href="#entry-secana" class="skt-link">n.</a> arrosage, aspersion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-seka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेक</span> <i>seka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sic" class="skt-link">sic</a>] <a href="#entry-seka" class="skt-link">m.</a> aspersion, arrosage, action de verser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> émission de liquide; éjaculation, sperme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेन</span> <i>sena</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेना</span> <i>senā</i> <a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> trait, javelot, missile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> armée; armé en rang de bataille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>senāmukha</i>] troupe de 3 éléphants et chars, 9 cavaliers, 15 fantassins — <a href="#entry-sena" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>sena</i> ifc. id. — <a href="#entry-sena" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>sena</i> ifc. hist. forme des noms de princes de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Usena" class="skt-link">Sena</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaadhipati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senādhipati</i> [<a href="#entry-adhipati" class="skt-link">adhipati</a>] <a href="#entry-senaadhipati" class="skt-link">m.</a> général en chef d'un corps d'armées.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaagra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senāgra</i> [<a href="#entry-agra" class="skt-link">agra</a>] <a href="#entry-senaagra" class="skt-link">n.</a> front d'une armée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaagraga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senāgraga</i> [<a href="#entry-ga_1" class="skt-link">ga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-senaagraga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-senaagraga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-senaagragaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>senāgragā</i> qui marche en tête d'une armée; général.<br> <a href="#entry-senaagra" class="skt-link">senāgra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaajit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senājit</i> [<a href="#entry-jit" class="skt-link">jit</a>] a. <a href="#entry-senaajit" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-senaajit" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-senaajit" class="skt-link">f.</a> «à l'armée victorieuse», nom de princes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>senajit</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaamukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senāmukha</i> [<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] <a href="#entry-senaamukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> troupe formée de 3 pelotons [<a href="#entry-patti" class="skt-link">patti</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-gulma" class="skt-link">gulma</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaanii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senānī</i> [<a href="#entry-nii_2" class="skt-link">nī_2</a>] <a href="#entry-senaanii" class="skt-link">m.</a> commandant d'armée; général.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senaapati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senāpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-senaapati" class="skt-link">m.</a> général d'armée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Senāpati «Chef de l'armée (des dieux)», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-senakula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>senakula</i> [<a href="#entry-kula" class="skt-link">kula</a>] <a href="#entry-senakula" class="skt-link">n.</a> hist. famille de la dynastie Sena, originaire du pays <a href="#entry-Ukanna_da" class="skt-link">Kannaḍa</a>, qui régna au Bengale aux 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ et 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles; son fondateur <a href="#entry-Uhemantasena" class="skt-link">Hemantasena</a> prit son indépendance de l'Empire <a href="#entry-Upaala" class="skt-link">Pāla</a> en 1095; l'hindouïsme <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> fut promu, et les bouddhistes persécutés.<br> <a href="#entry-sena" class="skt-link">sena</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sendra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेन्द्र</span> <i>sendra</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-indra" class="skt-link">indra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sendra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sendra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sendraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sendrā</i> myth. accompagné d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-setu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेतु</span> <i>setu</i> <a href="#entry-setu" class="skt-link">m.</a> digue, barrage; pont; frontière; limite infranchissable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) norme à respecter, tabou.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-setubandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>setubandha</i> [<a href="#entry-bandha" class="skt-link">bandha</a>] <a href="#entry-setubandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> construction d'un pont, d'un barrage ou d'une digue <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] construction de la jetée de rochers liant <a href="#entry-Uraamezvara" class="skt-link">Rāmeśvara</a> à l'île de <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a>, construite par <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> avec son armée de singes pour en permettre l'accès à l'armée de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Setubandha, poème sur la geste de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> en <a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">prākṛta</a> attribué à <a href="#entry-Upravarasena_1" class="skt-link">Pravarasena_1</a>; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uraava_navaha" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇavaha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Setubandha, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Uvaamakezvaratantra" class="skt-link">Vāmakeśvaratantra</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Ubhaaskararaaya" class="skt-link">Bhāskararāya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-setubandhaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>setubandhāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-setubandhaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> posture de yoga «en forme de pont».<br> <a href="#entry-setubandha" class="skt-link">setubandha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-setu" class="skt-link">setu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sev">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेव्</span> <i>sev</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(sevate)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>seviṣyate</i><i>)</i> pft. <i>(siṣeve)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sevita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>sevanīya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>ni</i><i>)</i> servir, honorer, rendre hommage à; chérir, élever (enfant); avoir des rapports sexuels avec ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> habiter, vivre à ⟨acc.⟩; vivre près de ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cultiver, pratiquer, se vouer à.<br> <i>etāvānme</i> <i>vibhavo</i> <i>bhavantaṃ</i> <i>sevitum</i> c'est tout ce que je peux faire pour vous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-seva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेव</span> <i>seva</i> [<a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] <a href="#entry-seva" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>sevaphala</i>] pomme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेवा</span> <i>sevā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] <a href="#entry-sevaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> hommage, service; cour faite à ⟨loc. g. iic.⟩; culte — ifc. pratique assidue de; commerce sexuel avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेवक</span> <i>sevaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sevaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sevaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sevikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sevikā</i> qui sert — ifc. qui s'occupe de, qui honore, qui révère — <a href="#entry-sevaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> serviteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aide, courtisan, adepte, volontaire — <a href="#entry-sevikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sevikā</i> servante.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेवन</span> <i>sevana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] <a href="#entry-sevana" class="skt-link">m.</a> service; hommage, révérence (not. du <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commerce sexuel — ifc. service de, hommage de, etc. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pratique assidue de, fait de se vouer à — <a href="#entry-sevanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sevanā</i> hommage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेवनीय</span> <i>sevanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sevaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sevaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sevaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sevanīyā</i> qu'il faut servir, honorer ou courtiser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेविन्</span> <i>sevin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sevin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sevin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sevinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sevinī</i> ifc. qui sert, qui honore; qui habite; qui pratique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> respectueux; courtisan.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेवित</span> <i>sevita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sevita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sevita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sevitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sevitā</i> habité; servi, honoré — ifc. pourvu de, plein de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेव्य</span> <i>sevya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sev" class="skt-link">sev</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sevya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sevya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sevyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sevyā</i> qui doit être habité (par ⟨g.⟩); qui doit être suivi (chemin); qui doit être utilisé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit être honoré; qui doit être servi ou gardé — <a href="#entry-sevya" class="skt-link">m.</a> maître (d'un serviteur).<br> <i>sevyasevaka</i> gram. relation entre maître et serviteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sevyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sevyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> utilisabilité; service (de ⟨g.⟩); fait d'être honoré ou révéré.<br> <i>prayā</i> <i>janasya</i> <i>sevyatām</i> être utile aux gens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sevyatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sevyatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sevyatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> id.<br> <a href="#entry-sevya" class="skt-link">sevya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सेश्वर</span> <i>seśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sezvara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sezvaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>seśvarā</i> phil. théiste; opp. <a href="#entry-niriizvara" class="skt-link">nirīśvara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sezvarasaafkhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>seśvarasāṃkhya</i> [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] <a href="#entry-sezvarasaa_mkhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. forme théiste du <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sezvara" class="skt-link">seśvara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिंह</span> <i>siṃha</i> <a href="#entry-si_mha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. signe zodiacal [<a href="#entry-raazi" class="skt-link">rāśi</a>] du Lion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaava_mza" class="skt-link">Mahāvaṃśa</a>] np. de Siṃha «le Lion», ancêtre mythique des Singhalais [<a href="#entry-Usi_mhalaas" class="skt-link">Siṃhalās</a>]; on dit qu'il épousa Suppadevī, princesse du <a href="#entry-Uvafga" class="skt-link">Vaṅga</a>; il vivait dans une caverne fermée par un rocher; Suppadevī s'en échappa avec son fils et sa fille; plus tard son fils <a href="#entry-Usi_mhabaahu" class="skt-link">Siṃhabāhu</a> revint pour le tuer d'une flèche — ifc. le premier, le meilleur des («un lion parmi les») — <a href="#entry-si_mhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siṃhī</i> lionne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> trône royal (aux accoudoirs décorés de têtes de lion) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] posture «du lion»: assis jambes croisées, chaque cheville sous le testicule opposé, mains posées sur les genoux, doigts écartés, bouche grande ouverte, langue pendante, en concentration oculaire [<a href="#entry-naasaagrad_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">nāsāgradṛṣṭi</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-si_mha" class="skt-link">siṃha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhaavalokana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhāvalokana</i> [<a href="#entry-avalokana" class="skt-link">avalokana</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhaavalokana" class="skt-link">n.</a> regard rétrospectif (not. sur l'œuvre d'une vie); réexamen.<br> <i>siṃhāvalokananyāya</i> [«maxime du regard du lion»] qui regarde en arrière pour voir ce qu'il a laissé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhabaahu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhabāhu</i> [<a href="#entry-baahu" class="skt-link">bāhu</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhabaahu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du roi Siṃhabāhu «aux bras de lion», fils du lion <a href="#entry-Usi_mha" class="skt-link">Siṃha</a>; il tua son père pour une récompense, et on lui proposa le trône du <a href="#entry-Uvafga" class="skt-link">Vaṅga</a>, mais créa sa propre capitale <a href="#entry-Usi_mhapura" class="skt-link">Siṃhapura</a> au <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a>; et épousa sa propre sœur, dont il eut 32 enfants; il bannit son fils aîné dissolu <a href="#entry-Uvijaya_2" class="skt-link">Vijaya_2</a>, qui partit en mer avec 700 compagnons pour devenir <a href="#entry-Usi_mhala" class="skt-link">Siṃhala</a> le fondateur de Ceylan [<a href="#entry-Usi_mhaladviipa" class="skt-link">Siṃhaladvīpa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhadeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhadeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhadeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Siṃhadeva, roi du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> (1286–1301); il succéda à <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_nadeva" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇadeva</a> (1273–1286); sa dynastie Damara remplaça les Lohara; Sūhadeva lui succéda.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhagho_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhaghoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-gho_sa" class="skt-link">ghoṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhagho_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> rugissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [DKC.] np. du prince Siṃhaghoṣa, fils du roi <a href="#entry-Uca_n_dasi_mha" class="skt-link">Caṇḍasiṃha</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukaamapaala" class="skt-link">Kāmapāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिंहल</span> <i>siṃhala</i> [<a href="#entry-si_mha" class="skt-link">siṃha</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhala" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Siṃhala «De la race du lion», patr. du marchand <a href="#entry-Uvijaya_2" class="skt-link">Vijaya_2</a>, petit-fils de <a href="#entry-Usi_mha" class="skt-link">Siṃha</a>; il était parti en mer à la recherche de pierres précieuses avec 700 nobles compagnons; ils firent naufrage, et échouèrent sur l'île de Ceylan [<a href="#entry-Utaamradviipa" class="skt-link">Tāmradvīpa</a>] le jour où <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> passa en <a href="#entry-parinirvaa_na" class="skt-link">parinirvāṇa</a>; ils y furent accueillis par les ogresses [<a href="#entry-raak_sasii" class="skt-link">rākṣasī</a>] qui se transformèrent en jolies nymphes pour les séduire; l'accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] <a href="#entry-Ulokezvara" class="skt-link">Lokeśvara</a> vint les sauver sous la forme du cheval volant <a href="#entry-Ubalaaha" class="skt-link">Balāha</a>; ils devaient s'envoler avec lui, les yeux fermés, sans céder aux appels des nymphes; seul <a href="#entry-Usi_mhala" class="skt-link">Siṃhala</a> eut la foi et fut sauvé; l'île de Ceylan porte son nom en son honneur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>siṃhādvīpa</i>] géo. Ceylan <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>siṃhalās</i> np. des Siṃhalās, les Singhalais.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhaladviipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhaladvīpa</i> [<a href="#entry-dviipa" class="skt-link">dvīpa</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhaladviipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Siṃhaladvīpa, l'île de Ceylan.<br> <a href="#entry-si_mhala" class="skt-link">siṃhala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhanaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhanāda</i> [<a href="#entry-naada" class="skt-link">nāda</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhanaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> rugissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. enseignement de la Loi par le <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de Siṃhapura «Ville du Lion»; plusieurs villes antiques portent ce nom, not. au <a href="#entry-Ulaa_ta" class="skt-link">Lāṭa</a> et au <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. np. de Siṃhapūr ou Singapour, la «Ville du Lion» — <a href="#entry-si_mhapurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siṃhapurī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vikramasi_mhapurii" class="skt-link">vikramasiṃhapurī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhatilaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siṃhatilaka</i> [<a href="#entry-tilaka" class="skt-link">tilaka</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhatilaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du mathématicien et astronome jaïne Siṃhatilaka <a href="#entry-Usuuri" class="skt-link">Sūri</a>; il vécut à Vijāpur au Gujarāt au 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il est l'auteur de commentaires du <a href="#entry-Uga_nitatilaka" class="skt-link">Gaṇitatilaka</a> et du <a href="#entry-Ubhuvanadiipaka" class="skt-link">Bhuvanadīpaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_mhikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिंहिका</span> <i>siṃhikā</i> [<a href="#entry-si_mha" class="skt-link">siṃha</a>-<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-si_mhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asurii" class="skt-link">asurī</a> Siṃhikā «Lionne», sœur de <a href="#entry-Uhira_nyakazipu" class="skt-link">Hiraṇyakaśipu</a>, épouse de Vipracitti, mère de <a href="#entry-Uraahu" class="skt-link">Rāhu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_saadhayi_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिषाधयिष्</span> <i>siṣādhayiṣ</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-saadh" class="skt-link">sādh</a>] v. pr. <i>(siṣādhayiṣati)</i> vouloir l'emporter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-si_saadhayi_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिषाधयिषा</span> <i>siṣādhayiṣā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-si_saadhayi_s" class="skt-link">siṣādhayiṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-si_saadhayi_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir de convaincre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] intention de faire une inférence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sic">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिच्</span> <i>sic</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(siñcati)</i> pft. <i>(siṣeca)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <i>(asicat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sikta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>ava</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>ni</i><i>)</i> verser, répandre, faire couler (not. <a href="#entry-jala" class="skt-link">jala</a>, <a href="#entry-retas" class="skt-link">retas</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arroser, asperger — ps. <i>(sicyate)</i> être versé, couler — ca. <i>(secayati)</i> répandre, arroser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> all. seichen.<br> <i>vṛkṣaṃ</i> <i>vṛkṣaṃ</i> <i>siñcati</i> il arrose chaque arbre l'un après l'autre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddha_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिद्ध</span> <i>siddha_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhā_1</i> accompli, réalisé; gagné, obtenu; parfait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a atteint son but, réalisé son objectif, accompli sa mission <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> achevé, à point, prêt; not. riz <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> stable, immuable, éternel; syn. <a href="#entry-nitya" class="skt-link">nitya</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-kaarya" class="skt-link">kārya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. qui a atteint le but suprême <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> doué de vertus surnaturelles, merveilleux, magique — <a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui a atteint la perfection; saint, bienheureux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> magicien; expert <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. Accompli, être humain devenu immortel et omniscient après avoir obtenu la libération [<a href="#entry-mok_sa" class="skt-link">mokṣa</a>], et doué de pouvoirs magiques [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>]; les <i>siddhās</i> habitent <a href="#entry-Ubhuvar" class="skt-link">Bhuvar</a>, l'Entre-Ciel-et-Terre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (règle) mutuellement applicable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. efficace (<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>, rite) — <a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> magie, surnaturel.<br> <i>iti</i> <i>siddham</i> fin; j'en ai terminé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] CQFD.<br> <i>arthaprāptiśca</i> <i>pratyakṣasiddhā</i> [<a href="#entry-Uvizvanaatha_1" class="skt-link">Viśvanātha_1</a>] L'acquisition de richesses seule est évidence de réussite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddha_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिद्ध</span> <i>siddha_2</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sidh_2" class="skt-link">sidh_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siddha_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddha_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhā_2</i> empêché, écarté, repoussé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> but suprême; conclusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> axiome, truisme; dogme, doctrine; savoir; enseignement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nom générique de certains traités (not. math. astr. et gram.) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [«argumentation conclusive»] textes tantr. shivaïstes respectant la pureté brahmanique, de tendance dualiste; <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> y révèle la connaissance qui mène à la délivrance; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukaamika" class="skt-link">Kāmika</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaantabindu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhāntabindu</i> [<a href="#entry-bindu" class="skt-link">bindu</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaantabindu" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Siddhāntabindu de <a href="#entry-Umadhusuudana_1" class="skt-link">Madhusūdana_1</a> <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_2" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_2</a>, aussi appelé Siddhāntatattvabindhu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaantakaumudii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhāntakaumudī</i> [<a href="#entry-kaumudii" class="skt-link">kaumudī</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaantakaumudii" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de la Siddhāntakaumudī «Élucidation de la doctrine» (de la grammaire de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>); son auteur est <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_toji" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭoji</a> <a href="#entry-Udiik_sita" class="skt-link">Dīkṣita</a> (17⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); son élève <a href="#entry-Uvaradaraaja_1" class="skt-link">Varadarāja_1</a> en fit une version simplifiée pour les étudiants, la <a href="#entry-Ulaghusiddhaantakaumudii" class="skt-link">Laghusiddhāntakaumudī</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ulaghukaumudii" class="skt-link">Laghukaumudī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaantalak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhāntalakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaantalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] définition exacte; définition acceptée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaantasaaraavalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhāntasārāvalī</i> [<a href="#entry-saaraavalii" class="skt-link">sārāvalī</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaantasaaraavalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Siddhāntasārāvalī, traité métrique du <a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Utrilocanaziva" class="skt-link">Trilocanaśiva</a> <a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaantazikhaama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhāntaśikhāmaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-zikhaama_ni" class="skt-link">śikhāmaṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaantazikhaama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Siddhāntaśikhāmaṇi, texte <a href="#entry-viirazaiva" class="skt-link">vīraśaiva</a> du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, dû à Śivayogī Śivācārya.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaantaziroma_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhāntaśiromaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-ziroma_ni" class="skt-link">śiromaṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaantaziroma_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> math. np. du Siddhāntaśiromaṇi «Couronnement de science», traité de mathématique et d'astronomie de <a href="#entry-Ubhaaskaraacaarya_2" class="skt-link">Bhāskarācārya_2</a>; il comprend 4 parties: <a href="#entry-Uliilaavatii" class="skt-link">Līlāvatī</a> (calcul arithmétique), Bījagaṇita (algèbre), Grahagaṇitādhyāya (calcul des planètes) et <a href="#entry-Ugolaadhyaaya" class="skt-link">Golādhyāya</a> (traité des globes terrestre et céleste).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaantin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhāntin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siddhaantin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhaantin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhaantinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhāntinī</i> expert (en science, grammaire ou textes sacrés) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. adepte de la doctrine <a href="#entry-siddhaanta" class="skt-link">siddhānta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-siddhaanta" class="skt-link">siddhānta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siddhaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhaartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhaarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhārthā</i> qui a du succès, qui réussit, efficace; qui a atteint le but — <a href="#entry-siddhaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. du prince népalais Siddhārtha <a href="#entry-Ugautama" class="skt-link">Gautama</a> «l'Accompli», qui deviendra le <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhaarthin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhārthin</i> [<a href="#entry-arthin" class="skt-link">arthin</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhaarthin" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. np. de Siddhārthī «qui cherche la perfection», personnifiant l'an 53 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhagraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhagraha</i> [<a href="#entry-graha" class="skt-link">graha</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhagraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] possession par un accompli.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhahaima">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhahaima</i> [<a href="#entry-haima_2" class="skt-link">haima_2</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhahaima" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-siddhahemacandra" class="skt-link">siddhahemacandra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhahemacandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhahemacandra</i> [<a href="#entry-hemacandra" class="skt-link">hemacandra</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhahemacandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Siddhahemacandra ou <a href="#entry-Usiddhahemazabdaanuzaasana" class="skt-link">Siddhahemaśabdānuśāsana</a> «(grammaire de) <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra" class="skt-link">Hemacandra</a> (dédiée à) Siddha (<i>-rāja</i>)».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhahemazabda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhahemaśabda</i> [<a href="#entry-hema" class="skt-link">hema</a>-<a href="#entry-zabda" class="skt-link">śabda</a>] iic. lit. grammaire de Hema (<i>-candra</i>) dédiée à Siddha (<i>-rāja</i>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhahemazabdaanuzaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhahemaśabdānuśāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-anuzaasana" class="skt-link">anuśāsana</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhahemazabdaanuzaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Siddhahemaśabdānuśāsana, synthèse des grammaires du sanskrit due à <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra" class="skt-link">Hemacandra</a>, sur la commande du roi <a href="#entry-Usiddharaaja" class="skt-link">Siddharāja</a>, qui la fit copier par 300 scribes; on l'appelle aussi Siddhahaima et <a href="#entry-Usiddhahemacandra" class="skt-link">Siddhahemacandra</a>; ses 7 premiers chapitres [<a href="#entry-adhyaaya" class="skt-link">adhyāya</a>] concernent le sanskrit, le 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ est une grammaire du <a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">prākṛta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-siddhahemazabda" class="skt-link">siddhahemaśabda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhakaa_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhakāṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-kaa_n_da" class="skt-link">kāṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhakaa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. partie de l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a> précédant la deuxième section du huitième livre; l'ordre d'application de ses règles dépend de critères de priorité; opp. <a href="#entry-asiddhakaa_n_da" class="skt-link">asiddhakāṇḍa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhapadasaannidhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhapadasāṃnidhya</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>-<a href="#entry-saannidhya" class="skt-link">sāṃnidhya</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhapadasaa_mnidhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. fait de désambiguïser un mot par collocation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhapraaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhaprāya</i> [<a href="#entry-praaya" class="skt-link">prāya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siddhapraaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhapraaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhapraayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhaprāyā</i> presque accompli.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhapurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhapurī</i> myth. np. de Siddhapura ou Siddhapurī, ville des accomplis; on la situe souvent dans le grand Nord.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddharaaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddharāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-siddharaaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Ujayasi_mha" class="skt-link">Jayasiṃha</a> Siddharāja «Accompli», de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Ucaulukya" class="skt-link">Caulukya</a> (12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il régnait à <a href="#entry-Ua_nahilapaa_taka" class="skt-link">Aṇahilapāṭaka</a> au <a href="#entry-Ugurjara" class="skt-link">Gurjara</a>; il fit une campagne militaire sur <a href="#entry-Uavantii" class="skt-link">Avantī</a> au <a href="#entry-Umaalava" class="skt-link">Mālava</a> pour en ramener comme butin la bibliothèque de sanskrit fondée par le roi <a href="#entry-Ubhojadeva" class="skt-link">Bhojadeva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddharasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddharasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <a href="#entry-siddharasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> mercure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> alchimiste; magicien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhasaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhasāra</i> [<a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhasaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhasaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Siddhasāra «Connaissance des humeurs», traité de médecine [<a href="#entry-aayurveda" class="skt-link">āyurveda</a>] dû à <a href="#entry-Uravigupta" class="skt-link">Ravigupta</a> (vers 650).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhasiddhaantapaddhati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhasiddhāntapaddhati</i> [<a href="#entry-siddhaanta" class="skt-link">siddhānta</a>-<a href="#entry-paddhati" class="skt-link">paddhati</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhasiddhaantapaddhati" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Siddhasiddhāntapaddhati «Manuel de doctrine accomplie», texte ancien de <a href="#entry-ha_thayoga" class="skt-link">haṭhayoga</a>, attribué à <a href="#entry-Ugorak_sanaatha" class="skt-link">Gorakṣanātha</a>; il décrit le renonçant [<a href="#entry-avadhuuta" class="skt-link">avadhūta</a>] comme apte à incarner tous les rôles sociaux, du roi à l'ascète.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> perfection <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. condition d'un être accompli [<a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> validité (d'une doctrine, d'une règle) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait d'être reconnu ou compris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. caractère accompli d'une action; opp. <a href="#entry-saadhyataa" class="skt-link">sādhyatā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] réalisation d'actes miraculeux par la pratique du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhayogezvaratantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhayogeśvaratantra</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>-<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhayogezvaratantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Siddhayogeśvaratantra, ouvrage tantr. sur le <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhayogezvariimata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhayogeśvarīmata</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvarii" class="skt-link">īśvarī</a>-<a href="#entry-mata" class="skt-link">mata</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhayogezvariimata" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Siddhayogeśvarīmata, ouvrage de la doctrine <a href="#entry-kaula" class="skt-link">kaula</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-siddhayoga" class="skt-link">siddhayoga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिद्धि</span> <i>siddhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> accomplissement, perfection acquise, habileté; confection, préparation (des aliments) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> efficacité, succès, réussite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] démonstration, preuve, conclusion, validité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> science, connaissance parfaite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chance, avantage, prospérité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] pouvoir surnaturel, puissance magique; l'un des 8 pouvoirs surnaturels canoniques; cf. <a href="#entry-a_s_tasiddhi" class="skt-link">aṣṭasiddhi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [tantr.] np. de Siddhi «Parfaite», l'une des 8 puissances divines [<a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Siddhi_1, la Perfection personnifiée, fille de <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [SP.] np. de Siddhi_2, épouse de <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a>, dont elle enfanta de <a href="#entry-Uk_sema" class="skt-link">Kṣema</a>.<br> <i>siddhir</i> <i>astu</i> (formule de bénédiction concluant un édit) qu'il en soit ainsi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhicandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhicandra</i> [<a href="#entry-candra" class="skt-link">candra</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhicandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du renonçant <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a> Siddhicandra «Pleine lune» (1587–1666); ce lettré du sanskrit, de grande intelligence et beauté, élève de <a href="#entry-Ubhaanucandra" class="skt-link">Bhānucandra</a>, était un intime de la cour des empereurs moghols.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhilak_smii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhilakṣmī</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_smii" class="skt-link">lakṣmī</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhilak_smii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-kaula" class="skt-link">kaula</a>] np. de Siddhilakṣmī, aspect terrible [<a href="#entry-mahaavidyaa" class="skt-link">mahāvidyā</a>] de la Déesse [<a href="#entry-Uzakti" class="skt-link">Śakti</a>], aussi appelée <a href="#entry-Ukamalaa" class="skt-link">Kamalā</a>; principale divinité Newar au Népal, son temple principal est à <a href="#entry-Ubhaktapura" class="skt-link">Bhaktapura</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhimat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhimat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siddhimat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhimat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhimatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhimatī</i> qui a atteint la perfection.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhipraaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhiprāya</i> [<a href="#entry-praaya" class="skt-link">prāya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siddhipraaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhipraaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siddhipraayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siddhiprāyā</i> presque parfait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhitraya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhitraya</i> [<a href="#entry-traya" class="skt-link">traya</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhitraya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Siddhitraya «Triple connaissance», œuvre phil. de <a href="#entry-Uyaamunaacaarya" class="skt-link">Yāmunācārya</a> (10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); elle eut une grande influence sur son élève <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siddhivinaayaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>siddhivināyaka</i> [<a href="#entry-vinaayaka" class="skt-link">vināyaka</a>] <a href="#entry-siddhivinaayaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Siddhivināyaka, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a> «Maître des pouvoirs».<br> <a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sidh_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिध्</span> <i>sidh_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(sidhyati)</i> pft. <i>(siṣedha)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>siddha_1</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> réussir, aboutir, atteindre le but <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avoir de la valeur, être démontré, être valide, s'ensuivre — ca. <i>(sādhayati)</i> cf. <a href="#entry-saadh" class="skt-link">sādh</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sidh_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिध्</span> <i>sidh_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sedhati)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(asedhīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>siddha_2</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>apa</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>prati</i><i>)</i> pousser, chasser, repousser, écarter, empêcher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sidhma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिध्म</span> <i>sidhma</i> a. <a href="#entry-sidhma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sidhma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sidhmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sidhmā</i> qui a des taches blanches; lépreux — <a href="#entry-sidhma" class="skt-link">m.</a> lèpre; on en dénombre 18 cas — <a href="#entry-sidhma" class="skt-link">n.</a> tache de lèpre — <a href="#entry-sidhmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sidhmā</i> méd. lésion de lèpre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sidhmala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sidhmala</i> [<a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sidhmala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sidhmala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sidhmalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sidhmalā</i> méd. lépreux — <a href="#entry-sidhmalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sidhmalā</i> sorte de lèpre.<br> <a href="#entry-sidhma" class="skt-link">sidhma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sidhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिध्य</span> <i>sidhya</i> [<a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-sidhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. np. de Sidhya «Délivrance» ou «Réussite», l'un des noms du <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Upu_sya" class="skt-link">Puṣya</a> le Cancer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siidhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीधु</span> <i>sīdhu</i> var. <i>śīdhu</i> <a href="#entry-siidhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> rhum.<br> <i>sīdhumāṃsapaśupriyā</i> f. myth. «friande de rhum de viande et d'animaux», épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> <a href="#entry-Umahi_saasuramardinii" class="skt-link">Mahiṣāsuramardinī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siidhupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sīdhupa</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_1" class="skt-link">pa_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siidhupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siidhupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siidhupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sīdhupā</i> <a href="#entry-siidhupii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sīdhupī</i> qui boit des liqueurs; buveur, ivrogne.<br> <a href="#entry-siidhu" class="skt-link">sīdhu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siimaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीमा</span> <i>sīmā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-siiman" class="skt-link">sīman</a>] <a href="#entry-siimaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> frontière; limite de village <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) délimitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siimaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sīmānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-siimaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> bord; frontière; borne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> limite d'un village — a. <a href="#entry-siimaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siimaanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siimaantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sīmāntā</i> délimité (par ⟨iic.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siimaantabhuupaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sīmāntabhūpāla</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuupaala" class="skt-link">bhūpāla</a>] <a href="#entry-siimaantabhuupaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> roi d'un pays limitrophe.<br> <a href="#entry-siimaanta" class="skt-link">sīmānta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siimaantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
