    <i>sīmāntara</i> [<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] <a href="#entry-siimaantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> limite d'un village.<br> <a href="#entry-siimaa" class="skt-link">sīmā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siiman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीमन्</span> <i>sīman</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-siitaa" class="skt-link">sītā</a>] <a href="#entry-siiman" class="skt-link">m.</a> raie (partageant les cheveux) — <a href="#entry-siiman" class="skt-link">f.</a> frontière, borne, extrémité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siimanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीमन्त</span> <i>sīmanta</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-siimaanta" class="skt-link">sīmānta</a>] <a href="#entry-siimanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> raie (partageant les cheveux) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. jointures du corps humain; on en dénombre 14, correspondant aux articulations [<a href="#entry-asthisafghaata" class="skt-link">asthisaṃghāta</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siimantonnayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sīmantonnayana</i> [<a href="#entry-unnayana" class="skt-link">unnayana</a>] <a href="#entry-siimantonnayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. rite de division des cheveux d'une femme par son époux au 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ (ou 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩) mois de sa 1⟨sup⟩re⟨/sup⟩ grossesse, un <a href="#entry-sa_mskaara" class="skt-link">saṃskāra</a>; le peigne est un rameau portant un fruit vert.<br> <a href="#entry-siimanta" class="skt-link">sīmanta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीर</span> <i>sīra</i> <a href="#entry-siira" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siira" class="skt-link">n.</a> charrue.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siiradhvaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sīradhvaja</i> [<a href="#entry-dhvaja" class="skt-link">dhvaja</a>] <a href="#entry-siiradhvaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Sīradhvaja <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a> «dont l'étendard porte la charrue», aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Ujanakaraaja" class="skt-link">Janakarāja</a>; fils de <a href="#entry-Uhrasvaromaa" class="skt-link">Hrasvaromā</a>, il descend de <a href="#entry-Umithi" class="skt-link">Mithi</a> <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a>; en labourant le terrain sacrificiel avec sa charrue, il fit surgir du sillon sa fille <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siirin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sīrin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-siirin" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sīrī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a> «qui tient la charrue».<br> <a href="#entry-siira" class="skt-link">sīra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीत्</span> <i>sīt</i> var. <i>śīt</i> [onomatopée] ind. son aspirant exprimant le plaisir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीता</span> <i>sītā</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-siira" class="skt-link">sīra</a>] <a href="#entry-siitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> sillon (de la charrue); champ, terre cultivée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. véd. np. de Sītā, personnifiant la terre cultivée et sa végétation, Pomone indienne, symbole de fertilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] son incarnation <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>, née à <a href="#entry-Umithilaa" class="skt-link">Mithilā</a> d'un sillon rituel tracé par son père le juste roi <a href="#entry-Ujanakaraaja" class="skt-link">Janakarāja</a> désirant une postérité, accomplissant ainsi le vœu de <a href="#entry-Uvedavatii" class="skt-link">Vedavatī</a>; elle épousa le divin roi <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> par choix [<a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">svayaṃvara</a>], lors d'une fête à laquelle assista <a href="#entry-Uparazuraama" class="skt-link">Paraśurāma</a>; elle fut enlevée par le <a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a> <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>; libérée par <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> aidé de <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a>, elle fut répudiée, puis pardonnée après avoir subi l'épreuve du feu [<a href="#entry-agnipariik_saa" class="skt-link">agniparīkṣā</a>]; à la fin de sa vie elle fut réabsorbée par sa mère la Terre [<a href="#entry-Ubhuumi" class="skt-link">Bhūmi</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Ujaanakii" class="skt-link">Jānakī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaidehii" class="skt-link">Vaidehī</a>.<br> <i>jaya</i> <i>sītā</i> <i>rāma</i> «gloire à <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a> et <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>», formule de salut.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siitaaphala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sītāphala</i> [<a href="#entry-phala" class="skt-link">phala</a>] <a href="#entry-siitaaphala" class="skt-link">n.</a> anone; syn. <a href="#entry-aat_rpya" class="skt-link">ātṛpya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siitaaraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sītārāma</i> [<a href="#entry-raama" class="skt-link">rāma</a>] <a href="#entry-siitaaraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> du. myth. <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a> et <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siitaaraamakalyaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siitkaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sītkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-siitkaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> production du son <a href="#entry-siit" class="skt-link">sīt</a> durant l'orgasme.<br> <a href="#entry-siit" class="skt-link">sīt</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siiv">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीव्</span> <i>sīv</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(sīvyati)</i> pft. <i>(siṣeva)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>syūta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>sīvya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i>, <i>prati</i><i>)</i> coudre — ca. <i>(sīvayati)</i> ca. <i>(sevayati)</i> id. — dés. <i>(susyūṣati)</i> vouloir coudre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>suo</i>; fr. suaire, suture; ang. sew.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siivaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीवक</span> <i>sīvaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-siiv" class="skt-link">sīv</a>] <a href="#entry-siivaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> couturier — <a href="#entry-siivikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sīvikā</i> couturière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siivana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीवन</span> <i>sīvana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-siiv" class="skt-link">sīv</a>] <a href="#entry-siivana" class="skt-link">n.</a> couture — <a href="#entry-siivanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sīvanī</i> raphé du périnée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siivanayantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sīvanayantra</i> [<a href="#entry-yantra" class="skt-link">yantra</a>] <a href="#entry-siivanayantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> mod. machine à coudre.<br> <a href="#entry-siivana" class="skt-link">sīvana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siivya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सीव्य</span> <i>sīvya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-siiv" class="skt-link">sīv</a>] a. <a href="#entry-siivya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siivya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siivyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sīvyā</i> à coudre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sikataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिकता</span> <i>sikatā</i> <a href="#entry-sikataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. <i>sikatās</i> sable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>siccus</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sikatila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिकतिल</span> <i>sikatila</i> [<a href="#entry-sikataa" class="skt-link">sikatā</a><a href="#entry--ila" class="skt-link">-ila</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sikatila" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sikatila" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sikatilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sikatilā</i> sablonneux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sikta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिक्त</span> <i>sikta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sic" class="skt-link">sic</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sikta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sikta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-siktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siktā</i> répandu, versé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siktha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिक्थ</span> <i>siktha</i> <a href="#entry-siktha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-siktha" class="skt-link">n.</a> riz cuit égoutté; boule de riz — <a href="#entry-siktha" class="skt-link">n.</a> cire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sikthavartinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sikthavartinī</i> [<a href="#entry-vartinii" class="skt-link">vartinī</a>] <a href="#entry-sikthavartinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> mod. bougie.<br> <a href="#entry-siktha" class="skt-link">siktha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sindhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिन्धु</span> <i>sindhu</i> <a href="#entry-sindhu" class="skt-link">f.</a> fleuve, rivière (en gén.) — <a href="#entry-sindhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sindhu" class="skt-link">f.</a> l'Indus; c'est une rivière sacrée [<a href="#entry-divyagafgaa" class="skt-link">divyagaṅgā</a>] — <a href="#entry-sindhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> la mer, l'océan <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. le Sindhu, vallée de l'Indus <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sindhavas</i> les habitants du <a href="#entry-Usindhu" class="skt-link">Sindhu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. Inde, hindou.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sindhudviipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sindhudvīpa</i> [<a href="#entry-dviipa" class="skt-link">dvīpa</a>] <a href="#entry-sindhudviipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Sindhudvīpa, roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Uzrutanaabha" class="skt-link">Śrutanābha</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Uayutaayu" class="skt-link">Ayutāyu</a>, ancêtre de <a href="#entry-Uraghu" class="skt-link">Raghu</a> et donc de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sindhudvīpa_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Ujahnu" class="skt-link">Jahnu</a>, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uaja_1" class="skt-link">Aja_1</a>; par ses pénitences au pélerinage de Pṛthūdakatīrtha il aurait accédé au statut de brâhmane; il est père de <a href="#entry-Ubalaakaazva" class="skt-link">Balākāśva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sindhuraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sindhurāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-sindhuraaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Sindhurāja, roi <a href="#entry-Uparamaara" class="skt-link">Paramāra</a> qui régnait à <a href="#entry-Udhaaraa" class="skt-link">Dhārā</a> à la fin du 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il succcéda à son frère aîné <a href="#entry-Umu_nja" class="skt-link">Muñja</a>; <a href="#entry-Ubhojadeva" class="skt-link">Bhojadeva</a> et <a href="#entry-Uudayaaditya" class="skt-link">Udayāditya</a> sont ses fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sindhuvaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sindhuvāra</i> [<a href="#entry-vaara" class="skt-link">vāra</a>] <a href="#entry-sindhuvaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Vitex negundo</i>, arbuste aromatique aux feuilles opposées en 5 folioles, aux fleurs pourpres en longs panicules; utilisé en médecine; syn. <a href="#entry-nirgu_n_dii" class="skt-link">nirguṇḍī</a>, <a href="#entry-sinduvaara" class="skt-link">sinduvāra</a> — <a href="#entry-sindhuvaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> sa baie, ovoïde, noire.<br> <a href="#entry-sindhu" class="skt-link">sindhu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sinduura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिन्दूर</span> <i>sindūra</i> <a href="#entry-sinduura" class="skt-link">n.</a> minium; vermillon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. par sa couleur, symbolique du <a href="#entry-brahmacaarin" class="skt-link">brahmacārin</a>; on en peint les images de <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a>; on emploie aussi ce sel de plomb en médecine, not. pour guérir des blessures.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sinduurita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sindūrita</i> [<a href="#entry--ita" class="skt-link">-ita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sinduurita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sinduurita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sinduuritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sindūritā</i> couvert de minium, rouge vermillon.<br> <a href="#entry-sinduura" class="skt-link">sindūra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sinduvaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिन्दुवार</span> <i>sinduvāra</i> [<a href="#entry-sindhuvaara" class="skt-link">sindhuvāra</a>] <a href="#entry-sinduvaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Vitex negundo</i>, arbuste aromatique aux feuilles opposées en 5 folioles, aux fleurs pourpres en longs panicules; utilisé en médecine; syn. <a href="#entry-nirgu_n_dii" class="skt-link">nirguṇḍī</a> — <a href="#entry-sinduvaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> sa baie, ovoïde, noire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siniivaalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिनीवाली</span> <i>sinīvālī</i> <a href="#entry-siniivaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> véd. np. de Sinīvālī, une déesse de la fécondité; elle préside le premier jour de la nouvelle lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sipra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिप्र</span> <i>sipra</i> <a href="#entry-sipra" class="skt-link">m.</a> sueur, transpiration — <a href="#entry-sipraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>siprā</i> géo. np. de la rivière Siprā, coulant à <a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uk_sipraa" class="skt-link">Kṣiprā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-siraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिरा</span> <i>sirā</i> [<a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-siraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> cours d'eau; drain, canal étroit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. vaisseau du corps; veine, artère, nerf; tendon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sis_rk_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिसृक्ष्</span> <i>sisṛkṣ</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-s_rj_1" class="skt-link">sṛj_1</a>] v. pr. <i>(sisṛkṣati)</i> désirer créer, vouloir émettre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sis_rk_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिसृक्षा</span> <i>sisṛkṣā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sis_rk_s" class="skt-link">sisṛkṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-sis_rk_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir de créer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sis_rk_su">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सिसृक्षु</span> <i>sisṛkṣu</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sis_rk_s" class="skt-link">sisṛkṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sis_rk_su" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sis_rk_su" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sis_rk_su" class="skt-link">f.</a> désireux de créer, qui veut émettre; prolifique; not. dit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>.<br> <i>sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ</i> <i>prajāḥ</i> Désireux de créer les diverses créatures.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sita_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सित</span> <i>sita_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-saa_1" class="skt-link">sā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sita_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sita_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sitaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sitā_1</i> lié, attaché, enchaîné; captif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sita_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सित</span> <i>sita_2</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-asita" class="skt-link">asita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sita_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sita_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sitaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sitā_2</i> blanc, clair, brillant; limpide — <a href="#entry-sita_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> la couleur blanc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. la «quinzaine claire» [<a href="#entry-zuklapak_sa" class="skt-link">śuklapakṣa</a>] — <a href="#entry-sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sitā</i> myth. np. de la Sitā, une <a href="#entry-divyagafgaa" class="skt-link">divyagaṅgā</a>; c'est une branche de la Voie lactée ou Gange céleste [<a href="#entry-Umandaakinii" class="skt-link">Mandākinī</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sitotpala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sitotpala</i> [<a href="#entry-utpala" class="skt-link">utpala</a>] <a href="#entry-sitotpala" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. bot. <i>Nelumbium speciosum</i>, lotus blanc de jour.<br> <a href="#entry-sita_2" class="skt-link">sita_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skaanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कान्द</span> <i>skānda</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-skanda" class="skt-link">skanda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-skaanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-skaanda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-skaandaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>skāndā</i> myth. relatif à <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skaandapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skāndapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-skaandapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-skandapuraa_na" class="skt-link">skandapurāṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-skaanda" class="skt-link">skānda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skambh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कम्भ्</span> <i>skambh</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-stambh" class="skt-link">stambh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(skabhnoti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(skabhnāti)</i> affermir; soutenir; fixer; établir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skambha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कम्भ</span> <i>skambha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-skambh" class="skt-link">skambh</a>] <a href="#entry-skambha" class="skt-link">m.</a> support; pilier; poteau, colonne; syn. <a href="#entry-stambha" class="skt-link">stambha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. np. de Skambha, «Pilier de l'Univers»; il est identifié à <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, ou à <a href="#entry-Upuru_sa" class="skt-link">Puruṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skand">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कन्द्</span> <i>skand</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(skandati)</i> pft. <i>(caskanda)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>skanna</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> monter, sauter, jaillir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> descendre, tomber, couler — ca. <i>(skandayati)</i> répandre, émettre (not. <a href="#entry-retas" class="skt-link">retas</a>); négliger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>scando</i>; fr. scander, descendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कन्द</span> <i>skanda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-skand" class="skt-link">skand</a>] <a href="#entry-skanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> jet, jaillissement; effusion, bondissement; fait de déborder <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mercure; sperme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. [ChU.] np. de Skanda pour le sage <a href="#entry-Uskandakumaara" class="skt-link">Skandakumāra</a> «Garçon bondissant», fils de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, éternellement jeune, insurpassable érudit du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>; il apprit à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> le pouvoir du <a href="#entry-pra_nava" class="skt-link">praṇava</a> <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> [<a href="#entry-om" class="skt-link">om</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. plus tard évoqué comme <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> «Qui jaillit (de la fécondation du Gange par le Feu du sperme de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>)»; on le dit né d'un jet du sperme de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> pénétré d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> dans le Gange; [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a> s'étant uni à <a href="#entry-Uumaa" class="skt-link">Umā</a>-<a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a>, les dieux furent inquiets de la naissance d'un fils dont la Terre ne pourrait supporter la puissance; ils le supplièrent de se consacrer à l'ascétisme; son sperme déjà versé, pénétré d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>, donna naissance à la Montagne Blanche [<a href="#entry-Uzveta_1" class="skt-link">Śveta_1</a>]; les dieux, désireux d'avoir un chef à leur armée, demandèrent à <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> de féconder <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a>; l'embryon d'or qui en jaillit était <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] (variante) <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> féconda les épouses des sept sages [<a href="#entry-saptar_si" class="skt-link">saptarṣi</a>] (sauf la fidèle <a href="#entry-Uarundhatii" class="skt-link">Arundhatī</a>) en lesquelles s'était transformée successivement <a href="#entry-Usvaahaa" class="skt-link">Svāhā</a>, qui recueillit son sperme pour le jeter [<a href="#entry-skanna" class="skt-link">skanna</a>] 6 fois dans un étang d'or du Mont <a href="#entry-Uzveta_1" class="skt-link">Śveta_1</a>; <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> fut confié aux 6 Pléiades [<a href="#entry-Uk_rttikaas" class="skt-link">Kṛttikās</a>] ses nourrices, qui l'élevèrent en cachette; il est ainsi souvent représenté avec 6 têtes [<a href="#entry-U_sa_nmukha" class="skt-link">Ṣaṇmukha</a>], et appelé <a href="#entry-Ukaarttikeya" class="skt-link">Kārttikeya</a> et <a href="#entry-Uguha" class="skt-link">Guha</a>; inquiets de ses pouvoirs, les dieux lui envoyèrent <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> qui lui déclara la guerre, mais fut vaincu; le choc de son <a href="#entry-vajra" class="skt-link">vajra</a> sur le flanc de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> ne fit que donner naissance à son double <a href="#entry-Uvizaakha" class="skt-link">Viśākha</a>; <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> s'inclina, mais <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> ne demanda qu'à devenir le général en chef de l'armée des dieux [<a href="#entry-Usenaapati" class="skt-link">Senāpati</a>]; il porte le javelot magique [<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a>] qui lui revient en main; on lui attribue beaucoup d'exploits; il tua le démon <a href="#entry-Utaaraka" class="skt-link">Tāraka</a> et son aide <a href="#entry-Umahi_sa" class="skt-link">Mahiṣa</a>; il tua le <a href="#entry-daitya" class="skt-link">daitya</a> <a href="#entry-Ubaa_na" class="skt-link">Bāṇa</a> caché dans la montagne <a href="#entry-Ukrau_nca" class="skt-link">Krauñca</a>; sa monture est le paon <a href="#entry-Uparavaa_ni" class="skt-link">Paravāṇi</a>, en lequel se transforma son ennemi vaincu <a href="#entry-Uzuurapadma" class="skt-link">Śūrapadma</a>; il porte un coq sur son fanion; il est identifié à la divinité dravidienne Murugan de la jeunesse, de la beauté et de la guerre; il est évoqué comme l'adolescent abstinent [<a href="#entry-brahmacaarin" class="skt-link">brahmacārin</a>] <a href="#entry-Ukumaara" class="skt-link">Kumāra</a>, évitant le contact avec les femmes, qui ne sont pas admises dans ses sanctuaires; il a néanmoins gardé de Murugan un caractère amoureux et dissipé, et son culte est déplacé pour les jeunes filles; il est aussi le patron des voleurs et des bandits; sous son aspect <a href="#entry-Unaigame_sa" class="skt-link">Naigameṣa</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvizaakha" class="skt-link">Viśākha</a> à tête de bélier, il assure la fertilité, et on l'implore pour avoir un fils; mais sous son aspect <a href="#entry-Uskandagraha" class="skt-link">Skandagraha</a> il fait du mal aux enfants; qqf. on lui attribue comme épouses <a href="#entry-Udevasenaa" class="skt-link">Devasenā</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvallii" class="skt-link">Vallī</a>; on l'appelle aussi <a href="#entry-Usubrahma_nya" class="skt-link">Subrahmaṇya</a> «Favorable aux brâhmanes» et <a href="#entry-Uyogiizvara" class="skt-link">Yogīśvara</a> «Suprême parmi les yogis»; il est <a href="#entry-Uzaktibh_rt" class="skt-link">Śaktibhṛt</a> «qui porte le javelot» (Velan en tamil); il est parfois associé à la planète Mars.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandaapasmaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skandāpasmāra</i> [<a href="#entry-apasmaara" class="skt-link">apasmāra</a>] <a href="#entry-skandaapasmaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Skandāpasmāra «Épilepsie de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>», démon issu du corps de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> pour faire du mal aux enfants.<br> <a href="#entry-skanda" class="skt-link">skanda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandagraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skandagraha</i> [<a href="#entry-graha" class="skt-link">graha</a>] <a href="#entry-skandagraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Skandagraha, aspect ou compagnon de <a href="#entry-Ukumaara" class="skt-link">Kumāra</a> qui fait du mal aux enfants; cf. <a href="#entry-Unejame_sa" class="skt-link">Nejameṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandakumaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skandakumāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kumaara" class="skt-link">kumāra</a>] <a href="#entry-skandakumaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. [ChU.] np. du sage Skandakumāra, fils de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, éternellement jeune [<a href="#entry-Usanatkumaara" class="skt-link">Sanatkumāra</a>], éternellement beau [<a href="#entry-Usanatsujaata" class="skt-link">Sanatsujāta</a>], insurpassable érudit du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>; plus tard évolue en <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>, né de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कन्दन</span> <i>skandana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-skand" class="skt-link">skand</a>] <a href="#entry-skandana" class="skt-link">n.</a> jaillissement; effusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avortement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> purge, défécation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> formation d'un caillot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skandapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-skandapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Skandapurāṇa ou Skāndapurāṇa, immense texte mythologique <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>, relativement récent; il comprend 7 sections: <a href="#entry-Umahezvarakha_n_da" class="skt-link">Maheśvarakhaṇḍa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nukha_n_da" class="skt-link">Viṣṇukhaṇḍa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubrahmakha_n_da_1" class="skt-link">Brahmakhaṇḍa_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukaaziikha_n_da" class="skt-link">Kāśīkhaṇḍa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uaavantyakha_n_da" class="skt-link">Āvantyakhaṇḍa</a>, <a href="#entry-Unaagarakha_n_da" class="skt-link">Nāgarakhaṇḍa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uprabhaasakha_n_da" class="skt-link">Prabhāsakhaṇḍa</a>; on y rattache aussi le <a href="#entry-Usahyaadrikha_n_da" class="skt-link">Sahyādrikhaṇḍa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कन्ध</span> <i>skandha</i> <a href="#entry-skandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> épaule, tronc, corps; tronc d'arbre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> poteau sacrificiel; syn. <a href="#entry-stambha" class="skt-link">stambha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> troupe, division d'une armée; multitude <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. section, division (d'un ouvrage) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. agrégat ou facteur constitutif de l'ego; on en compte 5 [<i>pañcaskandhī</i>]: la forme matérielle [<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>], la sensation [<a href="#entry-vedanaa" class="skt-link">vedanā</a>], la perception cognitive [<a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_2" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_2</a>], la formation mentale (émotion, pensée, opinion, compulsion) [<a href="#entry-sa_mskaara" class="skt-link">saṃskāra</a>] et la prise de conscience active [<a href="#entry-vij_naana" class="skt-link">vijñāna</a>]; <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> enseigna qu'il faut s'en libérer, en réalisant leur vacuité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>khanda</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandhaavaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skandhāvāra</i> [<a href="#entry-aavaara" class="skt-link">āvāra</a>] <a href="#entry-skandhaavaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> camp royal; quartier général d'une armée.<br> <a href="#entry-skandha" class="skt-link">skandha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कन्धक</span> <i>skandhaka</i> [<a href="#entry-skandha" class="skt-link">skandha</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-skandhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. mètre de poésie <a href="#entry-aaryaa" class="skt-link">āryā</a> utilisé pour certaines récits épiques de cour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandhasantaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skandhasaṃtāna</i> [<a href="#entry-santaana" class="skt-link">saṃtāna</a>] <a href="#entry-skandhasa_mtaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. suite des agrégats.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skandin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कन्दिन्</span> <i>skandin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-skand" class="skt-link">skand</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-skandin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-skandin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-skandinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>skandinī</i> qui jaillit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> écoulement, perte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्कन्न</span> <i>skanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-skand" class="skt-link">skand</a>] a. <a href="#entry-skanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-skanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-skannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>skannā</i> jeté; émis (not. sperme).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skhal">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्खल्</span> <i>skhal</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(skhalati)</i> pft. <i>(caskāla)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(askhālīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>skhalita</i><i>)</i> trébucher; hésiter; bégayer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire une erreur — ca. <i>(skhalayati)</i> ca. <i>(skhālayati)</i> faire trébucher; arrêter.<br> <i>na</i> <i>skhal</i> ne pas hésiter, rester ferme; réussir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skhala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्खल</span> <i>skhala</i> [act. <a href="#entry-skhal" class="skt-link">skhal</a>] <a href="#entry-skhala" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de trébucher, de vaciller; bégaiement, hésitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skhaladvaakya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>skhaladvākya</i> [<a href="#entry-vaakya" class="skt-link">vākya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-skhaladvaakya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-skhaladvaakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-skhaladvaakyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>skhaladvākyā</i> qui bégaie, qui prononce mal.<br> <a href="#entry-skhalat" class="skt-link">skhalat</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skhalana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्खलन</span> <i>skhalana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-skhal" class="skt-link">skhal</a>] <a href="#entry-skhalana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de trébucher, instabilité; ivresse; bégaiement, erreur de diction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> décharge saccadée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> erreur (en ⟨iic.⟩).<br> <i>manuṣyāḥ</i> <i>skhalanaśīlāḥ</i> L'erreur est humaine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skhalat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्खलत्</span> <i>skhalat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-skhal" class="skt-link">skhal</a>] a. <a href="#entry-skhalat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-skhalat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-skhalantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>skhalantī</i> qui trébuche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-skhalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्खलित</span> <i>skhalita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-skhal" class="skt-link">skhal</a>] a. <a href="#entry-skhalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-skhalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-skhalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>skhalitā</i> saccadé; instable; hésitant, inassuré; imparfait; déficient (langage) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vacillant; ivre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obstrué, empêché, interrompu; frustré, perplexe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> erroné en ⟨loc.⟩ — <a href="#entry-skhalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> erreur, faute, maladresse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मृ</span> <i>smṛ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(smarati)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>smariṣyati</i><i>)</i> pft. <i>(sasmāra)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>smṛta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> se souvenir de; se rappeller de ⟨acc. g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> penser à ⟨acc.⟩; enseigner — ps. <i>(smaryate)</i> être gardé en mémoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (impers.) on dit que, la tradition enseigne — ca. <i>(smārayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>smārita</i><i>)</i> rappeler qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ à qqn. ⟨acc. g.⟩; faire souvenir; faire regretter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. μερμερος; lat. <i>memor</i>; ang. memory; fr. mémoire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मृत</span> <i>smṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sm_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smṛtā</i> rappelé, à quoi ou à qui l'on pense <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enseigné, prescrit (par la <a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>); qui est déclaré par la tradition être, qui passe pour, légal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मृति</span> <i>smṛti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> mémoire, souvenir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. tradition, épopée; ensemble des textes sacrés et légaux traditionnels (opp. <a href="#entry-zruti" class="skt-link">śruti</a>, connaissance révélée) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] l'appel à la mémoire, un <a href="#entry-cittav_rtti" class="skt-link">cittavṛtti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [VP.] np. de Smṛti, épouse d'<a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a>; elle est mère d'<a href="#entry-Uanumati" class="skt-link">Anumati</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtigiitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtigītā</i> [<a href="#entry-giitaa" class="skt-link">gītā</a>] <a href="#entry-sm_rtigiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Smṛtigītā.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtikalpadruma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtikalpadruma</i> [<a href="#entry-kalpadruma" class="skt-link">kalpadruma</a>] <a href="#entry-sm_rtikalpadruma" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Smṛtikalpadruma.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtikara_n_dikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtikaraṇḍikā</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">karaṇḍikā</a>] <a href="#entry-sm_rtikara_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Smṛtikaraṇḍikā.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtikaumudii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtikaumudī</i> [<a href="#entry-kaumudii" class="skt-link">kaumudī</a>] <a href="#entry-sm_rtikaumudii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Smṛtikaumudī.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtikaumudii_tiikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtikaumudīṭīkā</i> [<a href="#entry-_tiikaa" class="skt-link">ṭīkā</a>] <a href="#entry-sm_rtikaumudii_tiikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Smṛtikaumudīṭīkā.<br> <a href="#entry-sm_rtikaumudii" class="skt-link">smṛtikaumudī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtimat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मृतिमत्</span> <i>smṛtimat</i> [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a><a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sm_rtimat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtimat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtimatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smṛtimatī</i> qui se souvient; qui a une bonne mémoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> versé dans la tradition sacrée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui permet de se souvenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtipaa_thaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtipāṭhaka</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_thaka" class="skt-link">pāṭhaka</a>] <a href="#entry-sm_rtipaa_thaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme de loi, juge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtisaadhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtisādhya</i> [<a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sm_rtisaadhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtisaadhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtisaadhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smṛtisādhyā</i> qui peut être justifié par la loi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtisammata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtisammata</i> [<a href="#entry-sammata" class="skt-link">sammata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sm_rtisammata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtisammata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtisammataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smṛtisammatā</i> approuvé par la loi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sm_rtisiddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smṛtisiddha</i> [<a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sm_rtisiddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtisiddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sm_rtisiddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smṛtisiddhā</i> conforme à la loi.<br> <a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्म</span> <i>sma</i> part. cl. d'assertion, donne au présent l'aspect imperfectif et le temps d'un passé narratif, progressif ou habituel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> renforce légèrement, not. après <a href="#entry-iti" class="skt-link">iti</a>, <a href="#entry-na" class="skt-link">na</a>, <a href="#entry-maa_2" class="skt-link">mā_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मार</span> <i>smāra</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-smaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> souvenir de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smaarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मारित</span> <i>smārita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-smar" class="skt-link">smar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-smaarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-smaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-smaaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smāritā</i> rappelé; souvenu — <a href="#entry-smaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> action de se souvenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smaarta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मार्त</span> <i>smārta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-smaarta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-smaarta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-smaartaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smārtā</i> relatif à la mémoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. fondé sur la <a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>; traditionnel, légal; qui suit la tradition [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>] — <a href="#entry-smaarta" class="skt-link">m.</a> juriste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. brâhmane effectuant les rites domestiques (par opposition à prêtre officiant dans un temple) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. désigne certains brâhmanes qui adorent aussi bien <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> que <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. brâhmane qui suit seulement la <a href="#entry-zruti" class="skt-link">śruti</a> et la <a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a> (opp. <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> suivant aussi les <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatraas" class="skt-link">pañcarātrās</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मर्</span> <i>smar</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(smarayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>smārita</i><i>)</i> rappeler qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ à qqn. ⟨acc. g.⟩; faire souvenir; faire regretter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मर</span> <i>smara</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-smara" class="skt-link">m.</a> mémoire, souvenir; obsession <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> désir amoureux; amour sexuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Smara «Obsession (d'Amour)», épith. du dieu <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a>.<br> <i>smarasi</i> <i>smara</i> Amour, souviens toi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मरण</span> <i>smaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-smara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> pensée, souvenir; réminiscence; mémoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tradition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] récitation mentale du nom d'une divinité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smaraanala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>smarānala</i> [<a href="#entry-anala" class="skt-link">anala</a>] <a href="#entry-smaraanala" class="skt-link">m.</a> feux de l'amour.<br> <a href="#entry-smara" class="skt-link">smara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smartavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मर्तव्य</span> <i>smartavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-smartavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-smartavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-smartavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smartavyā</i> ce dont on peut ou doit se souvenir, mémorable — <a href="#entry-smartavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smartavyā</i> mémoire.<br> <i>smara</i> <i>yat</i> <i>smartavyam</i> Souviens toi de ce dont tu dois te souvenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मय</span> <i>smaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-smi" class="skt-link">smi</a>] <a href="#entry-smaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> orgueil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smera">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मेर</span> <i>smera</i> [<a href="#entry-smi" class="skt-link">smi</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-smera" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-smera" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-smeraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smerā</i> souriant, amical; épanoui, ouvert (not. fleur); fier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> évident — ifc. plein de, joyeux de — <a href="#entry-smera" class="skt-link">m.</a> sourire; rire.<br> <i>smerīkṛ</i> sourire.<br> <i>smerīkṛta</i> souriant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मि</span> <i>smi</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(smayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>smita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> sourire; s'épanouir; rire doucement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> montrer de l'orgueil — ca. <i>(smāyayati)</i> faire sourire; se moquer de — dés. <i>(sismayiṣati)</i> désirer sourire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. μειδαω; lat. <i>mīror</i>; ang. to smile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मित</span> <i>smita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-smi" class="skt-link">smi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-smita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-smita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-smitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smitā</i> qui sourit; épanoui, fleuri — <a href="#entry-smita" class="skt-link">n.</a> sourire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-smitavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्मितवत्</span> <i>smitavat</i> [ppa. <a href="#entry-smi" class="skt-link">smi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-smitavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-smitavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-smitavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>smitavatī</i> qui a souri.<br> <i>buddhaḥ</i> <i>smitavān</i> <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> a souri (mod. message codé annonçant le premier essai atomique indien).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्ना</span> <i>snā</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(snāti)</i> imp. <i>(snāhi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>snāta</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>snātvā</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ni</i>, <i>pra</i><i>)</i> se baigner, se laver <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prendre le bain rituel, se purifier par des ablutions <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. νηχομαι; lat. <i>nato</i>; fr. natation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नान</span> <i>snāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-snaa" class="skt-link">snā</a>] <a href="#entry-snaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> bain, ablution; lustration rituelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. bain rituel au terme des études d'un <a href="#entry-brahmacaarin" class="skt-link">brahmacārin</a>, un <a href="#entry-sa_mskaara" class="skt-link">saṃskāra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lavage, nettoyage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaanadro_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snānadroṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-dro_nii" class="skt-link">droṇī</a>] <a href="#entry-snaanadro_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> bac à douche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> base-égouttoir de <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaanapuur_nimaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snānapūrṇimā</i> [<a href="#entry-puur_nimaa" class="skt-link">pūrṇimā</a>] <a href="#entry-snaanapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. pleine lune du mois <a href="#entry-jyai_s_tha" class="skt-link">jyaiṣṭha</a>; on y célèbre à <a href="#entry-Upurii" class="skt-link">Purī</a> le bain des idoles de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubalabhadra" class="skt-link">Balabhadra</a> et <a href="#entry-Usubhadraa" class="skt-link">Subhadrā</a>, au <a href="#entry-snaanavedi" class="skt-link">snānavedi</a>; on les ondoie avec le contenu de 108 seaux d'eau parfumée, et on les décore en <a href="#entry-ga_nezave_sa" class="skt-link">gaṇeśaveṣa</a> (ou <a href="#entry-haathiiveza" class="skt-link">hāthīveśa</a>) pour qu'ensemble elles évoquent <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a>; le soir elles sont montrées en public; elles sont alors confinées pour deux semaines [<a href="#entry-anavasara" class="skt-link">anavasara</a>], jusqu'au festival de procession de chars [<a href="#entry-rathayaatraa" class="skt-link">rathayātrā</a>]; on dit qu'elles ont pris froid et sont fiévreuses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaanavedi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snānavedi</i> [<a href="#entry-vedi" class="skt-link">vedi</a>] <a href="#entry-snaanavedi" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. lieu du bain rituel de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a>, à l'intérieur du temple de <a href="#entry-Upurii" class="skt-link">Purī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaanavelaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snānavelā</i> [<a href="#entry-velaa" class="skt-link">velā</a>] <a href="#entry-snaanavelaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> heure du bain.<br> <a href="#entry-snaana" class="skt-link">snāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaanayaatraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snānayātrā</i> [<a href="#entry-yaatraa" class="skt-link">yātrā</a>] <a href="#entry-snaanayaatraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. décoration des idoles de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubalabhadra" class="skt-link">Balabhadra</a> en éléphants (resp. par des costumes noir/argent et blanc/or), à l'occasion du festival du bain rituel à <a href="#entry-snaanapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">snānapūrṇimā</a> à <a href="#entry-Upurii" class="skt-link">Purī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नात</span> <i>snāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-snaa" class="skt-link">snā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-snaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-snaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>snātā</i> baigné, lavé; purifié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plongé dans ⟨loc. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaataanulipta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snātānulipta</i> [<a href="#entry-anulipta" class="skt-link">anulipta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-snaataanulipta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snaataanulipta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-snaataanuliptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>snātānuliptā</i> baigné et parfumé d'huile.<br> <a href="#entry-snaata" class="skt-link">snāta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नातक</span> <i>snātaka</i> [<a href="#entry-snaata" class="skt-link">snāta</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-snaataka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a> ayant accompli le bain rituel [<a href="#entry-snaana" class="skt-link">snāna</a>] au terme de ses études religieuses, et ainsi en état de pureté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaatavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नातवत्</span> <i>snātavat</i> [ppa. <a href="#entry-snaa" class="skt-link">snā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-snaatavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snaatavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-snaatavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>snātavatī</i> qui a accompli le bain rituel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snaayu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नायु</span> <i>snāyu</i> <a href="#entry-snaayu" class="skt-link">f.</a> <a href="#entry-snaayu" class="skt-link">n.</a> ligament, tendon, muscle; boyau servant de corde d'arc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> all. Sehne; ang. sinew.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नव</span> <i>snava</i> [act. <a href="#entry-snu" class="skt-link">snu</a>] <a href="#entry-snava" class="skt-link">m.</a> suintement, fuite, écoulement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sneh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नेह्</span> <i>sneh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-snih_1" class="skt-link">snih_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(snehayati)</i> graisser, rendre onctueux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sneha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नेह</span> <i>sneha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-snih_1" class="skt-link">snih_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sneha" class="skt-link">m.</a> onctuosité, viscosité; huile, graisse, onguent, liquide séminal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> penchant pour, tendresse, affection, amour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snehamaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snehamaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-snehamaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snehamaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-snehamayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>snehamayī</i> rempli d'affection; fait d'affection.<br> <a href="#entry-sneha" class="skt-link">sneha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snehaparyaakula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snehaparyākula</i> [<a href="#entry-paryaakula" class="skt-link">paryākula</a>] a. <a href="#entry-snehaparyaakula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snehaparyaakula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-snehaparyaakulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>snehaparyākulā</i> rempli d'affection, plein de tendresse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snigdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्निग्ध</span> <i>snigdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-snih_1" class="skt-link">snih_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-snigdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snigdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-snigdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>snigdhā</i> doux, onctueux; tendre, gentil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aimable, affectueux, amoureux (de ⟨loc.⟩); aimé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gras, gros, épais — <a href="#entry-snigdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> ami — <a href="#entry-snigdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>snigdhā</i> mœlle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snigdhad_r_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>snigdhadṛṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-d_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">dṛṣṭi</a>] <a href="#entry-snigdhad_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> regard affectueux.<br> <a href="#entry-snigdha" class="skt-link">snigdha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snih_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्निह्</span> <i>snih_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(snihyati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(snehati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>snigdha</i><i>)</i> être onctueux ou visqueux, être huileux ou collant; coller <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) s'attacher; éprouver de l'affection pour, avoir un penchant pour, aimer, chérir ⟨g. loc.⟩ — ca. <i>(snehayati)</i> graisser, rendre onctueux.<br> <i>śatrāvapi</i> <i>snihyati</i> <i>sādhuḥ</i> Un homme bon aime même ses ennemis.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snih_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्निह्</span> <i>snih_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-snih_1" class="skt-link">snih_1</a>] <a href="#entry-snih_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> humidité, suintement; graisse — a. <a href="#entry-snih_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snih_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-snih_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> affectueux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नु</span> <i>snu</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(snauti)</i> pr. md. <i>(snute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>snuta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> distiller; émettre un fluide; arroser — ca. <i>(snāvayati)</i> faire couler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snu_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नुषा</span> <i>snuṣā</i> <a href="#entry-snu_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> belle-fille, bru; syn. <a href="#entry-putravadhuu" class="skt-link">putravadhū</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>nurus</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snuh_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नुह्</span> <i>snuh_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(snuhyati)</i> vomir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-snuh_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्नुह्</span> <i>snuh_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-snuh_1" class="skt-link">snuh_1</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-snuh_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-snuh_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui vomit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-so_dha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोढ</span> <i>soḍha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sah_1" class="skt-link">sah_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-so_dha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-so_dha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-so_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>soḍhā</i> supporté, enduré; toléré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-so_s_nii_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोष्णीष</span> <i>soṣṇīṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-u_s_nii_sa" class="skt-link">uṣṇīṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-so_s_nii_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-so_s_nii_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-so_s_nii_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>soṣṇīṣā</i> enturbanné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sobhari">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोभरि</span> <i>sobhari</i> <a href="#entry-sobhari" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de Sobhari, auteur d'hymnes du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-socchvaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोच्छ्वास</span> <i>socchvāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ucchvaasa" class="skt-link">ucchvāsa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-socchvaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-socchvaasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-socchvaasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>socchvāsā</i> qui soupire; qui expire fortement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> essouflé.<br> <i>socchvāsam</i> adv. avec un soupir de soulagement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-solafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोलङ्क</span> <i>solaṅka</i> <a href="#entry-solafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> nom d'un clan <i>rājput</i> du <a href="#entry-Ugurjara" class="skt-link">Gurjara</a>, d'obédience <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a> — <a href="#entry-solafkii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>solaṅkī</i> hist. np. de la dynastie Solaṅkī; cf. <a href="#entry-Ua_nahilapaa_taka" class="skt-link">Aṇahilapāṭaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-soma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोम</span> <i>soma</i> [<a href="#entry-su_2" class="skt-link">su_2</a><a href="#entry--ma" class="skt-link">-ma</a>] <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. jus excitant extrait par pressage et filtrage des tiges de la plante <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> dont l'identification est controversiale (bot. <i>Cannabis sativa</i> ou <i>Sarcostema viminalis</i> ou <i>Asclepias acida</i> ou <i>Ephedra</i>), breuvage sacré bu par les prêtres lors du sacrifice védique; cf. <a href="#entry-a_mzu" class="skt-link">aṃśu</a>, <a href="#entry-adri" class="skt-link">adri</a>, <a href="#entry-pavitra" class="skt-link">pavitra</a>, <a href="#entry-sutya" class="skt-link">sutya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. sa personnification le dieu Soma, auquel est consacré le 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-ma_n_dala" class="skt-link">maṇḍala</a> du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; plus tard identifié à l'<a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a>, breuvage des dieux et source d'immortalité; le roi des dieux <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> en est ivre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. du dieu <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a> personnifiant la Lune comme «(récipient du) <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>», l'un des 8 Trésors [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>]; il est le gardien [<a href="#entry-dikpaala" class="skt-link">dikpāla</a>] de la direction du Nord-Est; son mariage avec <a href="#entry-Usuuryaa" class="skt-link">Sūryā</a> est évoqué dans les rites du mariage védique; astr. il préside le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Um_rgaziras" class="skt-link">Mṛgaśiras</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Utaaraa" class="skt-link">Tārā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvarcaa" class="skt-link">Varcā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-aayurveda" class="skt-link">āyurveda</a>] principe froid, opp. principe chaud [<a href="#entry-agni" class="skt-link">agni</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre 1 <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avestique Haoma.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-soma_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोम</span> <i>soma_1</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-umaa" class="skt-link">umā</a>] iic. avec <a href="#entry-Uumaa" class="skt-link">Umā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somaadhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somādhi</i> [<a href="#entry-aadhi_1" class="skt-link">ādhi_1</a>] <a href="#entry-somaadhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Somādhi ou Somāpi, fils de <a href="#entry-Usahadeva_1" class="skt-link">Sahadeva_1</a>, roi du <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somaananda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somānanda</i> [<a href="#entry-aananda" class="skt-link">ānanda</a>] <a href="#entry-somaananda" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Somānanda «Joie Lunaire», philosophe <a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a> du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> de la fin du 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, précurseur de la doctrine de la Reconnaissance [<a href="#entry-Upratyabhij_naa" class="skt-link">Pratyabhijñā</a>] qui fut développée par son disciple <a href="#entry-Uutpaladeva" class="skt-link">Utpaladeva</a>; il est l'auteur de la <a href="#entry-Uzivad_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">Śivadṛṣṭi</a>; il fut peut-être l'élève de <a href="#entry-Uvasugupta" class="skt-link">Vasugupta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somaapi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somāpi</i> [<a href="#entry-aapi" class="skt-link">āpi</a>] <a href="#entry-somaapi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. cf. Somādhi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somadaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somadā</i> [<a href="#entry--daa" class="skt-link">-dā</a>] <a href="#entry-somadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de la <a href="#entry-gandharvii" class="skt-link">gandharvī</a> Somadā; elle conçut le roi <a href="#entry-Ubrahmadatta" class="skt-link">Brahmadatta</a> du <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> <a href="#entry-Ucuulii" class="skt-link">Cūlī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somadatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somadatta</i> [<a href="#entry-datta" class="skt-link">datta</a>] <a href="#entry-somadatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du prince <a href="#entry-kaurava" class="skt-link">kaurava</a> Somadatta «Don lunaire», fils de <a href="#entry-Ubaahliika" class="skt-link">Bāhlīka</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Ubhuurizravaa" class="skt-link">Bhūriśravā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi de <a href="#entry-Uvizaalaa" class="skt-link">Viśālā</a> Somadatta_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Ukuzaazva" class="skt-link">Kuśāśva</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Ukakutstha_1" class="skt-link">Kakutstha_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somadeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somadeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-somadeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Somadeva <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a> «Roi du <a href="#entry-Usoma" class="skt-link">Soma</a>», poète de la cour du roi Kalaśa du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>; il composa le <a href="#entry-Ukathaasaritsaagara" class="skt-link">Kathāsaritsāgara</a> entre 1063 et 1082 à partir de la version <a href="#entry-paizaacii" class="skt-link">paiśācī</a> de <a href="#entry-Ugu_naa_dhya" class="skt-link">Guṇāḍhya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Somadeva_1 <a href="#entry-Usuuri" class="skt-link">Sūri</a>, érudit jaïne du 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle durant le règne du roi <a href="#entry-Uraa_s_trakuu_ta" class="skt-link">Rāṣṭrakūṭa</a> <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na_3" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa_3</a>; on lui doit les chefs-d'œuvre <a href="#entry-Uyazastilaka" class="skt-link">Yaśastilaka</a> et le <a href="#entry-Uniitivaakyaam_rta" class="skt-link">Nītivākyāmṛta</a>; il était considéré comme un très grand sage, lettré et poète <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Somadeva_2, alchimiste du Gujarat du 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Urasendracuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">Rasendracūḍāmaṇi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-somanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Somanātha «Maître de <a href="#entry-Usoma" class="skt-link">Soma</a>», premier parmi les 12 signes radieux de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> [<a href="#entry-jyotirlifga" class="skt-link">jyotirliṅga</a>]; on dit qu'il fut établi dans un temple en or par <a href="#entry-Usoma" class="skt-link">Soma</a> à <a href="#entry-Usomanaathapattana" class="skt-link">Somanāthapattana</a>, pour remercier <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> d'avoir adouci la malédiction de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>; son <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> était suspendu dans les airs par magnétisme; un temple moderne fut reconstruit à l'indépendance de l'Inde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Somanātha_1, musicologue du 17⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Uraagavibodha" class="skt-link">Rāgavibodha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somanaathapattana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somanāthapattana</i> [<a href="#entry-pattana" class="skt-link">pattana</a>] <a href="#entry-somanaathapattana" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de Somanāthapattana «Ville de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> Maître de la Lune», célèbre pour ses magnifiques portes et les nombreux trésors de son temple; elle fut pillée par Mahmud de Ghazni en 1025, saccagée de nouveau en 1297 et 1394, et finalement détruite par Aurangzeb en 1706; mod. Somnath Patan sur la côte du Gujarāt.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somanaathapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somanāthapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-somanaathapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Somanāthapura, près de Mysore au <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_taka" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭaka</a>, site du splendide temple de <a href="#entry-Ukezava" class="skt-link">Keśava</a>; elle fut fondée en 1269 par Somadaṇḍanāyaka, vassal du roi <a href="#entry-Uhoysala" class="skt-link">Hoysala</a> Narasiṃha III.<br> <a href="#entry-somanaatha" class="skt-link">somanātha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somapa</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_1" class="skt-link">pa_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-somapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-somapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-somapaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>somapā</i> soc. qui boit le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> — <a href="#entry-somapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. prêtre offrant le sacrifice de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>somapā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somapaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somapāna</i> [<a href="#entry-paana" class="skt-link">pāna</a>] <a href="#entry-somapaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. boisson du <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-somapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du grand monastère bd. de Somapura au Bengale (mod. Paharpur) établi par le roi <a href="#entry-Udharmapaala_1" class="skt-link">Dharmapāla_1</a> au 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il brûla lors d'une guerre au 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, fut reconstruit, et abandonné au 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle lors des invasions musulmanes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somaraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somarāma</i> [<a href="#entry-raama" class="skt-link">rāma</a>] <a href="#entry-somaraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Somarāma, grand lieu de pélerinage shivaïte à <a href="#entry-Uraamacandrapura" class="skt-link">Rāmacandrapura</a>; c'est un <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraamak_setra" class="skt-link">pañcarāmakṣetra</a>, on dit que le <a href="#entry-zivalifga" class="skt-link">śivaliṅga</a> <a href="#entry-Usomezvara" class="skt-link">Someśvara</a> y fut installé par <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a> lui-même.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somarasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somarasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <a href="#entry-somarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. suc de la plante <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somaskanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somaskanda</i> [<a href="#entry-skanda" class="skt-link">skanda</a>] <a href="#entry-somaskanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Somaskanda «(<a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>) avec <a href="#entry-Uumaa" class="skt-link">Umā</a> et <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>», groupe représentant la famille de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, idole de bronze traditionnelle de l'Inde du Sud; elle est associée au culte de <a href="#entry-Utyaagaraaja" class="skt-link">Tyāgarāja</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-soma_1" class="skt-link">soma_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-somasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> arch. gouttière évacuant les libations versées sur le <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> dans un sanctuaire <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somava_mza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somavaṃśa</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a>] <a href="#entry-somava_mza" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. lignée royale lunaire; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubudha" class="skt-link">Budha</a>, <a href="#entry-Upuru" class="skt-link">Puru</a>, <a href="#entry-Udu_syanta" class="skt-link">Duṣyanta</a>, <a href="#entry-Upuruuravaa" class="skt-link">Purūravā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubharata" class="skt-link">Bharata</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukuru" class="skt-link">Kuru</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzaantanu" class="skt-link">Śāṃtanu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somava_mzin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somavaṃśin</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mzin" class="skt-link">vaṃśin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-somava_mzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-somava_mzin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-somava_mzinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>somavaṃśinī</i> myth. prince de la lignée royale lunaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de la dynastie Somavaṃśī, qui régna en Orissa au 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ au siècle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somavaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somavāra</i> [<a href="#entry-vaara" class="skt-link">vāra</a>] <a href="#entry-somavaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lundi, le jour de la Lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somayaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somayāga</i> [<a href="#entry-yaaga" class="skt-link">yāga</a>] <a href="#entry-somayaaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. véd. sacrifice de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-pravargya" class="skt-link">pravargya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somayaajin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somayājin</i> [<a href="#entry-yaajin" class="skt-link">yājin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-somayaajin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-somayaajin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-somayaajinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>somayājinī</i> soc. qui effectue un sacrifice de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du mathématicien et astronome <a href="#entry-Uniilaka_n_tha_3" class="skt-link">Nīlakaṇṭha_3</a> Somayājī, auteur du <a href="#entry-Utantrasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tantrasaṃgraha</a> (1445–1545).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somazambhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somaśambhu</i> [<a href="#entry-zambhu" class="skt-link">śambhu</a>] <a href="#entry-somazambhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Somaśambhu, auteur <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> du 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle né au <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>; on lui doit un important manuel de rituel [<a href="#entry-paddhati" class="skt-link">paddhati</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somazambhupaddhati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somaśambhupaddhati</i> [<a href="#entry-paddhati" class="skt-link">paddhati</a>] <a href="#entry-somazambhupaddhati" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Somaśambhupaddhati, manuel de rituel <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> dû à Somaśambhu.<br> <a href="#entry-somazambhu" class="skt-link">somaśambhu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somazravas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>somaśravas</i> [<a href="#entry-zravas" class="skt-link">śravas</a>] <a href="#entry-somazravas" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Somaśravā «Gloire de l'astre Lune», fils d'un ermite et d'une serpente qui avait absorbé de sa semence; le roi <a href="#entry-Ujanamejaya" class="skt-link">Janamejaya</a> le prit comme chapelain [<a href="#entry-purohita" class="skt-link">purohita</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
