    <i>someśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-somezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du <a href="#entry-zivalifga" class="skt-link">śivaliṅga</a> Someśvara, établi au <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraamak_setra" class="skt-link">pañcarāmakṣetra</a> <a href="#entry-Usomaraama" class="skt-link">Somarāma</a> par <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Someśvara_1, de la dynastie des <a href="#entry-Ucaalukyaas" class="skt-link">Cālukyās</a> de l'Ouest, fils de <a href="#entry-Ujayasi_mha_3" class="skt-link">Jayasiṃha_3</a>; il régna de 1042 à 1068; il combattit sans succès les empereurs <a href="#entry-Ucolaas" class="skt-link">Colās</a>; il fonda la ville de <a href="#entry-Ukalyaa_nii" class="skt-link">Kalyāṇī</a>, dont il fit sa capitale; il se suicida en se noyant dans la <a href="#entry-Utufgabhadraa" class="skt-link">Tuṅgabhadrā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Someśvara_2, fils aîné du précédent; il régna à <a href="#entry-Ukalyaa_nii" class="skt-link">Kalyāṇī</a> de 1068 à 1076, quand il fut détrôné par son jeune frère <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_6" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_6</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Someśvara_3, fils de <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_6" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_6</a>; il régna à <a href="#entry-Ukalyaa_nii" class="skt-link">Kalyāṇī</a> de 1126 à 1138; on lui attribue l'œuvre encyclopédique <a href="#entry-Umaanasollaasa" class="skt-link">Mānasollāsa</a>, probablement composée par ses poètes de cour; Jagadhekamalla_2 lui succéda.<br> <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-somya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोम्य</span> <i>somya</i> [<a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-somya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-somya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-somyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>somyā</i> qui offre le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>; inspiré par le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> — voc. adr. [<i>saumya</i>] mon cher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sopaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोपान</span> <i>sopāna</i> <a href="#entry-sopaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> escalier, marches; échelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> degré, niveau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sopasarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सोपसर्ग</span> <i>sopasarga</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_1" class="skt-link">sa_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upasarga" class="skt-link">upasarga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sopasarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sopasarga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sopasargaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sopasargā</i> gram. se dit d'un verbe composé, précédé d'un préverbe [<a href="#entry-upasarga" class="skt-link">upasarga</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_r_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृष्ट</span> <i>spṛṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sp_rz_1" class="skt-link">spṛś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>spṛṣṭā</i> touché; affecté; affligé de ⟨i. iic.⟩; souillé — <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> phon. contact d'articulation des consonnes [<a href="#entry-sparza" class="skt-link">sparśa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_r_s_tamaithuna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>spṛṣṭamaithuna</i> [<a href="#entry-maithuna" class="skt-link">maithuna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_tamaithuna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_tamaithuna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_tamaithunaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>spṛṣṭamaithunā</i> souillé par le contact sexuel.<br> <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">spṛṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_rh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृह्</span> <i>spṛh</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(spṛhayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>spṛhaṇīya</i><i>)</i> désirer; espérer; être anxieux de, être avide de, être attiré par ⟨dat. g. acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> envier, jalouser ⟨dat. g. acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. σπερχω; ang. spring; all. springen.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_rha_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृहणीय</span> <i>spṛhaṇīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-sp_rh" class="skt-link">spṛh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sp_rha_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rha_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rha_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>spṛhaṇīyā</i> désirable, attractif (à ⟨g. i.⟩); enviable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_rhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृहा</span> <i>spṛhā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sp_rh" class="skt-link">spṛh</a>] <a href="#entry-sp_rhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir ardent; convoitise, envie; plaisir à ⟨dat. g. loc. inf.⟩.<br> <i>spṛhām</i> <i>kṛ</i> désirer, se languir de ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>spṛhām</i> <i>bandh</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_rz_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृश्</span> <i>spṛś_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(spṛśati)</i> pr. md. <i>(spṛśate)</i> pft. <i>(pasparśa)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>spṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(spṛṣat)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>spṛśya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>upa</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> toucher; manier; percevoir par le toucher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> atteindre (d'un mal); prendre pour cible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> asperger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. to sprinkle; fr. asperger.<br> <i>hastaṃ</i> <i>spṛś</i> donner la main.<br> <i>ṣoḍaśavarṣavayo'vasthāmaspṛśat</i> il avait atteint l'âge de 16 ans.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_rz_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृश्</span> <i>spṛś_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sp_rz_1" class="skt-link">spṛś_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-sp_rz_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rz_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rz_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui touche; qui participe à, qui éprouve.<br> <i>gṛtaspṛk</i> nom. m. qui touche le beurre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_rzat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृशत्</span> <i>spṛśat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-sp_rz_1" class="skt-link">spṛś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sp_rzat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rzat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rzantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>spṛśantī</i> touchant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sp_rzya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पृश्य</span> <i>spṛśya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sp_rz_1" class="skt-link">spṛś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sp_rzya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rzya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sp_rzyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>spṛśyā</i> à toucher; tangible; sensible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spa_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पष्ट</span> <i>spaṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-spaz_1" class="skt-link">spaś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-spa_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-spa_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-spa_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>spaṣṭā</i> distinct, clair, évident.<br> <i>spaṣṭam</i> acc. adv. distinctement; exactement.<br> <i>spaṣṭībhū</i> devenir clair.<br> <i>spaṣṭīkṛ</i> éclairer, éclaircir, expliquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spand">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पन्द्</span> <i>spand</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(spandate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>spandita</i><i>)</i> aor. md. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(aspandiṣṭa)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pari</i><i>)</i> frémir, remuer, s'agiter; palpiter, vibrer, trembler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> entrer en mouvement, venir au monde, vivre — ca. <i>(spandayati)</i> faire frémir; animer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पन्द</span> <i>spanda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-spand" class="skt-link">spand</a>] <a href="#entry-spanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> palpitation, mouvement léger autonome; tremblement, vibration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dynamique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. école philosophique <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> sur la nature vibratoire de la conscience, comme pouvoir de changer tout en restant soi-même.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spandakaarikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>spandakārikā</i> [<a href="#entry-kaarikaa" class="skt-link">kārikā</a>] <a href="#entry-spandakaarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. <i>spandakārikās</i> lit. np. des Spandakārikās «Strophes sur la Vibration (de la Conscience)»; ces strophes [<a href="#entry-kaarikaas" class="skt-link">kārikās</a>] commentent le <a href="#entry-Uzivasuutra" class="skt-link">Śivasūtra</a>, et constituent un traité de phil. non dualiste [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>]; elles furent composées par <a href="#entry-Ukalla_ta" class="skt-link">Kallaṭa</a> (9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle) sous la direction de son maître <a href="#entry-Uvasugupta" class="skt-link">Vasugupta</a>; son fils <a href="#entry-Umukula" class="skt-link">Mukula</a> en fit un commentaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spandanir_naya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>spandanirṇaya</i> [<a href="#entry-nir_naya" class="skt-link">nirṇaya</a>] <a href="#entry-spandanir_naya" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Spandanirṇaya «Identification de la Vibration», commentaire des <a href="#entry-Uspandakaarikaas" class="skt-link">Spandakārikās</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Uk_semaraaja" class="skt-link">Kṣemarāja</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-spanda" class="skt-link">spanda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spandita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पन्दित</span> <i>spandita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-spand" class="skt-link">spand</a>] a. <a href="#entry-spandita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-spandita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-spanditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>spanditā</i> tremblant; agité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mis en branle; produit — <a href="#entry-spandita" class="skt-link">n.</a> pulsation, battement, tremblement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. activité de l'intellect.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spardh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पर्ध्</span> <i>spardh</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(spardhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>spardhita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>prati</i><i>)</i> rivaliser, être en compétition avec ⟨i.-<a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a>⟩ (pour ⟨loc.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spardhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पर्धा</span> <i>spardhā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-spardh" class="skt-link">spardh</a>] <a href="#entry-spardhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> émulation, compétition, rivalité; concours.<br> <i>spardhāṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> rivaliser avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sparza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पर्श</span> <i>sparśa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sp_rz_1" class="skt-link">spṛś_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sparza" class="skt-link">m.</a> toucher, contact; sensation tactile; perception, tangibilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la perception [<a href="#entry-tanmaatra" class="skt-link">tanmātra</a>] du toucher [<a href="#entry-tvak" class="skt-link">tvak</a>]; son régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] est <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la propriété [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] du toucher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. le contact, 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ cause de souffrance [<a href="#entry-pratiityasamutpaada" class="skt-link">pratītyasamutpāda</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sentiment, sensation; état émotionnel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> attouchement; contact sexuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. point d'articulation (<a href="#entry-ka_n_thya" class="skt-link">kaṇṭhya</a>, <a href="#entry-taalavya" class="skt-link">tālavya</a>, <a href="#entry-muurdhanya" class="skt-link">mūrdhanya</a>, <a href="#entry-dantya" class="skt-link">dantya</a>, <a href="#entry-o_s_thya" class="skt-link">oṣṭhya</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. consonne de contact, occlusive (il y en a 25, de <i>ka</i> à <i>ma</i>); cf. <a href="#entry-sp_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">spṛṣṭa</a> — ifc. qui touche, qui atteint.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sparzakli_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sparśakliṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-kli_s_ta" class="skt-link">kliṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sparzakli_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzakli_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzakli_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sparśakliṣṭā</i> douloureux au toucher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sparzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पर्शन</span> <i>sparśana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sp_rz_1" class="skt-link">spṛś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sparzana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sparśanā</i> qui touche, qui manipule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui agit sur, qui affecte, qui afflige — <a href="#entry-sparzana" class="skt-link">m.</a> air, vent — <a href="#entry-sparzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> contact; toucher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sensation; sens du toucher; organe des sens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sparzanendriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sparśanendriya</i> [<a href="#entry-indriya" class="skt-link">indriya</a>] <a href="#entry-sparzanendriya" class="skt-link">n.</a> sens [<a href="#entry-buddhiindriya" class="skt-link">buddhīndriya</a>] du toucher.<br> <a href="#entry-sparzana" class="skt-link">sparśana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sparzasa_ncaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sparśasaṃcārin</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_ncaarin" class="skt-link">saṃcārin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sparzasa_mcaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzasa_mcaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzasa_mcaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sparśasaṃcāriṇī</i> qui se propage par le toucher; contagieux, infectieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sparzavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sparśavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sparzavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sparzavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sparśavatī</i> palpable; tangible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> doux au toucher, lisse, moelleux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sparzendriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sparśendriya</i> [<a href="#entry-indriya" class="skt-link">indriya</a>] <a href="#entry-sparzendriya" class="skt-link">n.</a> sens [<a href="#entry-buddhiindriya" class="skt-link">buddhīndriya</a>] du toucher.<br> <a href="#entry-sparza" class="skt-link">sparśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spaz_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पश्</span> <i>spaś_1</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-paz" class="skt-link">paś</a>] pft. md. <i>(paspaśe)</i> aor. md. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] <i>(aspaṣṭa)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>spaṣṭa</i><i>)</i> regarder, observer; épier — ca. <i>(spāśayati)</i> ca. md. <i>(spāśayate)</i> montrer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>specio</i>; ang. spy; fr. épier, spectacle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spaz_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्पश्</span> <i>spaś_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-spaz_1" class="skt-link">spaś_1</a>] <a href="#entry-spaz_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> observateur; espion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. espion de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>spaśa</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spha_tika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फटिक</span> <i>sphaṭika</i> <a href="#entry-spha_tika" class="skt-link">m.</a> cristal de roche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फा</span> <i>sphā</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(sphāyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sphīta</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(spāyat)</i> grossir, engraisser; gonfler; prospérer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphaa_tika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फाटिक</span> <i>sphāṭika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-spha_tika" class="skt-link">sphaṭika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sphaa_tika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphaa_tika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphaa_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphāṭikā</i> cristallin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphaalana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फालन</span> <i>sphālana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sphal" class="skt-link">sphal</a>] <a href="#entry-sphaalana" class="skt-link">n.</a> tremblement, vibration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> friction, mise en vibration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphaayat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फायत्</span> <i>sphāyat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-sphaa" class="skt-link">sphā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sphaayat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphaayat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphaayantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphāyantī</i> qui s'épanouit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphal">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फल्</span> <i>sphal</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sphalati)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i><i>)</i> trembler, vibrer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>fallo</i>; ang. to fall; all. fallen.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphiita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फीत</span> <i>sphīta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sphaa" class="skt-link">sphā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sphiita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphiita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphītā</i> prospère, florissant; riche, plein de ⟨i. iic.⟩; épais (fumée) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nombreux, abondant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फोट</span> <i>sphoṭa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> éclatement, crevaison, explosion; déploiement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. processus cognitif; révélation d'un concept, jaillissement subit du sens d'une énonciation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. son subtil; essence de la parole non encore manifeste; pouvoir évocatif d'un mot ou d'une phrase, véhicule de son sens dans l'esprit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. [<a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari</a>] signe linguistique, alliant signifiant [<a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a>] et signifié [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] en une unité de sens — <a href="#entry-spho_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphoṭā</i> capuchon de cobra déployé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tacandrikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭacandrikā</i> [<a href="#entry-candrikaa" class="skt-link">candrikā</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_tacandrikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. np. de la Sphoṭacandrikā, traité de Kṛṣṇabhaṭṭa.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फोटक</span> <i>sphoṭaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-spho_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_taka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphoṭikā</i> méd. éruption (not. variole); abcès, tumeur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फोटन</span> <i>sphoṭana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-spho_tana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_tana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_tanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphoṭanā</i> qui éclate; qui brise, qui détruit — <a href="#entry-spho_tana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sphoṭana, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «Destructeur» — <a href="#entry-spho_tanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphoṭanī</i> vrille — <a href="#entry-spho_tana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de battre, de déchirer, d'éclater <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> battage (grain) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait d'agiter les bras ou de faire craquer ses doigts.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_taniruupa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭanirūpaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-niruupa_na" class="skt-link">nirūpaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_taniruupa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. np. du Sphoṭanirūpaṇa «Investigation du pouvoir évocatif», œuvre d'Āpadeva.<br> <a href="#entry-spho_tatattva" class="skt-link">sphoṭatattva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tasiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭasiddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_tasiddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Sphoṭasiddhi «Connaissance du processus cognitif», œuvre de <a href="#entry-Uma_n_dana" class="skt-link">Maṇḍana</a> <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a> réfutant <a href="#entry-Ukumaarila" class="skt-link">Kumārila</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a> et établissant la doctrine du pouvoir évocatif (9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); Ṛṣiputra Parameśvara en fit le commentaire Gopālikā.<br> <a href="#entry-spho_ta" class="skt-link">sphoṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tatattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭatattva</i> [<a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_tatattva" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. essence du pouvoir évocatif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tatvaniruupa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭatvanirūpaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-niruupa_na" class="skt-link">nirūpaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_tatvaniruupa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. np. du Sphoṭatvanirūpaṇa «Investigation sur la nature du pouvoir évocatif», œuvre de Śeṣakṛṣṇa (16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_tavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. thèse de <a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari</a> postulant l'existence d'une unité de sens indivisible [<a href="#entry-abheda" class="skt-link">abheda</a>] inhérente à un mot ou à une phrase <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Sphoṭavāda «Doctrine du pouvoir évocatif», œuvre de <a href="#entry-Unaageza" class="skt-link">Nāgeśa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tazataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭaśataka</i> [<a href="#entry-zataka" class="skt-link">śataka</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_tazataka" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. np. du Sphoṭaśataka, traité de Kṛṣṇaśāstrī Arade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फोटित</span> <i>sphoṭita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-spho_tita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_tita" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphoṭita</i> éclaté, déchiré, fendu; révélé — <a href="#entry-spho_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> fissure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फोट्य</span> <i>sphoṭya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-spho_tya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_tya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-spho_tyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphoṭyā</i> à briser, à fendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-spho_tyaabhujafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphoṭyābhujaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-bhujafga" class="skt-link">bhujaṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-spho_tyaabhujafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. bot. <i>Raphidophora laciniata</i>, variété de philodendron, liane grimpant le long des troncs d'arbre; ses tiges sont utilisées en médecine.<br> <a href="#entry-spho_tya" class="skt-link">sphoṭya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphu_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुट्</span> <i>sphuṭ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(sphuṭati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(sphoṭati)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>sphuṭiṣyati</i><i>)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(asphoṭīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sphuṭita</i><i>)</i> se déchirer, se fendre; éclater, exploser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'ouvrir (fleur), s'épanouir — ca. <i>(sphoṭayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sphoṭita</i><i>)</i> faire éclater; fendre, diviser; détruire; crever (yeux).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphu_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुट</span> <i>sphuṭa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sphu_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphu_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphu_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphuṭā</i> ouvert, épanoui, développé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> distinct, clair, manifeste, évident; correct <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> large; répandu, vaste, étendu.<br> <i>sphuṭīkṛ</i> rendre évident; mettre au jour, révéler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphu_tikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुटिका</span> <i>sphuṭikā</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] <a href="#entry-sphu_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fragment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphu_tikama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sphuṭikamaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_ni" class="skt-link">maṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-sphu_tikama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> cristal.<br> <a href="#entry-sphu_tikaa" class="skt-link">sphuṭikā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphu_tita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुटित</span> <i>sphuṭita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sphu_t" class="skt-link">sphuṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sphu_tita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphu_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphu_titaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphuṭitā</i> éclaté; épanoui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphur">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुर्</span> <i>sphur</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(sphurati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sphurita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>nis</i>, <i>vi</i><i>)</i> trembler, vibrer, frémir, palpiter (œil, lèvre) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étinceler, scintiller; se révéler, apparaître subitement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sauter, bondir — ca. <i>(sphorayati)</i> tirer, bander (arc); faire briller; vanter, couvrir de louanges <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>sperno</i>; ang. spurn.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphur_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुर्</span> <i>sphur_1</i> [<a href="#entry-sphur" class="skt-link">sphur</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-sphur_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphur_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphur_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui tremble, qui palpite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphura_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुरण</span> <i>sphuraṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sphur" class="skt-link">sphur</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sphura_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphura_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphura_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphuraṇā</i> qui étincelle, qui brille — <a href="#entry-sphura_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> vibration, pulsation; palpitation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> surgissement, manifestation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de briller, d'étinceller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sphurita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्फुरित</span> <i>sphurita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sphur" class="skt-link">sphur</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sphurita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sphurita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sphuritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sphuritā</i> palpitant, tremblant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apparu soudainement; étalé, exhibé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gonflé — <a href="#entry-sphurita" class="skt-link">n.</a> mouvement convulsif; palpitation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agitation d'esprit, état émotif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étincelle, éclat; radiance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apparition soudaine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sra_ms">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्रंस्</span> <i>sraṃs</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(sraṃsate)</i> tomber.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sra_s_t_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्रष्टृ</span> <i>sraṣṭṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sru" class="skt-link">sru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sra_s_t_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sra_s_t_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sra_s_trii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sraṣṭrī</i> [«qui fait couler»] producteur, créateur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sraṣṭā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> «le Créateur».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sraav">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्राव्</span> <i>srāv</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sru" class="skt-link">sru</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(srāvayati)</i> faire couler, verser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sraava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्राव</span> <i>srāva</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sru" class="skt-link">sru</a>] <a href="#entry-sraava" class="skt-link">m.</a> flot (not. de sang), écoulement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-srag">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्रग्</span> <i>srag</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-sraj" class="skt-link">sraj</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sragdhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sragdhara</i> [<a href="#entry-dhara" class="skt-link">dhara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sragdhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sragdhara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sragdharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sragdharā</i> qui porte une guirlande — <a href="#entry-sragdharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sragdharā</i> lit. mètre poétique syllabique, de 4 pieds de 21 syllabes, avec coupes après le 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ et 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sragvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sragvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sragvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sragvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sragvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sragvatī</i> couronné, qui porte une guirlande.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sragvin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sragvin</i> [<a href="#entry--vin" class="skt-link">-vin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sragvin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sragvin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sragvi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sragviṇī</i> couronné, qui porte une guirlande.<br> <a href="#entry-srag" class="skt-link">srag</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sraj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्रज्</span> <i>sraj</i> <a href="#entry-sraj" class="skt-link">f.</a> guirlande de fleurs, couronne; chapelet porté sur la tête; anneau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> série, suite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sras">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्रस्</span> <i>sras</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sra_ms" class="skt-link">sraṃs</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-sras" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sras" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sras" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui tombe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sraughna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्रौघ्न</span> <i>sraughna</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-srughna" class="skt-link">srughna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sraughna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sraughna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sraugh_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sraughṇī</i> géo. originaire ou habitant de la ville de <a href="#entry-Usrughna" class="skt-link">Srughna</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> situé à, venant de, menant à <a href="#entry-Usrughna" class="skt-link">Srughna</a>, etc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-srava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्रव</span> <i>srava</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sru" class="skt-link">sru</a>] <a href="#entry-srava" class="skt-link">m.</a> courant, flot — ifc. cours de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui répand.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-srava_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stha_n_dila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थण्डिल</span> <i>sthaṇḍila</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-sthala" class="skt-link">sthala</a>] <a href="#entry-stha_n_dila" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. aire sacrificielle, site rituel véd. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sol en terre battue; champ — a. <a href="#entry-stha_n_dila" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stha_n_dila" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stha_n_dilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthaṇḍilā</i> qui dort à même le sol (en pénitence).<br> <i>śrīmadādyākālikāyāḥ</i> <i>devatāyāḥ</i> <i>sthaṇḍilāya</i> <i>namaḥ</i> [<a href="#entry-Umahaanirvaa_natantra" class="skt-link">Mahānirvāṇatantra</a>] Honneur à l'aire sacrée de la Déesse, la révérée <a href="#entry-Ukaalikaa" class="skt-link">Kālikā</a> primordiale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stha_n_dilazaayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthaṇḍilaśāyin</i> [<a href="#entry-zaayin" class="skt-link">śāyin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-stha_n_dilazaayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stha_n_dilazaayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stha_n_dilazaayinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthaṇḍilaśāyinī</i> étendu à même le sol.<br> <a href="#entry-stha_n_dila" class="skt-link">sthaṇḍila</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stha_n_dilazayyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthaṇḍilaśayyā</i> [<a href="#entry-zayyaa" class="skt-link">śayyā</a>] <a href="#entry-stha_n_dilazayyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. fait de s'allonger à même le sol (en pénitence).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaa_n_dila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थाण्डिल</span> <i>sthāṇḍila</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-stha_n_dila" class="skt-link">sthaṇḍila</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaa_n_dila" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaa_n_dila" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaa_n_dilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāṇḍilā</i> soc. qui dort à même le sol par suite d'un vœu religieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaa_nu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थाणु</span> <i>sthāṇu</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a><a href="#entry--nu" class="skt-link">-nu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaa_nu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaa_nu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaa_nu" class="skt-link">f.</a> ferme, fixe, immuable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tronc d'arbre, pilier, poteau, colonne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. mât du rituel <a href="#entry-vaajapeya" class="skt-link">vājapeya</a> — <a href="#entry-sthaa_nu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sthāṇu «Pilier (de feu)», l'un des 11 souffles divins [<a href="#entry-marut" class="skt-link">marut</a>]; épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; son signe [<a href="#entry-tejolifga" class="skt-link">tejoliṅga</a>] est adoré comme <a href="#entry-Uaru_naacalezvara" class="skt-link">Aruṇācaleśvara</a>.<br> <i>sthāṇuṃ</i> <i>vande</i> je rends hommage à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Usthaa_nu" class="skt-link">Sthāṇu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaa_nviizvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthāṇvīśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaa_nviizvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Sthāṇvīśvara «Seigneur du Pilier ardent», <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> de fondation de <a href="#entry-Usthaanezvara" class="skt-link">Sthāneśvara</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sthaa_nu" class="skt-link">sthāṇu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्था</span> <i>sthā_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(tiṣṭhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(tiṣṭhate)</i> pft. <i>(tasthau)</i> pft. md. <i>(tasthe)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <i>(asthāt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sthita</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(tiṣṭhat)</i> ppft. <i>(tasthivas)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>adhi</i>, <i>anu</i>, <i>abhi</i>, <i>ava</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>prati</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> se tenir debout; se tenir immobile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rester, demeurer; persister, subsister, durer; s'arrêter, attendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être présent, exister; être à un certain endroit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'appuyer sur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'occuper, être occupé à, pratiquer; suivre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'offir à ⟨dat.⟩ — ps. <i>(sthīyate)</i> demeurer debout — ca. <i>(sthāpayati)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(atiṣṭhipat)</i> mettre, placer; nommer, établir; arrêter; offrir la présidence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. εστην; lat. <i>sto</i>; all. stehen; ang. to stand; fr. stable.<br> <i>anyathā</i> <i>sthā</i> se comporter autrement.<br> <i>maunena</i> <i>sthā</i> garder le silence.<br> <i>samaṃ</i> <i>sthā</i> traiter qqn. ⟨loc.⟩ sur un pied d'égalité.<br> <i>sukhaṃ</i> <i>sthā</i> se sentir à l'aise.<br> <i>tiṣṭhatu</i> <i>tiṣṭhet</i> laissons cela, soit!<br> <i>śāsane</i> <i>tiṣṭha</i> <i>bhartuḥ</i> suis les instructions du maître<br> <i>chāttrāya</i> <i>tiṣṭhate</i> <i>kanyā</i> la jeune fille s'offre à l'écolier
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्था</span> <i>sthā_2</i> cf. <a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थाली</span> <i>sthālī</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> récipient, casserole, chaudron, marmite.<br> <i>randhanāya</i> <i>sthālī</i> chaudron pour faire la cuisine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaaliipaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthālīpāka</i> [<a href="#entry-paaka" class="skt-link">pāka</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaaliipaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. oblation d'un plat de riz ou d'orge cuit au lait; il est consommé lors du <a href="#entry-mahaavrata" class="skt-link">mahāvrata</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sthaalii" class="skt-link">sthālī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थाम</span> <i>sthāma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-sthaaman" class="skt-link">sthāman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थामन्</span> <i>sthāman</i> <a href="#entry-sthaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> force, puissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hennissement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थान</span> <i>sthāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> posture, position; état, rang, fonction, dignité, grade; condition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séjour, résidence, demeure, siège; trône <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pièce, chambre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> continuation, <i>statu quo</i> (tant que ⟨i.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> site, localité, emplacement, lieu, endroit, place; province, région, domaine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> place qui convient; forteresse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> défense de la position par une troupe (opp. charge [<a href="#entry-yuddha" class="skt-link">yuddha</a>]) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occurrence, cas, section; occasion, cause <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. position d'articulation; cf. <a href="#entry-utpattisthaana" class="skt-link">utpattisthāna</a> — ifc. à la place de, qui tient lieu de, qui joue le rôle de; représenté par.<br> <i>sthāne</i> adv. à propos, avec raison; à bon escient, de manière appropriée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à la place de, au lieu de ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>sthānesthāne</i> var. <i>sthānesthāneṣu</i> à différents endroits, de ça de là.<br> <i>yathāsthānam</i> adv. chacun à sa place.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaanaadhipati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthānādhipati</i> [<a href="#entry-adhipati" class="skt-link">adhipati</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaanaadhipati" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-sthaanapati" class="skt-link">sthānapati</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaanacitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthānacitra</i> [<a href="#entry-citra" class="skt-link">citra</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaanacitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. poésie savante [<a href="#entry-var_nacitra" class="skt-link">varṇacitra</a>] avec des contraintes sur les familles de phonèmes utilisés.<br> <i>agā</i> <i>gāṅgāṅgakākākagāhakāghakakākahā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ahāhāṅka</i> <i>khagāṅkāgakaṅkāgakhagakākaka</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (tout en gutturales) Ô voyageur, qui te baignes dans le courant tortueux des vagues du Gange; tu ne connais pas le triste son des souffrances du monde; ty peux aller jusqu'au Mont Meru; tu n'es pas sous l'empire des sens trompeurs; toi, qui dissipe les péchés, es venu en ce pays.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaananiyama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthānaniyama</i> [<a href="#entry-niyama" class="skt-link">niyama</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaananiyama" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. lipogramme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaanapati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthānapati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaanapati" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. chef d'une institution; not. supérieur de monastère.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaanezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthāneśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaanezvara" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de la ville de pélerinage Sthāneśvara (mod. Thāneswar au <a href="#entry-Uhariyaa_na" class="skt-link">Hariyāṇa</a>); c'était la capitale du roi <a href="#entry-Uhar_sa" class="skt-link">Harṣa</a>, consacrée à <a href="#entry-Usthaa_nviizvara" class="skt-link">Sthāṇvīśvara</a>; elle fut pillée par Mahmud de Ghaśni en 1011.<br> <a href="#entry-sthaana" class="skt-link">sthāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaani">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थानि</span> <i>sthāni</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-sthaanin" class="skt-link">sthānin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaanin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थानिन्</span> <i>sthānin</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaana" class="skt-link">sthāna</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaanin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaanin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaaninii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāninī</i> à sa place; permanent; approprié — <a href="#entry-sthaanin" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. forme originelle; marqueur positionnel à substituer (opp. <a href="#entry-aadeza" class="skt-link">ādeśa</a> le substitut).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaanivat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthānivat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] ind. tel l'élément primitif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. se dit du substitut s'il est sujet à toutes les règles applicables à l'élément originel.<br> <a href="#entry-sthaani" class="skt-link">sthāni</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थाप्</span> <i>sthāp</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(sthāpayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sthāpita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>sthāpya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>sthāpayitvā</i><i>)</i> mettre, placer; nommer, établir; arrêter — ps. <i>(sthāpyate)</i> être placé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaapaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थापक</span> <i>sthāpaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sthaap" class="skt-link">sthāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaapaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāpikā</i> qui place, qui fixe, qui établit; qui érige (not. une idole) — ifc. fondateur de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaapana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थापन</span> <i>sthāpana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sthaap" class="skt-link">sthāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaapana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāpanā</i> qui place, qui fixe; qui maintient, qui préserve — <a href="#entry-sthaapanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāpanā</i> établissement, maintien; régulation, gestion; préservation, renforcement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaapatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थापत्य</span> <i>sthāpatya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sthapati" class="skt-link">sthapati</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaapatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> gardien du gynécée — <a href="#entry-sthaapatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> charge de gouverneur de district <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> architecture, construction d'édifice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaapatyaveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthāpatyaveda</i> [<a href="#entry-veda" class="skt-link">veda</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaapatyaveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Sthāpatyaveda ou science de l'architecture, un <a href="#entry-upaveda" class="skt-link">upaveda</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sthaapatya" class="skt-link">sthāpatya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaapayitvaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थापयित्वा</span> <i>sthāpayitvā</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-sthaap" class="skt-link">sthāp</a>] ind. ayant placé, ayant établi, ayant arrêté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaapita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थापित</span> <i>sthāpita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaapita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāpitā</i> fixé, établi, nommé; déposé; mis en réserve.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaapya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थाप्य</span> <i>sthāpya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaapya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaapyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāpyā</i> à installer, à établir (not. idole) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à placer sur ou dans ⟨loc⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit être rendu immobile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à enfermer (not. à la maison [<i>veśmani</i>]).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaasnu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थास्नु</span> <i>sthāsnu</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaasnu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaasnu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaasnu" class="skt-link">f.</a> ferme; stationnaire; fixe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> durable, permanent; éternel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaasnutaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthāsnutā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaasnutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fermeté; stabilité; permanence.<br> <a href="#entry-sthaasnu" class="skt-link">sthāsnu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaat_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थातृ</span> <i>sthātṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> guide, conducteur (de chevaux, etc.) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> autorité — a. <a href="#entry-sthaat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaat_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthātrī</i> immobile; opp. <a href="#entry-jagat" class="skt-link">jagat</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaavara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थावर</span> <i>sthāvara</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a><a href="#entry--vara" class="skt-link">-vara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthaavara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaavara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthaavaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthāvarā</i> qui se tient debout; immobile; constant, invariable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non capable de mouvement — <a href="#entry-sthaavara" class="skt-link">n.</a> le règne végétal; opp. <a href="#entry-trasa" class="skt-link">trasa</a>, <a href="#entry-jafgama" class="skt-link">jaṅgama</a>, <a href="#entry-cara" class="skt-link">cara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> stabilité; permanence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. propriétés de famille non aliénables — <a href="#entry-sthaavara" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>sthāvarās</i> les plantes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaavaraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthāvaraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaavaraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de Sthāvaraka, serviteur de <a href="#entry-Usa_msthaanaka" class="skt-link">Saṃsthānaka</a> dans la <a href="#entry-Um_rcchaka_tikaa" class="skt-link">Mṛcchakaṭikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaayibhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthāyibhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-sthaayibhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> état d'esprit durable; sentiment stable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-Unaa_tyazaastra" class="skt-link">Nāṭyaśāstra</a>] humeur, émotion de base; <a href="#entry-Ubharatamuni" class="skt-link">Bharatamuni</a> en liste 8: le désir érotique [<a href="#entry-rati" class="skt-link">rati</a>], l'humour [<a href="#entry-haasa" class="skt-link">hāsa</a>], la peine [<a href="#entry-zoka" class="skt-link">śoka</a>], la colère [<a href="#entry-krodha" class="skt-link">krodha</a>], le courage [<a href="#entry-utsaaha" class="skt-link">utsāha</a>], la peur [<a href="#entry-bhaya" class="skt-link">bhaya</a>], le dégoût [<a href="#entry-jugupsaa" class="skt-link">jugupsā</a>] et l'étonnement [<a href="#entry-vismaya" class="skt-link">vismaya</a>]; ces émotions sont évoquées au théâtre par 8 modes esthétiques [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>]; <a href="#entry-Uudbha_ta" class="skt-link">Udbhaṭa</a> leur ajouta la quiétude [<a href="#entry-zama" class="skt-link">śama</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-vyabhicaaribhaava" class="skt-link">vyabhicāribhāva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sthaayi" class="skt-link">sthāyi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaayin">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthaga">

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(sthagayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>sthagita</i><i>)</i> recouvrir, cacher, faire disparaître <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. thugs.

</div>

Stelle; fr. lieu.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

Ancien (se dit des moines [<a href="#entry-bhik_su" class="skt-link">bhikṣu</a>] les plus anciens); cf. <a href="#entry-theravaada" class="skt-link">theravāda</a>.
  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थिर</span> <i>sthira</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthira" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthira" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthiraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthirā</i> ferme, dur; solide, fort; patient <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> calme, résolu, de sang-froid; persévérant, fermement attaché à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> durable, permanent; sûr, établi, certain — <a href="#entry-sthira" class="skt-link">n.</a> chose durable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthiraasana">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

[PT.] np. du corbeau Sthirajīvin.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthiramati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>
