  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthirapreman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthirapreman</i> [<a href="#entry-preman" class="skt-link">preman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthirapreman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthirapreman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthirapremaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthirapremā</i> fidèle en amour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthirataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthiratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sthirataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fermeté; persévérance, ténacité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> stabilité; constance, permanence; calme.<br> <i>sthiratām</i> <i>upe</i> retrouver ses esprits.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthiratva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthiratva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sthiratva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fermeté; stabilité; constance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थित</span> <i>sthita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthitā</i> debout, immobile; qui attend <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occupé à, qui fait; ferme, constant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui se conforme, qui suit, qui est en charge; résolu, convaincu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> présent, prêt, disponible; établi, admis, fixé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui appartient à ⟨g.⟩; qui dépend de ⟨loc.⟩; qui mène à ⟨dat.⟩ — <a href="#entry-sthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> action de s'arrêter, de rester <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. στατος; lat. <i>status</i>; fr. statut.<br> <i>evaṃ</i> <i>sthite</i> adv. cela étant, là dessus.<br> <i>puraḥ</i> <i>sthite</i> en cette imminence.<br> <i>sthitaṃ</i> <i>tena</i> il attendit.<br> <i>upaviśya</i> <i>sthitaḥ</i> il reste assis.<br> <i>kathaṃ</i> <i>sthitāsi</i> comment vas-tu?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthitapraj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthitaprajña</i> [<a href="#entry-praj_na" class="skt-link">prajña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthitapraj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthitapraj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthitapraj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthitaprajñā</i> ferme dans ses convictions; qui accorde ses actes et ses idéaux; dont le comportement est éthique; sage, calme, juste; éclairé; fiable, sincère; respectueux, amène, modeste.<br> <a href="#entry-sthita" class="skt-link">sthita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थिति</span> <i>sthiti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sthiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de se tenir debout bien droit; posture d'attente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séjour, résidence; situation, état permanent; position, rang <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conduite, maintien; occupation, condition, existence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> discipline, ordre, vertu; coutume, usage; règle, loi [«fait de rester dans les limites du devoir»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la préservation, l'une des 5 manifestations divines [<a href="#entry-pa_ncak_rtya" class="skt-link">pañcakṛtya</a>].<br> <i>sthityāṃ</i> <i>sthitaḥ</i> qui reste dans sa situation, constant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthitiprakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthitiprakaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-prakara_na" class="skt-link">prakaraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-sthitiprakara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sthitiprakaraṇa «Manuel de conduite», 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ section du <a href="#entry-Umok_sopaaya" class="skt-link">Mokṣopāya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sthiti" class="skt-link">sthiti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuu_naa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थूणा</span> <i>sthūṇā</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sthuu_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pilier, poteau, colonne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuu_naakar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthūṇākarṇa</i> a. <a href="#entry-sthuu_naakar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuu_naakar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuu_naakar_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthūṇākarṇī</i> aux oreilles pointues (not. vaches) — <a href="#entry-sthuu_naakar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-yak_sa" class="skt-link">yakṣa</a> Sthūṇakarṇa «aux oreilles en pointe», qui échangea son sexe avec <a href="#entry-Uzikha_n_dinii" class="skt-link">Śikhaṇḍinī</a> pour qu'elle devienne le transsexuel [<a href="#entry-kliiba" class="skt-link">klība</a>] <a href="#entry-Uzikha_n_dii" class="skt-link">Śikhaṇḍī</a>; <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> le condamna à rester féminin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] arme magique avec laquelle <a href="#entry-Ubaladeva" class="skt-link">Baladeva</a> dévia la massue de <a href="#entry-Ujaraasandha" class="skt-link">Jarāsandha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuu_naaraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthūṇārāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-sthuu_naaraaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> arch. pilier-maître, au centre d'un édifice.<br> <a href="#entry-sthuu_naa" class="skt-link">sthūṇā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थूल</span> <i>sthūla</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthuula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthūlā</i> gros; massif, épais; large, vaste; encombrant; obèse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rude, grossier; obtus, stupide <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. matériel, tangible (opp. <a href="#entry-suuk_sma" class="skt-link">sūkṣma</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuulabhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthūlabhūta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] <a href="#entry-sthuulabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] élément grossier ou matériel; syn. <a href="#entry-mahaabhuuta" class="skt-link">mahābhūta</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-suuk_smabhuuta" class="skt-link">sūkṣmabhūta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuulacara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthūlacaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-cara_na" class="skt-link">caraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthuulacara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuulacara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuulacara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthūlacaraṇī</i> pied-bot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuulazariira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthūlaśarīra</i> [<a href="#entry-zariira" class="skt-link">śarīra</a>] <a href="#entry-sthuulazariira" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] corps grossier de l'âme, formé d'<a href="#entry-annamayakoza" class="skt-link">annamayakośa</a> et de <a href="#entry-praa_namayakoza" class="skt-link">prāṇamayakośa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuulaziras">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sthūlaśiras</i> [<a href="#entry-ziras" class="skt-link">śiras</a>] <a href="#entry-sthuulaziras" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> Sthūlaśirāa «Grosse tête»; il maudit <a href="#entry-Urambhaa" class="skt-link">Rambhā</a>, qui se réincarna comme la jument <a href="#entry-Uazvah_rdayaa" class="skt-link">Aśvahṛdayā</a>, au service du roi <a href="#entry-Uzatadhanvaa" class="skt-link">Śatadhanvā</a> dans la ville de <a href="#entry-Um_rttikaavatii" class="skt-link">Mṛttikāvatī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sthuula" class="skt-link">sthūla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sthuura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्थूर</span> <i>sthūra</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-sthuula" class="skt-link">sthūla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sthuura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sthuuraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sthūrā</i> épais, dense, massif, solide <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gros; large, vaste — <a href="#entry-sthuura" class="skt-link">m.</a> cuisse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>sthūrau</i> les chevilles; les fesses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stiir_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तीर्ण</span> <i>stīrṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-st_rr" class="skt-link">stṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-stiir_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stiir_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stiir_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>stīrṇā</i> étendu; jonché, parsemé, éparpillé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stobha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तोभ</span> <i>stobha</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-stubh" class="skt-link">stubh</a>] <a href="#entry-stobha" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. syllabe sans signification, interjection chantée dans un <a href="#entry-saaman" class="skt-link">sāman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stoka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तोक</span> <i>stoka</i> a. <a href="#entry-stoka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stoka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stokaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>stokā</i> petit, bref, mince — <a href="#entry-stoka" class="skt-link">m.</a> goutte; mèche.<br> <i>stokam</i> adv. un peu; à peine; peu à peu.<br> <i>stokena</i> <i>na</i> adv. pas le moins du monde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stoma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तोम</span> <i>stoma</i> [<a href="#entry-stu" class="skt-link">stu</a><a href="#entry--ma" class="skt-link">-ma</a>] <a href="#entry-stoma" class="skt-link">n.</a> éloge; hymne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> masse, amas, multitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stotra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तोत्र</span> <i>stotra</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-stu" class="skt-link">stu</a>] <a href="#entry-stotra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. éloge, louange; hymne, ode <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. hymne à chanter (opp. <a href="#entry-zastra" class="skt-link">śastra</a> hymne à réciter); il se compose de 5 parties: l'ouverture [<a href="#entry-prastaava" class="skt-link">prastāva</a>], le chant [<a href="#entry-udgiitha" class="skt-link">udgītha</a>], les vocalises [<a href="#entry-pratihaara" class="skt-link">pratihāra</a>], l'attaque [<a href="#entry-upadrava" class="skt-link">upadrava</a>] et la finale [<a href="#entry-nidhana" class="skt-link">nidhana</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stotriiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तोत्रीय</span> <i>stotrīya</i> [<a href="#entry-stotra" class="skt-link">stotra</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-stotriiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stotriiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stotriiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>stotrīyā</i> relatif à un <a href="#entry-stotra" class="skt-link">stotra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>stotriya</i> f. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-strai_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्त्रैण</span> <i>straiṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-strii" class="skt-link">strī</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] a. <a href="#entry-strai_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-strai_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-strai_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>straiṇā</i> féminin; femelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> concernant les femmes; dirigé par les femmes — <a href="#entry-strai_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> la gent féminine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> la nature féminine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-strii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्त्री</span> <i>strī</i> <a href="#entry-strii" class="skt-link">f.</a> femme; épouse; femelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>strīliṅga</i>] gram. genre féminin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striidhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strīdhana</i> [<a href="#entry-dhana" class="skt-link">dhana</a>] <a href="#entry-striidhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. biens de la femme; dot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striidharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strīdharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-striidharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> condition féminine; droits et devoirs de la femme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strīka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-striika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-striika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-striikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>strīkā</i> féminin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striinaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strīnāman</i> [<a href="#entry-naaman" class="skt-link">nāman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-striinaaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-striinaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-striinaamnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>strīnāmnī</i> qui a un nom féminin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striiparvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strīparvan</i> [<a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>] <a href="#entry-striiparvan" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ livre du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>, «des (lamentations) des femmes».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striipratyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strīpratyaya</i> [<a href="#entry-pratyaya" class="skt-link">pratyaya</a>] <a href="#entry-striipratyaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. suffixe de formation de thème féminin, affixé à une base nominale [<a href="#entry-praatipadikaa" class="skt-link">prātipadikā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-strii" class="skt-link">strī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strītā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-striitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> féminité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-striitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>strītva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-striitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> état féminin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तु</span> <i>stu</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(stauti)</i> pft. <i>(tuṣṭāva)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>stoṣyati</i><i>)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(atuṣṭavat)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] <i>(astauṣīt)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(astāvīt)</i> aor. ps. <i>(astāvi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>stuta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>stutya</i>, <i>stāvya</i><i>)</i> ppr. ps. <i>(stūyamāna)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>stutvā</i>, <i>-stutya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> louer, célébrer, glorifier — ps. <i>(stūyate)</i> être loué — ca. <i>(stāvayati)</i> louer — ca. md. <i>(stāvayate)</i> faire célébrer — dés. <i>(tuṣṭūṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>tuṣṭūṣita</i><i>)</i> vouloir célébrer ou glorifier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stubdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तुब्ध</span> <i>stubdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-stubh" class="skt-link">stubh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-stubdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stubdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stubdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>stubdhā</i> chanté, célébré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stubh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तुभ्</span> <i>stubh</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(stobhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>stubdha</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i><i>)</i> célébrer; chanter (not. un <a href="#entry-saaman" class="skt-link">sāman</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stukaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तुका</span> <i>stukā</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-stoka" class="skt-link">stoka</a>] <a href="#entry-stukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> mèche, natte (de cheveux); touffe, tresse (not. de laine).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stut">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तुत्</span> <i>stut</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-stu" class="skt-link">stu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-stut" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stut" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stut" class="skt-link">f.</a> ifc. qui loue, qui célèbre — <a href="#entry-stut" class="skt-link">f.</a> hymne de louange.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तुत</span> <i>stuta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-stu" class="skt-link">stu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-stuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>stutā</i> loué, célébré, glorifié — <a href="#entry-stuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> louange; hymne; chant de l'<a href="#entry-udgaat_r" class="skt-link">udgātṛ</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-stotra" class="skt-link">stotra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तुति</span> <i>stuti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-stu" class="skt-link">stu</a>] <a href="#entry-stuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> louange, panégyrique; flatterie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stuupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तूप</span> <i>stūpa</i> <a href="#entry-stuupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> amas, tas; mont <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. tumulus en terre ou dôme-monument en brique, de forme conique servant de reliquaire ou commémorant un événement de la vie de <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-stuuyamaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्तूयमान</span> <i>stūyamāna</i> [ppr. ps. <a href="#entry-stu" class="skt-link">stu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-stuuyamaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-stuuyamaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-stuuyamaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>stūyamānā</i> étant loué.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-styaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्त्या</span> <i>styā</i> var. <i>stī</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(styāyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>styāna</i><i>)</i> durcir; se congeler; augmenter, s'étendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> répercuter (un son).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-styaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्त्यान</span> <i>styāna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-styaa" class="skt-link">styā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-styaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-styaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-styaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>styānā</i> coagulé, figé — <a href="#entry-styaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> intensité, accroissement, extension <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> son répercuté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_s_thu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुष्ठु</span> <i>suṣṭhu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] adv. bien, comme il faut; excellemment; extrêmement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excl. bien!<br> <i>suṣṭhu</i> <i>khalu</i> très certainement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_s_thuprayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suṣṭhuprayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-prayoga" class="skt-link">prayoga</a>] <a href="#entry-su_s_thuprayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> bon usage, emploi correct <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. not. usage correct d'un mot.<br> <a href="#entry-su_s_thu" class="skt-link">suṣṭhu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_sira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुषिर</span> <i>suṣira</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-siraa" class="skt-link">sirā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-su_sira" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-su_sira" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-su_siraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suṣirā</i> [«bien drainé»] percé, creux — <a href="#entry-su_sira" class="skt-link">m.</a> bambou, roseau, canne — <a href="#entry-su_sira" class="skt-link">n.</a> vaisseau, tube; creux, trou, cavité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> flûte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_sumna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुषुम्न</span> <i>suṣumna</i> var. <i>suṣumṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-sumna" class="skt-link">sumna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-su_sumna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-su_sumna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-su_sumnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suṣumnā</i> très aimable, très bon — <a href="#entry-su_sum_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suṣumṇā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] la voie psychique centrale [<a href="#entry-maarga" class="skt-link">mārga</a>] Suṣumṇā «Bonne prière», représentation de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_1" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_1</a> dans le microcosme; on y fait monter l'<a href="#entry-apaanavaayu" class="skt-link">apānavāyu</a> au moyen du <a href="#entry-muulabandha" class="skt-link">mūlabandha</a>; sa rencontre avec le <a href="#entry-praa_navaayu" class="skt-link">prāṇavāyu</a> provoque l'éveil de <a href="#entry-Uku_n_dalinii" class="skt-link">Kuṇḍalinī</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ui_daa" class="skt-link">Iḍā</a>, <a href="#entry-Upifgalaa" class="skt-link">Piṅgalā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_supta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुषुप्त</span> <i>suṣupta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-supta" class="skt-link">supta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-su_supta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-su_supta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-su_suptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suṣuptā</i> profondément endormi — <a href="#entry-su_supta" class="skt-link">n.</a> sommeil profond.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_supti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुषुप्ति</span> <i>suṣupti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-supti" class="skt-link">supti</a>] <a href="#entry-su_supti" class="skt-link">f.</a> l'état [<a href="#entry-avasthaa_2" class="skt-link">avasthā_2</a>] de sommeil profond <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le troisième stade de conscience; cf. <a href="#entry-maa_n_duukyopani_sad" class="skt-link">māṇḍūkyopaniṣad</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सु</span> <i>su_1</i> pf. bon, bien; beau, joli, agréable; très.<br> <i>su</i> <i>siktaṃ</i> <i>tvayā</i> Tu as bien arrosé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-su_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सु</span> <i>su_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(sunoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>suta_1</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>adhi</i>, <i>ā</i><i>)</i> véd. presser, exprimer; pressurer (not. le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> pour le sacrifice).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sub">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुब्</span> <i>sub</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-sup" class="skt-link">sup</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subaahu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुबाहु</span> <i>subāhu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-baahu" class="skt-link">bāhu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subaahu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subaahu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subaahu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui a de beaux bras; aux bras puissants — <a href="#entry-subaahu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a> Subāhu, fils de <a href="#entry-Usunda_1" class="skt-link">Sunda_1</a> et <a href="#entry-Utaa_takaa" class="skt-link">Tāṭakā</a>, devenu <a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a> par la malédiction d'<a href="#entry-Uagastya" class="skt-link">Agastya</a>; avec son frère <a href="#entry-Umaariica" class="skt-link">Mārīca</a> ils perturbèrent le sacrifice de <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Subāhu_1, fils du roi <a href="#entry-Uzatrughna" class="skt-link">Śatrughna</a>, qui lui donna la ville de <a href="#entry-Umadhuraa" class="skt-link">Madhurā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Subāhu_2, fils de <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>, roi des <a href="#entry-Ucedayas" class="skt-link">Cedayas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subahu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुबहु</span> <i>subahu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bahu" class="skt-link">bahu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subahu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subahu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subahvii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subahvī</i> très nombreux; en très grande quantité — adv. beaucoup, énormément; très souvent, fréquemment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subahudhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subahudhā</i> [<a href="#entry--dhaa" class="skt-link">-dhā</a>] adv. souvent, fréquemment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subahuzas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subahuśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. id.<br> <a href="#entry-subahu" class="skt-link">subahu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुबल</span> <i>subala</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bala" class="skt-link">bala</a>] <a href="#entry-subala" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Subala «Très Fort», roi du <a href="#entry-Ugandhaara" class="skt-link">Gandhāra</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Uzakuni" class="skt-link">Śakuni</a> et <a href="#entry-Ugaandhaarii" class="skt-link">Gāndhārī</a>; de l'os de sa cuisse ont été fabriqués les dés avec lesquels <a href="#entry-Uzakuni" class="skt-link">Śakuni</a> trichait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subandhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुबन्धु</span> <i>subandhu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bandhu" class="skt-link">bandhu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subandhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subandhu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subandhu" class="skt-link">f.</a> proche parent ou ami — <a href="#entry-subandhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Subandhu, écrivain antérieur à <a href="#entry-Ubaa_na_2" class="skt-link">Bāṇa_2</a>; il est l'auteur du célèbre roman en prose <a href="#entry-Uvaasavadattaa" class="skt-link">Vāsavadattā</a>, chef d'œuvre de figures <a href="#entry-zle_sa" class="skt-link">śleṣa</a>, émaillé d'images érotiques et de comparaisons scabreuses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subanta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-subanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. forme déclinée d'un thème nominal; opp. <a href="#entry-tifanta" class="skt-link">tiṅanta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subha_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभट</span> <i>subhaṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bha_ta" class="skt-link">bhaṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-subha_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> héros; champion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du poète Subhaṭa, auteur du drame Dūtāṅgada (13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभाष</span> <i>subhāṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_saa" class="skt-link">bhāṣā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhaa_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaa_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhāṣā</i> qui parle bien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभाषिन्</span> <i>subhāṣin</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_sin" class="skt-link">bhāṣin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhaa_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaa_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaa_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhāṣiṇī</i> qui parle gentiment, qui dit des paroles aimables.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभाषित</span> <i>subhāṣita</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_sita" class="skt-link">bhāṣita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhaa_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaa_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaa_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhāṣitā</i> bien dit; éloquent — <a href="#entry-subhaa_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> belle parole, éloge; stance morale, dicton, proverbe.<br> <i>bālādapi</i> <i>subhāṣitam</i> On peut profiter d'un bon conseil, même de la part d'un enfant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sitaavalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subhāṣitāvalī</i> [<a href="#entry-aavalii" class="skt-link">āvalī</a>] <a href="#entry-subhaa_sitaavalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Subhāṣitāvalī «Guirlande de proverbes», anthologie de dictons compilée par <a href="#entry-Uvallabhadeva" class="skt-link">Vallabhadeva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-subhaa_sita" class="skt-link">subhāṣita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sitakaustubha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subhāṣitakaustubha</i> [<a href="#entry-kaustubha" class="skt-link">kaustubha</a>] <a href="#entry-subhaa_sitakaustubha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Subhāṣitakaustubha, recueil de proverbes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sitaratnabhaa_n_daagaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subhāṣitaratnabhāṇḍāgāra</i> [<a href="#entry-ratnabhaa_n_daagaara" class="skt-link">ratnabhāṇḍāgāra</a>] <a href="#entry-subhaa_sitaratnabhaa_n_daagaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Subhāṣitaratnabhāṇḍāgāra (SRB.), anthologie moderne de proverbes due à Nārāyaṇa Rāma <a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>; aussi appelée Subhāṣitaratnakhaṇḍamañjūṣā.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sitaratnakoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subhāṣitaratnakośa</i> [<a href="#entry-ratnakoza" class="skt-link">ratnakośa</a>] <a href="#entry-subhaa_sitaratnakoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du recueil de poésie de cour Subhāṣitaratnakośa, du poète <a href="#entry-Uvidyaakara" class="skt-link">Vidyākara</a> (vers 1050).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaa_sitasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subhāṣitasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-subhaa_sitasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. recueil de dictons.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaanu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभानु</span> <i>subhānu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaanu" class="skt-link">bhānu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhaanu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaanu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaanu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui resplendit — <a href="#entry-subhaanu" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. np. de Subhānu «Resplendissant», personnification de l'an 17 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [BhP.] np. de Subhānu_1, un fils de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhadra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभद्र</span> <i>subhadra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhadra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhadra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhadraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhadrā</i> excellent, glorieux, magnifique — <a href="#entry-subhadraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhadrā</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Subhadrā «la Glorieuse», fille chérie de <a href="#entry-Uvasudeva" class="skt-link">Vasudeva</a> et de <a href="#entry-Udevakii" class="skt-link">Devakī</a>, sœur de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>; elle devint seconde épouse d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> qui l'enleva avec l'assentiment de son frère; pour vaincre la jalousie de <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a>, elle se présenta à elle à <a href="#entry-Uindraprastha" class="skt-link">Indraprastha</a> en tenue de vachère; elle enfanta d'<a href="#entry-Uabhimanyu" class="skt-link">Abhimanyu</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ucitraa_1" class="skt-link">Citrā_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभग</span> <i>subhaga</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaga" class="skt-link">bhaga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhaga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhagaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhagā</i> favorable; heureux, favorisé; chanceux, fortuné — voc. adr. mon cher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभव</span> <i>subhava</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhava" class="skt-link">bhava</a>] <a href="#entry-subhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«qui a une noble origine»] roi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhoja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभोज</span> <i>subhoja</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhoja" class="skt-link">bhoja</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhoja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhoja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhojaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhojā</i> facile à manger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभ्रु</span> <i>subhru</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhruu" class="skt-link">bhrū</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhru" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhru" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhru" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui a de beaux sourcils — <a href="#entry-subhruu" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhrū</i> jolie femme [«aux beaux sourcils»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभूत</span> <i>subhūta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-subhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subhūtā</i> (nourriture) bien préparée — <a href="#entry-subhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> bien-être.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subhuuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुभूति</span> <i>subhūti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bhuuti" class="skt-link">bhūti</a>] <a href="#entry-subhuuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> bien-être — <a href="#entry-subhuuti" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Subhūti, disciple du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvajracchedikaa" class="skt-link">Vajracchedikā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du lexicographe Subhūti_1 ou Subhūticandra, auteur de la <a href="#entry-Ukavikaamadhenu" class="skt-link">Kavikāmadhenu</a>, commentaire de l'<a href="#entry-Uamarako_sa" class="skt-link">Amarakoṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुबोध</span> <i>subodha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-bodha" class="skt-link">bodha</a>] <a href="#entry-subodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> bonne compréhension — a. <a href="#entry-subodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-subodha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-subodhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>subodhā</i> facile à comprendre, facile à enseigner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subodhinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subodhinī</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-subodhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> manuel introductif, œuvre didactique, commentaire.<br> <a href="#entry-subodha" class="skt-link">subodha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subrahma_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुब्रह्मण्य</span> <i>subrahmaṇya</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-brahma_nya" class="skt-link">brahmaṇya</a>] <a href="#entry-subrahma_nya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Subrahmaṇya, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> «Dévoué aux brâhmanes».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-subvibhakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>subvibhakti</i> [<a href="#entry-vibhakti" class="skt-link">vibhakti</a>] <a href="#entry-subvibhakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. suffixe marquant le cas d'une flexion nominale; on distingue les cas: <a href="#entry-prathamaa" class="skt-link">prathamā</a> nominatif, <a href="#entry-dvitiiyaa" class="skt-link">dvitīyā</a> accusatif, <a href="#entry-t_rtiiyaa" class="skt-link">tṛtīyā</a> instrumental, <a href="#entry-caturthii" class="skt-link">caturthī</a> datif, <a href="#entry-pa_ncamii" class="skt-link">pañcamī</a> ablatif, <a href="#entry-_sa_s_thii" class="skt-link">ṣaṣṭhī</a> génitif, et <a href="#entry-saptamii" class="skt-link">saptamī</a> locatif.<br> <a href="#entry-sub" class="skt-link">sub</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sucak_sus">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुचक्षुस्</span> <i>sucakṣus</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-cak_sus" class="skt-link">cakṣus</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sucak_sus" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sucak_sus" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sucak_su_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sucakṣuṣī</i> qui a de bons yeux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sucandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुचन्द्र</span> <i>sucandra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-candra" class="skt-link">candra</a>] <a href="#entry-sucandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi de <a href="#entry-Uvizaalaa" class="skt-link">Viśālā</a> Sucandra, fils de <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra_1" class="skt-link">Hemacandra_1</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Udhuumraazva" class="skt-link">Dhūmrāśva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sucarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुचरित</span> <i>sucarita</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-carita" class="skt-link">carita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sucarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sucarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sucaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sucaritā</i> bien accompli, correct <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui se conduit bien, vertueux — <a href="#entry-sucarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> bienfait, bonne œuvre; bonne conduite — <a href="#entry-sucarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du grammairien Sucarita <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a> (début du 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sucira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुचिर</span> <i>sucira</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-cira" class="skt-link">cira</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sucira" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sucira" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suciraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sucirā</i> très long — acc. <i>suciram</i> adv. iic. pendant longtemps — g. <i>sucirāya</i> adv. iic. id. — loc. <i>sucireṇa</i> adv. iic. id. — abl. <i>sucirāt</i> adv. iic. très longtemps après.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suciraayus">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sucirāyus</i> [<a href="#entry-aayus" class="skt-link">āyus</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suciraayus" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suciraayus" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suciraayus" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui vit très longtemps (se dit d'une divinité).<br> <a href="#entry-sucira" class="skt-link">sucira</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदाम</span> <i>sudāma</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-daaman_1" class="skt-link">dāman_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sudaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [BhP.] np. de Sudāma ou Sudāman «Généreux», jeune brâhmane compagnon d'étude [<a href="#entry-gurukula" class="skt-link">gurukula</a>] et ami intime de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> pendant sa jeunesse à <a href="#entry-Uv_rndaavana" class="skt-link">Vṛndāvana</a>, chez le maître <a href="#entry-Usaandiipani" class="skt-link">Sāndīpani</a>; il était pauvre, se maria, et vécut avec sa famille dans la misère; son épouse <a href="#entry-Usuziilaa" class="skt-link">Suśīlā</a> l'incita à rendre visite à <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, devenu roi à <a href="#entry-Udvaarakaa" class="skt-link">Dvārakā</a>; il avait honte de lui apporter en cadeau quelques flocons de riz, mais celui-ci l'honora comme un hôte de marque, lui lava les pieds et le couvrit de présents; à son retour sa modeste hutte était devenue un palais; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukucela" class="skt-link">Kucela</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. nom d'un peuple — <a href="#entry-sudaamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudāmā</i> myth. np. de Sudāmā, l'une des nourrices de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदामन्</span> <i>sudāman</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-daaman_1" class="skt-link">dāman_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudaaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudaamanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudāmanī</i> généreux, qui donne en abondance — <a href="#entry-sudaaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> np. de nombreux personnages; not. cf. <a href="#entry-Usudaama" class="skt-link">Sudāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदास</span> <i>sudāsa</i> <a href="#entry-sudaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. [RV.] np. du roi Sudāsa du peuple <a href="#entry-Ut_rtsu" class="skt-link">Tṛtsu</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Udivodaasa_1" class="skt-link">Divodāsa_1</a>; vainqueur de la bataille des 10 rois [<a href="#entry-daazaraaj_na" class="skt-link">dāśarājña</a>], il permit aux <a href="#entry-Ubharataas" class="skt-link">Bharatās</a> de s'établir au <a href="#entry-Ukuruk_setra" class="skt-link">Kurukṣetra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> Sudāsa_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Usarvakaama" class="skt-link">Sarvakāma</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Ukalmaa_sapaada" class="skt-link">Kalmāṣapāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudak_si_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदक्षिण</span> <i>sudakṣiṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dak_si_na" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudak_si_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudak_si_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudak_si_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudakṣiṇā</i> adroit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> courtois, poli; sincère, franc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> généreux envers les prêtres — <a href="#entry-sudak_si_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [BhP.] np. de Sudakṣiṇa, fils de <a href="#entry-Upau_n_draka" class="skt-link">Pauṇḍraka</a>; pour venger son père, il implora <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, qui lui donna le <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> pour créer le monstre <a href="#entry-Udak_si_naagni" class="skt-link">Dakṣiṇāgni</a>, qui échoua à combattre <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, et finit par se retourner contre lui — <a href="#entry-sudak_si_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudakṣiṇā</i> myth. np. de Sudakṣiṇā «Généreuse envers les prêtres», épouse de <a href="#entry-Udiliipa_2" class="skt-link">Dilīpa_2</a>, mère de <a href="#entry-Uraghu" class="skt-link">Raghu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदन्त</span> <i>sudanta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-danta" class="skt-link">danta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudantā</i> <a href="#entry-sudantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudantī</i> qui a de belles dents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदर्शन</span> <i>sudarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudarzana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudarzanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudarśanā</i> beau, gracieux, agréable [«plaisant au regard»] — <a href="#entry-sudarzana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. de Sudarśana «Magnifique», personnifiant le <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> ou disque flamboyant, arme solaire de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uvajranaabha" class="skt-link">Vajranābha</a> ou <a href="#entry-Ucakrapuru_sa" class="skt-link">Cakrapuruṣa</a>; il est issu du barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>]; ou [VP.] <a href="#entry-Uvizvakarmaa" class="skt-link">Viśvakarmā</a> le façonna avec les copeaux obtenus en rabotant l'éclat du Soleil; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> le donna à <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> après le <a href="#entry-khaa_n_davadahana" class="skt-link">khāṇḍavadahana</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «le Gracieux» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [BhP.] np. du <a href="#entry-vidyaadhara" class="skt-link">vidyādhara</a> Sudarśana_1, génie céleste de grande beauté, mais très vaniteux; pour s'être moqué de la laideur d'<a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a> celui-ci le maudit à renaître comme un démon serpent au bord de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a>; un jour il attaqua <a href="#entry-Unanda" class="skt-link">Nanda</a>, mais <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> le toucha du pied et il retrouva sa forme céleste, libéré de sa malédiction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> Sudarśana_2, fils de <a href="#entry-Uzafkha_na" class="skt-link">Śaṅkhaṇa</a>, père d'<a href="#entry-Uagnivar_na" class="skt-link">Agnivarṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Uhitopadeza" class="skt-link">Hitopadeśa</a>] np. du roi (fictif) Sudarśana_3.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदत्</span> <i>sudat</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dat" class="skt-link">dat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudatī</i> qui a de belles dents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदत्त</span> <i>sudatta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-datta" class="skt-link">datta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudatta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudattā</i> bien donné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suddhyupaasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुद्ध्युपास्य</span> <i>suddhyupāsya</i> [<a href="#entry-sudhii" class="skt-link">sudhī</a>-<a href="#entry-upaasya" class="skt-link">upāsya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suddhyupaasya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suddhyupaasya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suddhyupaasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suddhyupāsyā</i> adoré par les sages (se dit de Dieu).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sude_s_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदेष्ण</span> <i>sudeṣṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-de_s_na" class="skt-link">deṣṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sude_s_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sude_s_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sude_s_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudeṣṇā</i> généreux — <a href="#entry-sude_s_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sudeṣṇa «Généreux», un fils de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> — <a href="#entry-sude_s_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudeṣṇā</i> myth. np. de Sudeṣṇā «Généreuse», épouse du roi <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a>; elle enfanta de l'ascète <a href="#entry-Udiirghatamaa" class="skt-link">Dīrghatamā</a> les rois <a href="#entry-Uafga_1" class="skt-link">Aṅga_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvafga" class="skt-link">Vaṅga</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukalifga_1" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dra" class="skt-link">Puṇḍra</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzufga" class="skt-link">Śuṅga</a> et <a href="#entry-Usuhma" class="skt-link">Suhma</a>, qui donnèrent leurs noms aux royaumes corr. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de la reine Sudeṣṇā_1, épouse du roi <a href="#entry-Uviraa_ta" class="skt-link">Virāṭa</a>; son frère <a href="#entry-Ukiicaka" class="skt-link">Kīcaka</a> était le commandant de l'armée; pendant sa dernière année d'exil, <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a> était à son service, dissimulée comme la <a href="#entry-sairandhrii" class="skt-link">sairandhrī</a> <a href="#entry-Umaalinii_1" class="skt-link">Mālinī_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदेव</span> <i>sudeva</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-sudeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du roi Sudeva «Bon roi», de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>], fils de <a href="#entry-Ucu_ncu" class="skt-link">Cuñcu</a>; <a href="#entry-Ubharuka" class="skt-link">Bharuka</a> est son fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदेश</span> <i>sudeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-deza" class="skt-link">deśa</a>] <a href="#entry-sudeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> bon endroit; emplacement approprié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudezika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदेशिक</span> <i>sudeśika</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dezika" class="skt-link">deśika</a>] <a href="#entry-sudezika" class="skt-link">m.</a> bon guide.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudh_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुधृति</span> <i>sudhṛti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dh_rti" class="skt-link">dhṛti</a>] <a href="#entry-sudh_rti" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [BhP.] np. du roi Sudhṛti <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a> «le très résolu», fils de <a href="#entry-Umahaaviirya" class="skt-link">Mahāvīrya</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Udh_r_s_taketu_1" class="skt-link">Dhṛṣṭaketu_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुधा</span> <i>sudhā</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaa_2" class="skt-link">dhā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sudhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> nectar des fleurs; lait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. boisson des dieux, nectar; syn. <a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> crépi, stuc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhaakara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sudhākara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] <a href="#entry-sudhaakara" class="skt-link">m.</a> réceptacle de nectar.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhaalaharii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sudhālaharī</i> [<a href="#entry-laharii" class="skt-link">laharī</a>] <a href="#entry-sudhaalaharii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Sudhālaharī «Vague de nectar», poème d'éloges au Soleil de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha_1" class="skt-link">Jagannātha_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-sudhaa" class="skt-link">sudhā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुधन</span> <i>sudhana</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dhana" class="skt-link">dhana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudhanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudhanā</i> très riche — <a href="#entry-sudhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. du prince Sudhana «Fortuné», disciple exemplaire, qui après un long parcours initiatique, reçut l'Eveil grâce à <a href="#entry-Usamantabhadra" class="skt-link">Samantabhadra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhanaavadaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sudhanāvadāna</i> [<a href="#entry-avadaana_2" class="skt-link">avadāna_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sudhanaavadaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sudhanavadāna, «Légende dorée de <a href="#entry-Usudhana" class="skt-link">Sudhana</a>», œuvre bd.<br> <a href="#entry-sudhana" class="skt-link">sudhana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhanvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुधन्वन्</span> <i>sudhanvan</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dhanvan" class="skt-link">dhanvan</a>] <a href="#entry-sudhanvan" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sudhanvā «Habile à l'arc», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] <a href="#entry-Uvirocana" class="skt-link">Virocana</a> et lui s'éprirent de la même fille; ils demandèrent à <a href="#entry-Uprahlaada" class="skt-link">Prahlāda</a> de les arbitrer; <a href="#entry-Usudhanvaa" class="skt-link">Sudhanvā</a>, craignant que celui-ci ne favorise son fils, lui rappela la terrible punition pour un menteur (<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> leur éclate le crâne); après consultation de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uprahlaada" class="skt-link">Prahlāda</a> déclara que <a href="#entry-Usudhanvaa" class="skt-link">Sudhanvā</a> était de plus noble origine et avait ainsi préséance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Sudhanvā_1, qui régnait à <a href="#entry-Usafkaazyaa" class="skt-link">Saṃkāśyā</a>; il attaqua <a href="#entry-Umithilaa" class="skt-link">Mithilā</a> pour prendre l'arc <a href="#entry-Uajagava" class="skt-link">Ajagava</a> au roi <a href="#entry-Ujanakaraaja" class="skt-link">Janakarāja</a>, mais ce dernier le tua et donna sa capitale à son frère <a href="#entry-Ukuzadhvaja_1" class="skt-link">Kuśadhvaja_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुधर्म</span> <i>sudharma</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-sudharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> bonne loi; justice; devoir — a. <a href="#entry-sudharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudharma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudharmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudharmā</i> qui rend bonne justice — <a href="#entry-sudharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. un des 10 disciples de <a href="#entry-Umahaaviira" class="skt-link">Mahāvīra</a> — <a href="#entry-sudharmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudharmā</i> myth. salle de réunion des dieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुधी</span> <i>sudhī</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dhii_2" class="skt-link">dhī_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sudhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> intelligence — a. <a href="#entry-sudhii" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudhii" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> intelligent, avisé, sage; pieux — <a href="#entry-sudhii" class="skt-link">m.</a> précepteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> expert.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhuumravar_naa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुधूम्रवर्णा</span> <i>sudhūmravarṇā</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dhuumravar_na" class="skt-link">dhūmravarṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-sudhuumravar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. épith. de l'une des 7 langues d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudhyupaasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sudhyupāsya</i> [<a href="#entry-upaasya" class="skt-link">upāsya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sudhyupaasya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sudhyupaasya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sudhyupaasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sudhyupāsyā</i> qui doit être vénéré par le sage.<br> <a href="#entry-sudhii" class="skt-link">sudhī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदि</span> <i>sudi</i> cf. <a href="#entry-zudi" class="skt-link">śudi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुदिन</span> <i>sudina</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dina" class="skt-link">dina</a>] <a href="#entry-sudina" class="skt-link">n.</a> belle journée; heureuse occasion — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(sudināyate)</i> se remettre au beau (temps).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sudyumna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुद्युम्न</span> <i>sudyumna</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dyumna" class="skt-link">dyumna</a>] <a href="#entry-sudyumna" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sudyumna «le Splendide», fils de <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>, obtenu par le changement de sexe d'<a href="#entry-Ui_daa" class="skt-link">Iḍā</a> par <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a>; étant allé chasser dans la forêt <a href="#entry-Ukumaaravana" class="skt-link">Kumāravana</a>, il redevint la belle <a href="#entry-Ui_daa" class="skt-link">Iḍā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sug_rhiita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगृहीत</span> <i>sugṛhīta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-g_rhiita" class="skt-link">gṛhīta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sug_rhiita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sug_rhiita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sug_rhiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugṛhītā</i> tenu fermement; bien attrapé, bien reçu; bien compris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sug_rhiitanaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sugṛhītanāman</i> [<a href="#entry-naaman" class="skt-link">nāman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sug_rhiitanaaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sug_rhiitanaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sug_rhiitanaamnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugṛhītanāmnī</i> soc. dont le nom est invoqué favorablement.<br> <a href="#entry-sug_rhiita" class="skt-link">sugṛhīta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugaatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगात्र</span> <i>sugātra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gaatra" class="skt-link">gātra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugaatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugaatra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugātrī</i> gracile, qui a de beaux membres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगम</span> <i>sugama</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gama" class="skt-link">gama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugamā</i> facile à traverser; praticable, facile d'accès <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> facile à comprendre; évident.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगन्ध</span> <i>sugandha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gandha" class="skt-link">gandha</a>] <a href="#entry-sugandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> bonne odeur; parfum — a. <a href="#entry-sugandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugandhā</i> parfumé; odorant — <a href="#entry-sugandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soufre — <a href="#entry-sugandhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugandhā</i> myth. np. de la nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] Sugandhā «Parfumée» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. diverses plantes odorantes, not. la <a href="#entry-tulasii" class="skt-link">tulasī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugandhavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sugandhavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugandhavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandhavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandhavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugandhavatī</i> parfumé.<br> <a href="#entry-sugandha" class="skt-link">sugandha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugandhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगन्धि</span> <i>sugandhi</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gandhi" class="skt-link">gandhi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugandhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandhi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> parfumé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugandhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगन्धिन्</span> <i>sugandhin</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gandhin" class="skt-link">gandhin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugandhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugandhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugandhinī</i> parfumé, suave — <a href="#entry-sugandhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugandhinī</i> natu. bot. <i>Pandanus odoratissimus</i>, arbre pandane; sa fleur; syn. <a href="#entry-ketakii" class="skt-link">ketakī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugandhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sugandhitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sugandhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> parfum.<br> <a href="#entry-sugandhi" class="skt-link">sugandhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगत</span> <i>sugata</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gata" class="skt-link">gata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sugatā</i> qui va bien <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bien loti; qui a la belle vie — <a href="#entry-sugata" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. bouddhiste; maître bouddhiste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. np. de Sugata «Bienvenu», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगति</span> <i>sugati</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gati" class="skt-link">gati</a>] <a href="#entry-sugati" class="skt-link">f.</a> belle vie; existence agréable; bonheur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> refuge sûr — a. <a href="#entry-sugati" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugati" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugati" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui est en position favorable (astre).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugho_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुघोष</span> <i>sughoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gho_sa" class="skt-link">ghoṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugho_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugho_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugho_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sughoṣā</i> très bruyant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a un son plaisant — <a href="#entry-sugho_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Sughoṣa, conque de <a href="#entry-Unakula" class="skt-link">Nakula</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugla">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुग्ल</span> <i>sugla</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gla" class="skt-link">gla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugla" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugla" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suglaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suglā</i> très fatigué.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugrii_sma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुग्रीष्म</span> <i>sugrīṣma</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-grii_sma" class="skt-link">grīṣma</a>] <a href="#entry-sugrii_sma" class="skt-link">m.</a> bel été.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugrii_smaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sugrīṣmaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-sugrii_smaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. np. du festival estival Sugrīṣmaka, célébré dans le <a href="#entry-Ukofka_na" class="skt-link">Koṅkaṇa</a> les 5 jours précédant la pleine lune <a href="#entry-phaalgunii" class="skt-link">phālgunī</a>; mod. Śigmo (<a href="#entry-kofka_nii" class="skt-link">koṅkaṇī</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prakrit suggimaho.<br> <a href="#entry-sugrii_sma" class="skt-link">sugrīṣma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugriiva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुग्रीव</span> <i>sugrīva</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-griivaa" class="skt-link">grīvā</a>] <a href="#entry-sugriiva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Sugrīva «Joli Cou», roi des singes, allié de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> contre <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>; on le dit fils de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a> [<a href="#entry-Uravinandana" class="skt-link">Ravinandana</a>], et capable de changer de forme à volonté; il combattit son frère aîné <a href="#entry-Uvaalii" class="skt-link">Vālī</a>, qui le détrôna et l'exila, mais fut réinstallé dans sa capitale de <a href="#entry-Uki_skindhaa" class="skt-link">Kiṣkindhā</a> par <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> à la mort de celui-ci; il fut vaincu par <a href="#entry-Ukumbhakar_na" class="skt-link">Kumbhakarṇa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uruumaa" class="skt-link">Rūmā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [PP.] np. de Sugrīva_1, «à la Belle Encolure», l'un des 4 chevaux du char de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, de couleur jaune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sugu_nin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुगुणिन्</span> <i>suguṇin</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gu_nin" class="skt-link">guṇin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sugu_nin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sugu_nin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sugu_ninii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suguṇinī</i> plein de bonnes qualités, très vertueux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suh_rd">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुहृद्</span> <i>suhṛd</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-h_rd" class="skt-link">hṛd</a>] <a href="#entry-suh_rd" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suh_rd" class="skt-link">f.</a> [«qui a bon cœur»] ami, allié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suhma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुह्म</span> <i>suhma</i> <a href="#entry-suhma" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du roi Suhma, fils de <a href="#entry-Udiirghatamaa" class="skt-link">Dīrghatamā</a> et <a href="#entry-Usude_s_naa" class="skt-link">Sudeṣṇā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. du pays de <a href="#entry-Usuhma" class="skt-link">Suhma</a>, à l'ouest du Bengale (mod. district de Bankura) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. les Suhmās, ses habitants.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suhotra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुहोत्र</span> <i>suhotra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-hotra" class="skt-link">hotra</a>] <a href="#entry-suhotra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Suhotra «qui sacrifie abondamment», fils de <a href="#entry-Uvitatha" class="skt-link">Vitatha</a>, ancêtre de <a href="#entry-Ugaadhi" class="skt-link">Gādhi</a> et <a href="#entry-Ujahnu" class="skt-link">Jahnu</a>; <a href="#entry-Ub_rhatputra" class="skt-link">Bṛhatputra</a> est son fils <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Suhotra_1, 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ fils de <a href="#entry-Ujamadagni" class="skt-link">Jamadagni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sujaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुजात</span> <i>sujāta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-jaata" class="skt-link">jāta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sujaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sujaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sujaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sujātā</i> bien né, bien fait, beau — <a href="#entry-sujaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> naissance sous d'heureux auspices — <a href="#entry-sujaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sujātā</i> bd. [<a href="#entry-Ubuddhacarita" class="skt-link">Buddhacarita</a>] np. de Sujātā «Bien née», jeune fille qui offrit au futur <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> son premier repas après 6 ans d'austérités sur les bords de la <a href="#entry-Uniilaa_njanaa" class="skt-link">Nīlāñjanā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sujaati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुजाति</span> <i>sujāti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-jaati" class="skt-link">jāti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sujaati" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sujaati" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sujaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> de bonne race, de bonne tribu, de bonne famille, de bonne classe; noble — <a href="#entry-sujaati" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Sujāti «le Bien-né», héros de légende; enfant, il offrit sa chair pour nourrir ses parents affamés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sujana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुजन</span> <i>sujana</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sujana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sujana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sujanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sujanā</i> bon, bienveillant, gentil, serviable, charitable; vertueux — <a href="#entry-sujana" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme bienveillant, homme bon; homme vertueux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sujanataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sujanatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sujanataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bonté, bienveillance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sujanatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sujanatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-sujanatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> bonté, bienveillance.<br> <a href="#entry-sujana" class="skt-link">sujana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sujita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुजित</span> <i>sujita</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-jita" class="skt-link">jita</a>] <a href="#entry-sujita" class="skt-link">m.</a> «qui a vaincu facilement», nom d'homme — <a href="#entry-sujita" class="skt-link">n.</a> victoire facile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sujyotis">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
