  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suj_naana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुज्ञान</span> <i>sujñāna</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-j_naana" class="skt-link">jñāna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suj_naana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suj_naana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suj_naanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sujñānā</i> qui a de bonnes connaissances <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> facile à comprendre — <a href="#entry-suj_naana" class="skt-link">n.</a> bonne compréhension; intelligence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bonne connaissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suj_naanatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sujñānatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-suj_naanatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'être bien informé; compétence.<br> <a href="#entry-suj_naana" class="skt-link">sujñāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suk_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकृत्</span> <i>sukṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suk_rt" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_rt" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_rt" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui agit bien; bon; vertueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fortuné; sage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> habile — <a href="#entry-suk_rtas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_rtas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>sukṛtas</i> pl. soc. les mânes (récompensés de leur vertu dans l'au-delà).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suk_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकृत</span> <i>sukṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suk_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukṛtā</i> bien fait, réussi; bien conduit; joli, juste, utile — <a href="#entry-suk_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> bénéfice; butin; aide, faveur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bonne action, bienfait, acte méritoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> récompense; bonheur, chance.<br> <i>sukṛtam</i> bien! bravo!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suk_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकृति</span> <i>sukṛti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-k_rti" class="skt-link">kṛti</a>] <a href="#entry-suk_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> bonne conduite, vertu; gentillesse, bonté — a. <a href="#entry-suk_rti" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_rti" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> vertueux, juste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suk_satra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुक्षत्र</span> <i>sukṣatra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-k_satra" class="skt-link">kṣatra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suk_satra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_satra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suk_satraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukṣatrā</i> qui règne bien; puissant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suk_satriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुक्षत्रिय</span> <i>sukṣatriya</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-k_satriya" class="skt-link">kṣatriya</a>] <a href="#entry-suk_satriya" class="skt-link">m.</a> bon guerrier; bon prince.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukanyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकन्या</span> <i>sukanyā</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-kanyaa" class="skt-link">kanyā</a>] <a href="#entry-sukanyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> belle jeune fille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sukanyā «Jolie fille», fille du roi <a href="#entry-Uzaryaati" class="skt-link">Śaryāti</a> qui la donna en mariage au vieux sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] <a href="#entry-Ucyavana" class="skt-link">Cyavana</a> en expiation de sa maltraitance; après qu'il eût pris son bain de jouvence elle lui donna pour fils <a href="#entry-Upramati" class="skt-link">Pramati</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukavitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकविता</span> <i>sukavitā</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-kavitaa" class="skt-link">kavitā</a>] <a href="#entry-sukavitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> talent poétique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suketu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकेतु</span> <i>suketu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ketu" class="skt-link">ketu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suketu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suketu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suketu" class="skt-link">f.</a> très brillant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Suketu, le «Très brillant» roi des génies [<a href="#entry-yak_sa" class="skt-link">yakṣa</a>]; après une longue ascèse, <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> lui accorda d'engendrer une fille <a href="#entry-Utaa_takaa" class="skt-link">Tāṭakā</a> forte comme 1000 éléphants; il la maria à <a href="#entry-Usunda_1" class="skt-link">Sunda_1</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [BhP.] np. du roi Suketu_1 <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Unandivardhana" class="skt-link">Nandivardhana</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Udevaraata" class="skt-link">Devarāta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकेश</span> <i>sukeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-keza" class="skt-link">keśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukeza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukezii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukeśī</i> qui a de beaux cheveux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुख</span> <i>sukha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-kha" class="skt-link">kha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhā</i> facile, agréable; joyeux, heureux — <a href="#entry-sukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> joie, bonheur, plaisir; confort, prospérité; opp <a href="#entry-du_hkha" class="skt-link">duḥkha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la propriété [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] du plaisir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chance — f. cf. <a href="#entry-sukhaa" class="skt-link">sukhā</a> — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(sukhāyate)</i> éprouver du plaisir — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(sukhyati)</i> rendre heureux.<br> <i>sukham</i> adv. heureusement; tranquillement, facilement; aisément, à l'aise; volontiers, avec plaisir.<br> <i>kadalīsukham</i> aussi facilement que (d'attraper) une banane.<br> <i>sukham</i> <i>...</i> <i>na</i> <i>punar</i> plutôt ... que.<br> <i>sukham</i> <i>asūn</i> <i>api</i> <i>saṃtyajanti</i> <i>na</i> <i>punaḥ</i> <i>pratijñām</i> Ils préfèrent renoncer à la vie plutôt qu'à un serment.<br> <i>sukhena</i> var. <i>sukhāt</i> adv. aisément, commodément.<br> <i>mahatā</i> <i>sukhena</i> avec grand plaisir.<br> <i>sukhaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> faire plaisir à ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>sukhaṃ</i> <i>dā</i> donner du plaisir.<br> <i>sukhā</i> <i>kṛ</i> rendre heureux.<br> <i>sukhībhū</i> se réjouir.<br> <i>sa</i> <i>bhaviṣyati</i> <i>sukhaṃ</i> <i>hantum</i> il sera facile à tuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुखा</span> <i>sukhā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-sukha" class="skt-link">sukha</a>] <a href="#entry-sukhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bonheur, félicité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. effort pour gagner des mérites, piété.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhaavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sukhāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukhaavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhaavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhaavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhāvatī</i> qui procure le bonheur — <a href="#entry-sukhaavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhāvatī</i> bd. np. de Sukhāvatī_1 «Terre du bonheur», paradis de l'Ouest d'<a href="#entry-Uamitaabha" class="skt-link">Amitābha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de Sukhāvatī_2 «Bienfaisante», épouse de <a href="#entry-Usuuryaprabha" class="skt-link">Sūryaprabha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhabuddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhaprati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhapratiik_sa">

    <i>sukhapratīkṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-pratiik_sa" class="skt-link">pratīkṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukhapratiik_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhapratiik_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhapratiik_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhapratīkṣā</i> qui anticipe du plaisir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de nature optimiste.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhasambodhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sukhasaṃbodhya</i> var. <i>sukhasambodhya</i> [<a href="#entry-sambodhya" class="skt-link">saṃbodhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukhasa_mbodhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhasa_mbodhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhasa_mbodhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhasaṃbodhyā</i> facile à comprendre; facile à expliquer ou enseigner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sukhatara</i> [<a href="#entry--tara" class="skt-link">-tara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukhatara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhatara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhataraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhatarā</i> compar. plus facile.<br> <i>sukhataram</i> adv. plus facilement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुखिन्</span> <i>sukhin</i> [<a href="#entry-sukha" class="skt-link">sukha</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhinī</i> qui est heureux.<br> <i>sarve</i> <i>bhavantu</i> <i>sukhinaḥ</i> Œuvrons au bonheur de tous.<br> <i>sukhinaste</i> <i>panthānaḥ</i> <i>santu</i> Que le voyage te soit agréable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुखित</span> <i>sukhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-sukha" class="skt-link">sukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukhitā</i> heureux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sukumaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुकुमार</span> <i>sukumāra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-kumaara" class="skt-link">kumāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sukumaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sukumaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sukumaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sukumārī</i> tendre, délicat, gracile; dans la grâce de la jeunesse — <a href="#entry-sukumaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du poète Sukumāra, auteur du <a href="#entry-Uzriik_r_s_navilaasa" class="skt-link">Śrīkṛṣṇavilāsa</a>.<br> <i>sukumāra</i> <i>caraṇa</i> <i>yugalam</i> Une paire de pieds délicats.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sulabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुलभ</span> <i>sulabha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-labh" class="skt-link">labh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sulabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sulabha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sulabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sulabhā</i> facile à trouver, à obtenir, à acquérir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sulaimat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुलैमत्</span> <i>sulaimat</i> <a href="#entry-sulaimat" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de Sulaimān, le roi Salomon; son histoire romancée, le Sulaimaccaitra, fut écrite en sanskrit par <a href="#entry-Ukalyaa_na" class="skt-link">Kalyāṇa</a> <a href="#entry-Umalla" class="skt-link">Malla</a> à la demande du prince Lāḍkhān, de la lignée afghane de Lodi, vers 1500.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sulalaa_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुललाट</span> <i>sulalāṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-lalaa_ta" class="skt-link">lalāṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sulalaa_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sulalaa_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sulalaa_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sulalāṭā</i> qui a un joli cou.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sulalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुललित</span> <i>sulalita</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-lalita" class="skt-link">lalita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sulalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sulalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sulalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sulalitā</i> gracieux; charmant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aguicheur — <a href="#entry-sulalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sulalitā</i> femme facile.<br> <i>sulalitam</i> adv. d'une manière gracieuse; avec facilité, en se jouant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sulalitavistara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुललितविस्तर</span> <i>sulalitavistara</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-lalitavistara" class="skt-link">lalitavistara</a>] <a href="#entry-sulalitavistara" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. du charmant <a href="#entry-Ulalitavistara" class="skt-link">Lalitavistara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sulava_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुलवण</span> <i>sulavaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-lava_na" class="skt-link">lavaṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sulava_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sulava_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sulava_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sulavaṇā</i> bien salé — <a href="#entry-sulava_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sulavaṇā</i> natu. bot. <i>Chionachne gigantea</i>, une graminée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sulocana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुलोचन</span> <i>sulocana</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-locana" class="skt-link">locana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sulocana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sulocana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sulocanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sulocanā</i> qui a de jolis yeux — <a href="#entry-sulocana" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. cerf <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. Sulocana, l'un des fils de <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumaagadhii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमागधी</span> <i>sumāgadhī</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-maagadhii" class="skt-link">māgadhī</a>] <a href="#entry-sumaagadhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de la rivière Sumāgadhī, qui coule aux pieds de <a href="#entry-Ugirivraja" class="skt-link">Girivraja</a> vers le <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. mod. Sonanadī, affluent important du sud du Gange, qui la rejoint en amont de <a href="#entry-Upaa_taliputra" class="skt-link">Pāṭaliputra</a>-Paṭnā.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumaali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमालि</span> <i>sumāli</i> var. <i>sumālin</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-maalin" class="skt-link">mālin</a>] <a href="#entry-sumaali" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a> Sumāli, père de <a href="#entry-Ukaikasii" class="skt-link">Kaikasī</a> par <a href="#entry-Uketumatii" class="skt-link">Ketumatī</a>, grand-père de <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Usaavitra" class="skt-link">Sāvitra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumafgala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमङ्गल</span> <i>sumaṅgala</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mafgala" class="skt-link">maṅgala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumafgala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumafgala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumafgalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumaṅgalā</i> <a href="#entry-sumafgalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumaṅgalī</i> de bon augure; qui porte chance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumahaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमहा</span> <i>sumahā</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-sumahat" class="skt-link">sumahat</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumahaatapas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sumahātapas</i> [<a href="#entry-tapas" class="skt-link">tapas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumahaatapas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumahaatapas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumahaatapas" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui pratique de grandes pénitences.<br> <a href="#entry-sumahaa" class="skt-link">sumahā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumahat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमहत्</span> <i>sumahat</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mahat" class="skt-link">mahat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumahat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumahat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumahatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumahatī</i> très grand; vaste, immense; nombreux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> très glorieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumanas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमनस्</span> <i>sumanas</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-manas" class="skt-link">manas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumanas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumanas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumanas" class="skt-link">f.</a> bienveillant, aimable, bien disposé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> content, joyeux, à l'aise; d'humeur égale, sage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du roi Sumanā, dont l'histoire est contée dans la <a href="#entry-Ub_rhatkathaa" class="skt-link">Bṛhatkathā</a>; il est transposé comme le roi <a href="#entry-Uzuudraka_1" class="skt-link">Śūdraka_1</a> dans le roman <a href="#entry-Ukaadambarii" class="skt-link">Kādambarī</a> de <a href="#entry-Ubaa_na_2" class="skt-link">Bāṇa_2</a> qui en est inspiré — <a href="#entry-sumanas" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. <i>sumanasas</i> fleurs — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(sumanāyate)</i> devenir bienveillant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumanastaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sumanastā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-sumanastaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> gaieté; opp. <a href="#entry-durmanastaa" class="skt-link">durmanastā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>sumanassa</i>.<br> <a href="#entry-sumanas" class="skt-link">sumanas</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमन्त्र</span> <i>sumantra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumantra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumantraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumantrā</i> qui conseille bien — <a href="#entry-sumantra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Sumantra «de bon conseil», conseiller et cocher de <a href="#entry-Udazaratha" class="skt-link">Daśaratha</a>; il emmena <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> exilé aux bords de la <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumantrin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमन्त्रिन्</span> <i>sumantrin</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mantrin" class="skt-link">mantrin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumantrin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumantrin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumantri_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumantriṇī</i> qui est bien conseillé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumantrita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमन्त्रित</span> <i>sumantrita</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mantrita" class="skt-link">mantrita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumantrita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumantrita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumantritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumantritā</i> bien conseillé; sagement planifié — <a href="#entry-sumantrita" class="skt-link">n.</a> bon conseil.<br> <i>sumantritam</i> (impers.) c'est de bon conseil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमति</span> <i>sumati</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mati" class="skt-link">mati</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumati" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumati" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumati" class="skt-link">f.</a> sage, avisé; versé dans ⟨g.⟩ — <a href="#entry-sumati" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Sumati «le Sage», fils de <a href="#entry-Ukakutstha_1" class="skt-link">Kakutstha_1</a>; il reçut <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> et <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_na" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇa</a> dans sa capitale de <a href="#entry-Uvizaalaa" class="skt-link">Viśālā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du philosophe jaïne Sumati_1 (9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle) — <a href="#entry-sumati" class="skt-link">f.</a> bienveillance, faveur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plaisir à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Sumati_2 «la Sage», fille d'<a href="#entry-Uari_s_tanemi" class="skt-link">Ariṣṭanemi</a>, à la beauté incomparable; deuxième épouse de <a href="#entry-Usagara" class="skt-link">Sagara</a>, elle lui donna 60000 fils qui, à la recherche du cheval du sacrifice de leur père, furent réduits en cendres par <a href="#entry-Ukapila" class="skt-link">Kapila</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumatinaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sumatinātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-sumatinaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. de Sumatinātha «Maître bienveillant», 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est jaune d'or, son symbole est un oiseau ou une roue.<br> <a href="#entry-sumati" class="skt-link">sumati</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumedhas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमेधस्</span> <i>sumedhas</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-medhaa" class="skt-link">medhā</a>] <a href="#entry-sumedhas" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> Sumedhā «Très sage».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumeru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमेरु</span> <i>sumeru</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-meru" class="skt-link">meru</a>] <a href="#entry-sumeru" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sumeru, épith. du Beau Mont <a href="#entry-Umeru" class="skt-link">Meru</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-meru" class="skt-link">meru</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमित्र</span> <i>sumitra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mitra" class="skt-link">mitra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumitraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumitrā</i> qui a de bons amis — <a href="#entry-sumitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [JB.] np. de Sumitra «Bon ami», qui aida <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> à tuer <a href="#entry-Udiirghajihvii" class="skt-link">Dīrghajihvī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [DKC.] np. de Sumitra_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Udharmapaala_2" class="skt-link">Dharmapāla_2</a>, demi-frère aîné de <a href="#entry-Ukaamapaala" class="skt-link">Kāmapāla</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> np. de nombreux autres personnages — <a href="#entry-sumitraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumitrā</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Sumitrā «Bonne amie», épouse secondaire du roi <a href="#entry-Udazaratha" class="skt-link">Daśaratha</a>, mère des jumeaux <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_na" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzatrughna" class="skt-link">Śatrughna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumla">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुम्ल</span> <i>sumla</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mla" class="skt-link">mla</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-sumla" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumla" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumlaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumlā</i> très abattu, fortement déprimé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुम्न</span> <i>sumna</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mnaa" class="skt-link">mnā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sumna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumnā</i> plaisant, gracieux; gentil, agréable; favorable — <a href="#entry-sumna" class="skt-link">n.</a> grâce, faveur; dévotion, prière <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> paix, joie, bonheur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sumukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुमुख</span> <i>sumukha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] <a href="#entry-sumukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> jolie bouche; visage avenant — a. <a href="#entry-sumukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumukhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumukhī</i> qui a un joli visage; qui sourit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avenant, aimable; joyeux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de bonne humeur; bien disposé, favorable; gentil envers ⟨g.⟩ — a. <a href="#entry-sumukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sumukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sumukhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sumukhā</i> bien visée (flèche); qui a une grande ouverture — <a href="#entry-sumukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du prince <a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a> Sumukha «au beau visage»; il est fils de <a href="#entry-Ucikura" class="skt-link">Cikura</a>, mis à mort par <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> lui donna l'<a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a> pour l'en protéger; il épousa <a href="#entry-Ugu_nakezii" class="skt-link">Guṇakeśī</a> «aux beaux cheveux».<br> <i>sumukhena</i> joyeusement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sunanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुनन्द</span> <i>sunanda</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-nanda" class="skt-link">nanda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sunanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sunanda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sunandaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sunandā</i> plaisant, agréable — <a href="#entry-sunanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-dvaarapaala" class="skt-link">dvārapāla</a> Sunanda (son double étant appelé <a href="#entry-Unanda" class="skt-link">Nanda</a>) — <a href="#entry-sunandaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sunandā</i> géo. np. de la montagne Sunandā <a href="#entry-devii" class="skt-link">devī</a>, sommet de 7816 m de l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a>, pic est de <a href="#entry-Unandaa" class="skt-link">Nandā</a> <a href="#entry-devii" class="skt-link">devī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sunda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुन्द</span> <i>sunda</i> <a href="#entry-sunda" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du démon [<a href="#entry-daitya" class="skt-link">daitya</a>] Sunda; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] <a href="#entry-Usunda" class="skt-link">Sunda</a> et son frère <a href="#entry-Uupasunda" class="skt-link">Upasunda</a> étaient des démons qui avaient obtenu de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> de ne pouvoir être tués que l'un par l'autre; les dieux envoyèrent <a href="#entry-Utilottamaa" class="skt-link">Tilottamā</a> les séduire pour qu'ils s'entretuent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a> Sunda_1, il épousa la puissante <a href="#entry-yak_sii" class="skt-link">yakṣī</a> <a href="#entry-Utaa_takaa" class="skt-link">Tāṭakā</a>, dont il eut pour fils <a href="#entry-Umaariica" class="skt-link">Mārīca</a> et <a href="#entry-Usubaahu" class="skt-link">Subāhu</a>; un jour, ivre, il attaqua l'ermitage d'<a href="#entry-Uagastya" class="skt-link">Agastya</a>, et ce dernier le réduisit en cendres; <a href="#entry-Utaa_takaa" class="skt-link">Tāṭakā</a> et ses fils voulurent le venger, et <a href="#entry-Uagastya" class="skt-link">Agastya</a> les maudit de devenir ogres [<a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sundara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुन्दर</span> <i>sundara</i> a. <a href="#entry-sundara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sundara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sundarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sundarī</i> beau, joli; plaisant, aimable, charmant — <a href="#entry-sundarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sundarī</i> belle femme; cf. <a href="#entry-lokasundarii" class="skt-link">lokasundarī</a>.<br> <i>sundaram</i> ind. très bien; exactement; d'accord.<br> <i>sundarī</i> <i>nārī</i> une belle femme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sundarakaa_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sundarakāṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-kaa_n_da" class="skt-link">kāṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-sundarakaa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sundarakāṇḍa, 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ livre «plaisant» du <a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>; il décrit la visite de <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> à <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a>, sa rencontre avec <a href="#entry-Usitaa" class="skt-link">Sitā</a>, sa capture par <a href="#entry-Uindrajit" class="skt-link">Indrajit</a>, et sa mise à feu du palais de <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>.<br> <i>sundare</i> <i>sundaro</i> <i>ramah</i> <i>sundare</i> <i>sundarī</i> <i>kathā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>sundare</i> <i>sundarī</i> <i>sītā</i> <i>sundare</i> <i>sundaram</i> <i>vanam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>sundare</i> <i>sundaram</i> <i>kavyam</i> <i>sundare</i> <i>sundarah</i> <i>kapiḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>sundare</i> <i>sundaram</i> <i>mantram</i> <i>sundare</i> <i>kim</i> <i>na</i> <i>sundaram</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Dans le plaisant livre, <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> est plaisant, dans ce plaisant livre, l'histoire est plaisante; Dans le plaisant livre, <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a> est plaisante, dans ce plaisant livre, le bois est plaisant; Dans le plaisant livre, le poème est plaisant, dans ce plaisant livre, le singe est plaisant; Dans le plaisant livre, le <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> est plaisant, dans ce plaisant livre, quoi n'est pas plaisant?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sundaramuurti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sundaramūrti</i> [<a href="#entry-muurti" class="skt-link">mūrti</a>] <a href="#entry-sundaramuurti" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> Sundaramūrti «Joli garçon», saint shivaïte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sundaravarada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sundaravarada</i> [<a href="#entry-varada" class="skt-link">varada</a>] <a href="#entry-sundaravarada" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du temple de Sundaravarada, dédié à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvarada" class="skt-link">Varada</a>, à Uttiramerur (district de <a href="#entry-Ukaa_nciipuram" class="skt-link">Kāñcīpuram</a> au Tamil Nadu), construit en 750 par les <a href="#entry-Upallavaas" class="skt-link">Pallavās</a>, rénové par les <a href="#entry-Ucolaas" class="skt-link">Colās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sundarezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sundareśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-sundarezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sundareśvara «Plaisant Seigneur», aspect de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> adoré notamment au grand temple de <a href="#entry-Umiinaak_sii" class="skt-link">Mīnākṣī</a>-<a href="#entry-Usundarezvara" class="skt-link">Sundareśvara</a> à Madurai, au Tamil Nadu.<br> <a href="#entry-sundara" class="skt-link">sundara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suniita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुनीत</span> <i>sunīta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-niita" class="skt-link">nīta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suniita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suniita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suniitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sunītā</i> bien mené, bien exécuté — <a href="#entry-suniita" class="skt-link">n.</a> sagesse, prudence, habileté; solution, bonne exécution.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suniitha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुनीथ</span> <i>sunītha</i> <a href="#entry-suniitha" class="skt-link">m.</a> np d'homme — <a href="#entry-suniithaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sunīthā</i> myth. np. de Sunīthā, fille aînée de <a href="#entry-Um_rtyu" class="skt-link">Mṛtyu</a>, mère de <a href="#entry-Uvena" class="skt-link">Vena</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suniiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुनीति</span> <i>sunīti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-niiti" class="skt-link">nīti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suniiti" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suniiti" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suniiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui (se) conduit bien; vertueux — <a href="#entry-suniiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> bonne conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sunīti «Vertueuse», femme d'<a href="#entry-Uuttaanapaada" class="skt-link">Uttānapāda</a> et mère de <a href="#entry-Udhruva" class="skt-link">Dhruva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sunizcita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुनिश्चित</span> <i>suniścita</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-nizcita" class="skt-link">niścita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sunizcita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sunizcita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sunizcitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suniścitā</i> fermement résolu.<br> <i>suniścitam</i> adv. avec complète certitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sunva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुन्व</span> <i>sunva</i> [<a href="#entry-su_2" class="skt-link">su_2</a><a href="#entry--va" class="skt-link">-va</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sunva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sunva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sunvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sunvā</i> véd. qui presse (le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> pour le sacrifice); qui consacre aux dieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sup">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्</span> <i>sup</i> var. <i>sub</i> nota. gram. désinence du loc. pl.; en gén. désinence casuelle d'une forme nominale; opp. <a href="#entry-tif" class="skt-link">tiṅ</a>.<br> <i>suptiṅantam</i> <i>padam</i> [<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>] Une forme fléchie (nominale ou verbale) est un mot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supaarzva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपार्श्व</span> <i>supārśva</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-paarzva" class="skt-link">pārśva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-supaarzva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supaarzva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-supaarzvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>supārśvā</i> qui a un beau côté, un beau torse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supaarzvanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>supārśvanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-supaarzvanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. de Supārśvanātha «Maître au beau torse», 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est vert, son symbole est un <a href="#entry-svastika" class="skt-link">svastika</a> et un cobra à 7 têtes.<br> <a href="#entry-supaarzva" class="skt-link">supārśva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपद्</span> <i>supad</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">pad_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-supad" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supad" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-supadii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>supadī</i> qui a de bons ou jolis pieds <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aux pieds rapides.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपद्य</span> <i>supadya</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-padya" class="skt-link">padya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-supadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-supadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>supadyā</i> lit. en bons vers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supakva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपक्व</span> <i>supakva</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-pakva" class="skt-link">pakva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-supakva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supakva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-supakvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>supakvā</i> bien cuit; bien mûr.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपर्ण</span> <i>suparṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-par_na" class="skt-link">parṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-supar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [RV.] np. de Suparṇa, oiseau merveilleux qui ravit au ciel le divin <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a> «au beau plumage» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>supaṇṇa</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supar_naakhyaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suparṇākhyāna</i> [<a href="#entry-aakhyaana" class="skt-link">ākhyāna</a>] <a href="#entry-supar_naakhyaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Suparṇākhyāna «Histoire de <a href="#entry-Usupar_na" class="skt-link">Suparṇa</a>».<br> <a href="#entry-supar_na" class="skt-link">suparṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supathin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपथिन्</span> <i>supathin</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-pathin" class="skt-link">pathin</a>] <a href="#entry-supathin" class="skt-link">m.</a> bon chemin, bonne route — a. <a href="#entry-supathin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supathin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-supathii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>supathī</i> qui a de bonnes routes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suprabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्रभ</span> <i>suprabha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-prabha" class="skt-link">prabha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suprabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suprabha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suprabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suprabhā</i> magnifique, splendide; glorieux — <a href="#entry-suprabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-daanava" class="skt-link">dānava</a> Suprabha — <a href="#entry-suprabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suprabhā</i> myth. np. de Suprabhā, fille de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>; elle épousa <a href="#entry-Uk_rzaazva" class="skt-link">Kṛśāśva</a>, dont elle eut 50 fils très puissants, missiles magiques infaillibles [<a href="#entry-sa_mhaara" class="skt-link">saṃhāra</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suprabhaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्रभात</span> <i>suprabhāta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-prabhaata" class="skt-link">prabhāta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suprabhaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suprabhaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suprabhaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suprabhātā</i> éclairé par la lumière de l'aube — <a href="#entry-suprabhaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> beau matin, jour heureux.<br> <i>suprabhātam</i> adr. bonjour (le matin).<br> <i>suprabhāte</i> à la première lueur de l'aube.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supratiika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्रतीक</span> <i>supratīka</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-pratiika" class="skt-link">pratīka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-supratiika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supratiika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-supratiikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>supratīkā</i> de belle apparence, joli; admirable — <a href="#entry-supratiika" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'éléphant céleste Supratīka_1 «au large front», <a href="#entry-diggaja" class="skt-link">diggaja</a> du Nord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Supratīka_2, éléphant de guerre du roi <a href="#entry-Ubhagadatta" class="skt-link">Bhagadatta</a>; il écrasa le char de <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> et manqua de le massacrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suprayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्रयोग</span> <i>suprayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-prayoga" class="skt-link">prayoga</a>] <a href="#entry-suprayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> bonne application, bon usage; bonne gestion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dextérité; compétence; expertise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suprayukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्रयुक्त</span> <i>suprayukta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-prayukta" class="skt-link">prayukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suprayukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suprayukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suprayuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suprayuktā</i> bien utilisé; bien conçu, bien planifié; bien administré, bien organisé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bien envoyé (flèche).<br> <i>ekaḥ</i> <i>śabdaḥ</i> <i>samyak</i> <i>jñātaḥ</i> <i>śāstrānvitaḥ</i> <i>suprayuktaḥ</i> <i>svarge</i> <i>loke</i> <i>kāmadhuk</i> <i>bhavati</i> <i>iti</i> [<a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a>] Un mot utilisé à bon escient et correctement compris produit la connaissance comme la vache céleste exhauce nos vœux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्त</span> <i>supta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-svap" class="skt-link">svap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-supta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suptā</i> endormi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> immobile, latent — <a href="#entry-supta" class="skt-link">n.</a> sommeil; léthargie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुप्ति</span> <i>supti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-svap" class="skt-link">svap</a>] <a href="#entry-supti" class="skt-link">f.</a> sommeil; sommeil profond <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> engourdissement; paralysie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-supu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपु</span> <i>supu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-puu_2" class="skt-link">pū_2</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-supu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-supu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-supu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui purifie bien, qui nettoie bien; qui clarifie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुपुत्र</span> <i>suputra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] <a href="#entry-suputra" class="skt-link">m.</a> bon fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sur">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुर्</span> <i>sur</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-svar_2" class="skt-link">svar_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(surati)</i> avoir des pouvoirs surnaturels <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> briller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुर</span> <i>sura</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-sur" class="skt-link">sur</a>] <a href="#entry-sura" class="skt-link">m.</a> dieu, divinité; syn. <a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरा</span> <i>surā</i> [<a href="#entry-su_2" class="skt-link">su_2</a>] <a href="#entry-suraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> boisson spiritueuse, alcool; not. bière de riz <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. liqueur produite lors du barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>]; np. de Surā ou Surādevī, sa personnification, fille de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvaaru_nii" class="skt-link">Vāruṇī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suraa_s_tra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुराष्ट्र</span> <i>surāṣṭra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-raa_s_tra" class="skt-link">rāṣṭra</a>] <a href="#entry-suraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du Surāṣṭra, pays à l'ouest de l'Inde (mod. péninsule de Kathiawar et côte de Surāt au Gujarāt) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. ses habitants.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suraafganaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>surāṅganā</i> [<a href="#entry-afganaa" class="skt-link">aṅganā</a>] <a href="#entry-suraafganaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. épouse divine; beauté céleste, syn. <a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suraapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>surāpa</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_1" class="skt-link">pa_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suraapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suraapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suraapaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>surāpā</i> qui boit des liqueurs; buveur, ivrogne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suraapaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>surāpāna</i> [<a href="#entry-paana" class="skt-link">pāna</a>] <a href="#entry-suraapaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> ivrognerie, alcoolisme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>surāpāṇa</i> id.<br> <a href="#entry-suraa" class="skt-link">surā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suraatri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरात्रि</span> <i>surātri</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-raatri" class="skt-link">rātri</a>] <a href="#entry-suraatri" class="skt-link">f.</a> belle nuit.<br> <i>surātri</i> <i>bhavatu</i> adr. bonne nuit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-surabhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरभि</span> <i>surabhi</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-rabh" class="skt-link">rabh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-surabhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-surabhi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-surabhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>surabhi</i> <a href="#entry-surabhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>surabhī</i> [«qui affecte plaisamment»] odoriférant, parfumé; agréable, charmant — <a href="#entry-surabhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> printemps; jasmin — <a href="#entry-surabhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> var. <i>surabhī</i> myth. np. de Surabhi ou Surabhī «la Parfumée», vache céleste créée par <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>, mère des <a href="#entry-Urudraas" class="skt-link">Rudrās</a>, de <a href="#entry-Urohi_nii_2" class="skt-link">Rohiṇī_2</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ugandharvii" class="skt-link">Gandharvī</a>; elle s'incarna sur terre comme <a href="#entry-Urohi_nii_3" class="skt-link">Rohiṇī_3</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Surabhī_1, fille de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> et <a href="#entry-Ukrodhavazaa" class="skt-link">Krodhavaśā</a>; elle engendra la race des vaches — <a href="#entry-surabhi" class="skt-link">n.</a> parfum.<br> <i>surabhi</i> <i>kṛ</i> parfumer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suradvi_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suradviṣ</i> var. <i>suradviṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-dvi_s_2" class="skt-link">dviṣ_2</a>] <a href="#entry-suradvi_s" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi des dieux; démon [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suragaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suragaja</i> [<a href="#entry-gaja" class="skt-link">gaja</a>] <a href="#entry-suragaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Suragaja, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uairaava_na" class="skt-link">Airāvaṇa</a> «l'éléphant divin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suraguru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suraguru</i> [<a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>] <a href="#entry-suraguru" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Suraguru, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ub_rhaspati" class="skt-link">Bṛhaspati</a> «Précepteur des dieux».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-surapaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>surapāla</i> [<a href="#entry-paala" class="skt-link">pāla</a>] <a href="#entry-surapaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Surapāla, médecin de la cour de <a href="#entry-Uraamapaala" class="skt-link">Rāmapāla</a>; on lui doit not. le <a href="#entry-Uv_rk_saayurveda" class="skt-link">Vṛkṣāyurveda</a>; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Usurezvara_1" class="skt-link">Sureśvara_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-surasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरस</span> <i>surasa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-surasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-surasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-surasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>surasā</i> juteux, plein de suc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> savoureux, délicieux — <a href="#entry-surasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>surasā</i> natu. bot. <i>Ocymum sanctum</i>, basilic sacré; syn. <a href="#entry-tulasii" class="skt-link">tulasī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Surasā, fille de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> et <a href="#entry-Ukrodhavazaa" class="skt-link">Krodhavaśā</a>; elle est la mère des hérons [<a href="#entry-kafka" class="skt-link">kaṅka</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukadruu" class="skt-link">Kadrū</a>, fille de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a> et épouse de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>; elle est la mère de la race des serpents [<a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-surata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरत</span> <i>surata</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-rata" class="skt-link">rata</a>] <a href="#entry-surata" class="skt-link">n.</a> jouissance, plaisir sexuel; copulation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suratama_njarii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suratamañjarī</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_njarii" class="skt-link">mañjarī</a>] <a href="#entry-suratama_njarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de la nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] Suratamañjarī «Bouquet de volupté»; elle fut maudite par <a href="#entry-Umaarka_n_deya" class="skt-link">Mārkaṇḍeya</a>, et transformée en une chaîne d'argent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suratarasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suratarasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <a href="#entry-suratarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> plaisir sexuel, passion, volupté.<br> <a href="#entry-surata" class="skt-link">surata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suratha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरथ</span> <i>suratha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ratha" class="skt-link">ratha</a>] <a href="#entry-suratha" class="skt-link">m.</a> np. de Suratha «au beau char», épith. de divers rois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sureza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sureśa</i> [<a href="#entry-iiz_2" class="skt-link">īś_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sureza" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Sureśa «Seigneur des dieux», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> ou (véd.) d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> — <a href="#entry-surezii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sureśī</i> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> «qui commande les dieux».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-surezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sureśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-surezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du lettré [<a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>] Sureśvara «Divin seigneur», nom de renonçant de <a href="#entry-Uma_n_dana" class="skt-link">Maṇḍana</a> <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a>, philosophe du 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; champion de la doctrine <a href="#entry-puurvamiimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">pūrvamīmāṃsā</a>, il perdit un débat avec <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṃkara_1</a>, devint son élève et se convertit à la doctrine <a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>; on lui doit notamment la <a href="#entry-Uspho_tasiddhi" class="skt-link">Sphoṭasiddhi</a>, la <a href="#entry-Ubrahmasiddhi" class="skt-link">Brahmasiddhi</a>, et la <a href="#entry-Unai_skarmyasiddhi" class="skt-link">Naiṣkarmyasiddhi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Sureśvara_1, épith. de <a href="#entry-Usurapaala" class="skt-link">Surapāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-surottama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>surottama</i> [<a href="#entry-uttama" class="skt-link">uttama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-surottama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-surottama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-surottama" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>surottama</i> super. meilleur des dieux.<br> <a href="#entry-sura" class="skt-link">sura</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suruc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरुच्</span> <i>suruc</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ruc_2" class="skt-link">ruc_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suruc" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suruc" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suruc" class="skt-link">f.</a> au vif éclat; très beau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suruci">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरुचि</span> <i>suruci</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ruci" class="skt-link">ruci</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suruci" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suruci" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suruci" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui a beaucoup de plaisir à ⟨loc.⟩ — <a href="#entry-suruci" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Suruci, favorite d'<a href="#entry-Uuttaanapaada" class="skt-link">Uttānapāda</a> et mère d'<a href="#entry-Uuttama" class="skt-link">Uttama</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुरूप</span> <i>surūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suruupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>surūpā</i> bien formé, beau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-susa_mvaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुसंवाद</span> <i>susaṃvāda</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_mvaada" class="skt-link">saṃvāda</a>] <a href="#entry-susa_mvaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. évangile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-susa_mviita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुसंवीत</span> <i>susaṃvīta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_mviita" class="skt-link">saṃvīta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-susa_mviita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-susa_mviita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-susa_mviitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>susaṃvītā</i> bien habillé; bien couvert; bien harnaché — ifc. richement pourvu en ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-susafgata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुसंगत</span> <i>susaṃgata</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-safgata" class="skt-link">saṃgata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-susa_mgata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-susa_mgata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-susa_mgataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>susaṃgatā</i> bon ami, agréable compagnon — <a href="#entry-susa_mgataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>susaṃgatā</i> lit.     <i>sūdadohas</i> [<a href="#entry-dohas" class="skt-link">dohas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suudadohas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suudadohas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suudadohas" class="skt-link">f.</a> véd. qui donne du lait comme un puits — <a href="#entry-suudadohas" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. formule sacrificielle «source de lait».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suudana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूदन</span> <i>sūdana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-suud" class="skt-link">sūd</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suudana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suudana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suudanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūdanā</i> ifc. qui tue, qui détruit — <a href="#entry-suudana" class="skt-link">n.</a> destruction, fait de tuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suudazaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūdaśālā</i> [<a href="#entry-zaalaa" class="skt-link">śālā</a>] <a href="#entry-suudazaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> cuisine.<br> <a href="#entry-suuda" class="skt-link">sūda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuk_sma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूक्ष्म</span> <i>sūkṣma</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-suuci" class="skt-link">sūci</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suuk_sma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suuk_sma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suuk_smaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūkṣmā</i> fin, menu, mince; petit, étroit; faible, insignifiant; subtil, aigu; atomique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. subtil (opp. <a href="#entry-sthuula" class="skt-link">sthūla</a>) — <a href="#entry-suuk_sma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suuk_sma" class="skt-link">n.</a> atome.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuk_smaagama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūkṣmāgama</i> [<a href="#entry-aagama" class="skt-link">āgama</a>] <a href="#entry-suuk_smaagama" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Sūkṣmāgama, manuel de rituel shivaïte [<a href="#entry-zaivaagama" class="skt-link">śaivāgama</a>]; il est considéré comme l'une des 28 écritures révélées du <a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-suuk_sma" class="skt-link">sūkṣma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuk_smabhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūkṣmabhūta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] <a href="#entry-suuk_smabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] substance subtile, perception; syn. <a href="#entry-tanmaatra" class="skt-link">tanmātra</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-sthuulabhuuta" class="skt-link">sthūlabhūta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuk_smamati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūkṣmamati</i> [<a href="#entry-mati" class="skt-link">mati</a>] <a href="#entry-suuk_smamati" class="skt-link">f.</a> perception subtile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuk_smazariira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūkṣmaśarīra</i> [<a href="#entry-zariira" class="skt-link">śarīra</a>] <a href="#entry-suuk_smazariira" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] corps subtil de l'âme, formé de <a href="#entry-manomayakoza" class="skt-link">manomayakośa</a> et de <a href="#entry-vij_naanamayakoza" class="skt-link">vijñānamayakośa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suukara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूकर</span> <i>sūkara</i> var. <i>śūkara</i> [<i>(sū)</i>-<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] <a href="#entry-suukara" class="skt-link">m.</a> porc, cochon; sanglier — <a href="#entry-suukarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūkarī</i> truie, laie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूक्त</span> <i>sūkta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ukta" class="skt-link">ukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūktā</i> bien dit, bien parlé — <a href="#entry-suukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. prière, récitation pieuse; hymne védique; not. division d'un <a href="#entry-ma_n_dala" class="skt-link">maṇḍala</a> du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-zriisuukta" class="skt-link">śrīsūkta</a>.<br> <i>ṛṣiḥ</i> <i>sūktam</i> <i>paśyati</i> Le sage a la vision des hymnes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suukti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूक्ति</span> <i>sūkti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ukti" class="skt-link">ukti</a>] <a href="#entry-suukti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. poésie bien tournée; dicton; syn. <a href="#entry-subhaa_sita" class="skt-link">subhāṣita</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuktimuktaavalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūktimuktāvalī</i> [<a href="#entry-muktaavalii" class="skt-link">muktāvalī</a>] <a href="#entry-suuktimuktaavalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Sūktimūktāvalī, recueil de proverbes dû à <a href="#entry-Ujalha_na" class="skt-link">Jalhaṇa</a> (1258).<br> <a href="#entry-suukti" class="skt-link">sūkti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suunaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूना</span> <i>sūnā</i> <a href="#entry-suunaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> abattoir; boucherie; massacre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suunu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूनु</span> <i>sūnu</i> <a href="#entry-suunu" class="skt-link">m.</a> fils, enfant — <a href="#entry-suunu" class="skt-link">f.</a> fille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. son; lat. <i>sūnus</i>; all. Sohn.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूप</span> <i>sūpa</i> <a href="#entry-suupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> sauce, soupe; bouillon, curry de légumes; ragoût.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suupaayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूपायन</span> <i>sūpāyana</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upaayana" class="skt-link">upāyana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suupaayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suupaayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suupaayanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūpāyanā</i> facile d'approche, accessible.<br> <i>sa</i> <i>naḥ</i> <i>piteva</i> <i>sūnave</i> <i>'gne</i> <i>sūpāyano</i> <i>bhava</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>sa</i> <i>casvā</i> <i>naḥ</i> <i>svastaye</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [RV.] Sois nous accessible, Ô <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>, comme le père l'est au fils; sois toujours présent pour notre bien-être.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूर</span> <i>sūra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sura" class="skt-link">sura</a>] <a href="#entry-suura" class="skt-link">m.</a> le Soleil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूरि</span> <i>sūri</i> [<a href="#entry-svar_2" class="skt-link">svar_2</a>] <a href="#entry-suuri" class="skt-link">m.</a> érudit; sage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. titre Sūri de lettré <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Usi_mhatilaka" class="skt-link">Siṃhatilaka</a>, <a href="#entry-Usomadeva_1" class="skt-link">Somadeva_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Uharibhadra" class="skt-link">Haribhadra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suurmii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूर्मी</span> <i>sūrmī</i> <a href="#entry-suurmii" class="skt-link">f.</a> enclume.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suurya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूर्य</span> <i>sūrya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sura" class="skt-link">sura</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-suurya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soleil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du «Divin» Sūrya, dieu Soleil; il est le Radieux [<a href="#entry-Uaaditya" class="skt-link">Āditya</a>] fils d'<a href="#entry-Uaditi" class="skt-link">Aditi</a> et de <a href="#entry-Udyau" class="skt-link">Dyau</a> (ou [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>); il est Resplendissant [<a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>]; à son lever sous son aspect d'Incitateur [<a href="#entry-Usavitaa" class="skt-link">Savitā</a>] il inspire les pensées; il est représenté tenant 2 lotus; [VP.] son char est tiré par 7 chevaux symbolisant les 7 jours de la semaine, et nommés d'après des mètres védiques: <a href="#entry-Ugaayatrii_1" class="skt-link">Gāyatrī_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Ub_rhatii_1" class="skt-link">Bṛhatī_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujagatii" class="skt-link">Jagatī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uu_s_nik" class="skt-link">Uṣṇik</a>, <a href="#entry-Utri_s_tup" class="skt-link">Triṣṭup</a>, <a href="#entry-Uanu_s_tup" class="skt-link">Anuṣṭup</a> et <a href="#entry-Upafkti" class="skt-link">Paṅkti</a>; son cocher est <a href="#entry-Uaru_na" class="skt-link">Aruṇa</a> l'Aurore; il est le gardien [<a href="#entry-dikpaala" class="skt-link">dikpāla</a>] de la direction du Sud-Ouest; de son épouse Conscience [<a href="#entry-Usa_nj_naa" class="skt-link">Sañjñā</a>] il engendra <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvaivasvata" class="skt-link">Vaivasvata</a>, <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a> et <a href="#entry-Uyamii" class="skt-link">Yamī</a>; de son substitut [<a href="#entry-Usavar_naa" class="skt-link">Savarṇā</a>] l'Ombre [<a href="#entry-Uchaayaa" class="skt-link">Chāyā</a>] il engendra <a href="#entry-Uzani" class="skt-link">Śani</a> (Saturne) et <a href="#entry-Utapatii" class="skt-link">Tapatī</a> (Canicule); de <a href="#entry-Usa_nj_naa" class="skt-link">Sañjñā</a>-<a href="#entry-Usara_nyuu" class="skt-link">Saraṇyū</a> transformée en jument il engendra les <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a> et <a href="#entry-Urevanta" class="skt-link">Revanta</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvizvakarmaa" class="skt-link">Viśvakarmā</a> rabota le huitième de son éclat pour que <a href="#entry-Usa_nj_naa" class="skt-link">Sañjñā</a> puisse le supporter, et de ses copeaux façonna <a href="#entry-Usudarzana" class="skt-link">Sudarśana</a> et les autres armes des dieux; <a href="#entry-Uda_n_dii" class="skt-link">Daṇḍī</a> et <a href="#entry-Upifgala" class="skt-link">Piṅgala</a> sont ses serviteurs; ses temples principaux se trouvent à Konarak (mod. Orissa) et Modhera (mod. Gujarāt); cf. <a href="#entry-Uarka" class="skt-link">Arka</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukhaga" class="skt-link">Khaga</a>, <a href="#entry-Ucitraratha" class="skt-link">Citraratha</a>, <a href="#entry-Utapana" class="skt-link">Tapana</a>, <a href="#entry-Udinakara" class="skt-link">Dinakara</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhaanu" class="skt-link">Bhānu</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhaaskara" class="skt-link">Bhāskara</a>, <a href="#entry-Uravi" class="skt-link">Ravi</a> — <a href="#entry-suuryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūryā</i> myth. np. de Sūryā, fille de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>; elle accompagne les <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a> dans leur chariot; son mariage avec <a href="#entry-Usoma" class="skt-link">Soma</a> est le prototype mythique de la cérémonie de mariage védique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. σειριος; lat. <i>sol</i>; fr. soleil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryaa_s_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryāṣṭaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a_s_taka" class="skt-link">aṣṭaka</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryaa_s_taka" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. de l'hymne Sūryāṣṭaka de dévotion au Soleil.<br> <a href="#entry-suurya" class="skt-link">sūrya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryadaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryadāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-daasa" class="skt-link">dāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryadaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du poète Sūryadāsa «Serviteur du Soleil» (16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il composa le <a href="#entry-vilomakaavya" class="skt-link">vilomakāvya</a> <a href="#entry-Uraamak_r_s_nakaavya" class="skt-link">Rāmakṛṣṇakāvya</a> vers 1580; il est sans doute l'inventeur de ce genre littéraire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryagraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryagraha</i> [<a href="#entry-graha" class="skt-link">graha</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryagraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. soleil (en tant qu'influence astrale) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> éclipse de soleil (en tant que phénomène); syn. <a href="#entry-suuryagraha_na" class="skt-link">sūryagrahaṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uraahu" class="skt-link">Rāhu</a>, démon des éclipses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryagraha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryagrahaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-graha_na" class="skt-link">grahaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryagraha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> éclipse de soleil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryakaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryakānta</i> [<a href="#entry-kaanta" class="skt-link">kānta</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryakaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [«aimé du soleil»] cristal aux propriétés merveilleuses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryanaa_dii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryanāḍī</i> [<a href="#entry-naa_dii" class="skt-link">nāḍī</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryanaa_dii" class="skt-link">f.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-pifgalaa" class="skt-link">piṅgalā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryanamaskaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryanamaskāra</i> [<a href="#entry-namaskaara" class="skt-link">namaskāra</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryanamaskaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] la salutation au Soleil; elle débute une séance d'exercices [<a href="#entry-ha_thayoga" class="skt-link">haṭhayoga</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryaprabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryaprabha</i> [<a href="#entry-prabha" class="skt-link">prabha</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryaprabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [KSs.] np. du bon roi Sūryaprabha «Soleil resplendissant»; il régnait à <a href="#entry-Uvakrolaka" class="skt-link">Vakrolaka</a>; son épouse était <a href="#entry-Usukhaavatii_2" class="skt-link">Sukhāvatī_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryapuujaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryapūjā</i> [<a href="#entry-puujaa" class="skt-link">pūjā</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryapuujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. festival fêtant la guérison de la lèpre de <a href="#entry-Usaamba" class="skt-link">Sāmba</a> par <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>; on le célèbre à la <a href="#entry-saambadazamii" class="skt-link">sāmbadaśamī</a>, pour souhaiter la bonne santé des enfants; cf. <a href="#entry-dhanuyaatraa" class="skt-link">dhanuyātrā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryava_mza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryavaṃśa</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. lignée solaire; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>, <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a>, <a href="#entry-Udazaratha" class="skt-link">Daśaratha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>, <a href="#entry-Uharizcandra" class="skt-link">Hariścandra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryava_mzin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryavaṃśin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suuryava_mzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suuryava_mzin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suuryava_mzinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūryavaṃśinī</i> myth. se dit de la lignée solaire Sūryavaṃśī.<br> <a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuryavaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūryavāra</i> [<a href="#entry-vaara" class="skt-link">vāra</a>] <a href="#entry-suuryavaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> dimanche, le jour du Soleil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suut">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूत्</span> <i>sūt</i> [onomatopée] ind. snort.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuta_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
