    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूत</span> <i>sūta_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-suu_1" class="skt-link">sū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suuta_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suuta_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūtā</i> né, engendré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a engendré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuta_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूत</span> <i>sūta_2</i> <a href="#entry-suuta_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> hérault, messager <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cocher, conducteur de char, combattant d'un char <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cocher royal, emploi élevé; son titulaire était souvent de père <a href="#entry-k_satriya" class="skt-link">kṣatriya</a> et de mère <a href="#entry-braahma_nii" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du sage Sūta, qui récita le <a href="#entry-Ubhaagavatapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Bhāgavatapurāṇa</a> aux sages de la forêt de <a href="#entry-Unaimi_sa" class="skt-link">Naimiṣa</a>; il l'avait entendu récité par <a href="#entry-Uzuka" class="skt-link">Śuka</a> au roi <a href="#entry-Upariik_sit" class="skt-link">Parīkṣit</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Sūta_1 <a href="#entry-Ugosvaamii" class="skt-link">Gosvāmī</a>, qui donna sa vision du <a href="#entry-kaliyuga" class="skt-link">kaliyuga</a> à <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a> pour composer le <a href="#entry-Ubhavi_syapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Bhaviṣyapurāṇa</a>.<br> <i>duḥsūta</i> mauvais conducteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-suutaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> naissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. impureté liée à la naissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> impureté en gén. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] impureté d'un <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> par contamination de son contexte, remédiée par encapsulation [<a href="#entry-sampu_ta" class="skt-link">saṃpuṭa</a>] — <a href="#entry-suutakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūtakā</i> <a href="#entry-suutikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūtikā</i> parturiente, jeune accouchée.<br> <a href="#entry-suuta_1" class="skt-link">sūta_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूति</span> <i>sūti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-suu_1" class="skt-link">sū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-suuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> naissance, enfantement; production; cf. <a href="#entry-puna_hsuuti" class="skt-link">punaḥsūti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूतिका</span> <i>sūtikā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-suutaka" class="skt-link">sūtaka</a>] <a href="#entry-suutikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> femme en couches <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (vache) ayant mis bas récemment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutikaa_sa_s_thii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtikāṣaṣṭhī</i> [<a href="#entry-_sa_s_thii" class="skt-link">ṣaṣṭhī</a>] <a href="#entry-suutikaa_sa_s_thii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. tantr. <a href="#entry-U_sa_s_thii" class="skt-link">Ṣaṣṭhī</a> «au nourrisson».<br> <a href="#entry-suutikaa" class="skt-link">sūtikā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutkaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-suutkaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui fait le son <a href="#entry-suut" class="skt-link">sūt</a>; qui grogne.<br> <a href="#entry-suut" class="skt-link">sūt</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूत्र</span> <i>sūtra</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-siiv" class="skt-link">sīv</a>] <a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> fil, corde, cordon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. cordon sacré; cf. <a href="#entry-anantasuutra" class="skt-link">anantasūtra</a>, <a href="#entry-brahmasuutra" class="skt-link">brahmasūtra</a>, <a href="#entry-yaj_nasuutra" class="skt-link">yajñasūtra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. aphorisme, formule condensée; traité de rituel; cf. <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. formule, règle (de la grammaire de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>); formulaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>sūtrāṇi</i> bd. traité d'enseignement canonique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. règles de grammaire — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(sūtrayati)</i> composer un <a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a> — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(sūtrayate)</i> mettre en forme de <a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. suture; pali <i>sutta</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutraanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtrānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-suutraanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. du Sūtrānta, doctrine bd. définie par des aphorismes.<br> <a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutradhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtradhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaara_1" class="skt-link">dhāra_1</a>] <a href="#entry-suutradhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> architecte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> directeur de compagnie théâtrale; il présente le prologue des pièces [<a href="#entry-puurvarafga" class="skt-link">pūrvaraṅga</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marionnettiste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutragraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtragraha</i> [<a href="#entry-graha" class="skt-link">graha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suutragraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suutragraha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suutragrahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>sūtragrahā</i> qui saisit le sens du <a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui porte le cordon sacré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutrakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtrakāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-suutrakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. auteur des règles (de l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>); désigne not. <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutrakrii_daa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtrakrīḍā</i> [<a href="#entry-krii_daa" class="skt-link">krīḍā</a>] <a href="#entry-suutrakrii_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. l'art des marionnettes, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutrapaa_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtrapāṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_tha" class="skt-link">pāṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-suutrapaa_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. np. du Sūtrapāṭha «Recueil des règles (de la grammaire de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>)»; syn. <a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suutrasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>sūtrasthāna</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaana" class="skt-link">sthāna</a>] <a href="#entry-suutrasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. section générale (not. d'un ouvrage de médecine).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suuya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सूय</span> <i>sūya</i> cf. <a href="#entry-sutya" class="skt-link">sutya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suv_rkti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुवृक्ति</span> <i>suvṛkti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-_rc_2" class="skt-link">ṛc_2</a>] <a href="#entry-suv_rkti" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. hymne de louange.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suv_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुवृत्त</span> <i>suvṛtta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-v_rtta" class="skt-link">vṛtta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suv_rtta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suv_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suv_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvṛttā</i> bien tourné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui se conduit bien, vertueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. bien composé, bien versifié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suv_rttatilaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvṛttatilaka</i> [<a href="#entry-tilaka" class="skt-link">tilaka</a>] <a href="#entry-suv_rttatilaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Suvṛttatilaka «Trésor de versification», œuvre de poétique de <a href="#entry-Uk_semendra" class="skt-link">Kṣemendra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-suv_rtta" class="skt-link">suvṛtta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvaastu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुवास्तु</span> <i>suvāstu</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vaastu" class="skt-link">vāstu</a>] <a href="#entry-suvaastu" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la vallée de la rivière Suvāstu «Bonne Résidence», qui descend des montagnes de l'Hindukush pour se jeter dans la rivière Kabul, près de mod. Peshawar; mod. Swat — <a href="#entry-suvaastu" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>suvāstavas</i> les habitants de cette vallée; cf. <a href="#entry-zriivaastu" class="skt-link">śrīvāstu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुवर्ण</span> <i>suvarṇa</i> var. <i>svarṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-var_na" class="skt-link">varṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvarṇā</i> brillant, doré, en or — <a href="#entry-suvar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> poids d'or (une pièce d'or, environ 25 g, ou 16 <a href="#entry-maa_sa" class="skt-link">māṣa</a>); syn. <a href="#entry-kar_sa" class="skt-link">karṣa</a> — <a href="#entry-suvar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> or; pièce d'or <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>suvaṇṇa</i>.<br> <i>kuṇḍalāya</i> <i>suvarṇam</i> or convenant à des bijoux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_nabhuumi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvarṇabhūmi</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuumi" class="skt-link">bhūmi</a>] <a href="#entry-suvar_nabhuumi" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de Suvarṇabhūmi «Terre d'or», presqu'île de Sumatra; syn. <a href="#entry-Usuvar_nadviipa" class="skt-link">Suvarṇadvīpa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. np. de l'aéroport Suwannaphum de Bangkok.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_nadviipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvarṇadvīpa</i> [<a href="#entry-dviipa" class="skt-link">dvīpa</a>] <a href="#entry-suvar_nadviipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Suvarṇadvīpa, presqu'île de Sumatra; syn. <a href="#entry-Usuvar_nabhuumi" class="skt-link">Suvarṇabhūmi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_nakaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvarṇakāla</i> [<a href="#entry-kaala_1" class="skt-link">kāla_1</a>] <a href="#entry-suvar_nakaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> âge d'or.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_nakara_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvarṇakaraṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_nii" class="skt-link">karaṇī</a>] <a href="#entry-suvar_nakara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] herbe <a href="#entry-suvar_nakara_nii" class="skt-link">suvarṇakaraṇī</a> «qui redonne un teint doré», rapportée par <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> de l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a> pour guérir l'armée de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_napura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvarṇapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-suvar_napura" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. de la cité mythique Suvarṇapura, habitée par les <a href="#entry-Ukiraataas" class="skt-link">Kirātās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_navar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvarṇavarṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-var_na" class="skt-link">varṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvar_navar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvar_navar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvar_navar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvarṇavarṇā</i> couleur d'or, doré — <a href="#entry-suvar_navar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvarṇavarṇā</i> curcuma.<br> <a href="#entry-suvar_na" class="skt-link">suvarṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvar_navat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvarṇavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvar_navat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvar_navat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvar_navatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvarṇavatī</i> qui contient ou possède de l'or <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> joli, gracieux — adv. comme l'or.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvarcas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुवर्चस्</span> <i>suvarcas</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-varcas" class="skt-link">varcas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvarcas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvarcas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvarcas" class="skt-link">f.</a> vigoureux; ardent; splendide.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुवर्ग</span> <i>suvarga</i> cf. <a href="#entry-svarga" class="skt-link">svarga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvicaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुविचार</span> <i>suvicāra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaara" class="skt-link">vicāra</a>] <a href="#entry-suvicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> bonne pensée — a. <a href="#entry-suvicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvicaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvicaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvicārā</i> animé de bonnes pensées.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvidha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुविध</span> <i>suvidha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vidha" class="skt-link">vidha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvidha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvidha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvidhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvidhā</i> de bonne sorte, convenable.<br> <i>suvidham</i> adv. facilement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुविधि</span> <i>suvidhi</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vidhi" class="skt-link">vidhi</a>] <a href="#entry-suvidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> bonne règle, bon procédé.<br> <i>suvidhinā</i> adv. comme il convient; de la bonne manière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvidhinaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvidhinātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-suvidhinaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. de Suvidhinātha «Maître des rites favorables», épith. de <a href="#entry-Upu_spadanta" class="skt-link">Puṣpadanta</a>, 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique.<br> <a href="#entry-suvidhi" class="skt-link">suvidhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvidita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुविदित</span> <i>suvidita</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vidita" class="skt-link">vidita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvidita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvidita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suviditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suviditā</i> bien connu; bien compris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suviira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुवीर</span> <i>suvīra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-viira" class="skt-link">vīra</a>] <a href="#entry-suviira" class="skt-link">m.</a> grand héros <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. peuple des bouches de l'Indus [<a href="#entry-Usindhu" class="skt-link">Sindhu</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-saindhava" class="skt-link">saindhava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvikraanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुविक्रान्त</span> <i>suvikrānta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vikraanta" class="skt-link">vikrānta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvikraanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvikraanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvikraantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvikrāntā</i> très vaillant, héroïque; audacieux; chevaleresque — <a href="#entry-suvikraanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> héros.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvikraantavikrama_naparip_rcchaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suvikrāntavikramaṇaparipṛcchā</i> [<a href="#entry-vikrama_na" class="skt-link">vikramaṇa</a>-<a href="#entry-parip_rcchaa" class="skt-link">paripṛcchā</a>] <a href="#entry-suvikraantavikrama_naparip_rcchaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Suvikrāntavikramaṇaparipṛcchā, œuvre bd.<br> <a href="#entry-suvikraanta" class="skt-link">suvikrānta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvikrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुविक्रम</span> <i>suvikrama</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vikrama" class="skt-link">vikrama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvikrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvikrama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvikramaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvikramā</i> à la jolie démarche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> courageux, brave — <a href="#entry-suvikrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> haut exploit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> héros.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suvrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुव्रत</span> <i>suvrata</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suvrata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suvrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suvrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suvratā</i> vertueux, chaste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> docile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suyaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुयश</span> <i>suyaśa</i> [<a href="#entry-suyazas" class="skt-link">suyaśas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suyaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suyaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suyazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suyaśā</i> très fameux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suyazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुयशस्</span> <i>suyaśas</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yazas" class="skt-link">yaśas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suyazas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suyazas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suyazas" class="skt-link">f.</a> très fameux — <a href="#entry-suyazas" class="skt-link">n.</a> gloire, célébrité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suyodhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुयोधन</span> <i>suyodhana</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yodhana" class="skt-link">yodhana</a>] <a href="#entry-suyodhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Suyodhana «Bon guerrier», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uduryodhana" class="skt-link">Duryodhana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suyudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुयुध्</span> <i>suyudh</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yudh_2" class="skt-link">yudh_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suyudh" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suyudh" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suyudh" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui combat bien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suzarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुशर्मन्</span> <i>suśarman</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-zarman" class="skt-link">śarman</a>] <a href="#entry-suzarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Śusharmā «Bon protecteur», roi des <a href="#entry-Utrigartaas" class="skt-link">Trigartās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suziila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुशील</span> <i>suśīla</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ziila" class="skt-link">śīla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suziila" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suziila" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suziilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suśīlā</i> bien disposé; bon, aimable; vertueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bien fait, bien formé — <a href="#entry-suziilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suśīlā</i> myth. [BhP.] np. de Suśīlā «Vertueuse», épouse de <a href="#entry-Usudaama" class="skt-link">Sudāma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [HV.] np. de Suśīlā_1, une épouse de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [MP.] np. de Suśīlā_2, fille du roi de <a href="#entry-Ukaazii" class="skt-link">Kāśī</a>, en laquelle <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a> se trouva transformé lorsqu'il demanda à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> le secret de sa <a href="#entry-Umaayaa" class="skt-link">Māyā</a>; elle épousa le roi du <a href="#entry-Uvidarbha" class="skt-link">Vidarbha</a>, vécut heureuse, eut de nombreux enfants; mais son père et son époux se livrèrent bataille, et toute sa famille périt; elle se jeta sur le bûcher de son mari, et redevint <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a> mystifié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suziitala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुशीतल</span> <i>suśītala</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ziitala" class="skt-link">śītala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suziitala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suziitala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suziitalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suśītalā</i> rafraîchissant.<br> <i>koṭicandrasuśītala</i> rafraîchissant comme des millions de lunes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suziras">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुशिरस्</span> <i>suśiras</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ziras" class="skt-link">śiras</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suziras" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suziras" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suziras" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui a une jolie tête.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suzro_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुश्रोणी</span> <i>suśroṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-zro_nii" class="skt-link">śroṇī</a>] <a href="#entry-suzro_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> (femme) qui a de belles hanches, callipyge; syn. <a href="#entry-nitambinii" class="skt-link">nitambinī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suzruta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">सुश्रुत</span> <i>suśruta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-zruta" class="skt-link">śruta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-suzruta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-suzruta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-suzrutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>suśrutā</i> célèbre, renommé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qu'on entend bien; appris avec plaisir — <a href="#entry-suzruta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Suśruta, médeçin antique fameux; il écrivit la <a href="#entry-Usuzrutasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">Suśrutasaṃhitā</a>, présentée comme somme des leçons de <a href="#entry-Udhanvantari_1" class="skt-link">Dhanvantari_1</a>; le texte d'origine est antérieur au 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant., le texte définitif fut fixé vers 500.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suzrutapaa_thazuddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suśrutapāṭhaśuddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_tha" class="skt-link">pāṭha</a>-<a href="#entry-zuddhi" class="skt-link">śuddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-suzrutapaa_thazuddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Suśrutapāṭhaśuddhi «Correction des variantes de <a href="#entry-Usuzruta" class="skt-link">Suśruta</a>», due à <a href="#entry-Ucandra_ta" class="skt-link">Candraṭa</a> (fin 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-suzrutasa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>suśrutasaṃhitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] <a href="#entry-suzrutasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Suśrutasaṃhitā, ouvrage de base de médecine et de chirurgie de l'<a href="#entry-Uaayurveda" class="skt-link">Āyurveda</a>, attribué à <a href="#entry-Usuzruta" class="skt-link">Suśruta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-suzruta" class="skt-link">suśruta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्व</span> <i>sva</i> pn. <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svā</i> son, sa, ses <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (pronom réfléchi, aux cas obliques) cf. <a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a> — a. <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svā</i> propre, personnel — <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme de sa propre famille, de son peuple [«l'un des siens»]; relation, ami, allié — <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">n.</a> son propre soi, son ego — <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">n.</a> son propre bien, sa fortune — <a href="#entry-svaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svā</i> soc. femme de sa propre caste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>sūs</i>; fr. soi.<br> <i>svīkṛ</i> s'approprier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sva_h">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वः</span> <i>svaḥ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-svar_3" class="skt-link">svar_3</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sva_hsad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svaḥsad</i> [<a href="#entry-sad_2" class="skt-link">sad_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sva_hsad" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sva_hsad" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sva_hsad" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. qui réside aux cieux (se dit des dieux).<br> <a href="#entry-sva_h" class="skt-link">svaḥ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaabhaavika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाभाविक</span> <i>svābhāvika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-svabhaava" class="skt-link">svabhāva</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaabhaavika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaabhaavika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaabhaavikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svābhāvikī</i> nature, natifl; propre à sa nature; autonome; spontané <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. se dit not. des maladies liées au grand âge <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. irrégulier (se dit des formes spontanées non prévues par la règle); opp. <a href="#entry-vaacanika" class="skt-link">vācanika</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. bd. nom d'une école bd. — <a href="#entry-svaabhaavika" class="skt-link">n.</a> nature propre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaabhaavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाभाव्य</span> <i>svābhāvya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-svabhaava" class="skt-link">svabhāva</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaabhaavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaabhaavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaabhaavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svābhāvyā</i> auto-existant, spontané (se dit not. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>) — <a href="#entry-svaabhaavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> nature propre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. autonomie du pouvoir de connotation du mot; elle justifie les formes irrégulières.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाद</span> <i>svāda</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-svad" class="skt-link">svad</a>] <a href="#entry-svaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> goût, saveur — ifc. goût, intérêt pour; cf. <a href="#entry-brahmaasvaada" class="skt-link">brahmāsvāda</a>, <a href="#entry-rasaasvaada" class="skt-link">rasāsvāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वादन</span> <i>svādana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-svad" class="skt-link">svad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaadana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svādanā</i> qui assaisonne, qui donne du goût — <a href="#entry-svaadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> acte de goûter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait d'apprécier (un poème).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaadhi_s_thaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाधिष्ठान</span> <i>svādhiṣṭhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-adhi_s_thaana" class="skt-link">adhiṣṭhāna</a>] <a href="#entry-svaadhi_s_thaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. «le Siège du soi», 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a> tantr. situé au niveau des parties génitales; il est représenté par un lotus de 6 pétales rouges; un croissant y symbolise l'élément eau, et porte le <a href="#entry-biijamantra" class="skt-link">bījamantra</a> <i>vaṃ</i>; il contrôle le sens du goût; il est le centre psychique de la jouissance du soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaadhyaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाध्याय</span> <i>svādhyāya</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-adhyaaya" class="skt-link">adhyāya</a>] <a href="#entry-svaadhyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. récitation privée (not. de textes sacrés, du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>); c'est un <a href="#entry-pa_ncopaasana" class="skt-link">pañcopāsana</a> selon <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la connaissance (acquise par la lecture des textes sacrés), une des disciplines [<a href="#entry-niyama" class="skt-link">niyama</a>] du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>.<br> <i>satyaṃ</i> <i>vada</i> <i>dharmaṃ</i> <i>cara</i> <i>svādhyāyānmā</i> <i>pramadaḥ</i> [TU.] Dis la vérité, fais ton devoir, ne néglige pas tes études.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaadi_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वादिष्ठ</span> <i>svādiṣṭha</i> [super. <a href="#entry-svaada" class="skt-link">svāda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaadi_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadi_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadi_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svādiṣṭhā</i> le meilleur, le plus savoureux; délicieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plus sucré que ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaadu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वादु</span> <i>svādu</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-svad" class="skt-link">svad</a><a href="#entry--u" class="skt-link">-u</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaadu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadu" class="skt-link">f.</a> savoureux, doux, agréable; délicieux, plaisant au goût — <a href="#entry-svaadu" class="skt-link">n.</a> douceur, saveur sucrée; sirop.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaadurasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svādurasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaadurasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadurasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaadurasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svādurasā</i> au goût plaisant, succulent.<br> <a href="#entry-svaadu" class="skt-link">svādu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaagama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वागम</span> <i>svāgama</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aagama" class="skt-link">āgama</a>] <a href="#entry-svaagama" class="skt-link">m.</a> salutation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaagata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वागत</span> <i>svāgata</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aagata" class="skt-link">āgata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaagata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaagata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaagataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svāgatā</i> bienvenu — <a href="#entry-svaagata" class="skt-link">n.</a> salut (de bienvenue); bienvenue.<br> <i>svāgatam</i> var. <i>susvāgatam</i> adr. bienvenue!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaahaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाहा</span> <i>svāhā</i> ind. excl. soc. gloire à ⟨dat.⟩! (accompagne l'oblation à une divinité); véd. prononcé en offrant le bois dans le feu dans le <a href="#entry-devayaj_na" class="skt-link">devayajña</a> — <a href="#entry-svaahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Svāhā «Oblation», épouse d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>; elle prit la forme des épouses des 7 sages pour s'unir à lui et ainsi procréer <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>.<br> <i>śivāya</i> <i>svāhā</i> gloire à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>!<br> <i>agnaye</i> <i>svāhā</i> <i>agnaya</i> <i>idam</i> <i>na</i> <i>mama</i> gloire à <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>! ceci est pour <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>, non pour moi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaahaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाहार</span> <i>svāhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aahaara" class="skt-link">āhāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaahaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaahaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svāhārā</i> facile à se procurer — <a href="#entry-svaahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> nourriture succulente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prêtre-cuisinier chargé de préparer les offrandes [<a href="#entry-prasaada" class="skt-link">prasāda</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaami">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वामि</span> <i>svāmi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-svaamin" class="skt-link">svāmin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaamibhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svāmibhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-svaamibhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> domination; propriété.<br> <a href="#entry-svaami" class="skt-link">svāmi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaamigu_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svāmiguṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-svaamigu_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> aptitude au commandement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaamii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वामी</span> <i>svāmī</i> [nom. <a href="#entry-svaamin" class="skt-link">svāmin</a>] ind. titre [Svāmī] dans divers ordres religieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaamiinaaraaya_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svāmīnārāyaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-naaraaya_na" class="skt-link">nārāyaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-svaamiinaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Svāmīnārāyaṇa, né Ghanṣyam Paṇḍe (1781–1830), fondateur de l'ordre religieux [<a href="#entry-sampradaaya" class="skt-link">saṃpradāya</a>] éponyme; il quitta sa famille à 11 ans pour devenir l'ascète errant Nīlakaṇṭha Varṇi; il fut initié comme Sahajānanda <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> par <a href="#entry-Uraamaananda_1" class="skt-link">Rāmānanda_1</a> <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> et s'établit à Gadhada au Gujarāt; il prônait la non-violence, le régime végétarien, l'interdiction de l'alcool, l'éducation des femmes, la suppression de la ségrégation des castes et du suicide des veuves [<a href="#entry-satii" class="skt-link">satī</a>]; il fut déifié comme incarnation de <a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. np. du temple Svāmīnārāyaṇa_1 Akṣaradhāman, inauguré à Delhi en 2005.<br> <a href="#entry-svaamii" class="skt-link">svāmī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaamin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वामिन्</span> <i>svāmin</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a><a href="#entry--min" class="skt-link">-min</a>] <a href="#entry-svaamin" class="skt-link">m.</a> propriétaire, maître; seigneur, chef; roi, prince (de ⟨g. loc.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mari, amant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. précepteur spirituel, brâhmane éclairé; titre [<a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a>] dans divers ordres religieux — ifc. maître (honorifique) — <a href="#entry-svaaminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svāminī</i> maîtresse, princesse; favorite.<br> <i>svasvāmibhāva</i> gram. relation entre possesseur et possession.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaamitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svāmitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-svaamitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> propriété, maîtrise, gouvernance de ⟨iic. g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaamitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svāmitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-svaamitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> propriété, maîtrise, gouvernance de ⟨iic. g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वान्त</span> <i>svānta</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-svaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> sa propre fin, sa propre mort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> son propre domaine; sa province, son pays — <a href="#entry-svaanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> esprit, cœur (siège des émotions).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaanu_s_thaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वानुष्ठान</span> <i>svānuṣṭhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-anu_s_thaana" class="skt-link">anuṣṭhāna</a>] <a href="#entry-svaanu_s_thaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> l'action personnelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाप</span> <i>svāpa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-svap" class="skt-link">svap</a>] <a href="#entry-svaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> sommeil, rêve; somnolence, engourdissement; stupidité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaaroci_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वारोचिष</span> <i>svārociṣa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-svarocis" class="skt-link">svarocis</a>] <a href="#entry-svaaroci_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Svārociṣa «Issu de sa propre grâce», 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> du <a href="#entry-kalpa" class="skt-link">kalpa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वार्थ</span> <i>svārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-svaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> (son) propre destin, (ses) propres affaires, (sa) cause, (son) but <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ses propres intérêts; travail égoïste; opp. <a href="#entry-paramaartha" class="skt-link">paramārtha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> substance propre; fin en soi, signification propre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. pléonasme — a. <a href="#entry-svaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svārthā</i> égoïste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> destiné à son propre usage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. qui n'apporte pas de sens supplémentaire (se dit de certains suffixes formant des dérivés endocentriques); opp. <a href="#entry-anyapadaartha" class="skt-link">anyapadārtha</a>.<br> <i>svārtham</i> adv. pour soi-même.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaarthaanumaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svārthānumāna</i> [<a href="#entry-anumaana" class="skt-link">anumāna</a>] <a href="#entry-svaarthaanumaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] utilisation du raisonnement pour son propre usage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaarthataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svārthatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-svaarthataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> égoïsme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaarthika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svārthika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaarthika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaarthika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaarthikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svārthikā</i> gram. se dit des suffixes n'apportant pas de sens supplémentaire au thème.<br> <a href="#entry-svaartha" class="skt-link">svārtha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaasthya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वास्थ्य</span> <i>svāsthya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-svastha" class="skt-link">svastha</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-svaasthya" class="skt-link">n.</a> autonomie; confort; bonne santé; bonne condition (physique ou mentale).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaatantrya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वातन्त्र्य</span> <i>svātantrya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-svatantra" class="skt-link">svatantra</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-svaatantrya" class="skt-link">n.</a> liberté, indépendance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. libre arbitre.<br> <i>svātantryāt</i> var. <i>svātantryena</i> adv. de soi-même, de son propre gré; librement, volontairement.<br> <i>na</i> <i>strī</i> <i>svātantryamarhati</i> [<a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>] La femme ne mérite pas l'indépendance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaatantryavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svātantryavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-svaatantryavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. doctrine de l'autonomie (du Soi), développée par le shivaïsme non dualiste [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>] du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> [<a href="#entry-trika" class="skt-link">trika</a>]; c'est une théorie de la liberté par la reconnaissance [<a href="#entry-Upratyabhij_naa" class="skt-link">Pratyabhijñā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-svaatantrya" class="skt-link">svātantrya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वाति</span> <i>svāti</i> var. <i>svātī</i> <a href="#entry-svaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> astr. np. de Svāti ou Svātī, régente du 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>], corr. à l'étoile Arcturus du Bouvier; <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a> y préside; son symbole est le corail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaatma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वात्म</span> <i>svātma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-svaatman" class="skt-link">svātman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaatmaaraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svātmārāma</i> [<a href="#entry-aaraama" class="skt-link">ārāma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaatmaaraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaatmaaraama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaatmaaraamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svātmārāmā</i> qui se contente du soi — <a href="#entry-svaatmaaraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Svātmārāma, nom religieux du <a href="#entry-naathayogin" class="skt-link">nāthayogin</a> <a href="#entry-Ucintaama_ni_1" class="skt-link">Cintāmaṇi_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-svaatma" class="skt-link">svātma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaatman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वात्मन्</span> <i>svātman</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a>] <a href="#entry-svaatman" class="skt-link">m.</a> soi, nature propre; sa propre personne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaatmani_s_thita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svātmaniṣṭhita</i> [<a href="#entry-ni_s_thita" class="skt-link">niṣṭhita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaatmani_s_thita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaatmani_s_thita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaatmani_s_thitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svātmaniṣṭhitā</i> phil. autonome; confiné en soi-même.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaatmavij_naana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svātmavijñāna</i> [<a href="#entry-vij_naana" class="skt-link">vijñāna</a>] <a href="#entry-svaatmavij_naana" class="skt-link">m.</a> connaissance de soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaayambhuva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वायंभुव</span> <i>svāyaṃbhuva</i> var. <i>svāyambhuva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-svayambhu" class="skt-link">svayaṃbhu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaaya_mbhuva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaaya_mbhuva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaaya_mbhuvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svāyaṃbhuvā</i> myth. relatif à <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>-<a href="#entry-Usvayambhu" class="skt-link">Svayaṃbhu</a> — <a href="#entry-svaaya_mbhuva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Svāyaṃbhuva, «(fils) de l'Auto-engendré», 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> du <a href="#entry-kalpa" class="skt-link">kalpa</a>; il engendra les 10 géniteurs [<a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaayambhuvatantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svāyaṃbhuvatantra</i> [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] <a href="#entry-svaaya_mbhuvatantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Svāyaṃbhuvatantra.<br> <a href="#entry-svaayambhuva" class="skt-link">svāyaṃbhuva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-svabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> disposition naturelle, nature innée ou spontanée; nature propre; caractère — <a href="#entry-svabhaavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svabhāvā</i> ifc. nature propre de.<br> <i>devosmi</i> <i>na</i> <i>cānyo'smi</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>brahmaivāham</i> <i>na</i> <i>śokabhāk</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>saccidānandarūpo'ham</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>nityamuktasvabhāvavān</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Je ne suis autre que Dieu; pareil au <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a>, je ne ressens pas de peine; je suis existence, conscience et joie; la libération éternelle est ma nature propre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaavaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāvaja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svabhaavaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavaja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svabhāvajā</i> né spontanément — <a href="#entry-svabhaavaja" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>svabhāvajavarṇa</i>] se dit d'une couleur primaire: blanc, rouge, jaune et bleu [<a href="#entry-niila" class="skt-link">nīla</a>]; par mélange on obtient les couleurs secondaires [<i>saṃyogajavarṇa</i>] et auxiliaires [<i>upavarṇa</i>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaavasa_msiddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāvasaṃsiddha</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_msiddha" class="skt-link">saṃsiddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svabhaavasa_msiddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavasa_msiddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavasa_msiddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svabhāvasaṃsiddhā</i> accompli spontanément; inné.<br> <i>svabhāvasaṃsiddhalakṣaṇāt</i> selon les lois naturelles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaavasaukumaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāvasaukumārya</i> [<a href="#entry-saukumaarya" class="skt-link">saukumārya</a>] <a href="#entry-svabhaavasaukumaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. beauté naturelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaavasiddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāvasiddha</i> [<a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svabhaavasiddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavasiddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavasiddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svabhāvasiddhā</i> phil. naturellement vrai, découlant de sa nature; inné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> évident.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaavazuunya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāvaśūnya</i> [<a href="#entry-zuunya" class="skt-link">śūnya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svabhaavazuunya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavazuunya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavazuunyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svabhāvaśūnyā</i> phil. vide d'être propre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaavokta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāvokta</i> [<a href="#entry-ukta" class="skt-link">ukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svabhaavokta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavokta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svabhaavoktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svabhāvoktā</i> déclaré spontanément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svabhaavokti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svabhāvokti</i> [<a href="#entry-ukti" class="skt-link">ukti</a>] <a href="#entry-svabhaavokti" class="skt-link">f.</a> déclaration spontanée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> description naturaliste, description fidèle des propriétés de qqc. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. procédé poétique [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] de description pittoresque; poèmes miniatures inspirés de la nature.<br> <a href="#entry-svabhaava" class="skt-link">svabhāva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaccha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वच्छ</span> <i>svaccha</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-accha_1" class="skt-link">accha_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaccha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaccha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svacchaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svacchā</i> très clair, cristallin, transparent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> clair, limpide; propre, pur — <a href="#entry-svaccha" class="skt-link">m.</a> cristal de roche — <a href="#entry-svaccha" class="skt-link">n.</a> perle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>svacchadhātuka</i>] alliage d'argent et d'or — <a href="#entry-svacchaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svacchā</i> variété blanche d'herbe <a href="#entry-duurvaa" class="skt-link">dūrvā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svacchanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svacchanda</i> [<a href="#entry-chanda" class="skt-link">chanda</a>] <a href="#entry-svacchanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> sa propre volonté, son bon plaisir; libre arbitre — a. <a href="#entry-svacchanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svacchanda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svacchandaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svacchandā</i> qui suit son libre arbitre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> indépendant; spontané.<br> <i>svacchandāt</i> var. <i>svacchandena</i> adv. suivant son bon plaisir; librement; spontanément; indépendamment.<br> <i>svacchandatas</i> adv. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svacchandabhairavatantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svacchandabhairavatantra</i> [<a href="#entry-bhairava" class="skt-link">bhairava</a>-<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] <a href="#entry-svacchandabhairavatantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Svacchandabhairavatantra, texte <a href="#entry-kaula" class="skt-link">kaula</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-svacchanda" class="skt-link">svacchanda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svacchatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svacchatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-svacchatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> clarté, limpidité, transparence; pûreté, propreté.<br> <a href="#entry-svaccha" class="skt-link">svaccha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वद्</span> <i>svad</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(svadati)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i><i>)</i> goûter, savourer, manger avec plaisir — pr. md. <i>(svadate)</i> être agréable au goût, plaire à ⟨dat. g.⟩ — ca. <i>(svādayati)</i> ca. <i>(sādayati)</i> rendre agréable au goût, assaisonner, cuire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ηδυς; lat. <i>suāvis</i>; all. süss; ang. sweet; fr. suave.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svadeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svadeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-deza" class="skt-link">deśa</a>] <a href="#entry-svadeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> patrie, pays d'origine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. compatriotes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svadezin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svadeśin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svadezin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svadezin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svadezinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svadeśinī</i> national, autochtone.<br> <a href="#entry-svadeza" class="skt-link">svadeśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svadhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svadhā</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaa_3" class="skt-link">dhā_3</a>] <a href="#entry-svadhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pouvoir personnel, autorité naturelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> état naturel; usage, coutume, environnement culturel; loi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lieu d'origine; chez-soi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. sacrifice aux dieux; not. offrande d'eau ou de beurre clarifié servant de libation aux ancêtres dans le <a href="#entry-pit_ryaj_na" class="skt-link">pitṛyajña</a> — interj. invocation de bénédiction en offrant la libation aux mânes [<a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a>].<br> <i>svade</i> du. ses deux résidences: sur Terre et au Ciel.<br> <i>anusvadhām</i> var. <i>svadhāmanu</i> adv. de son propre chef; naturellement, facilement, librement.<br> <i>svadhākṛ</i> soc. effectuer l'invocation rituelle <a href="#entry-svadhaa" class="skt-link">svadhā</a>.<br> <i>svadhāstu</i> interj. soc. que la libation soit bénéfique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svadharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svadharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-svadharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. son propre devoir; le devoir de sa classe sociale (opp. <a href="#entry-saadhaara_nadharma" class="skt-link">sādhāraṇadharma</a>).<br> <i>svadharma</i> <i>labh</i> faire reconnaître ses droits.<br> <i>śreyān</i> <i>svadharmo</i> <i>viguṇaḥ</i> <i>paradharmāt</i> <i>svanuṣṭhitāt</i> [BhG.] Mieux vaut mal faire son propre devoir que d'exceller dans celui des autres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svadita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वदित</span> <i>svadita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-svad" class="skt-link">svad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svadita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svaditā</i> bien assaisonné, savoureux — <a href="#entry-svadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. [«bon appêtit»] invocation lors de la <a href="#entry-zraddhaa_2" class="skt-link">śraddhā_2</a> au moment de la présentation de l'oblation aux ancêtres [<a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svagaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वगा</span> <i>svagā</i> interj. soc. prospérité! (exclamation rituelle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svagraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svagrāma</i> [<a href="#entry-graama" class="skt-link">grāma</a>] <a href="#entry-svagraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> village d'origine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svahasta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svahasta</i> [<a href="#entry-hasta" class="skt-link">hasta</a>] <a href="#entry-svahasta" class="skt-link">m.</a> sa propre main <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sa propre écriture; signature, autographe.<br> <i>svahastaṃ</i> <i>dā</i> offrir sa main pour ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>svahasto</i> <i>mama</i> (inscription, colophon) de ma propre main.<br> <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वैर</span> <i>svaira</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-iira" class="skt-link">īra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaira" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaira" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svairaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svairā</i> autonome, indépendant; libre, sans contrainte — acc. <i>svairam</i> adv. à son gré, librement, de son propre mouvement, sans obstacle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans réserve, en toute confiance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svairin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वैरिन्</span> <i>svairin</i> [<a href="#entry-svaira" class="skt-link">svaira</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svairin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svairin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svairi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svairiṇī</i> libre de ses mouvements, indépendant — <a href="#entry-svairi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svairiṇī</i> soc. femme libre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. chauve-souris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svairitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वैरिता</span> <i>svairitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-iiritaa" class="skt-link">īritā</a>] <a href="#entry-svairitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> libre arbitre; autonomie, indépendance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svajaati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svajāti</i> [<a href="#entry-jaati" class="skt-link">jāti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svajaati" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svajaati" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svajaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> de sa propre espèce — <a href="#entry-svajaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> sa propre espèce, caste, famille ou race.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svajaatiiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svajātīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svajaatiiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svajaatiiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svajaatiiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svajātīyā</i> [«qui est de sa propre espèce»] semblable, égal, pareil.<br> <a href="#entry-svajaati" class="skt-link">svajāti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svajana</i> [<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] <a href="#entry-svajana" class="skt-link">m.</a> compatriote; apparenté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> son propre peuple; son clan — <a href="#entry-janaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>janā</i> ifc. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svak_rtya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svakṛtya</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rtya" class="skt-link">kṛtya</a>] <a href="#entry-svak_rtya" class="skt-link">n.</a> son propre devoir, sa responsabilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वक</span> <i>svaka</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svakā</i> son; son propre; de son entourage — <a href="#entry-svaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> allié, ami <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>svakās</i> les siens; ses gens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svakaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svakārya</i> [<a href="#entry-kaarya" class="skt-link">kārya</a>] <a href="#entry-svakaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> son occupation propre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svakaaryaarthin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svakāryārthin</i> [<a href="#entry-arthin" class="skt-link">arthin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svakaaryaarthin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svakaaryaarthin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svakaaryaarthinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svakāryārthinī</i> égoïste.<br> <a href="#entry-svakaarya" class="skt-link">svakārya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svakasvaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svakasvaka</i> [red.] a. <a href="#entry-svakasvaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svakasvaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svakasvakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svakasvakā</i> id.<br> <i>svakasvakā</i> <i>bhaginī</i> sa propre sœur (opp. <a href="#entry-vaimaat_rkaa" class="skt-link">vaimātṛkā</a> <a href="#entry-bhaginii" class="skt-link">bhaginī</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svakiiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svakīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svakiiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svakiiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svakiiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svakīyā</i> id. (opp. <a href="#entry-parakiiya" class="skt-link">parakīya</a>) — <a href="#entry-svakiiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svakīyā</i> sa propre femme.<br> <i>svakīya</i> <i>bhava</i> nature propre.<br> <a href="#entry-svaka" class="skt-link">svaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svalafk_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वलंकृत</span> <i>svalaṃkṛta</i> var. <i>svalaṅkṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-alafk_rta" class="skt-link">alaṃkṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svala_mk_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svala_mk_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svala_mk_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svalaṃkṛtā</i> bien préparé; bien décoré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svalak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svalakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-salak_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>salakṣaṇā</i> qui a ses caractéristiques propres — <a href="#entry-svalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> signe particulier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-Udifnaaga" class="skt-link">Diṅnāga</a>] évènement particulier unique constituant la réalité; interprété par un <a href="#entry-yogaacaarin" class="skt-link">yogācārin</a> comme un moment de conscience, par un <a href="#entry-sautraantika" class="skt-link">sautrāntika</a> comme un point temporel externe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svalikhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svalikhita</i> [<a href="#entry-likhita" class="skt-link">likhita</a>] <a href="#entry-svalikhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> document écrit de sa propre main.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svalpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वल्प</span> <i>svalpa</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-alpa" class="skt-link">alpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svalpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svalpa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svalpaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svalpā</i> très petit, minuscule; bref; insignifiant, négligeable.<br> <i>svalpena</i> i. adv. en un éclair.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svalpazilaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svalpaśilā</i> [<a href="#entry-zilaa" class="skt-link">śilā</a>] <a href="#entry-svalpazilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> toute petite pierre — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(svalpaśilāyate)</i> devenir un caillou insignifiant.<br> <a href="#entry-svalpa" class="skt-link">svalpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svamedhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svamedhā</i> [<a href="#entry-medhaa" class="skt-link">medhā</a>] <a href="#entry-svamedhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> intelligence propre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वन्</span> <i>svan</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(svanati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>svanita</i><i>)</i> ca. <i>(svanayati)</i> sonner, résonner, retentir, émettre un bruit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>sonare</i>; fr. sonner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वन</span> <i>svana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-svan" class="skt-link">svan</a>] <a href="#entry-svana" class="skt-link">m.</a> son, bruit, parole <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>sonus</i>; fr. son.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svanaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svanāman</i> [<a href="#entry-naaman" class="skt-link">nāman</a>] <a href="#entry-svanaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> son propre nom.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वप्</span> <i>svap</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(svapiti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(svapati)</i> pft. <i>(suṣvāpa)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>supta</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(svapat)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> dormir, s'endormir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se coucher pour s'endormir, être couché; être mort — ps. <i>(supyate)</i> être endormi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. υπνος; lat. <i>sopor</i>; ang. sleep; fr. soporifique.<br> <i>mayā</i> <i>supyate</i> var. <i>svapimi</i> je dors.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svapar_nazaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svaparṇaśālā</i> [<a href="#entry-par_nazaalaa" class="skt-link">parṇaśālā</a>] <a href="#entry-svapar_nazaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> sa propre hutte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svapat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वपत्</span> <i>svapat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-svap" class="skt-link">svap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svapat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svapat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svapatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svapatī</i> dormant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svapna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वप्न</span> <i>svapna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-svap" class="skt-link">svap</a>] <a href="#entry-svapna" class="skt-link">m.</a> l'état [<a href="#entry-avasthaa_2" class="skt-link">avasthā_2</a>] de sommeil; rêve <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le deuxième stade de conscience; cf. <a href="#entry-maa_n_duukyopani_sad" class="skt-link">māṇḍūkyopaniṣad</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>somnus</i>; fr. sommeil.<br> <i>svapne</i> en songe.<br> <i>svapnaṃ</i> <i>dṛś</i> [«voir en rêve»] rêver.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svapnavaasavadattaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svapnavāsavadattā</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasavadattaa" class="skt-link">vāsavadattā</a>] <a href="#entry-svapnavaasavadattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Svapnavāsavadattā «<a href="#entry-Uvaasavadattaa_2" class="skt-link">Vāsavadattā_2</a> vue en songe», pièce de théâtre [<a href="#entry-naa_taka" class="skt-link">nāṭaka</a>] de <a href="#entry-Ubhaasa" class="skt-link">Bhāsa</a>, inspirée de légendes de la <a href="#entry-Ub_rhatkathaa" class="skt-link">Bṛhatkathā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-svapna" class="skt-link">svapna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaprakaaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svaprakāśa</i> [<a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">prakāśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaprakaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaprakaaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaprakaazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svaprakāśā</i> évident en soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaprakaazatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svaprakāśatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-svaprakaazatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> auto-évidence; fait de se manifester.<br> <a href="#entry-svaprakaaza" class="skt-link">svaprakāśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वर्ण</span> <i>svarṇa</i> [contr. <i>suvarṇa</i>] <a href="#entry-svar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> or.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_nacuu_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarṇacūḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-cuu_daa" class="skt-link">cūḍā</a>] <a href="#entry-svar_nacuu_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. [«à la crête dorée»] geai bleu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_nadviipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarṇadvīpa</i> [<a href="#entry-dviipa" class="skt-link">dvīpa</a>] <a href="#entry-svar_nadviipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svar_nadviipa" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de Svarṇadvīpa, l'Île d'or, mod. Ceylan <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. serendipity.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_nakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarṇakāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-svar_nakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> orfèvre, bijoutier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_namaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarṇamaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svar_namaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svar_namaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svar_namayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svarṇamayī</i> doré; en or.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_naroman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarṇaroman</i> [<a href="#entry-roman" class="skt-link">roman</a>] <a href="#entry-svar_naroman" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [BhP.] np. du roi Svarṇaromā «aux cheveux d'or», fils de <a href="#entry-Umahaaromaa" class="skt-link">Mahāromā</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Uhrasvaromaa" class="skt-link">Hrasvaromā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-svar_na" class="skt-link">svarṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वर्</span> <i>svar_1</i> var. <i>svṛ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(svarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>svarita</i><i>)</i> bruire; émettre un son, résonner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sonner; chanter les louanges <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. σηριγξ; lat. <i>susurrus</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वर्</span> <i>svar_2</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-sur" class="skt-link">sur</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(svarati)</i> briller <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ηλιος.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svar_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वर्</span> <i>svar_3</i> var. <i>suvar</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-svar_2" class="skt-link">svar_2</a>] ind. ciel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>svarloka</i>] myth. np. de Svar ou <a href="#entry-Usvarga" class="skt-link">Svarga</a>, le Ciel ou Paradis d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, plus haut des 3 mondes célestes [<a href="#entry-lokatraya" class="skt-link">lokatraya</a>], habité par les dieux [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>], paradis des bienheureux; cf. <a href="#entry-vyaah_rti" class="skt-link">vyāhṛti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excl. Ciel! (prononcé entre <a href="#entry-om" class="skt-link">om</a> et la <a href="#entry-gaayatrii" class="skt-link">gāyatrī</a>).<br> <i>bhūr</i> <i>bhuvar</i> <i>svar</i> par la terre, les mondes et le ciel (exclamation rituelle [<a href="#entry-vyaah_rti" class="skt-link">vyāhṛti</a>]).<br> <i>svaḥ</i> <i>prayātaḥ</i> défunt (parti au ciel).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वर</span> <i>svara</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-svar_1" class="skt-link">svar_1</a>] <a href="#entry-svara" class="skt-link">m.</a> son, bruit; cri; accent, ton; note de musique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-Uabhinavagupta" class="skt-link">Abhinavagupta</a>] musique comme redécouverte du Soi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. phonème, voyelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaraaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarāj</i> [<a href="#entry-raaj_2" class="skt-link">rāj_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaraaj" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaraaj" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaraaj" class="skt-link">f.</a> autonome, indépendant — <a href="#entry-svaraaj" class="skt-link">m.</a> autonomie; indépendance; autodétermination <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. principe du soi; microcosme; opp. <a href="#entry-viraaj_2" class="skt-link">virāj_2</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. souveraineté propre d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-samraaj" class="skt-link">samrāj</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svarabhakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarabhakti</i> [<a href="#entry-bhakti" class="skt-link">bhakti</a>] <a href="#entry-svarabhakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phon. brisure vocalique, où une voyelle (en gén. ‘a’) est insérée dans un groupe consonantique (par ex. <i>variṣa</i> pour <i>varṣa</i>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaracitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svaracitra</i> [<a href="#entry-citra" class="skt-link">citra</a>] <a href="#entry-svaracitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. poésie savante [<a href="#entry-var_nacitra" class="skt-link">varṇacitra</a>] avec des contraintes sur les voyelles utilisées.<br> <i>uruguṃ</i> <i>dyuguruṃ</i> <i>yutsu</i> <i>cukruśustuṣṭuvuḥ</i> <i>puru</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>lulubhuḥ</i> <i>pupuṣurmutsu</i> <i>mumuhurnu</i> <i>muhurmuhuḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (‘u’ seule voyelle) Les dieux prirent refuge en <a href="#entry-Ub_rhaspati" class="skt-link">Bṛhaspati</a>, seigneur de la parole, chapelain des dieux aux cieux, lorsqu'ils partirent au combat; ils prièrent encore et encore qu'il demeure heureux et fort, et que son esprit ne s'égare pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svarasa_myoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarasaṃyoga</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_myoga" class="skt-link">saṃyoga</a>] <a href="#entry-svarasa_myoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> accord musical.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svarbhaanu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarbhānu</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaanu" class="skt-link">bhānu</a>] <a href="#entry-svarbhaanu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Svarbhānu, <a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> causant les éclipses de Soleil; plus tard assimilé à <a href="#entry-Uraahu" class="skt-link">Rāhu</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-svar_3" class="skt-link">svar_3</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
