    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वर्ग</span> <i>svarga</i> var. <i>suvarga</i> [<a href="#entry-svar_3" class="skt-link">svar_3</a>-<a href="#entry-ga_1" class="skt-link">ga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svarga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svargaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svargā</i> qui va au Ciel; céleste — <a href="#entry-svarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> [<i>svargaloka</i>] myth. np. de Svarga le Ciel-de-Lumière, paradis d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">vaikuṇṭha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] félicité céleste comme fruit légitime du sacrifice; accomplissement suprême du désir de bonheur de l'homme, bonheur à l'état pur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. <a href="#entry-Usvarga" class="skt-link">Svarga</a> de la section [<a href="#entry-kha_n_da" class="skt-link">khaṇḍa</a>] d'un <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a> traitant de mythes de création.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svargaaroha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svargārohaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-aaroha_na" class="skt-link">ārohaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-svargaaroha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. montée au Ciel; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] not. montée au Ciel de <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> avec son propre corps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svargaaroha_naparvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svargārohaṇaparvan</i> [<a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>] <a href="#entry-svargaaroha_naparvan" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. 18⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ livre du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>, «de l'ascension au Ciel».<br> <a href="#entry-svargaaroha_na" class="skt-link">svargārohaṇa</a> <br> <a href="#entry-svarga" class="skt-link">svarga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वरित</span> <i>svarita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-svar_1" class="skt-link">svar_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svaritā</i> qu'on fait résonner, grave (son) — <a href="#entry-svarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. accent grave (opp. <a href="#entry-udaatta" class="skt-link">udātta</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svarocis">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarocis</i> [<a href="#entry-rocis" class="skt-link">rocis</a>] <a href="#entry-svarocis" class="skt-link">n.</a> sa propre lumière — a. <a href="#entry-svarocis" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svarocis" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svarocis" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui éclaire par soi-même.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svarodaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarodaya</i> [<a href="#entry-udaya" class="skt-link">udaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svarodaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svarodaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svarodayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svarodayā</i> phon. suivi d'une voyelle — <a href="#entry-svarodaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svarodaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Svarodaya <a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>, qui traite d'arts divinatoires.<br> <a href="#entry-svara" class="skt-link">svara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] <a href="#entry-svaruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> nature propre, naturel, essence de ⟨g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. propriété essentielle d'un objet — ifc. qui a la forme de.<br> <i>svarūpeṇa</i> adv. en réalité, en soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaruupamantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarūpamantra</i> [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] <a href="#entry-svaruupamantra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaruupamantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. essence sonore d'une divinité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaruupapadaarthaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarūpapadārthaka</i> [<a href="#entry-padaarthaka" class="skt-link">padārthaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaruupapadaarthaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaruupapadaarthaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaruupapadaarthikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svarūpapadārthikā</i> gram. autonyme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaruupasthiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarūpasthiti</i> [<a href="#entry-sthiti" class="skt-link">sthiti</a>] <a href="#entry-svaruupasthiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> [«maintien de son essence»] sincérité, naturel, authenticité.<br> <a href="#entry-svaruupa" class="skt-link">svarūpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaruupavaacin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svarūpavācin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaacin" class="skt-link">vācin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaruupavaacin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaruupavaacin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaruupavaacinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svarūpavācinī</i> gram. se dit de mots en usage self-référentiel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svas_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वसृ</span> <i>svasṛ</i> <a href="#entry-svas_r" class="skt-link">f.</a> sœur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>soror</i>; ang. sister; fr. sœur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svasriiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svasrīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-svasriiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> neveu (fils d'une sœur); syn. <a href="#entry-bhaagineya" class="skt-link">bhāgineya</a> — <a href="#entry-svastriiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svastrīyā</i> nièce.<br> <a href="#entry-svas_r" class="skt-link">svasṛ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svastha</i> [<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svasthā</i> naturel, sain; en forme, à l'aise; satisfait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> indépendant; confiant; résolu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svasthataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svasthatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-svasthataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> aise, bien-être, confort, satisfaction.<br> <a href="#entry-svastha" class="skt-link">svastha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svasti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वस्ति</span> <i>svasti</i> [<a href="#entry-su_1" class="skt-link">su_1</a>-<a href="#entry-asti" class="skt-link">asti</a>] <a href="#entry-svasti" class="skt-link">f.</a> bien-être; bonne fortune, succès — ind. excl. vive ⟨dat.⟩! <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> adr. bonne chance! à votre santé! <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> salutations (formule de politesse pour commencer une lettre).<br> <i>svastirastu</i> adr. tous mes souhaits de succès.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svastika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svastika</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-svastika" class="skt-link">m.</a> barde (chargé de prononcer le <a href="#entry-svasti" class="skt-link">svasti</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. swastika ou croix gammée, signe mystique de bon augure, d'origine solaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svastikaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svastikāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-svastikaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] posture assise, avec la plante de chaque pied entre la cuisse et le mollet opposés.<br> <a href="#entry-svastika" class="skt-link">svastika</a> <br> <a href="#entry-svasti" class="skt-link">svasti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svasva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svasva</i> [red.] iic. son ... respectif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svasvaamibhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svasvāmibhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-svaamibhaava" class="skt-link">svāmibhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-svasvaamibhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] relation entre le Moi et l'Âme; cf. <a href="#entry-bimbabimbiibhaava" class="skt-link">bimbabimbībhāva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svatantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svatantra</i> [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svatantra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svatantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svatantraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svatantrā</i> [«qui n'est soumis qu'à sa propre règle»] libre, indépendant, autonome — <a href="#entry-svatantra" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. l'acteur indépendant; son rôle sémantique [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] est celui d'agent [<a href="#entry-kart_r" class="skt-link">kartṛ</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svatantrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svatantratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-svatantrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> liberté, indépendance, autonomie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svatantrika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svatantrika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-svatantrika" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de la doctrine bd. Svatantrika ou Svātantrika.<br> <a href="#entry-svatantra" class="skt-link">svatantra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaya_mvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃvara</i> [<a href="#entry-vara_2" class="skt-link">vara_2</a>] <a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. mode de mariage par choix de la jeune fille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svaya_mvaramantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃvaramantra</i> [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] <a href="#entry-svaya_mvaramantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. np. du Svayaṃvaramantra, en hommage à <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">svayaṃvara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वयम्</span> <i>svayam</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] ind. soi-même, lui-même, moi-même, en personne — adv. de soi-même, par soi-même; spontanément, volontairement.<br> <i>manuḥ</i> <i>svayam</i> <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> en personne.<br> <i>svayamevāgata</i> venu spontanément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayamaat_r_n_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayamātṛṇṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-aat_r_n_na" class="skt-link">ātṛṇṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svayamaat_r_n_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svayamaat_r_n_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svayamaat_r_n_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svayamātṛṇṇā</i> percé de trous naturels — <a href="#entry-svayamaat_r_n_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svayamātṛṇṇā</i> soc. brique «naturellement percée» de l'autel de l'<a href="#entry-agnicayana" class="skt-link">agnicayana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayambhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃbhu</i> var. <i>svayambhu</i> [<a href="#entry-bhu" class="skt-link">bhu</a>] <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Svayaṃbhu, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, le démiurge «Auto-engendré» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cf. <a href="#entry-svayambhuu" class="skt-link">svayaṃbhū</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayambhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃbhū</i> var. <i>svayambhū</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuu_2" class="skt-link">bhū_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> [«auto-engendré»] indépendant, autonome, spontané — <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Svayaṃbhu, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, le démiurge «Auto-engendré» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>, etc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayambhuulifga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃbhūliṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuulifga" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> primordial ou spontané; il y en a 12 en Inde, correspondant à des lieux de pélerinage; cf. <a href="#entry-jyotirlifga" class="skt-link">jyotirliṅga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] support de la <a href="#entry-Uku_n_dalinii" class="skt-link">Kuṇḍalinī</a> endormie dans le <a href="#entry-muulaadhaara" class="skt-link">mūlādhāra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-svayambhuu" class="skt-link">svayaṃbhū</a> <br> <a href="#entry-svayam" class="skt-link">svayam</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayambhuupuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃbhūpurāṇa</i> var. <i>svayambhūpurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuupuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Svayambhūpurāṇa.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayambhuva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃbhuva</i> var. <i>svayambhuva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuva" class="skt-link">bhuva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svayaṃbhuvā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-svayambhuu" class="skt-link">svayaṃbhū</a> — <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Svayambhuva, premier <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayambhuvasuutrasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃbhuvasūtrasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>-<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-svaya_mbhuvasuutrasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Svayaṃbhuvasūtrasaṃgraha «Recueil des aphorismes de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>», <a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a> shivaïte.<br> <a href="#entry-svayambhuva" class="skt-link">svayaṃbhuva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svayampaakin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svayaṃpākin</i> [<a href="#entry-paakin" class="skt-link">pākin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svaya_mpaakin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svaya_mpaakin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svaya_mpaakinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svayaṃpākinī</i> soc. qui prépare soi-même ses repas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sva_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वञ्ज्</span> <i>svañj</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(svajate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>svakta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pari</i><i>)</i> embrasser, encercler, presser dans ses bras — ca. <i>(svañjayati)</i> faire embrasser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svecchaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वेच्छा</span> <i>svecchā</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-icchaa" class="skt-link">icchā</a>] <a href="#entry-svecchaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir, libre volonté, bon plaisir.<br> <i>svecchayā</i> à son gré.<br> <i>svecchatas</i> de son propre gré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svecchaacaari_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svecchācāriṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-caari_nii" class="skt-link">cāriṇī</a>] <a href="#entry-svecchaacaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> femme de mœurs libres.<br> <a href="#entry-svecchaa" class="skt-link">svecchā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sveccham">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वेच्छम्</span> <i>sveccham</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>-<a href="#entry-icchaa" class="skt-link">icchā</a>] adv. à son gré, à sa fantaisie; de sa propre volonté, volontairement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वेद</span> <i>sveda</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-svid_2" class="skt-link">svid_2</a>] <a href="#entry-sveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> sueur, transpiration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svedaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svedaja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-svedaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«né de la sueur»] vermine.<br> <a href="#entry-sveda" class="skt-link">sveda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svedana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वेदन</span> <i>svedana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-svid_2" class="skt-link">svid_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-svedana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-svedana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-svedanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svedanā</i> qui transpire, qui a tendance à transpirer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui fait transpirer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. sudorifique — <a href="#entry-svedana" class="skt-link">n.</a> sudation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svid_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्विद्</span> <i>svid_1</i> part. cl. pensez vous? vraiment? peut-être? n'importe.<br> <i>āho</i> <i>svid</i> ou bien.<br> <i>kiṃ</i> <i>svid</i> quoi donc?<br> <i>kva</i> <i>svid</i> n'importe où.<br> <i>kaḥ</i> <i>svid</i> n'importe qui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svid_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्विद्</span> <i>svid_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(svedate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>svinna</i><i>)</i> suer, transpirer — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(svidyati)</i> être en sueur — ca. <i>(svedayati)</i> faire transpirer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>sudor</i>; ang. sweat; fr. sueur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-svii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वी</span> <i>svī</i> iiv. de <a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sviik_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svīkṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-k_r_1" class="skt-link">kṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(svīkaroti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>svīkṛta</i><i>)</i> s'approprier, revendiquer.<br> <i>sarve</i> <i>bhāgam</i> <i>svīkurvantu</i> (formule de politesse) Veuillez recevoir toutes mes bénédictions.<br> <a href="#entry-svii" class="skt-link">svī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sviikaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svīkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-sviikaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> appropriation, revendication <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> consentement, accord; promesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sviikara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svīkaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-sviikara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> revendication; acquisition, appropriation, prise <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mariage [«faire sienne (son épouse)»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sviikara_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svīkaraṇīya</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_niiya" class="skt-link">karaṇīya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sviikara_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sviikara_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sviikara_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svīkaraṇīyā</i> acceptable; auquel on peut agréer; que l'on peut s'approprier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sviikartavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>svīkartavya</i> [<a href="#entry-kartavya" class="skt-link">kartavya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sviikartavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sviikartavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sviikartavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svīkartavyā</i> que l'on doit accepter; à quoi l'on doit donner son accord.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sviiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्वीय</span> <i>svīya</i> [<a href="#entry-sva" class="skt-link">sva</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-sviiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-sviiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-sviiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>svīyā</i> sien, propre; caractéristique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्य</span> <i>sya</i> [m. <a href="#entry-tyad" class="skt-link">tyad</a>] pn. dém. <a href="#entry-sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. ce, le.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्या</span> <i>syā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-tyad" class="skt-link">tyad</a>] pn. dém. <a href="#entry-syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> véd. cette, la.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syaadvaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>syādvāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-syaadvaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [jn.] agnosticisme jaïne; il postule la relativité de la vérité selon le point de vue [<a href="#entry-nayavaada" class="skt-link">nayavāda</a>] en proposant une logique modale selon différents modes de prédication qui permet de rendre compte de la nature multiforme de la réalité [<a href="#entry-anekaantavaada" class="skt-link">anekāntavāda</a>] et peut accommoder différentes présuppositions ontologiques, not. les sept aspects de la réalité [<a href="#entry-saptabhafgii" class="skt-link">saptabhaṅgī</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syaadvaadama_njarii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>syādvādamañjarī</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_njarii" class="skt-link">mañjarī</a>] <a href="#entry-syaadvaadama_njarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> jn. np. de la Syādvādamañjarī «Bouquet d'agnosticisme», œuvre de <a href="#entry-Umalli_se_na" class="skt-link">Malliṣeṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-syaat" class="skt-link">syāt</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्याल</span> <i>syāla</i> var. <i>śyāla</i> <a href="#entry-syaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> beau-frère (frère de sa femme) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> favori du roi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gredin, canaille (injure) — <a href="#entry-syaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>syālī</i> var. <i>śyālī</i> belle-sœur (sœur de sa femme) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>sālā</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syaalajaayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>syālajāyā</i> var. <i>śyālajāyā</i> [<a href="#entry-jaayaa" class="skt-link">jāyā</a>] <a href="#entry-syaalajaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> femme d'un frère de sa femme.<br> <a href="#entry-syaala" class="skt-link">syāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syaat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यात्</span> <i>syāt</i> [opt. <a href="#entry-as_1" class="skt-link">as_1</a>] adv. peut-être, il se peut <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pourvu que, fasse que <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> advienne que.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यद</span> <i>syada</i> [<a href="#entry-syand" class="skt-link">syand</a>] <a href="#entry-syada" class="skt-link">m.</a> vitesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syamantaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यमन्तक</span> <i>syamantaka</i> <a href="#entry-syamantaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [VP.] np. du joyau [<a href="#entry-ma_ni" class="skt-link">maṇi</a>] Syamantaka, favorable aux justes et néfaste aux méchants; il donne de l'or à qui l'adore avec dévotion, et protège des maladies; <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a> le donna à <a href="#entry-Usatraajit" class="skt-link">Satrājit</a> qui le donna à son frère <a href="#entry-Uprasena" class="skt-link">Prasena</a>, qui fut tué par un lion, tué à son tour par <a href="#entry-Ujaambavaan" class="skt-link">Jāmbavān</a>; <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, soupçonné à tort de vol, combattit ce dernier pendant vingt-huit jours et obtint le joyau, qu'il porte à son poignet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. np. d'un acteur d'une vie antérieure du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>, modèle de piété filiale, à rapprocher de <a href="#entry-Uzrava_nakumaara" class="skt-link">Śravaṇakumāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syand">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यन्द्</span> <i>syand</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(syandate)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ni</i><i>)</i> courir, se précipiter; couler, ruisseler, jaillir — ca. <i>(syandayati)</i> couler, courir; faire couler, faire courir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यन्द</span> <i>syanda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-syand" class="skt-link">syand</a>] <a href="#entry-syanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de couler, ruissellement, suintement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syandana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यन्दन</span> <i>syandana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-syand" class="skt-link">syand</a>] a. <a href="#entry-syandana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-syandana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-syandanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>syandanī</i> véloce (char, vent) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui s'écoule (rivière); qui ruisselle, qui arrose — <a href="#entry-syandana" class="skt-link">m.</a> char (de guerre) — <a href="#entry-syandanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>syandanī</i> salive.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syona">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्योन</span> <i>syona</i> a. <a href="#entry-syona" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-syona" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-syonaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>syonā</i> agréable, confortable, moelleux (not. pour marcher ou s'asseoir) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tendre, doux — <a href="#entry-syona" class="skt-link">n.</a> couche moelleuse, siège confortable; situation agréable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bonheur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syonazii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>syonaśī</i> [<a href="#entry-zii_2" class="skt-link">śī_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-syonazii" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-syonazii" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-syonazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui repose confortablement.<br> <a href="#entry-syona" class="skt-link">syona</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syota">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्योत</span> <i>syota</i> [<a href="#entry-syuuta" class="skt-link">syūta</a>] <a href="#entry-syota" class="skt-link">m.</a> sac.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यू</span> <i>syū</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-siiv" class="skt-link">sīv</a>] <a href="#entry-syuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> fil; ficelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-syuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">स्यूत</span> <i>syūta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-siiv" class="skt-link">sīv</a>] a. <a href="#entry-syuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-syuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-syuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>syūtā</i> tissé; cousu; assemblé (vêtement) — <a href="#entry-syuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> sac de jute.
  </div>
</div>
